blocks.title: Tuần 1 · Mở khóa: bài đầu vào, ôn quét từ của khóa trước

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 1. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào (phần 1) – Ôn quét Larva U1–6

web.label: Ngày 1. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào – Chào bạn cũ, ôn Larva U1–3 (bản thân, một ngày, nghề nghiệp)

en.tu: Ôn (Larva U1–3): country, flag, language, always, sometimes, usually, shower, half, quarter, minute, engineer, pilot, future, grow, cry
en.cum: could swim / look for my flag / how often / how long / all right / be called / police officer
en.cau: Which country are you from? I'm from Viet Nam. / How often do you have a shower? I always have a shower in the evening. / [Ngữ pháp: trạng từ tần suất] I usually get up at half past six. / What do you want to be in the future? I want to be a pilot.
en.truyen: Back to Class — It is Monday morning. Nhan sees Anna at the school gate. 'Hello, Anna! I looked for you last week, but I couldn't find you.' 'I was at my grandma's house,' says Anna. 'I always help her in the garden. Now I'm back! Let's look for our new classroom.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "where are you from song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (Larva U1–3): 国家 guójiā, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 男 nán, 每 měi, 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 电脑 diànnǎo, 帮助 bāngzhù, 警察 jǐngchá, 哭 kū
zh.cum: 我自己 / 每天早上 / 七点半 / 一个小时 / 帮助妈妈 / 当警察
zh.cau: 你是哪个国家的人？(Nǐ shì nǎge guójiā de rén?) / 我是越南人。(Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.) / 你每天几点起床？(Nǐ měitiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?) / 我每天七点半起床。(Wǒ měitiān qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng.) / 我长大以后想当警察。(Wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jǐngchá.)
zh.truyen: 又见面了 — Nhan每天早上七点半起床，洗澡以后去学校。他在学校门口看见Anna。"Anna，你好！你去哪儿了？""我去奶奶家了，我每天帮助奶奶。""我们一起去教室吧！" (Yòu jiànmiàn le — Nhan měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn qǐchuáng, xǐzǎo yǐhòu qù xuéxiào. Tā zài xuéxiào ménkǒu kànjiàn Anna. "Anna, nǐ hǎo! Nǐ qù nǎr le?" "Wǒ qù nǎinai jiā le, wǒ měitiān bāngzhù nǎinai." "Wǒmen yīqǐ qù jiàoshì ba!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你是哪国人 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 2. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào – Ôn Larva U4–6 (quần áo, con vật, thể thao)

en.tu: Ôn (Larva U4–6): dream, straight, sweater, kangaroo, panda, slow, fast, heavy, than, ice, practise, skate, team, volleyball, win
en.cum: put on / take off / get dressed / ice skating / roller skates / comic book / dress up
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn -er than] A kangaroo is faster than a panda. / An elephant is heavier than a tiger. / It's cold. Put on your sweater, please. / Our team practises volleyball every Saturday.
en.truyen: The Volleyball Match — Leo puts on his sweater and goes to the sports centre. His team practises volleyball every Saturday. Today they play against Xiaomei's team. Leo is fast, but Xiaomei is faster! 'We didn't win, but it was great fun,' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "put on take off clothes song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (Larva U4–6): 衣服 yīfu, 裤子 kùzi, 裙子 qúnzi, 鞋 xié, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 外面 wàimiàn, 找 zhǎo, 最 zuì, 快 kuài, 慢 màn, 当然 dāngrán, 知道 zhīdào, 跑步 pǎobù, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 乒乓球 pīngpāngqiú
zh.cum: 一件衣服 / 一条裙子 / 一双鞋 / 打篮球 / 踢足球 / 去跑步
zh.cau: 你最喜欢什么颜色？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme yánsè?) / 我最喜欢红色。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuan hóngsè.) / 兔子很快，大象很慢。(Tùzi hěn kuài, dàxiàng hěn màn.) / 你喜欢打篮球吗？当然喜欢！(Nǐ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú ma? Dāngrán xǐhuan!)
zh.truyen: 下雨了 — 星期六，Leo穿上新衣服去打篮球。外面下雨了，他找不到雨伞。Xiaomei说："我的雨伞给你！"Leo说："谢谢你！你是我最好的朋友。" (Xià yǔ le — Xīngqīliù, Leo chuānshang xīn yīfu qù dǎ lánqiú. Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, tā zhǎo bu dào yǔsǎn. Xiaomei shuō: "Wǒ de yǔsǎn gěi nǐ!" Leo shuō: "Xièxie nǐ! Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou.")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "穿衣服 儿歌"

en.flash: country, flag, language, always, sometimes, usually, shower, half past, quarter past, engineer, pilot, sweater, kangaroo, panda, faster, heavier, team, volleyball
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): I always have a shower in the evening. / I usually get up at half past six. / I want to be a pilot. / A kangaroo is faster than a panda. / Put on your sweater. / Our team practises volleyball. 2) Nối câu hỏi với câu trả lời (4 cặp): Which country are you from? – I'm from Viet Nam. / How often do you play volleyball? – Sometimes. / What do you want to be? – An engineer. / How long is the lesson? – Thirty minutes. 3) Lật thẻ Hộp ôn: con đọc to, thẻ nào con chưa nhớ cô cho vào Hộp ôn: engineer / quarter / sweater / heavy / language.
en.truyen: My Summer — Nhan tells the class about his summer. 'I always got up at half past six. I sometimes went to the sports centre with my team, and we practised volleyball. My cousin wants to be a pilot in the future. I want to be an engineer. I could ride a bike too!' The class claps. 'Well done, Nhan!' says the teacher.
en.baihat: Hello Again – giai điệu Frère Jacques: Hello again, hello again! / How are you? How are you? / Back to class this morning, / back to class this morning. / Let's begin! Let's begin!

zh.flash: 国家 guójiā, 先生 xiānsheng, 小姐 xiǎojiě, 自己 zìjǐ, 每 měi, 半 bàn, 小时 xiǎoshí, 洗澡 xǐzǎo, 帮助 bāngzhù, 警察 jǐngchá, 衣服 yīfu, 裙子 qúnzi, 鞋 xié, 雨伞 yǔsǎn, 最 zuì, 当然 dāngrán, 跑步 pǎobù, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú
zh.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 我每天七点半起床。/ 我长大以后想当警察。/ 外面下雨了。/ 我最喜欢穿红裙子。/ 兔子很快。/ 他喜欢打篮球。2) Nhìn pinyin chọn chữ Hán (6 thẻ): guójiā → 国家 / bàn → 半 / xiǎoshí → 小时 / xié → 鞋 / zuì → 最 / bāngzhù → 帮助. 3) Sắp xếp từ thành câu (3 câu): 我 / 最 / 喜欢 / 跑步 → 我最喜欢跑步。/ 你 / 是 / 哪个 / 国家 / 的人 → 你是哪个国家的人？/ 我 / 每天 / 洗澡 → 我每天洗澡。
zh.truyen: 上课了 — 星期一，Xiaomei早上七点起床。她洗澡，穿上最喜欢的红裙子，然后去学校。在学校，她帮助老师拿书，也帮助同学找铅笔。老师说："Xiaomei，谢谢你！"Xiaomei说："不客气！" (Shàngkè le — Xīngqīyī, Xiaomei zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Tā xǐzǎo, chuānshang zuì xǐhuan de hóng qúnzi, ránhòu qù xuéxiào. Zài xuéxiào, tā bāngzhù lǎoshī ná shū, yě bāngzhù tóngxué zhǎo qiānbǐ. Lǎoshī shuō: "Xiaomei, xièxie nǐ!" Xiaomei shuō: "Bù kèqi!")
zh.baihat: 新的一天 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 新的一天，新的一天，上课了，上课了。老师早上你好，同学大家你好，一起学，一起玩。(Xīn de yī tiān, xīn de yī tiān, shàngkè le, shàngkè le. Lǎoshī zǎoshang nǐ hǎo, tóngxué dàjiā nǐ hǎo, yīqǐ xué, yīqǐ wán.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 2. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào (phần 2) – Ôn quét Larva U7–12, lập Hộp ôn · Giới thiệu thi nói Flyers và YCT口试（中级）

web.label: Ngày 3. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào – Ôn Larva U7–9 (đồ ăn, sức khỏe, trường học)

en.tu: Ôn (Larva U7–9): sandwich, sweet, biscuit, cookie, cough, temperature, toothache, sore, spring, summer, winter, gate, leave, office, turn, left, right
en.cum: excuse me / have got to / come on / turn left / turn right / have a temperature
en.cau: Excuse me, can I have a sandwich, please? / I've got a toothache. I have to see the dentist. / [Ngữ pháp: mệnh lệnh chỉ đường] Turn left at the school gate. The office is on the right. / We leave school at four o'clock.
en.truyen: A Visit for Leo — It's winter. Leo has a cough and a temperature. Mum says, 'You have to stay at home today.' In the afternoon, Anna comes with a bag of biscuits. 'Excuse me, is Leo here?' 'Come on in, Anna!' says Mum. Leo smiles. The biscuits are very sweet!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "turn left turn right song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (Larva U7–9): 面包 miànbāo, 饼干 bǐnggān, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 辣 là, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 肚子 dùzi, 疼 téng, 药 yào, 休息 xiūxi, 教室 jiàoshì, 迟到 chídào, 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 中间 zhōngjiān
zh.cum: 吃药 / 好好休息 / 肚子疼 / 往左走 / 往右走 / 上课迟到
zh.cau: 你哪儿不舒服？(Nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?) / 我肚子疼。(Wǒ dùzi téng.) / 你要吃药，好好休息。(Nǐ yào chī yào, hǎohāo xiūxi.) / 图书馆在两个教室中间。(Túshūguǎn zài liǎng gè jiàoshì zhōngjiān.) / 往左走，别迟到！(Wǎng zuǒ zǒu, bié chídào!)
zh.truyen: Leo感冒了 — Leo感冒了，还发烧。妈妈说："你要吃药，在家好好休息。"下午，Anna来了，她送给Leo一些饼干和巧克力。Leo说："谢谢你！我明天去上学！" (Leo gǎnmào le — Leo gǎnmào le, hái fāshāo. Māma shuō: "Nǐ yào chī yào, zài jiā hǎohāo xiūxi." Xiàwǔ, Anna lái le, tā sòng gěi Leo yīxiē bǐnggān hé qiǎokèlì. Leo shuō: "Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ míngtiān qù shàngxué!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我生病了 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 4. Mở khóa · Bài đầu vào – Ôn Larva U10–12 (mua sắm, kỳ nghỉ, lễ hội)

en.tu: Ôn (Larva U10–12): shopping, supermarket, cheap, expensive, money, let, shark, ticket, travel, hotel, suitcase, visit, holiday, festival, lucky, wish
en.cum: go shopping / how much / bus stop / get on / get off / swimming pool / city centre
en.cau: How much is this suitcase? It's very expensive. / Let's go shopping at the supermarket. / We get on the bus at the bus stop. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh cheap – cheaper] The red suitcase is cheaper than the blue one. / [Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu): con nghe câu hỏi, ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói] Where did you go last holiday? – I went to the beach. / What did you buy? – I bought a T-shirt. / What do you like doing at the weekend? – I like riding my bike.
en.truyen: Holiday Shopping — Anna and her mum go shopping in the city centre. They need a suitcase for their holiday. 'How much is this blue one?' 'It's very expensive!' says Mum. 'Look, this red one is cheaper.' They buy the red suitcase and two bus tickets. 'I wish we could go now!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how much is it song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (Larva U10–12): 超市 chāoshì, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 元 yuán, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 玩具 wánjù, 送 sòng, 让 ràng, 远 yuǎn, 近 jìn, 车站 chēzhàn, 参观 cānguān, 节日 jiérì
zh.cum: 去超市 / 多少钱 / 太贵了 / 很便宜 / 参观动物园 / 节日快乐
zh.cau: 这个玩具多少钱？(Zhège wánjù duōshao qián?) / 五十元。(Wǔshí yuán.) / 太贵了！(Tài guì le!) / 我们去超市买水果吧。(Wǒmen qù chāoshì mǎi shuǐguǒ ba.) / 车站很远吗？不远，很近。(Chēzhàn hěn yuǎn ma? Bù yuǎn, hěn jìn.) / 节日快乐！(Jiérì kuàilè!) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu): con nghe rồi nói lại, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] 我在商店买了一个新书包。(Wǒ zài shāngdiàn mǎile yī ge xīn shūbāo.) / 节日的时候，我们全家一起吃饭。(Jiérì de shíhou, wǒmen quánjiā yīqǐ chīfàn.) / 这个玩具太贵了，那个很便宜。(Zhège wánjù tài guì le, nàge hěn piányi.)
zh.truyen: 去超市 — 星期天，Anna和妈妈去超市。超市很近，她们走路去。Anna想买一个玩具。"多少钱？""五十元。""太贵了！"妈妈说："我们买水果吧，水果很便宜。" (Qù chāoshì — Xīngqītiān, Anna hé māma qù chāoshì. Chāoshì hěn jìn, tāmen zǒulù qù. Anna xiǎng mǎi yī gè wánjù. "Duōshao qián?" "Wǔshí yuán." "Tài guì le!" Māma shuō: "Wǒmen mǎi shuǐguǒ ba, shuǐguǒ hěn piányi.")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "多少钱 儿歌 买东西"

en.flash: sandwich, biscuit, sweet, cough, temperature, toothache, winter, gate, office, turn left, turn right, supermarket, cheap, expensive, ticket, suitcase, holiday, festival
en.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe và đánh dấu đường đi trên bản đồ trường (4 câu): Turn left at the gate. / The office is on the right. / Turn right at the library. / Our classroom is between the office and the library. 2) Đóng vai đi mua sắm theo thẻ giá (4 lượt): How much is this suitcase? – It's very expensive. / How much are the biscuits? – They're cheap. 3) Phiếu đầu vào phần nói: con nhìn tranh kể 3 câu về kỳ nghỉ (I went to … / I bought … / It was …); cô ghi từ con chưa nhớ vào Hộp ôn. 4) Giới thiệu bài thi Nói A2 Flyers (7–9 phút, 4 phần; cô làm giám khảo, làm mẫu mỗi phần 1 lượt): Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu): tìm điểm khác giữa 2 tranh – In my picture, there are two dogs, but in your picture there are three. / Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): hỏi – đáp trao đổi thông tin – What's his name? – Peter. / How old is he? – Ten. / Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): kể truyện theo 5 tranh – Last Sunday, Leo went to the park with his dad. They played football. Then it started to rain… / Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu): câu hỏi về bản thân (từng em với cô, 4 câu) – Where did you go last holiday? – I went to the beach. / What did you buy there? – I bought a T-shirt. / What do you like doing at the weekend? – I like riding my bike. / Tell me about your best friend. – Her name is … She likes …
en.truyen: Leo's Lucky Day — Leo has a cold, so he stays at home and takes his medicine. On Saturday he feels better. 'Let's go shopping!' says Dad. They get on the bus at the bus stop and get off in the city centre. At the supermarket, Leo finds a cheap kite. 'This is my lucky day!' he says.
en.baihat: The Shopping Song – giai điệu London Bridge: How much is it? Is it cheap? / Is it cheap? Is it cheap? / How much is it? Is it cheap? / No, it's expensive! // Let's go shopping, you and me, / you and me, you and me. / Let's go shopping, you and me, / at the supermarket!

zh.flash: 面包 miànbāo, 饼干 bǐnggān, 巧克力 qiǎokèlì, 甜 tián, 感冒 gǎnmào, 发烧 fāshāo, 疼 téng, 药 yào, 休息 xiūxi, 迟到 chídào, 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu, 超市 chāoshì, 贵 guì, 便宜 piányi, 元 yuán, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 节日 jiérì
zh.slide: 1) Bài đầu vào – Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 我肚子疼。/ 你要吃药。/ 往左走。/ 这个玩具太贵了。/ 水果很便宜。/ 节日快乐！2) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân (3 lượt): 你哪儿不舒服？– 我头疼。/ 你要吃药，好好休息。– 谢谢医生！3) Đóng vai mua hàng với thẻ giá (4 lượt): 这个面包多少钱？– 五元。/ 那个玩具多少钱？– 八十元，太贵了！Cô ghi chữ con chưa đọc được vào Hộp ôn. 2) Giới thiệu YCT口试（中级）(14 câu, ~9 phút thi + 10 phút chuẩn bị, đạt từ 60/100; cô làm mẫu mỗi phần 1 lượt): 第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu): cô đọc 1 lần, con nói lại – 我肚子疼，我要去看医生。/ 第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu): nhìn tranh cửa hàng, nói một đoạn – 这是一个商店。商店里有很多水果和面包。水果很便宜，玩具太贵了。妈妈买了五个苹果。/ 第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, câu hỏi in kèm pinyin): 你喜欢什么节日？为什么？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme jiérì? Wèishénme?) – 我喜欢春节，因为春节可以吃很多好吃的。
zh.truyen: 节日快乐 — 星期五是节日。Leo感冒好了，他和爸爸妈妈去超市。超市里有很多人。Leo想买巧克力，妈妈说："巧克力太甜了，我们买水果吧。"爸爸买了一个蛋糕，送给奶奶。奶奶很高兴："节日快乐！" (Jiérì kuàilè — Xīngqīwǔ shì jiérì. Leo gǎnmào hǎo le, tā hé bàba māma qù chāoshì. Chāoshì li yǒu hěn duō rén. Leo xiǎng mǎi qiǎokèlì, māma shuō: "Qiǎokèlì tài tián le, wǒmen mǎi shuǐguǒ ba." Bàba mǎile yī gè dàngāo, sòng gěi nǎinai. Nǎinai hěn gāoxìng: "Jiérì kuàilè!")
zh.baihat: 去超市 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 去超市，去超市，买东西，买东西。这个多少钱呀？那个多少钱呀？太贵了！太贵了！(Qù chāoshì, qù chāoshì, mǎi dōngxi, mǎi dōngxi. Zhège duōshao qián ya? Nàge duōshao qián ya? Tài guì le! Tài guì le!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 3. Unit 1 · Family – Gia đình (1/4): Người thân, vợ chồng, cháu

web.label: Ngày 5. Unit 1 · Chú, dì và vợ chồng

en.tu: Mới: husband, wife, married, niece, nephew | Ôn: uncle, aunt, cousin, parent, grandparent
en.cum: be married / Uncle Minh's wife / Aunt Lan's husband / her niece and nephew
en.cau: Who is he? He is Nhan's uncle. / Who is she? She is his wife. / [Ngữ pháp: sở hữu cách 's] Uncle Minh is married. His wife is Aunt Lan. / [Ngữ pháp: sở hữu cách 's] I am Aunt Lan's nephew. Bông is her niece.
en.truyen: Nhan's Family Photo — Nhan shows Anna a family photo. 'Who is he?' asks Anna. 'He is my uncle, Uncle Minh. He is my dad's brother. He is married, and that's his wife, Aunt Lan.' 'And who is the girl?' 'That's my sister, Bông. She is Aunt Lan's niece, and I am her nephew!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "family members song uncle aunt niece nephew"

zh.tu: Mới: 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē | Ôn: 爷爷 yéye, 奶奶 nǎinai, 爸爸 bàba, 妈妈 māma, 哥哥 gēge
zh.cum: Nhan的叔叔 / 我的阿姨 / 外公和外婆 / 我的表哥
zh.cau: 他是谁？(Tā shì shéi?) / [Ngữ pháp: sở hữu 的] 他是Nhan的叔叔。(Tā shì Nhan de shūshu.) / 她是谁？(Tā shì shéi?) / [Ngữ pháp: sở hữu 的] 她是Nhan的阿姨。(Tā shì Nhan de āyí.) / 这是我外公，那是我外婆。(Zhè shì wǒ wàigōng, nà shì wǒ wàipó.) / 我的表哥十二岁。(Wǒ de biǎogē shí'èr suì.)
zh.truyen: 一张照片 — Nhan给Xiaomei看一张照片。"他是谁？""他是我的叔叔，是爸爸的弟弟。""她是谁？""她是我的阿姨，是妈妈的妹妹。""这两个老人呢？""他们是我的外公和外婆。"照片里还有阿姨的儿子，他是我的表哥，他很高。 (Yī zhāng zhàopiàn — Nhan gěi Xiaomei kàn yī zhāng zhàopiàn. "Tā shì shéi?" "Tā shì wǒ de shūshu, shì bàba de dìdi." "Tā shì shéi?" "Tā shì wǒ de āyí, shì māma de mèimei." "Zhè liǎng gè lǎorén ne?" "Tāmen shì wǒ de wàigōng hé wàipó." Zhàopiàn li hái yǒu āyí de érzi, tā shì wǒ de biǎogē, tā hěn gāo.)

en.cau: What's your surname? My surname is Tran. / You look like your mum. / Who do you look like? I look like my dad. / [Ngữ pháp: work as + nghề nghiệp] My aunt works as a nurse. / I am Grandpa's grandchild. Bông is his granddaughter.
en.truyen: Who Do I Look Like? — Leo and his grandpa look at some old photos. 'Who is this boy?' asks Leo. 'That's me!' says Grandpa. 'You look like me, Leo. You are my grandchild, and we have the same surname.' Leo laughs. 'And this is Grandma. She worked as a nurse in a hospital.'

zh.tu: Mới: 儿子 érzi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 孩子 háizi, 孙子 sūnzi, 孙女 sūnnǚ, 亲戚 qīnqi | Ôn: 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē
zh.cum: 叔叔的儿子 / 叔叔的女儿 / 爷爷的孙子 / 奶奶的孙女 / 很多亲戚
zh.cau: 叔叔有一个儿子和一个女儿。(Shūshu yǒu yī gè érzi hé yī gè nǚ'ér.) / [Ngữ pháp: sở hữu 的] Nhan是爷爷的孙子。(Nhan shì yéye de sūnzi.) / Bông是奶奶的孙女。(Bông shì nǎinai de sūnnǚ.) / 阿姨的孩子三岁。(Āyí de háizi sān suì.) / 星期天，很多亲戚来我家吃饭。(Xīngqītiān, hěn duō qīnqi lái wǒ jiā chī fàn.)
zh.truyen: 亲戚来了 — 星期天，很多亲戚来爷爷奶奶家。叔叔带来了他的儿子和女儿。爷爷说："孩子们，你们好！"Nhan是爷爷的孙子，Bông是爷爷的孙女。大家一起吃饭，很快乐。 (Qīnqi lái le — Xīngqītiān, hěn duō qīnqi lái yéye nǎinai jiā. Shūshu dàiláile tā de érzi hé nǚ'ér. Yéye shuō: "Háizimen, nǐmen hǎo!" Nhan shì yéye de sūnzi, Bông shì yéye de sūnnǚ. Dàjiā yīqǐ chī fàn, hěn kuàilè.)

en.slide: 1) Nhìn cây gia đình chọn từ (5 câu): Uncle Minh is Aunt Lan's ___ (husband / wife). / Aunt Lan is Uncle Minh's ___ (wife / niece). / Nhan is Aunt Lan's ___ (nephew / niece). / Bông is Aunt Lan's ___ (niece / nephew). / Is Uncle Minh married? (Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.) 2) Hỏi đáp theo cặp với ảnh gia đình của con: Who is he? – He is my uncle. / Who is she? – She is his wife. / What's your surname? – My surname is ___. 3) Nối nửa câu (3 câu): My surname – is Tran. / You look like – your mum. / My aunt works as – a nurse.
en.truyen: Uncle Minh's Wedding Photo — Nhan's family looks at Uncle Minh's wedding photo. 'Uncle Minh and Aunt Lan got married five years ago,' says Mum. 'Aunt Lan works as a nurse.' Bông points at a little girl. 'Who is she?' 'That's you, Bông! You are their niece, and Nhan is their nephew.' 'Bông looks like Mum!' says Nhan. 'And you look like Dad!' says Bông.
en.baihat: My Family Tree – giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb: Uncle Minh has got a wife, / got a wife, got a wife. / Uncle Minh has got a wife, / and Aunt Lan is her name. // I'm their nephew, she's their niece, / she's their niece, she's their niece. / I'm their nephew, she's their niece, / and we look like Mum and Dad!

zh.flash: 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē, 儿子 érzi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 孩子 háizi, 孙子 sūnzi, 孙女 sūnnǚ, 亲戚 qīnqi, 爷爷 yéye, 奶奶 nǎinai
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm vào người trong cây gia đình (6 câu): 他是Nhan的叔叔。/ 她是Nhan的阿姨。/ 他是Nhan的外公。/ 她是Nhan的外婆。/ 他是Nhan的表哥。/ Bông是奶奶的孙女。2) Chọn từ điền chỗ trống (儿子 / 女儿 / 孙子 / 孙女), 4 câu: 叔叔有一个___和一个___。/ Nhan是爷爷的___。/ Bông是奶奶的___。3) Hỏi đáp theo cặp với ảnh: 他是谁？– 他是我的叔叔。/ 她是谁？– 她是我的外婆。/ 你家有很多亲戚吗？– 有，很多！
zh.truyen: 我的大家庭 — 我叫Nhan，这是我的大家庭。爸爸的爸爸妈妈是我的爷爷奶奶，妈妈的爸爸妈妈是我的外公外婆。叔叔是爸爸的弟弟，他有一个儿子和一个女儿。阿姨是妈妈的妹妹，她的儿子是我的表哥。我是爷爷的孙子，我妹妹Bông是爷爷的孙女。我们家有很多亲戚！ (Wǒ de dà jiātíng — Wǒ jiào Nhan, zhè shì wǒ de dà jiātíng. Bàba de bàba māma shì wǒ de yéye nǎinai, māma de bàba māma shì wǒ de wàigōng wàipó. Shūshu shì bàba de dìdi, tā yǒu yī gè érzi hé yī gè nǚ'ér. Āyí shì māma de mèimei, tā de érzi shì wǒ de biǎogē. Wǒ shì yéye de sūnzi, wǒ mèimei Bông shì yéye de sūnnǚ. Wǒmen jiā yǒu hěn duō qīnqi!)
zh.baihat: 我的家 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 爷爷奶奶，外公外婆，叔叔好，阿姨好。表哥表哥你好，孩子们都来了，一家人，一家人。(Yéye nǎinai, wàigōng wàipó, shūshu hǎo, āyí hǎo. Biǎogē biǎogē nǐ hǎo, háizimen dōu lái le, yī jiā rén, yī jiā rén.)

en.cum: of course / the best uncle ever / a king and a queen / work in a school
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi isn't he?] He is your grandfather, isn't he? – Yes, he is. / [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi isn't he?] Your uncle is a teacher, isn't he? – No, he isn't. He's a doctor. / [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi doesn't he?] Your uncle works in a school, doesn't he? – Of course! / Have you ever seen a real king and queen?
en.truyen: The Best Uncle Ever — Anna meets Nhan's uncle. 'He is your uncle, isn't he?' 'Yes, he is. He's Uncle Minh.' 'He works in a school, doesn't he?' 'Of course! He teaches English.' After lunch, Uncle Minh tells them a story about a king and a queen. 'He is the best uncle ever!' says Anna.

zh.cum: 当护士 / 是售票员 / 他们俩 / 好像很累 / 在医院工作
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu xác nhận 是不是？] 他是你的外公，是不是？– 是。(Tā shì nǐ de wàigōng, shì bu shì? – Shì.) / [Ngữ pháp: 是不是？] 你叔叔是老师，是不是？– 不是，他是售票员。(Nǐ shūshu shì lǎoshī, shì bu shì? – Bù shì, tā shì shòupiàoyuán.) / [Ngữ pháp: 是不是？] 你叔叔在学校工作，是不是？(Nǐ shūshu zài xuéxiào gōngzuò, shì bu shì?) / 我阿姨是护士，她在医院工作。(Wǒ āyí shì hùshi, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.) / 他们俩好像很累。(Tāmen liǎ hǎoxiàng hěn lèi.)
zh.truyen: 叔叔和阿姨的工作 — Xiaomei问Nhan："你叔叔是老师，是不是？""不是，他是售票员，他在车站工作。""你阿姨是医生，是不是？""不是，她是护士，她在医院工作。"晚上，叔叔和阿姨来Nhan家吃饭，他们俩好像很累。 (Shūshu hé āyí de gōngzuò — Xiaomei wèn Nhan: "Nǐ shūshu shì lǎoshī, shì bu shì?" "Bù shì, tā shì shòupiàoyuán, tā zài chēzhàn gōngzuò." "Nǐ āyí shì yīshēng, shì bu shì?" "Bù shì, tā shì hùshi, tā zài yīyuàn gōngzuò." Wǎnshang, shūshu hé āyí lái Nhan jiā chī fàn, tāmen liǎ hǎoxiàng hěn lèi.)

en.truyen: Grandpa Repairs Everything — Bông's school bag has got a big hole. 'Can you repair it, Grandpa?' 'Of course!' Grandpa repairs her bag, Leo's bike and Mum's old radio. 'Is there enough time for my kite too?' asks Nhan. Grandpa laughs and repairs the kite. 'He's the best grandpa ever, isn't he?' says Bông.

zh.tu: Mới: 别人 biérén, 另外 lìngwài, 够 gòu | Ôn: 护士 hùshi, 售票员 shòupiàoyuán, 俩 liǎ, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 孩子 háizi, 帮助 bāngzhù, 书包 shūbāo
zh.cum: 帮助别人 / 别人的书包 / 另外一个 / 够不够 / 够了
zh.cau: 我们要帮助别人。(Wǒmen yào bāngzhù biérén.) / 这是别人的书包，不是我的。(Zhè shì biérén de shūbāo, bù shì wǒ de.) / 蛋糕够不够？– 够了！(Dàngāo gòu bu gòu? – Gòu le!) / 我有一个哥哥，另外还有一个妹妹。(Wǒ yǒu yī gè gēge, lìngwài hái yǒu yī gè mèimei.) / [Ngữ pháp: 是不是？] 这是你的书包，是不是？(Zhè shì nǐ de shūbāo, shì bu shì?)
zh.truyen: 外婆的蛋糕 — 外婆做了一个大蛋糕。Nhan问："蛋糕够不够？"外婆说："够了！另外还有饼干。"Bông看见一个书包："这是你的书包，是不是？""不是，这是别人的。"外婆说："我们一起帮助别人，找一找吧！" (Wàipó de dàngāo — Wàipó zuòle yī gè dà dàngāo. Nhan wèn: "Dàngāo gòu bu gòu?" Wàipó shuō: "Gòu le! Lìngwài hái yǒu bǐnggān." Bông kànjiàn yī gè shūbāo: "Zhè shì nǐ de shūbāo, shì bu shì?" "Bù shì, zhè shì biérén de." Wàipó shuō: "Wǒmen yīqǐ bāngzhù biérén, zhǎo yi zhǎo ba!")

en.flash: of course, ever, king, queen, repair, hole, enough, nurse, teacher, doctor, husband, wife, surname
en.slide: 1) Chọn đuôi câu đúng (5 câu, chọn isn't he / isn't she / doesn't he): He is your grandfather, ___? / Your uncle works in a school, ___? / She is your aunt, ___? / Your uncle is a teacher, ___? / Your grandpa repairs bikes, ___? 2) Nghe và chọn câu trả lời theo tranh (4 câu): Yes, he is. / No, he isn't. / Yes, she is. / Of course! 3) Kéo thả từ vào câu (3 câu): Grandpa can repair the ___ (hole) in my bag. / Is there ___ (enough) cake? – Of course! / The king and the ___ (queen) live in a big house. 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): hỏi – đáp trao đổi thông tin, từng em với cô. Cô: 'Nhan's uncle and Anna's aunt both have jobs. I don't know about Anna's aunt, so ask me some questions.' Con hỏi theo thẻ gợi ý: What's her name? – Aunt Hoa. / What's her job? – She works as a nurse. / Where does she work? – In a big hospital. / Is she married? – Yes, she is. / What does she like doing? – Cooking. Rồi cô hỏi về Uncle Minh, con trả lời theo thẻ: What's his name? – Uncle Minh. / What's his job? – He's a teacher. / Where does he work? – In a school. / Has he got any children? – Yes, a son and a daughter. / What does he like doing? – Repairing bikes.
en.truyen: The King's Shoe — Uncle Minh tells a story. Once there was a king and a queen. One day the king found a big hole in his shoe. 'Who can repair it?' he shouted. A young man said, 'Of course I can!' He repaired the hole very quickly. 'You're the cleverest man ever!' said the queen. 'Is the shoe big enough now?' asked the young man. 'Yes, it is!' said the king, and he gave him a big cake.
en.baihat: Isn't He? – giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus: He is your uncle, isn't he? / isn't he? isn't he? / He is your uncle, isn't he? / Yes, he is! // Grandpa repairs the hole, doesn't he? / doesn't he? doesn't he? / Grandpa repairs the hole, doesn't he? / Of course he does!

zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chọn nghề theo tranh (5 câu): 我阿姨是护士。/ 我叔叔是售票员。/ 他是医生。/ 她是老师。/ 他们俩是学生。2) Trả lời 是 / 不是 theo tranh (4 câu): 他是你的外公，是不是？/ 你叔叔在学校工作，是不是？/ 你阿姨是护士，是不是？/ 这是别人的书包，是不是？3) Chọn từ điền chỗ trống (够 / 另外 / 别人 / 好像), 4 câu: 蛋糕___不___？/ 我们要帮助___。/ 外公___很累。/ 我有一个哥哥，___还有一个妹妹。 2) YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, 10 câu, từng em; cô đọc 1 lần, con nói lại 1 lần): 我阿姨是护士，她在医院工作。/ 我叔叔是售票员。/ 他们俩是阿姨的孩子。/ 外婆一边做饭，一边唱歌。/ 我好像我妈妈。/ 我们要帮助别人。/ 蛋糕够了，大家一起吃吧。/ 她的儿子是我的表哥。/ 我有一个哥哥，另外还有一个妹妹。/ 我们俩是好朋友。
zh.truyen: 售票员叔叔 — 叔叔是售票员，他每天在车站工作。一天，一个孩子丢了书包，他好像很着急。叔叔说："别哭，我帮助你。"他们俩一起找，找到了！孩子说："谢谢叔叔！"叔叔说："不客气。帮助别人，我很快乐。" (Shòupiàoyuán shūshu — Shūshu shì shòupiàoyuán, tā měitiān zài chēzhàn gōngzuò. Yī tiān, yī gè háizi diūle shūbāo, tā hǎoxiàng hěn zháojí. Shūshu shuō: "Bié kū, wǒ bāngzhù nǐ." Tāmen liǎ yīqǐ zhǎo, zhǎodào le! Háizi shuō: "Xièxie shūshu!" Shūshu shuō: "Bù kèqi. Bāngzhù biérén, wǒ hěn kuàilè.")
zh.baihat: 是不是 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 是不是呀，是不是呀，你叔叔，是老师？不是不是不是，他是售票员呀。是不是？是不是？(Shì bu shì ya, shì bu shì ya, nǐ shūshu, shì lǎoshī? Bù shì bù shì bù shì, tā shì shòupiàoyuán ya. Shì bu shì? Shì bu shì?)

zh.cum: 一边吃一边说 / 一边做饭一边唱歌 / 无论下不下雨 / 无论是谁
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 一边…一边…] 外婆一边做饭，一边唱歌。(Wàipó yībiān zuò fàn, yībiān chàng gē.) / [Ngữ pháp: 一边…一边…] 我们一边吃饭，一边说话。(Wǒmen yībiān chī fàn, yībiān shuōhuà.) / [Ngữ pháp: 无论…都…] 无论下不下雨，外公每天早上都去散步。(Wúlùn xià bu xià yǔ, wàigōng měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù sànbù.) / [Ngữ pháp: 无论…都…] 无论是谁，我们都要帮助别人。(Wúlùn shì shéi, wǒmen dōu yào bāngzhù biérén.)
zh.truyen: 星期天的午饭 — 星期天，亲戚们来外婆家吃午饭。外婆一边做饭，一边唱歌。孩子们一边玩，一边笑。外公说："无论多远，大家每个星期天都来。"Nhan说："我们的家真大！" (Xīngqītiān de wǔfàn — Xīngqītiān, qīnqimen lái wàipó jiā chī wǔfàn. Wàipó yībiān zuò fàn, yībiān chàng gē. Háizimen yībiān wán, yībiān xiào. Wàigōng shuō: "Wúlùn duō yuǎn, dàjiā měi gè xīngqītiān dōu lái." Nhan shuō: "Wǒmen de jiā zhēn dà!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "一边一边 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 10. Unit 1 · Ôn không tranh – Đoán người thân

en.tu: Ôn (không tranh): husband, wife, married, niece, nephew, grandchild, surname, look like, as, of course, ever, king, queen, repair, hole, enough, finish, such
en.cum: look like her mum / of course / work as a nurse / such a kind uncle / enough time
en.cau: He is my dad's brother. Who is he? – He's my uncle. / She is my uncle's daughter. Who is she? – She's my cousin. / He is my sister's son. Who is he? – He's my nephew. / [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi isn't she?] Your aunt is married, isn't she? – Yes, she is.
en.truyen: Guess Who! — Leo plays a game with his class. 'He's my mum's brother. He's married, and his wife works as a nurse. Who is he?' 'He's your uncle!' says Anna. 'She's my uncle's daughter. She looks like her mum. Who is she?' 'She's your cousin!' 'Of course!' says Leo. 'You're such good players!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "guess who family riddles for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (không tranh): 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē, 儿子 érzi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 孩子 háizi, 孙子 sūnzi, 孙女 sūnnǚ, 亲戚 qīnqi, 护士 hùshi, 售票员 shòupiàoyuán, 俩 liǎ, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 别人 biérén, 另外 lìngwài, 够 gòu, 无论 wúlùn, 一边…一边… yībiān…yībiān…
zh.cum: 爸爸的弟弟 / 妈妈的妹妹 / 妈妈的爸爸 / 阿姨的儿子
zh.cau: 爸爸的弟弟是谁？– 是我的叔叔。(Bàba de dìdi shì shéi? – Shì wǒ de shūshu.) / 妈妈的妹妹是谁？– 是我的阿姨。(Māma de mèimei shì shéi? – Shì wǒ de āyí.) / 妈妈的爸爸是谁？– 是我的外公。(Māma de bàba shì shéi? – Shì wǒ de wàigōng.) / 阿姨的儿子比我大，他是我的表哥。(Āyí de érzi bǐ wǒ dà, tā shì wǒ de biǎogē.) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu): con nghe rồi nói lại, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] 我叔叔是售票员，我阿姨是护士。(Wǒ shūshu shì shòupiàoyuán, wǒ āyí shì hùshi.) / 外婆一边做饭，一边唱歌。(Wàipó yībiān zuòfàn, yībiān chànggē.) / 她的女儿好像她。(Tā de nǚ'ér hǎoxiàng tā.)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — Xiaomei说："我们来猜一猜！他是妈妈的爸爸，他每天早上去散步。他是谁？"Leo说："他是你的外公！""她是妈妈的妹妹，她是护士。她是谁？""她是你的阿姨！"Xiaomei说："对了！你们俩真棒！" (Cāi yi cāi — Xiaomei shuō: "Wǒmen lái cāi yi cāi! Tā shì māma de bàba, tā měitiān zǎoshang qù sànbù. Tā shì shéi?" Leo shuō: "Tā shì nǐ de wàigōng!" "Tā shì māma de mèimei, tā shì hùshi. Tā shì shéi?" "Tā shì nǐ de āyí!" Xiaomei shuō: "Duì le! Nǐmen liǎ zhēn bàng!")

en.flash: finish, such, husband, wife, married, niece, nephew, grandchild, surname, look like, of course, ever, repair, hole, enough
en.slide: 1) Nghe định nghĩa – chọn từ, không có tranh (5 câu): my dad's brother → uncle / my uncle's wife → aunt / my sister's son → nephew / my brother's daughter → niece / our family name → surname. 2) Hoàn thành câu với such a (3 câu): It's ___ big family! / She is ___ kind aunt! / He is ___ clever grandpa! 3) Đóng vai hỏi – xác nhận theo cặp (4 lượt): He's your uncle, isn't he? – Yes, he is. / She works as a nurse, doesn't she? – Of course! / Your cousin looks like his dad, doesn't he? – No, he doesn't.
en.truyen: Aunt Lan's Busy Day — Aunt Lan works as a nurse. Every morning she finishes her breakfast at seven o'clock and goes to the hospital. There she helps lots of people. In the evening she repairs the hole in her son's trousers. 'You're such a busy mum!' says her husband, Uncle Minh. 'Is there enough time for a story?' asks her son. 'Of course!' she says.
en.baihat: Such a Big Family – giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat: Uncle, aunt and cousins too, / come to lunch today. / Finish up and then we'll play, / such a lovely day! // Niece and nephew, grandchild too, / laugh and sing and play. / We have got such a big family, / hip, hip, hip, hooray!

zh.flash: 无论 wúlùn, 一边…一边… yībiān…yībiān…, 别人 biérén, 另外 lìngwài, 够 gòu, 护士 hùshi, 售票员 shòupiàoyuán, 俩 liǎ, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē
zh.slide: 1) Nối nửa câu 一边…一边… (4 câu): 外婆一边做饭，– 一边唱歌。/ 我们一边吃饭，– 一边说话。/ 孩子们一边玩，– 一边笑。/ 爸爸一边洗澡，– 一边唱歌。2) Nghe – không tranh, chọn người thân (5 câu): 妈妈的爸爸 → 外公 / 妈妈的妈妈 → 外婆 / 爸爸的弟弟 → 叔叔 / 妈妈的妹妹 → 阿姨 / 阿姨的儿子，比我大 → 表哥. 3) Nói theo khung 无论…都… (3 lượt): 无论下不下雨，外公每天都去散步。→ 无论下不下雨，我每天都___。
zh.truyen: 外公每天去散步 — 外公七十岁了。无论下不下雨，他每天早上都去散步。他一边走，一边唱歌。回家以后，他一边吃早饭，一边给孩子们讲故事。外婆说："你外公好像一点都不累！" (Wàigōng měitiān qù sànbù — Wàigōng qīshí suì le. Wúlùn xià bu xià yǔ, tā měitiān zǎoshang dōu qù sànbù. Tā yībiān zǒu, yībiān chàng gē. Huí jiā yǐhòu, tā yībiān chī zǎofàn, yībiān gěi háizimen jiǎng gùshi. Wàipó shuō: "Nǐ wàigōng hǎoxiàng yīdiǎn dōu bù lèi!")
zh.baihat: 一边一边 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 一边唱歌，一边跳舞，真快乐，真快乐。外婆一边做饭，外公一边看书，一家人，一家人。(Yībiān chàng gē, yībiān tiàowǔ, zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè. Wàipó yībiān zuò fàn, wàigōng yībiān kàn shū, yī jiā rén, yī jiā rén.)

He is married. His wife works as a nurse. I look like my mum. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 1 – nghe chọn tranh (5 câu): He is Nhan's uncle. / She is his wife. / Grandpa repairs the hole. / There is enough cake. / She is such a kind aunt. 4) Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu): tìm điểm khác giữa 2 tranh 'The Family Photo' (cô giữ tranh A, con xem tranh B). Cô: 'Here are two pictures. My picture is nearly the same as yours, but some things are different. For example, in my picture Grandpa is wearing glasses, but in your picture he isn't.' Cô nói, con nêu điểm khác (5 câu): In my picture, Grandma is sitting. – In my picture, she's standing. / In my picture, there are two children in front. – In my picture, there are three. / In my picture, Uncle Minh has got a hat. – In my picture, he hasn't got a hat. / In my picture, Aunt Lan is holding a cake. – In my picture, she's holding some flowers. / In my picture, Bông's dress has got a hole. – In my picture, it hasn't.
en.truyen: The Family Photo Day (bản đầy đủ) — Nhan's family meets at Grandpa's house. Grandpa and Grandma sit in the middle. Uncle Minh and his wife, Aunt Lan, stand behind them. Bông looks at her dress. 'Oh no, there's a hole!' 'Don't worry,' says Grandma. 'I can repair it.' 'Is everyone here?' asks Grandpa. 'Not yet! Aunt Hoa and her son are late.' At last they come. 'Smile, everyone!' Click! 'Nhan looks like his grandpa, doesn't he?' says Aunt Hoa. 'Of course! We're the best family ever!'
en.baihat: My Family Tree + Isn't He? (hát nối hai bài của unit) – giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb rồi The Wheels on the Bus: Uncle Minh has got a wife, / got a wife, got a wife … // He is your uncle, isn't he? / isn't he? isn't he? / He is your uncle, isn't he? / Yes, he is!

zh.baihat: 我的家 + 是不是 (hát nối hai bài của unit) – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 爷爷奶奶，外公外婆，叔叔好，阿姨好 … // 是不是呀，是不是呀，你叔叔，是老师？不是不是不是，他是售票员呀。是不是？是不是？(Yéye nǎinai, wàigōng wàipó, shūshu hǎo, āyí hǎo … // Shì bu shì ya, shì bu shì ya, nǐ shūshu, shì lǎoshī? Bù shì bù shì bù shì, tā shì shòupiàoyuán ya. Shì bu shì? Shì bu shì?)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 7. Unit 2 · School – Trường học (1/4): Đồ dùng học tập, cấp học, câu lệnh và Let's…

web.label: Ngày 13. Unit 2 · Sẵn sàng đến trường – đồ dùng và câu lệnh

en.tu: Mới: timetable, uniform, textbook, workbook, dictionary | Ôn: book, page, pencil, lesson, open, school
en.cum: check your timetable / put on your school uniform / open your textbook / a new workbook / use a dictionary
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu mệnh lệnh] Open your textbooks, please. / [Ngữ pháp: câu mệnh lệnh] Use your dictionary. / Check your timetable. / Put on your school uniform. / [Ngữ pháp: mệnh lệnh phủ định Don't …] Don't forget your workbook.
en.truyen: Ready for School — It's Monday morning. Leo puts on his school uniform. 'Check your timetable, Leo,' says Mum. 'You've got English and Maths today.' Leo puts his textbook and his dictionary in his bag. 'Don't forget your workbook!' says Mum. 'Thanks, Mum! Goodbye!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "classroom instructions song for kids open your book"

zh.tu: Mới: 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 校服 xiàofú, 练习册 liànxícè, 练习 liànxí | Ôn: 书包 shūbāo, 铅笔 qiānbǐ, 本 běn, 课 kè, 读 dú, 写 xiě
zh.cum: 打开课本 / 用词典 / 看看时间表 / 穿上校服 / 做练习
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 请 + động từ] 请打开你们的课本。(Qǐng dǎkāi nǐmen de kèběn.) / [Ngữ pháp: 请 + động từ] 请用你的词典。(Qǐng yòng nǐ de cídiǎn.) / 看看你的课程表。(Kànkan nǐ de kèchéngbiǎo.) / 穿上你的校服。(Chuānshang nǐ de xiàofú.) / [Ngữ pháp: 别 + động từ] 别忘了你的练习册。(Bié wàngle nǐ de liànxícè.) / 这是我们班的时间表。(Zhè shì wǒmen bān de shíjiānbiǎo.)
zh.truyen: 上学去 — 星期一早上，Xiaomei穿上校服。妈妈说："看看你的时间表，今天有什么课？""有汉语课和英语课。"Xiaomei把课本和词典放进书包。妈妈说："别忘了你的练习册！今天要做练习。" (Shàngxué qù — Xīngqīyī zǎoshang, Xiaomei chuānshang xiàofú. Māma shuō: "Kànkan nǐ de shíjiānbiǎo, jīntiān yǒu shénme kè?" "Yǒu Hànyǔ kè hé Yīngyǔ kè." Xiaomei bǎ kèběn hé cídiǎn fàngjìn shūbāo. Māma shuō: "Bié wàngle nǐ de liànxícè! Jīntiān yào zuò liànxí.")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "上学歌 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 14. Unit 2 · Các cấp học – cùng nhau đi chơi

en.tu: Mới: primary, junior, senior, high, gym, together | Ôn: textbook, workbook, uniform, timetable, dictionary, classmate, playground
en.cum: primary school / junior high school / senior high school / go to the gym / together with my friends
en.cau: I go to a primary school. / My cousin goes to a junior high school. / My brother is at senior high school. / [Ngữ pháp: câu đề nghị Let's …] Let's go to the playground together. / [Ngữ pháp: câu đề nghị Let's …] Let's play basketball in the gym.
en.truyen: Anna's Cousins — Anna goes to a primary school. Her cousin Sam goes to a junior high school, and her cousin Tom is at senior high school. On Saturday they go to the gym together. 'Let's play basketball!' says Sam. 'Your schools are very big!' says Anna. 'Primary school is fun too,' says Tom.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "let's go to school song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 小学 xiǎoxué, 初中 chūzhōng, 高中 gāozhōng, 毕业 bìyè, 介绍 jièshào | Ôn: 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 校服 xiàofú, 练习册 liànxícè, 年级 niánjí, 学生 xuésheng, 同学 tóngxué
zh.cum: 上小学 / 上初中 / 上高中 / 小学毕业 / 介绍一下
zh.cau: 我上小学三年级。(Wǒ shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí.) / 我表哥上初中。(Wǒ biǎogē shàng chūzhōng.) / 我哥哥上高中，明年毕业。(Wǒ gēge shàng gāozhōng, míngnián bìyè.) / [Ngữ pháp: 我们一起 + động từ + 吧] 我们一起去操场吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng ba.) / 我来介绍一下，这是我的同学Anna。(Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, zhè shì wǒ de tóngxué Anna.)
zh.truyen: 我的学校 — Nhan上小学三年级。他的表哥上初中，阿姨的女儿上高中，今年毕业。星期六，Nhan给表哥介绍他的同学："这是Leo，这是Anna。"表哥说："你们好！我们一起去操场打篮球吧！" (Wǒ de xuéxiào — Nhan shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí. Tā de biǎogē shàng chūzhōng, āyí de nǚ'ér shàng gāozhōng, jīnnián bìyè. Xīngqīliù, Nhan gěi biǎogē jièshào tā de tóngxué: "Zhè shì Leo, zhè shì Anna." Biǎogē shuō: "Nǐmen hǎo! Wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng dǎ lánqiú ba!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我们一起去 儿歌 学校"

en.flash: timetable, uniform, textbook, workbook, dictionary, primary, junior, senior, high, gym, together, playground, classmate
en.slide: 1) Nghe mệnh lệnh – làm động tác kiểu Simon says (6 câu): Open your textbooks. / Close your workbook. / Use your dictionary. / Check your timetable. / Put on your uniform. / Don't forget your workbook. 2) Chọn trường đúng cho 3 nhân vật theo tuổi (primary school / junior high school / senior high school): Anna is 8. / Sam is 13. / Tom is 16. 3) Nối Let's … với tranh (3 câu): Let's go to the gym together. / Let's read books in the library. / Let's play in the playground.
en.truyen: The First Day — It's the first day at school. 'Good morning, class!' says the teacher. 'Open your textbooks, please. Now check your timetable: we've got PE in the gym today.' Oh no! Leo can't find his workbook. 'Don't worry,' says Anna. 'You can use my workbook today.' After the lesson, the teacher says, 'Put on your trainers. Let's go to the gym together!'
en.baihat: Get Ready for School – giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush: This is the way we put on our uniform, / put on our uniform, put on our uniform. / This is the way we put on our uniform, / early in the morning. // This is the way we check our timetable … / This is the way we open our textbooks, / open our textbooks, open our textbooks. / This is the way we open our textbooks, / then we go to the gym together!

zh.flash: 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 校服 xiàofú, 练习册 liànxícè, 练习 liànxí, 课本 kèběn, 小学 xiǎoxué, 初中 chūzhōng, 高中 gāozhōng, 毕业 bìyè, 介绍 jièshào, 操场 cāochǎng
zh.slide: 1) Nghe mệnh lệnh – làm theo (6 câu): 请打开你们的课本。/ 请用你的词典。/ 看看你的时间表。/ 穿上你的校服。/ 别忘了你的练习册。/ 我们一起去操场吧。2) Kéo thẻ sắp xếp các cấp học theo thứ tự: 高中 / 小学 / 初中 → 小学 → 初中 → 高中; rồi nghe chọn: 我上小学。/ 表哥上初中。/ 哥哥高中毕业了。3) Giới thiệu bạn theo khung: 我来介绍一下，这是___，他/她上小学___年级。
zh.truyen: 新同学 — 一个新同学来我们班了。老师说："我来介绍一下，她叫Xiaomei。"Xiaomei没有校服，也没有时间表。Anna说："别着急，我的时间表给你看。"Nhan说："你可以用我的词典。"下课了，大家说："我们一起去操场吧！" (Xīn tóngxué — Yī gè xīn tóngxué lái wǒmen bān le. Lǎoshī shuō: "Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, tā jiào Xiaomei." Xiaomei méiyǒu xiàofú, yě méiyǒu shíjiānbiǎo. Anna shuō: "Bié zháojí, wǒ de shíjiānbiǎo gěi nǐ kàn." Nhan shuō: "Nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de cídiǎn." Xiàkè le, dàjiā shuō: "Wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng ba!")
zh.baihat: 上学歌 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 穿上校服，穿上校服，去上学，去上学。带上课本词典，别忘了练习册，真棒啊，真棒啊。(Chuānshang xiàofú, chuānshang xiàofú, qù shàngxué, qù shàngxué. Dàishang kèběn cídiǎn, bié wàngle liànxícè, zhēn bàng a, zhēn bàng a.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 8. Unit 2 · School – Trường học (2/4): Câu lạc bộ, cuộc thi, ôn tập và thi cử · Luyện YCT口试（中级）第三部分

web.label: Ngày 15. Unit 2 · Câu lạc bộ – làm việc nhóm

en.tu: Mới: club, join a club, member, group, share | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): as, ever, enough, finish, of course, look like, surname | Ôn: gym, together
en.cum: join a club / join the English club / a member of the club / work in groups / share a dictionary
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu đề nghị Let's …] Let's join the English club together! / I am a member of the football club. / Work in groups of four, please. / [Ngữ pháp: câu mệnh lệnh] Share your dictionary with your friend. / Is there enough time to finish? – Of course!
en.truyen: The English Club — Nhan wants to join a club. 'Have you ever been to the English club?' asks Anna. 'No. Is it fun?' 'Of course! I'm a member. We work in groups and share books.' 'Is there enough space for me?' 'Yes! Let's go together!' Nhan writes his name and his surname on the list. Now he is a member too.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "school clubs vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 句子 jùzi, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): 别人 biérén, 够 gòu, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 俩 liǎ, 一边…一边… yībiān…yībiān… | Ôn: 小学 xiǎoxué, 介绍 jièshào
zh.cum: 参加运动会 / 努力学习 / 一个句子 / 明白了 / 听清楚 / 说清楚
zh.cau: 我想参加学校的运动会。(Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā xuéxiào de yùndònghuì.) / 我们要努力学习。(Wǒmen yào nǔlì xuéxí.) / 你明白这个句子吗？– 明白了。(Nǐ míngbai zhège jùzi ma? – Míngbai le.) / 老师，我没听清楚，请再说一次。(Lǎoshī, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu, qǐng zài shuō yī cì.) / [Ngữ pháp: 一边…一边… (ôn)] 他们俩一边读句子，一边写。(Tāmen liǎ yībiān dú jùzi, yībiān xiě.)
zh.truyen: 我没听清楚 — 汉语课上，老师读了一个句子。Leo说："老师，我没听清楚，请再说一次。"老师又读了一次。"现在明白了吗？""明白了！"下课以后，Leo和Nhan一边走，一边练习。老师说："你们俩真努力！" (Wǒ méi tīng qīngchu — Hànyǔ kè shang, lǎoshī dúle yī gè jùzi. Leo shuō: "Lǎoshī, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu, qǐng zài shuō yī cì." Lǎoshī yòu dúle yī cì. "Xiànzài míngbai le ma?" "Míngbai le!" Xiàkè yǐhòu, Leo hé Nhan yībiān zǒu, yībiān liànxí. Lǎoshī shuō: "Nǐmen liǎ zhēn nǔlì!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "课堂用语 汉语 儿童 我明白了"

web.label: Ngày 16. Unit 2 · Cuộc thi đánh vần – giải thưởng

en.tu: Mới: competition, prize, winner, letter (mail), ring | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): king, queen, husband, wife, repair, hole, such | Ôn: club, member, group, share
en.cum: a spelling competition / win a prize / the winner of the competition / write a letter / the bell rings
en.cau: The bell rings at eight o'clock. / There is a spelling competition on Friday. / [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi (ôn Unit 1)] Anna is the winner, isn't she? – Yes, she is! / The winner gets a prize. / I wrote a letter to my uncle. / It was such a good competition!
en.truyen: The Spelling Competition — The bell rings. It's the spelling competition! Anna and Leo are in the same group. The teacher says, 'Spell "queen", please.' 'Q-U-E-E-N!' says Anna. Anna is the winner! Her prize is a new dictionary. That evening, she writes a letter to her grandma: 'I won a prize!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "spelling bee for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì | Ôn (từ nối Unit 1): 孩子 háizi, 另外 lìngwài, 无论 wúlùn, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 儿子 érzi | Ôn: 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 明白 míngbai
zh.cum: 汉语考试 / 复习课本 / 好成绩 / 一起复习
zh.cau: 下个星期有汉语考试。(Xià gè xīngqī yǒu Hànyǔ kǎoshì.) / [Ngữ pháp: 我们一起…吧] 我们一起复习吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ fùxí ba.) / Anna的成绩很好。(Anna de chéngjì hěn hǎo.) / [Ngữ pháp: 无论…都… (ôn)] 无论多累，她每天都复习。(Wúlùn duō lèi, tā měitiān dōu fùxí.) / 另外，别忘了复习句子。(Lìngwài, bié wàngle fùxí jùzi.)
zh.truyen: 考试以前 — 下个星期有汉语考试。Anna和Xiaomei一起复习。无论多累，她们每天都复习课本和练习册。考试那天，她们都很努力。一个星期以后，老师说："Anna和Xiaomei的成绩都很好！"妈妈说："我的女儿真棒！" (Kǎoshì yǐqián — Xià gè xīngqī yǒu Hànyǔ kǎoshì. Anna hé Xiaomei yīqǐ fùxí. Wúlùn duō lèi, tāmen měitiān dōu fùxí kèběn hé liànxícè. Kǎoshì nà tiān, tāmen dōu hěn nǔlì. Yī gè xīngqī yǐhòu, lǎoshī shuō: "Anna hé Xiaomei de chéngjì dōu hěn hǎo!" Māma shuō: "Wǒ de nǚ'ér zhēn bàng!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "复习 考试 儿童 汉语"

en.flash: club, join a club, member, group, share, competition, prize, winner, letter, ring, as, ever, enough, of course, such
en.slide: 1) Nghe 4 bạn nói – kéo tên bạn vào đúng câu lạc bộ: I want to join the art club. / I'm a member of the football club. / I joined the English club last week. / We work in groups in the computer club. 2) Điền từ (competition / prize / winner / rings), 4 câu: The bell ___ at eight. / Who is the ___? / The winner gets a ___. / There's a spelling ___ on Friday. 3) Làm việc nhóm – viết lá thư 3 câu cho người thân: Dear Uncle Minh, I joined the English club. I won a prize! Love, ___.
en.truyen: Leo's Letter — Leo writes a letter to his uncle. 'Dear Uncle Tom, I joined the art club last week. Now I'm a member! We work in groups and share paints. On Friday there was a painting competition. The bell rang and we started. I wasn't the winner, but I got a small prize for my picture of a king and a queen. Love, Leo.'
en.baihat: Join the Club – giai điệu London Bridge: Come and join the English club, / English club, English club. / Come and join the English club, / be a member! // Work in groups and share our books, / share our books, share our books. / Work in groups and share our books, / we're all winners!

zh.flash: 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 句子 jùzi, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì, 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 小学 xiǎoxué, 初中 chūzhōng, 介绍 jièshào, 别人 biérén, 够 gòu
zh.slide: 1) Câu dùng trong lớp – nghe chọn tình huống trong tranh (4 câu): 老师，我没听清楚。/ 明白了！/ 请再说一次。/ 你明白这个句子吗？2) Đọc thời gian biểu trong tranh, chọn đúng / sai (4 câu): 星期五有汉语考试。/ 星期四我们复习。/ Anna的成绩很好。/ 考试以前要努力复习。3) Đóng vai theo cặp (3 lượt): 我们一起复习吧！– 好啊！/ 你参加运动会吗？– 参加！/ 你明白了吗？– 明白了。 2) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, từng em, câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 你最喜欢上什么课？为什么？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shàng shénme kè? Wèishénme?) – Đoạn mẫu: 我最喜欢上汉语课，因为汉语很有意思。老师说得很清楚。我每天努力练习句子。/ 考试以前你怎么复习？(Kǎoshì yǐqián nǐ zěnme fùxí?) – Đoạn mẫu: 考试以前，我和朋友一起复习。我们练习句子，不明白的就问老师。
zh.truyen: 运动会 — 星期五，学校有运动会。Nhan和Leo都参加跑步。Nhan很努力，跑得很快。老师说："Nhan第一，Leo第二！"Leo说："我不是第一，可是我很快乐。"Nhan说："下次我们一起练习吧！" (Yùndònghuì — Xīngqīwǔ, xuéxiào yǒu yùndònghuì. Nhan hé Leo dōu cānjiā pǎobù. Nhan hěn nǔlì, pǎo de hěn kuài. Lǎoshī shuō: "Nhan dì yī, Leo dì èr!" Leo shuō: "Wǒ bù shì dì yī, kěshì wǒ hěn kuàilè." Nhan shuō: "Xià cì wǒmen yīqǐ liànxí ba!")
zh.baihat: 复习歌 – giai điệu 小星星 (Twinkle Twinkle Little Star): 考试以前要复习，读读句子写一写。老师说的要听清，不明白就问一问。每天努力来练习，成绩一定会很好。(Kǎoshì yǐqián yào fùxí, dúdu jùzi xiě yi xiě. Lǎoshī shuō de yào tīngqīng, bù míngbai jiù wèn yi wèn. Měitiān nǔlì lái liànxí, chéngjì yīdìng huì hěn hǎo.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 9. Unit 2 · School – Trường học (3/4): Phòng máy tính, kỳ nghỉ, ôn không tranh

web.label: Ngày 17. Unit 2 · Phòng máy tính – nghe giảng, nhắc lại

en.tu: Mới: file, screen, explain, repeat, suddenly | Ôn: laptop, club, member, competition, prize, winner, letter, ring, dictionary, timetable
en.cum: open a file / close the file / look at the screen / explain the word / repeat after me
en.cau: Open the file on the computer, please. / Look at the screen. / [Ngữ pháp: câu mệnh lệnh] Repeat after me: dictionary! / Can you explain this word, please? / Suddenly, the screen went black.
en.truyen: The Black Screen — In the computer room, the teacher says, 'Open the file called "My Family".' Leo opens the file and looks at the screen. Suddenly, the screen goes black! 'Oh no!' 'Don't worry,' says the teacher. She explains, 'Close the file and open it again.' Leo does it, and his family photo comes back!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "repeat after me classroom English for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià | Ôn: 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì, 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 句子 jùzi, 毕业 bìyè
zh.cum: 放假了 / 放寒假 / 寒假快乐 / 什么时候放假
zh.cau: 我们什么时候放假？(Wǒmen shénme shíhou fàngjià?) / 考试以后就放寒假了。(Kǎoshì yǐhòu jiù fàng hánjià le.) / 寒假你想做什么？(Hánjià nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?) / [Ngữ pháp: 我们一起…吧] 寒假我们一起去图书馆看书吧。(Hánjià wǒmen yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū ba.)
zh.truyen: 放寒假了 — 考试完了，成绩也出来了。老师说："明天放寒假！"孩子们很高兴。Xiaomei问Anna："寒假你想做什么？"Anna说："我想去外婆家。另外，我还要复习汉语。"Xiaomei说："我们一起去图书馆看书吧！" (Fàng hánjià le — Kǎoshì wán le, chéngjì yě chūlai le. Lǎoshī shuō: "Míngtiān fàng hánjià!" Háizimen hěn gāoxìng. Xiaomei wèn Anna: "Hánjià nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?" Anna shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng qù wàipó jiā. Lìngwài, wǒ hái yào fùxí Hànyǔ." Xiaomei shuō: "Wǒmen yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū ba!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "放假了 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 18. Unit 2 · Ôn không tranh – Đoán đồ vật và nơi chốn ở trường

en.tu: Ôn (không tranh): timetable, uniform, textbook, workbook, dictionary, primary, junior, senior, high, gym, together, club, join a club, member, group, share, competition, prize, winner, letter, ring, file, screen, explain, repeat, suddenly
en.cum: join a club / open a file / repeat after me / win a prize / check your timetable / put on your uniform
en.cau: You use it to find new words. What is it? – A dictionary. / It shows your lessons every day. What is it? – A timetable. / You wear it to school. What is it? – A uniform. / [Ngữ pháp: câu đề nghị Let's …] Let's go to the gym together!
en.truyen: What Is It? — Anna plays a guessing game with the English club. 'You use it to find new words.' 'A dictionary!' says Leo. 'It's on the wall and it shows our lessons.' 'The timetable!' says Nhan. 'It's the person who wins the competition.' 'The winner!' 'Well done! Everyone gets a prize!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "school things riddles for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (không tranh): 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 校服 xiàofú, 练习册 liànxícè, 练习 liànxí, 小学 xiǎoxué, 初中 chūzhōng, 高中 gāozhōng, 毕业 bìyè, 介绍 jièshào, 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 句子 jùzi, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì, 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià
zh.cum: 用词典 / 穿校服 / 看时间表 / 做练习 / 放寒假
zh.cau: 这个字的意思你不懂，你用什么？– 我用词典。(Zhège zì de yìsi nǐ bù dǒng, nǐ yòng shénme? – Wǒ yòng cídiǎn.) / 上学的时候穿什么？– 穿校服。(Shàngxué de shíhou chuān shénme? – Chuān xiàofú.) / 小学毕业以后上什么？– 上初中。(Xiǎoxué bìyè yǐhòu shàng shénme? – Shàng chūzhōng.) / 考试以前要做什么？– 要复习。(Kǎoshì yǐqián yào zuò shénme? – Yào fùxí.) / [YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu): con đọc câu hỏi có pinyin, ghi âm câu trả lời 2–3 câu trên Trang luyện nói] 你最喜欢学校的什么地方？为什么？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan xuéxiào de shénme dìfang? Wèishénme?) – 我最喜欢操场，因为我可以和朋友一起踢足球。(Wǒ zuì xǐhuan cāochǎng, yīnwèi wǒ kěyǐ hé péngyou yīqǐ tī zúqiú.)
zh.truyen: 猜猜是什么 — Leo说："我们来猜一猜！上学的时候我们都穿它。"Xiaomei说："校服！""这个字的意思不懂，我们用它。""词典！""上面写着星期一到星期五的课。""时间表！"Leo说："你们俩都很清楚！" (Cāicai shì shénme — Leo shuō: "Wǒmen lái cāi yi cāi! Shàngxué de shíhou wǒmen dōu chuān tā." Xiaomei shuō: "Xiàofú!" "Zhège zì de yìsi bù dǒng, wǒmen yòng tā." "Cídiǎn!" "Shàngmiàn xiězhe xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ de kè." "Shíjiānbiǎo!" Leo shuō: "Nǐmen liǎ dōu hěn qīngchu!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "学习用品 儿歌"

en.flash: file, screen, explain, repeat, suddenly, timetable, uniform, dictionary, gym, club, member, winner, prize
en.slide: 1) Nghe – làm theo trên màn hình máy tính giả lập (4 lệnh): Open the file. / Close the file. / Look at the screen. / Repeat after me. 2) Đoán từ qua định nghĩa, không tranh (5 câu): You find words in it. → dictionary / It shows your lessons. → timetable / You wear it to school. → uniform / The person who wins. → winner / You play sports there. → gym. 3) Kể tiếp truyện với suddenly (mỗi nhóm 2 câu): I was in the gym. Suddenly, ___.
en.truyen: The Computer Club — Nhan is a member of the computer club. Today Mr Brown explains how to make a poster. 'Open a new file. Look at the screen and repeat after me: Our School.' Nhan types 'Our School' and adds a photo of the gym. Suddenly, the bell rings! 'Don't forget to close your file,' says Mr Brown. 'We'll finish next week.'
en.baihat: Repeat After Me – giai điệu Frère Jacques: Repeat after me, repeat after me: / dictionary, dictionary! / Look at the screen now, look at the screen now, / open the file, close the file!

zh.flash: 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì, 词典 cídiǎn, 校服 xiàofú, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 练习册 liànxícè, 初中 chūzhōng, 毕业 bìyè
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chọn đúng ngày trên lịch trong tranh (4 câu): 一月二十号放寒假。/ 星期五考试。/ 星期四复习。/ 放假以前有运动会。2) Đoán từ qua câu mô tả, không tranh (5 câu): 上学的时候穿的 → 校服 / 不懂的字用它 → 词典 / 写着每天的课 → 时间表 / 做练习用的本子 → 练习册 / 小学毕业以后上 → 初中. 3) Hỏi đáp theo cặp (2 câu): 寒假你想做什么？– 我想___。/ 我们什么时候放假？– ___放假。
zh.truyen: 我的寒假 — 放寒假了！Nhan每天早上一边吃早饭，一边听汉语故事。下午他和表哥一起去图书馆看书。晚上他复习课本里的句子。Nhan说："寒假我也要努力，我想考一个好成绩！" (Wǒ de hánjià — Fàng hánjià le! Nhan měitiān zǎoshang yībiān chī zǎofàn, yībiān tīng Hànyǔ gùshi. Xiàwǔ tā hé biǎogē yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū. Wǎnshang tā fùxí kèběn li de jùzi. Nhan shuō: "Hánjià wǒ yě yào nǔlì, wǒ xiǎng kǎo yī gè hǎo chéngjì!")
zh.baihat: 放假了 – giai điệu 小星星 (Twinkle Twinkle Little Star): 考试完了放假了，寒假寒假真快乐。去外婆家看一看，去图书馆读一读。每天早上练一练，我和同学一起玩。(Kǎoshì wán le fàngjià le, hánjià hánjià zhēn kuàilè. Qù wàipó jiā kàn yi kàn, qù túshūguǎn dú yi dú. Měitiān zǎoshang liàn yi liàn, wǒ hé tóngxué yīqǐ wán.)

web.label: Ngày 19. Unit 2 · Truyện và chuyển ngữ – Cuộc thi đố vui

en.tu: Ôn: competition, prize, winner, group, member, club, together, share, explain, repeat, suddenly, uniform, timetable, ring
en.cum: in the same group / win a prize / work together / time's up
en.cau: [Chuyển ngữ EN → ZH] Let's go to the playground together. → 我们一起去操场吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng ba.) / [Chuyển ngữ EN → ZH] Don't forget your workbook. → 别忘了你的练习册。(Bié wàngle nǐ de liànxícè.) / The teacher explains the rules. / Our group is the winner!
en.truyen: The Big Quiz — The English club has a quiz competition. Nhan, Anna and Leo are in the same group. The teacher explains the rules and asks, 'What's a timetable?' Anna answers. 'What do you wear to school?' 'A uniform!' says Leo. Suddenly, the bell rings. 'Time's up! Group 2 is the winner!' They share the prize: a big box of biscuits.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "school quiz for kids English"

zh.tu: Ôn: 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 句子 jùzi, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì, 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià, 介绍 jièshào, 小学 xiǎoxué
zh.cum: 一起复习 / 说清楚 / 成绩很好 / 快放假了
zh.cau: [Chuyển ngữ ZH → EN] 请打开你们的课本。(Qǐng dǎkāi nǐmen de kèběn.) → Open your textbooks, please. / [Chuyển ngữ ZH → EN] 我们一起去图书馆看书吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū ba.) → Let's read books in the library. / 我没听清楚，请再说一次。(Wǒ méi tīng qīngchu, qǐng zài shuō yī cì.) / 快放寒假了！(Kuài fàng hánjià le!)
zh.truyen: 汉语小老师 — 快放寒假了。老师说："谁来介绍一下我们的学校？"Nhan很努力，他说："我们的小学很大，有图书馆，有操场，还有很多教室。"老师问："大家听清楚了吗？""听清楚了！"老师说："Nhan的汉语成绩很好，他是我们的小老师！" (Hànyǔ xiǎo lǎoshī — Kuài fàng hánjià le. Lǎoshī shuō: "Shéi lái jièshào yīxià wǒmen de xuéxiào?" Nhan hěn nǔlì, tā shuō: "Wǒmen de xiǎoxué hěn dà, yǒu túshūguǎn, yǒu cāochǎng, hái yǒu hěn duō jiàoshì." Lǎoshī wèn: "Dàjiā tīng qīngchu le ma?" "Tīng qīngchu le!" Lǎoshī shuō: "Nhan de Hànyǔ chéngjì hěn hǎo, tā shì wǒmen de xiǎo lǎoshī!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "我的学校 汉语 儿童 故事"

web.label: Ngày 20. Unit 2 · Phiên dịch nhí – Dẫn bạn mới đi thăm trường

en.tu: Ôn: uniform, timetable, dictionary, textbook, workbook, gym, together, member, join a club, primary
en.cum: show you our school / join a club / check the timetable / this is the gym
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí ZH → EN] 穿上你的校服。(Chuānshang nǐ de xiàofú.) → Put on your school uniform. / 看看你的课程表。(Kànkan nǐ de kèchéngbiǎo.) → Check your timetable. / 请用你的词典。(Qǐng yòng nǐ de cídiǎn.) → Use your dictionary. / 我们一起去操场吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng ba.) → Let's go to the playground together. / [Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): con nghe câu hỏi về câu lạc bộ, nhìn thẻ thông tin rồi ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói] What's the name of your club? – The Art Club. / Where do you meet? – In the art room. / What day do you meet? – On Tuesday. / How many members are there? – Ten.
en.truyen: A New Friend — A new girl comes to Nhan's primary school. She is from China and she can't speak much English. Xiaomei helps her. 'This is our timetable. This is the gym. Do you want to join the dance club?' Xiaomei says it in Chinese, and then in English. 'You're a great helper!' says the new girl. Now they are good friends.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "welcome to our school song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 校服 xiàofú, 练习册 liànxícè, 小学 xiǎoxué, 介绍 jièshào, 参加 cānjiā, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 复习 fùxí
zh.cum: 我来介绍一下 / 这是我们的教室 / 参加运动会 / 一起复习
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí EN → ZH] Open your textbooks, please. → 请打开你们的课本。(Qǐng dǎkāi nǐmen de kèběn.) / Don't forget your workbook. → 别忘了你的练习册。(Bié wàngle nǐ de liànxícè.) / Let's read books in the library. → 我们一起去图书馆看书吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn kàn shū ba.) / I don't understand. Please say it again. → 我不明白，请再说一次。(Wǒ bù míngbai, qǐng zài shuō yī cì.)
zh.truyen: 新同学来了 — 我们班来了一个新同学。Xiaomei说："我来介绍一下，这是我们的教室，那是图书馆。这是我们的时间表。"新同学说："我没听清楚。"Xiaomei一边走，一边慢慢地说。新同学说："现在我明白了！谢谢你！" (Xīn tóngxué lái le — Wǒmen bān láile yī gè xīn tóngxué. Xiaomei shuō: "Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, zhè shì wǒmen de jiàoshì, nà shì túshūguǎn. Zhè shì wǒmen de shíjiānbiǎo." Xīn tóngxué shuō: "Wǒ méi tīng qīngchu." Xiaomei yībiān zǒu, yībiān mànmàn de shuō. Xīn tóngxué shuō: "Xiànzài wǒ míngbai le! Xièxie nǐ!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "欢迎新同学 儿歌"

en.flash: timetable, uniform, textbook, workbook, dictionary, primary, junior, senior, high, gym, together, club, join a club, member, group, share, competition, prize, winner, letter, ring, file, screen, explain, repeat, suddenly
en.slide: 1) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp (4 thẻ, con A đọc tiếng Trung, con B nói tiếng Anh): 穿上你的校服。→ Put on your school uniform. / 看看你的课程表。→ Check your timetable. / 我们一起去操场吧。→ Let's go to the playground together. / 别忘了你的练习册。→ Don't forget your workbook. 2) Dự án nhỏ 'Tour trường em': mỗi nhóm cầm sơ đồ trường, giới thiệu 4 câu: This is the gym. / This is our timetable. / You can join the art club. / Let's go to the library together. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 2 – nghe chọn tranh (5 câu): Open your textbooks. / The bell rings. / Anna is the winner. / Look at the screen. / Share your dictionary. 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): hỏi – đáp trao đổi thông tin về câu lạc bộ. Cô: 'Anna and Leo are members of school clubs. I don't know about Leo's club, so ask me some questions.' Con hỏi: What's the name of the club? – The Computer Club. / Where do they meet? – In the computer room. / What day do they meet? – On Wednesday. / How many members are there? – Twelve. / What do they do? – They make games together. Rồi cô hỏi về câu lạc bộ của Anna, con trả lời theo thẻ: The English Club / in the library / on Friday / fifteen members / They read books and write letters.
en.truyen: The Big Quiz (bản đầy đủ) — The English club has a quiz competition. Nhan, Anna and Leo are in Group 2. The teacher explains the rules: 'Listen, then answer. Don't shout!' 'What's a timetable?' 'It shows our lessons!' says Anna. 'Where do we play basketball?' 'In the gym!' says Nhan. 'Repeat after me: dictionary!' Leo repeats it very fast. Suddenly, the bell rings. 'Time's up! Group 2 is the winner!' They share the prize, a big box of biscuits, with all the members of the club.
en.baihat: Get Ready for School + Join the Club (hát nối hai bài của unit) – giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush rồi London Bridge: This is the way we put on our uniform … early in the morning. // Come and join the English club, / English club, English club. / Come and join the English club, / be a member!

Lǎoshī shuō: "Shéi lái jièshào yīxià wǒmen de xuéxiào?" Nhan zhàn qǐlai shuō: "Wǒmen de xiǎoxué hěn dà, yǒu túshūguǎn, yǒu cāochǎng, hái yǒu hěn duō jiàoshì. Wǒmen měitiān chuān xiàofú shàngxué." Lǎoshī shuō: "Nhan hěn nǔlì, tā de Hànyǔ chéngjì hěn hǎo, tā shì wǒmen de xiǎo lǎoshī!")

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 11. Unit 3 · The Countryside – Làng quê (1/4): Cảnh vật làng quê, There is / There are, 上/下/里 + 有

web.label: Ngày 21. Unit 3 · Làng của bà – đồi, đường mòn, suối

en.tu: Mới: hill, path, stream, pond, view | Ôn: farm, forest, cow, sheep, goat, horse
en.cum: on the hill / a path to the village / a small stream / near the pond / a beautiful view
en.cau: What is there in your village? / [Ngữ pháp: There is + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There is a forest near my village. / [Ngữ pháp: There are + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There are some cows on the hill. / There is a small stream next to the path. / What a beautiful view!
en.truyen: Grandma's Village — Nhan visits his grandma's village. 'What is there in your village, Grandma?' 'There is a big hill behind my house, and there is a forest near the village.' They walk along a small path. There is a stream and a pond with ducks. Nhan climbs the hill. 'What a beautiful view!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "there is there are countryside song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 农民 nóngmín, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín | Ôn: 旁边 pángbiān, 后面 hòumiàn, 鸟 niǎo, 鱼 yú, 工作 gōngzuò
zh.cum: 在农村 / 一块田 / 农民叔叔 / 村子里 / 一片森林
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 里 + 有] 你们村子里有什么？(Nǐmen cūnzi li yǒu shénme?) / [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 有] 我的村子旁边有一片森林。(Wǒ de cūnzi pángbiān yǒu yī piàn sēnlín.) / 我家后面有很多田。(Wǒ jiā hòumiàn yǒu hěn duō tián.) / [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 里 + 有] 村子里有很多人。(Cūnzi li yǒu hěn duō rén.) / 农民在田里工作。(Nóngmín zài tián li gōngzuò.)
zh.truyen: 外婆的村子 — 放假了，Nhan去农村看外婆。外婆的村子旁边有一片森林，外婆家后面有很多田。很多农民在田里工作。Nhan问："村子里有什么好玩的？"外婆说："明天我带你去看看！" (Wàipó de cūnzi — Fàngjià le, Nhan qù nóngcūn kàn wàipó. Wàipó de cūnzi pángbiān yǒu yī piàn sēnlín, wàipó jiā hòumiàn yǒu hěn duō tián. Hěn duō nóngmín zài tián li gōngzuò. Nhan wèn: "Cūnzi li yǒu shénme hǎowán de?" Wàipó shuō: "Míngtiān wǒ dài nǐ qù kànkan!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "农村 儿歌 小朋友"

web.label: Ngày 22. Unit 3 · Không khí trong lành – trâu, bướm, côn trùng

en.tu: Mới: buffalo, fresh, peaceful, butterfly, insect, beetle | Ôn: hill, path, stream, pond, view, bee, spider, frog
en.cum: a big buffalo / fresh air / a peaceful village / a yellow butterfly / small insects / a black beetle
en.cau: The air in the countryside is fresh. / My grandma's village is very peaceful. / [Ngữ pháp: There are + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There are lots of butterflies near the pond. / [Ngữ pháp: There is + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There is a buffalo next to the stream. / A beetle is an insect.
en.truyen: The Butterfly Walk — In the morning, the air is fresh and the village is peaceful. Nhan and his cousin walk to the pond. There is a big buffalo next to the stream. 'Look! There are lots of butterflies!' says Nhan. His cousin finds a black beetle on a leaf. 'Insects are so interesting!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "insects song for kids butterfly beetle"

zh.tu: Mới: 水牛 shuǐniú, 虫子 chóngzi, 蝴蝶 húdié, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān | Ôn: 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 农民 nóngmín, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 鸟 niǎo
zh.cum: 一头水牛 / 很多虫子 / 漂亮的蝴蝶 / 新鲜的空气
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 里 + 有] 田里有一头水牛。(Tián li yǒu yī tóu shuǐniú.) / 农村的空气很新鲜。(Nóngcūn de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān.) / [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 上 + 有] 花上有一只蝴蝶。(Huā shang yǒu yī zhī húdié.) / [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 下 + 有] 树下有很多虫子。(Shù xià yǒu hěn duō chóngzi.)
zh.truyen: 看蝴蝶 — 早上，农村的空气很新鲜。Nhan和表哥去田里玩。田里有一头大水牛。花上有很多漂亮的蝴蝶，树下还有小虫子。表哥说："你看，蝴蝶飞来飞去！"Nhan说："农村真好玩！" (Kàn húdié — Zǎoshang, nóngcūn de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān. Nhan hé biǎogē qù tián li wán. Tián li yǒu yī tóu dà shuǐniú. Huā shang yǒu hěn duō piàoliang de húdié, shù xià hái yǒu xiǎo chóngzi. Biǎogē shuō: "Nǐ kàn, húdié fēi lái fēi qù!" Nhan shuō: "Nóngcūn zhēn hǎowán!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "蝴蝶 儿歌"

en.flash: hill, path, stream, pond, view, buffalo, fresh, peaceful, butterfly, insect, beetle, forest, farm, cow
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh làng quê – chọn There is / There are (5 câu): ___ a stream near the path. / ___ some cows on the hill. / ___ lots of butterflies. / ___ a buffalo next to the pond. / ___ a forest behind the village. 2) Nghe – kéo hình vào đúng chỗ trong tranh (4 câu): There is a beetle on the leaf. / There are two butterflies above the pond. / The buffalo is next to the stream. / The path goes up the hill. 3) Hỏi đáp theo cặp: What is there in your village? – There is ___. / There are ___.
en.truyen: A Day in the Countryside — Nhan wakes up early at Grandma's house. The air is fresh and it's very peaceful. After breakfast, they walk along a path to the hill. On the way, there is a stream with small fish. A big buffalo drinks water from the pond. There are lots of insects: butterflies, bees and beetles. At the top of the hill, Nhan says, 'What a beautiful view! I love the countryside!'
en.baihat: In My Village – giai điệu The Farmer in the Dell: There's a hill near my house, / there's a hill near my house, / hi-ho, the countryside, / there's a hill near my house. // There are cows on the hill, / there are cows on the hill, / hi-ho, the countryside, / there are cows on the hill. // The air is fresh and clean … / There are butterflies by the pond …

zh.flash: 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 农民 nóngmín, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 水牛 shuǐniú, 虫子 chóngzi, 蝴蝶 húdié, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān, 山 shān, 牛 niú
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm đúng chỗ trong tranh làng (5 câu): 山上有一些牛。/ 田里有一头水牛。/ 花上有一只蝴蝶。/ 树下有很多虫子。/ 村子旁边有一片森林。2) Chọn 上 / 下 / 里 điền chỗ trống (4 câu): 山___有一些牛。/ 田___有一头水牛。/ 树___有很多虫子。/ 村子___有很多人。3) Hỏi đáp theo cặp: 你们村子里有什么？– 我们村子里有___。
zh.truyen: 农村的早上 — 外婆家在农村。早上，空气很新鲜。农民们去田里工作，水牛也去了。村子旁边有一片森林，森林里有很多鸟。花上有蝴蝶，树下有虫子。山上有一些牛。Nhan说："外婆，我喜欢农村！" (Nóngcūn de zǎoshang — Wàipó jiā zài nóngcūn. Zǎoshang, kōngqì hěn xīnxiān. Nóngmínmen qù tián li gōngzuò, shuǐniú yě qù le. Cūnzi pángbiān yǒu yī piàn sēnlín, sēnlín li yǒu hěn duō niǎo. Huā shang yǒu húdié, shù xià yǒu chóngzi. Shān shang yǒu yīxiē niú. Nhan shuō: "Wàipó, wǒ xǐhuan nóngcūn!")
zh.baihat: 农村好 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 农村农村，空气新鲜，真好玩，真好玩。田里有头水牛，花上有只蝴蝶，真漂亮，真漂亮。(Nóngcūn nóngcūn, kōngqì xīnxiān, zhēn hǎowán, zhēn hǎowán. Tián li yǒu tóu shuǐniú, huā shang yǒu zhī húdié, zhēn piàoliang, zhēn piàoliang.)

web.label: Ngày 23. Unit 3 · Hàng xóm thân thiện – tổ chim đại bàng

en.tu: Mới: neighbour, friendly, relationship, nest, eagle | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): together, member, group, share, explain, suddenly, winner | Ôn: hill, pond
en.cum: my friendly neighbours / a good relationship / a bird's nest / an eagle in the sky
en.cau: My neighbours are very friendly. / We have a good relationship with our neighbours. / [Ngữ pháp: There is + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There is an eagle's nest on the hill. / [Ngữ pháp: Let's … (ôn Unit 2)] Let's share our cake with the neighbours. / Suddenly, an eagle flew over the pond.
en.truyen: The Friendly Neighbours — Grandma's neighbours are very friendly. Every afternoon they sit together and share fruit. 'We have a very good relationship,' says Grandma. Suddenly, Mr Ba, the neighbour, points at the hill. 'Look! There is an eagle's nest in that tall tree!' Nhan sees a big eagle flying over the hill.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "friendly neighbours song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): 参加 cānjiā, 介绍 jièshào, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 努力 nǔlì | Ôn: 农村 nóngcūn, 蝴蝶 húdié
zh.cum: 我的邻居 / 很友好 / 关系很好 / 很亲密
zh.cau: 我的邻居很友好。(Wǒ de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.) / 我们和邻居的关系很好。(Wǒmen hé línjū de guānxi hěn hǎo.) / 外婆和邻居很亲密。(Wàipó hé línjū hěn qīnmì.) / 我来介绍一下，这是外婆的邻居。(Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, zhè shì wàipó de línjū.) / 邻居的孩子也参加了我们的游戏。(Línjū de háizi yě cānjiāle wǒmen de yóuxì.)
zh.truyen: 友好的邻居 — 外婆的邻居很友好。他们每天下午一起喝茶，一起说话。外婆说："我和邻居的关系很亲密，就像一家人。"Nhan说："我来介绍一下，我叫Nhan，上小学三年级。"邻居笑着说："欢迎你来我们村子！" (Yǒuhǎo de línjū — Wàipó de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo. Tāmen měitiān xiàwǔ yīqǐ hē chá, yīqǐ shuōhuà. Wàipó shuō: "Wǒ hé línjū de guānxi hěn qīnmì, jiù xiàng yī jiā rén." Nhan shuō: "Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, wǒ jiào Nhan, shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí." Línjū xiàozhe shuō: "Huānyíng nǐ lái wǒmen cūnzi!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "邻居 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 24. Unit 3 · Hang sau đồi – rùa và lâu đài

en.tu: Mới: castle, cave, tortoise, creature | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): club, competition, prize, repeat, timetable | Ôn: neighbour, friendly, nest, eagle, stream, ever
en.cum: an old castle / a dark cave / a slow tortoise / a strange creature
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: There is + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There is an old castle on the hill. / [Ngữ pháp: There is + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There is a dark cave behind the forest. / A tortoise is a slow creature. / Have you ever seen a tortoise in a pond? / The art club has a competition: draw a creature!
en.truyen: The Cave Behind the Hill — Nhan and his neighbour's son walk along the stream. Behind the forest there is a dark cave. 'Is there a creature in it?' asks Nhan. They look inside. Suddenly, something moves! It's a big, old tortoise. 'Hello, Mr Tortoise!' they laugh. From the cave they can see an old castle on the next hill.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "the tortoise and the hare story for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr | Ôn (từ nối Unit 2): 考试 kǎoshì, 成绩 chéngjì, 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià, 复习 fùxí | Ôn: 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 关系 guānxi
zh.cum: 很安静 / 别打扰 / 安静一点儿 / 打扰一下
zh.cau: 晚上，村子里很安静。(Wǎnshang, cūnzi li hěn ānjìng.) / 请安静一点儿！(Qǐng ānjìng yīdiǎnr!) / [Ngữ pháp: 别 + động từ (ôn Unit 2)] 外公在睡觉，别打扰他。(Wàigōng zài shuìjiào, bié dǎrǎo tā.) / 对不起，打扰一下。(Duìbuqǐ, dǎrǎo yīxià.) / 寒假我在农村，每天复习一点儿汉语。(Hánjià wǒ zài nóngcūn, měitiān fùxí yīdiǎnr Hànyǔ.)
zh.truyen: 别打扰外公 — 下午，外公在睡觉，家里很安静。Nhan和邻居的孩子在外面玩，他们一边跑，一边笑。外婆说："请安静一点儿，别打扰外公。"孩子们说："对不起！"他们去田里看蝴蝶了。 (Bié dǎrǎo wàigōng — Xiàwǔ, wàigōng zài shuìjiào, jiā li hěn ānjìng. Nhan hé línjū de háizi zài wàimiàn wán, tāmen yībiān pǎo, yībiān xiào. Wàipó shuō: "Qǐng ānjìng yīdiǎnr, bié dǎrǎo wàigōng." Háizimen shuō: "Duìbuqǐ!" Tāmen qù tián li kàn húdié le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "安静 儿歌"

en.flash: neighbour, friendly, relationship, nest, eagle, castle, cave, tortoise, creature, together, share, suddenly, competition
en.slide: 1) Nghe mô tả – kéo hình vào tranh (4 câu): There is a castle on the hill. / There is a cave behind the forest. / There is an eagle's nest in the tree. / There is a tortoise next to the pond. 2) Chọn từ đúng (friendly / neighbour / relationship), 3 câu: Mr Ba is my ___. / He is very ___. / We have a good ___. 3) Đóng vai chào hàng xóm mới (3 lượt): Hello! I'm your new neighbour. – Nice to meet you! / Let's have tea together. – You're very friendly!
en.truyen: The Tortoise and the Eagle — Once there was a slow tortoise and a fast eagle. They were neighbours near a peaceful pond. The eagle lived in a nest on the hill, and the tortoise lived in a small cave. They had a very good relationship. One day, the tortoise said, 'I want to see the view from the hill!' The eagle carried him up. 'What a beautiful view! Thank you, my friend!'
en.baihat: Friendly Neighbours – giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb: Hello, hello, my neighbour friend, / neighbour friend, neighbour friend. / Hello, hello, my neighbour friend, / you're so friendly! // There's a nest up on the hill, / on the hill, on the hill. / There's a tortoise in the cave, / slow and friendly!

zh.flash: 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 介绍 jièshào, 参加 cānjiā, 寒假 hánjià
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh tình huống (4 câu): 请安静一点儿！/ 别打扰外公。/ 对不起，打扰一下。/ 我的邻居很友好。2) Nối nửa câu (3 câu): 外婆和邻居 – 很亲密。/ 我们和邻居的关系 – 很好。/ 晚上村子里 – 很安静。3) Đóng vai thăm hàng xóm mới (3 lượt): 对不起，打扰一下！– 你好！/ 我来介绍一下，我是Nhan。– 欢迎你！/ 我们一起喝茶吧。– 好啊！ 2) YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, 10 câu, từng em; cô đọc 1 lần, con nói lại 1 lần): 晚上村子里很安静。/ 外公在睡觉，别打扰他。/ 对不起，打扰一下，请问你家在哪儿？/ 我的邻居很友好。/ 山上有一些牛。/ 树下有很多虫子。/ 花上有一只蝴蝶。/ 请安静一点儿！/ 外婆和邻居的关系很好。/ 田里有一头水牛。
zh.truyen: 新邻居 — 外婆家旁边来了一个新邻居。他们家有一个小女儿。外婆说："我们去看看新邻居吧。"到了门口，Nhan说："对不起，打扰一下！"新邻居很友好，请他们进来喝茶。小女儿很安静，可是很可爱。以后，两家的关系很亲密。 (Xīn línjū — Wàipó jiā pángbiān láile yī gè xīn línjū. Tāmen jiā yǒu yī gè xiǎo nǚ'ér. Wàipó shuō: "Wǒmen qù kànkan xīn línjū ba." Dàole ménkǒu, Nhan shuō: "Duìbuqǐ, dǎrǎo yīxià!" Xīn línjū hěn yǒuhǎo, qǐng tāmen jìnlai hē chá. Xiǎo nǚ'ér hěn ānjìng, kěshì hěn kě'ài. Yǐhòu, liǎng jiā de guānxi hěn qīnmì.)
zh.baihat: 好邻居 – giai điệu 小星星 (Twinkle Twinkle Little Star): 我家旁边有邻居，邻居个个很友好。外公睡觉要安静，大家不要去打扰。我们关系很亲密，就像一家在一起。(Wǒ jiā pángbiān yǒu línjū, línjū gègè hěn yǒuhǎo. Wàigōng shuìjiào yào ānjìng, dàjiā bùyào qù dǎrǎo. Wǒmen guānxi hěn qīnmì, jiù xiàng yī jiā zài yīqǐ.)

en.tu: Mới: dinosaur, extinct, camel, pyramid, octopus | Ôn: tortoise, creature, castle, cave, eagle, nest, of course
en.cum: a big dinosaur / extinct animals / camels near the pyramids / an octopus in the sea
en.cau: Dinosaurs are extinct. There are no dinosaurs now. / [Ngữ pháp: There are + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn] There are camels near the pyramids. / An octopus has got eight legs. / Is a tortoise a creature? – Of course!
en.truyen: Grandpa's Old Book — It's raining in the village, so Nhan reads Grandpa's old book about creatures. There's a picture of a dinosaur. 'Dinosaurs are extinct,' says Grandpa. 'There are no dinosaurs now.' On the next page, there are camels near the pyramids, and an octopus with eight long legs. 'I want to see all these creatures!' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "dinosaurs for kids extinct animals"

zh.tu: Mới: 既…又… jì…yòu… | Ôn: 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 水牛 shuǐniú, 蝴蝶 húdié, 虫子 chóngzi, 农村 nóngcūn, 新鲜 xīnxiān
zh.cum: 既安静又漂亮 / 既大又高 / 既新鲜又便宜 / 既友好又可爱
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 既…又…] 农村既安静又漂亮。(Nóngcūn jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang.) / [Ngữ pháp: 既…又…] 这头水牛既大又高。(Zhè tóu shuǐniú jì dà yòu gāo.) / [Ngữ pháp: 既…又…] 农村的水果既新鲜又便宜。(Nóngcūn de shuǐguǒ jì xīnxiān yòu piányi.) / [Ngữ pháp: 既…又…] 邻居的小女儿既友好又可爱。(Línjū de xiǎo nǚ'ér jì yǒuhǎo yòu kě'ài.)
zh.truyen: 我爱农村 — 寒假，Nhan在外婆家住了一个星期。他说："农村既安静又漂亮。"村子里的水果既新鲜又便宜，邻居们既友好又亲密。Nhan每天一边看蝴蝶，一边听鸟唱歌。他说："明年我还要来！" (Wǒ ài nóngcūn — Hánjià, Nhan zài wàipó jiā zhùle yī gè xīngqī. Tā shuō: "Nóngcūn jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang." Cūnzi li de shuǐguǒ jì xīnxiān yòu piányi, línjūmen jì yǒuhǎo yòu qīnmì. Nhan měitiān yībiān kàn húdié, yībiān tīng niǎo chàng gē. Tā shuō: "Míngnián wǒ hái yào lái!")

en.cum: on the hill / near the pond / in the cave / friendly neighbours / fresh air
en.cau: It's very old and a king lived in it. What is it? – A castle. / It's slow and it carries its house. What is it? – A tortoise. / It's got eight legs and lives in the sea. What is it? – An octopus. / [Ngữ pháp: There are + danh từ] There are lots of insects in the countryside.
en.truyen: Guess the Creature — Anna and Leo play a game in the English club. 'It's a big bird. It lives in a nest on a hill.' 'An eagle!' 'It was very big, but now it's extinct.' 'A dinosaur!' 'It works in the field with the farmers.' 'A buffalo!' 'Well done! You're the winners!' says the teacher.

zh.tu: Ôn (không tranh): 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 农民 nóngmín, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 水牛 shuǐniú, 虫子 chóngzi, 蝴蝶 húdié, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 既…又… jì…yòu…
zh.cum: 田里 / 山上 / 树下 / 村子里 / 很安静
zh.cau: 它很大，在田里工作。它是什么？– 水牛。(Tā hěn dà, zài tián li gōngzuò. Tā shì shénme? – Shuǐniú.) / 它很漂亮，会飞，喜欢花。它是什么？– 蝴蝶。(Tā hěn piàoliang, huì fēi, xǐhuan huā. Tā shì shénme? – Húdié.) / 住在你家旁边的人是谁？– 是邻居。(Zhù zài nǐ jiā pángbiān de rén shì shéi? – Shì línjū.) / 在田里工作的人是谁？– 是农民。(Zài tián li gōngzuò de rén shì shéi? – Shì nóngmín.)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — Xiaomei说："我们来猜一猜！它很小，树下有很多。""虫子！""它住在农村，很大，在田里工作。""水牛！""他们住在你家旁边，很友好。""邻居！"Xiaomei说："你们都猜对了！" (Cāi yi cāi — Xiaomei shuō: "Wǒmen lái cāi yi cāi! Tā hěn xiǎo, shù xià yǒu hěn duō." "Chóngzi!" "Tā zhù zài nóngcūn, hěn dà, zài tián li gōngzuò." "Shuǐniú!" "Tāmen zhù zài nǐ jiā pángbiān, hěn yǒuhǎo." "Línjū!" Xiaomei shuō: "Nǐmen dōu cāi duì le!")

en.flash: dinosaur, extinct, camel, pyramid, octopus, tortoise, creature, castle, cave, eagle, nest, buffalo, butterfly, insect, peaceful, fresh
en.slide: 1) Đoán qua định nghĩa, không tranh (5 câu): It lives in a nest. → eagle / It carries its house. → tortoise / It has got eight legs. → octopus / It lived a long time ago. → dinosaur / A king lived in it. → castle. 2) Đúng hay sai (4 câu): Dinosaurs are extinct. / An octopus has got six legs. / There are camels near the pyramids. / A beetle is an insect. 3) Tả làng quê của con (4 câu, nói rồi viết): There is ___ near my house. / There are ___ on the hill. / The air is ___. / My neighbours are ___.
en.truyen: Nhan's Countryside Diary — Monday: There is a stream near Grandma's house. I saw a beetle and two butterflies. Tuesday: It rained. I read about dinosaurs, camels and an octopus in Grandpa's old book. Dinosaurs are extinct! Wednesday: I climbed the hill with our friendly neighbour, Mr Ba. There was an eagle's nest in a tree! The village is so peaceful. I don't want to go home!
en.baihat: The Dinosaur Song – giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat: Dinosaurs, dinosaurs, / a long, long time ago. / Now they are extinct, my friend, / no more dinosaurs! // Octopus, octopus, / eight long legs, oh no! / Camels, camels, near the pyramids, / walking very slow!

zh.flash: 既…又… jì…yòu…, 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 水牛 shuǐniú, 蝴蝶 húdié, 虫子 chóngzi, 农民 nóngmín
zh.slide: 1) Ghép câu với 既…又… (4 câu): 农村___安静___漂亮。/ 水牛___大___高。/ 水果___新鲜___便宜。/ 邻居___友好___亲密。2) Đoán qua câu mô tả, không tranh (5 câu): 在田里工作的大动物 → 水牛 / 会飞、喜欢花 → 蝴蝶 / 很小，树下有很多 → 虫子 / 住在你家旁边 → 邻居 / 在田里工作的人 → 农民. 3) Nói 3 câu về làng của con: ___里有___。/ ___上有___。/ 我的村子既___又___。
zh.truyen: 外婆讲的故事 — 外婆的村子既安静又漂亮。晚上，Nhan听外婆讲故事："从前，山后面有一片深林，深林里住着很多动物。有一头水牛，它既大又友好。有一只蝴蝶，它既小又漂亮。它们是好邻居，关系很亲密。"Nhan说："外婆，明天再讲一个吧！" (Wàipó jiǎng de gùshi — Wàipó de cūnzi jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang. Wǎnshang, Nhan tīng wàipó jiǎng gùshi: "Cóngqián, shān hòumiàn yǒu yī piàn shēnlín, shēnlín li zhùzhe hěn duō dòngwù. Yǒu yī tóu shuǐniú, tā jì dà yòu yǒuhǎo. Yǒu yī zhī húdié, tā jì xiǎo yòu piàoliang. Tāmen shì hǎo línjū, guānxi hěn qīnmì." Nhan shuō: "Wàipó, míngtiān zài jiǎng yī gè ba!")
zh.baihat: 既又歌 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 我的村子，我的村子，既安静，又漂亮。水牛既大又高，蝴蝶既小又美，真好玩，真好玩。(Wǒ de cūnzi, wǒ de cūnzi, jì ānjìng, yòu piàoliang. Shuǐniú jì dà yòu gāo, húdié jì xiǎo yòu měi, zhēn hǎowán, zhēn hǎowán.)

en.tu: Ôn: hill, path, stream, pond, buffalo, neighbour, friendly, peaceful, view, eagle, nest, together, such
en.cum: along the path / next to the stream / on the hill / help a neighbour
en.cau: [Chuyển ngữ EN → ZH] There are some cows on the hill. → 山上有一些牛。(Shān shang yǒu yīxiē niú.) / [Chuyển ngữ EN → ZH] My neighbours are very friendly. → 我的邻居很友好。(Wǒ de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.) / Where is the buffalo? – It's next to the stream. / [Ngữ pháp: Let's … (ôn Unit 2)] Let's look for it together! / [Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu): nhìn 2 tranh làng quê, nghe câu tranh A rồi nói câu tranh B, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] In my picture, the buffalo is next to the stream. – In my picture, it's on the hill. / In my picture, there are four butterflies. – In my picture, there are two. / In my picture, the eagle is in its nest. – In my picture, it's flying.
en.truyen: The Lost Buffalo — One morning, the neighbour's buffalo isn't in the field. 'Where is it?' asks Mr Ba. Nhan and his cousin help. They walk along the path, past the pond and up the hill. From the top there is a great view. 'There it is! Next to the stream!' The buffalo is eating grass. Mr Ba is very happy. 'You're such good neighbours!'

zh.tu: Ôn: 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 水牛 shuǐniú, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān, 既…又… jì…yòu…, 着急 zháojí
zh.cum: 找水牛 / 在森林旁边 / 一起找 / 帮助邻居
zh.cau: [Chuyển ngữ ZH → EN] 农村的空气很新鲜。(Nóngcūn de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān.) → The air in the countryside is fresh. / [Chuyển ngữ ZH → EN] 村子里有很多人。(Cūnzi li yǒu hěn duō rén.) → There are a lot of people in the village. / 水牛在哪儿？– 在森林旁边。(Shuǐniú zài nǎr? – Zài sēnlín pángbiān.) / 我们一起帮助邻居吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ bāngzhù línjū ba!)
zh.truyen: 水牛不见了 — 一天早上，邻居的水牛不见了。邻居很着急。Nhan和表哥说："我们一起帮你找吧！"他们去了田里，又去了山上。表哥说："你看！水牛在森林旁边吃草呢！"邻居很高兴："你们既聪明又友好！" (Shuǐniú bù jiàn le — Yī tiān zǎoshang, línjū de shuǐniú bù jiàn le. Línjū hěn zháojí. Nhan hé biǎogē shuō: "Wǒmen yīqǐ bāng nǐ zhǎo ba!" Tāmen qùle tián li, yòu qùle shān shang. Biǎogē shuō: "Nǐ kàn! Shuǐniú zài sēnlín pángbiān chī cǎo ne!" Línjū hěn gāoxìng: "Nǐmen jì cōngming yòu yǒuhǎo!")

en.tu: Ôn: hill, forest, pond, butterfly, insect, neighbour, friendly, peaceful, fresh, buffalo, view
en.cum: in my grandma's village / near the village / by the pond / so peaceful
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí ZH → EN] 你们村子里有什么？(Nǐmen cūnzi li yǒu shénme?) → What is there in your village? / 我的村子旁边有一片森林。(Wǒ de cūnzi pángbiān yǒu yī piàn sēnlín.) → There is a forest near my village. / 山上有一些牛。(Shān shang yǒu yīxiē niú.) → There are some cows on the hill. / 我的邻居很友好。(Wǒ de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.) → My neighbours are very friendly.
en.truyen: A Message from the Village — Nhan sends a video message to Anna. 'Hi, Anna! I'm in my grandma's village. There is a hill and a forest near the village. There are lots of butterflies near the pond. The neighbours are very friendly.' Xiaomei watches it too and says it again in Chinese for her grandma. 'Nhan's village is so peaceful!'

zh.tu: Ôn: 农村 nóngcūn, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 田 tián, 水牛 shuǐniú, 蝴蝶 húdié, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 安静 ānjìng, 既…又… jì…yòu…
zh.cum: 我在外婆的村子里 / 田里有水牛 / 花上有蝴蝶 / 既安静又漂亮
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí EN → ZH] There are a lot of people in the village. → 村子里有很多人。(Cūnzi li yǒu hěn duō rén.) / The air in the countryside is fresh. → 农村的空气很新鲜。(Nóngcūn de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān.) / There is a buffalo in the field. → 田里有一头水牛。(Tián li yǒu yī tóu shuǐniú.) / The village is quiet and beautiful. → 村子既安静又漂亮。(Cūnzi jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang.)
zh.truyen: 给Xiaomei打电话 — Nhan给Xiaomei打电话："我在外婆的村子里。村子旁边有一片森林，田里有水牛，花上有很多蝴蝶。邻居们都很友好。"Xiaomei说："你的村子既安静又漂亮！我也想去！" (Gěi Xiaomei dǎ diànhuà — Nhan gěi Xiaomei dǎ diànhuà: "Wǒ zài wàipó de cūnzi li. Cūnzi pángbiān yǒu yī piàn sēnlín, tián li yǒu shuǐniú, huā shang yǒu hěn duō húdié. Línjūmen dōu hěn yǒuhǎo." Xiaomei shuō: "Nǐ de cūnzi jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang! Wǒ yě xiǎng qù!")
