en.flash: hill, path, stream, pond, view, buffalo, fresh, peaceful, butterfly, insect, beetle, neighbour, friendly, relationship, nest, eagle, castle, cave, tortoise, creature, dinosaur, extinct, camel, pyramid, octopus
en.slide: 1) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp (4 thẻ, con A đọc tiếng Trung, con B nói tiếng Anh): 你们村子里有什么？→ What is there in your village? / 山上有一些牛。→ There are some cows on the hill. / 农村的空气很新鲜。→ The air in the countryside is fresh. / 我的邻居很友好。→ My neighbours are very friendly. 2) Dự án nhỏ 'Bản đồ làng em': mỗi nhóm vẽ bản đồ, nói 4 câu: There is a hill behind the village. / There is a pond next to the path. / There are butterflies near the stream. / Our neighbours are friendly. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 3 – nghe chọn tranh (5 câu): There is a castle on the hill. / The buffalo is next to the stream. / There is an eagle's nest. / The tortoise is in the cave. / Dinosaurs are extinct. 4) Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu): tìm điểm khác giữa 2 tranh 'Grandma's Village'. Cô: 'My picture is nearly the same as yours, but some things are different. For example, in my picture there is a castle on the hill, but in your picture there isn't.' Con nêu 5 điểm khác: In my picture, there are three cows on the hill. – In my picture, there are two. / In my picture, the butterfly is on a flower. – In my picture, it's on a tree. / In my picture, the tortoise is next to the pond. – In my picture, it's in the cave. / In my picture, the path is next to the stream. – In my picture, it's behind the forest. / In my picture, the neighbour is waving. – In my picture, he's sleeping.
en.truyen: The Lost Buffalo (bản đầy đủ) — One morning, Mr Ba's buffalo isn't in the field. 'Oh dear! Where is it?' Nhan and his cousin want to help. 'Let's look for it together!' They walk along the path and past the pond. There are lots of butterflies and insects, but no buffalo. They climb the hill. From the top there is a great view of the peaceful village. 'There it is! Next to the stream, near the old cave!' The buffalo is eating grass. Mr Ba is very happy. 'Thank you! You're such good neighbours!' That evening, he shares a big basket of fruit with Grandma's family.
en.baihat: In My Village + Friendly Neighbours (hát nối hai bài của unit) – giai điệu The Farmer in the Dell rồi Mary Had a Little Lamb: There's a hill near my house … hi-ho, the countryside … // Hello, hello, my neighbour friend, / neighbour friend, neighbour friend. / Hello, hello, my neighbour friend, / you're so friendly!

zh.flash: 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 农民 nóngmín, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 水牛 shuǐniú, 虫子 chóngzi, 蝴蝶 húdié, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 既…又… jì…yòu…
zh.slide: 1) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp (4 thẻ, con A đọc tiếng Anh, con B nói tiếng Trung): There is a forest near my village. → 我的村子旁边有一片森林。/ There is a buffalo in the field. → 田里有一头水牛。/ My neighbours are very friendly. → 我的邻居很友好。/ Please be quiet. → 请安静一点儿。2) Dự án nhỏ "我的村子": mỗi nhóm giới thiệu bản đồ làng bằng 4 câu: 村子旁边有___。/ 田里有___。/ 我的邻居很___。/ 我的村子既___又___。3) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 3 – đọc câu chọn tranh (5 câu): 山上有一些牛。/ 花上有一只蝴蝶。/ 树下有很多虫子。/ 别打扰外公。/ 农村既安静又漂亮。
zh.truyen: 水牛不见了（完整版） — 一天早上，邻居的水牛不见了。邻居很着急："我的水牛在哪儿？"Nhan和表哥说："别着急，我们一起帮你找吧！"他们先去了田里，田里只有很多虫子。他们又去了山上，山上有一些牛，可是没有水牛。表哥说："你看！水牛在森林旁边吃草呢！"邻居很高兴："谢谢你们！你们既聪明又友好！"晚上，邻居送给外婆一些新鲜的水果。外婆说："我们两家的关系真亲密！" (Shuǐniú bù jiàn le (wánzhěng bǎn) — Yī tiān zǎoshang, línjū de shuǐniú bù jiàn le. Línjū hěn zháojí: "Wǒ de shuǐniú zài nǎr?" Nhan hé biǎogē shuō: "Bié zháojí, wǒmen yīqǐ bāng nǐ zhǎo ba!" Tāmen xiān qùle tián li, tián li zhǐ yǒu hěn duō chóngzi. Tāmen yòu qùle shān shang, shān shang yǒu yīxiē niú, kěshì méiyǒu shuǐniú. Biǎogē shuō: "Nǐ kàn! Shuǐniú zài sēnlín pángbiān chī cǎo ne!" Línjū hěn gāoxìng: "Xièxie nǐmen! Nǐmen jì cōngming yòu yǒuhǎo!" Wǎnshang, línjū sòng gěi wàipó yīxiē xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ. Wàipó shuō: "Wǒmen liǎng jiā de guānxi zhēn qīnmì!")
zh.baihat: 农村好 + 好邻居 (hát nối hai bài của unit) – giai điệu 两只老虎 rồi 小星星: 农村农村，空气新鲜，真好玩，真好玩 … // 我家旁边有邻居，邻居个个很友好。外公睡觉要安静，大家不要去打扰。(Nóngcūn nóngcūn, kōngqì xīnxiān, zhēn hǎowán, zhēn hǎowán … // Wǒ jiā pángbiān yǒu línjū, línjū gègè hěn yǒuhǎo. Wàigōng shuìjiào yào ānjìng, dàjiā bùyào qù dǎrǎo.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 15. Unit 4 · City Life – Cuộc sống thành phố (1/4): Địa điểm trong thành phố, địa chỉ, so sánh hơn

web.label: Ngày 29. Unit 4 · Thành phố của Anna – bảo tàng, nhà hát, cây cầu

en.tu: Mới: museum, theatre, bank, bridge, airport | Ôn: cinema, library, hospital, supermarket, city, building, street
en.cum: go to the museum / a theatre in the city centre / a big bank / cross the bridge / at the airport
en.cau: What's city life like? / [Ngữ pháp: There is + giới từ (ôn Unit 3)] There is a big museum near the bridge. / We went to the theatre on Saturday. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn more … than] The museum is more beautiful than the bank. / My uncle works at the airport.
en.truyen: Anna's City — Anna lives in the city. 'What's city life like?' asks Nhan. 'It's great! There is a big museum near the bridge, and there is a theatre in the city centre. My dad works in a bank.' On Sunday they cross the bridge and go to the museum. 'The museum is more beautiful than the bank!' says Nhan.

zh.tu: Mới: 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 馆 guǎn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 酒店 jiǔdiàn, 机场 jīchǎng, 城市 chéngshì, 生活 shēnghuó | Ôn: 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 超市 chāoshì, 医院 yīyuàn, 商店 shāngdiàn, 动物园 dòngwùyuán
zh.cum: 去博物馆 / 去电影院看电影 / 住酒店 / 去机场 / 城市生活
zh.cau: 城市生活怎么样？(Chéngshì shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?) / 城市里有博物馆、电影院和酒店。(Chéngshì li yǒu bówùguǎn, diànyǐngyuàn hé jiǔdiàn.) / 我们星期六去电影院看电影。(Wǒmen xīngqīliù qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng.) / 叔叔在机场工作。(Shūshu zài jīchǎng gōngzuò.) / 图书馆和博物馆都有一个"馆"字。(Túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu yǒu yī gè "guǎn" zì.)
zh.truyen: 城市生活 — Xiaomei住在城市。Nhan问："城市生活怎么样？"Xiaomei说："很好玩！城市里有博物馆、电影院，还有很多大酒店。我叔叔在机场工作。"星期天，他们一起去博物馆，然后去电影院看电影。 (Chéngshì shēnghuó — Xiaomei zhù zài chéngshì. Nhan wèn: "Chéngshì shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?" Xiaomei shuō: "Hěn hǎowán! Chéngshì li yǒu bówùguǎn, diànyǐngyuàn, hái yǒu hěn duō dà jiǔdiàn. Wǒ shūshu zài jīchǎng gōngzuò." Xīngqītiān, tāmen yīqǐ qù bówùguǎn, ránhòu qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "城市 地方 儿歌"

web.label: Ngày 30. Unit 4 · Đồn cảnh sát, trạm cứu hỏa – địa chỉ nhà con

en.tu: Mới: police station, fire station, fire fighter, factory, motorway, platform | Ôn: museum, theatre, bank, bridge, airport, police officer, bus station, car park, brave
en.cum: the police station / the fire station / a brave fire fighter / a big factory / a busy motorway / on platform 3
en.cau: The police station is next to the fire station. / A fire fighter works at the fire station. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn -er than] The motorway is busier than our street. / The train is at platform 3. / There is a factory near the bridge.
en.truyen: A Visit to the Fire Station — Leo's class visits the fire station. A brave fire fighter shows them the big red fire engine. 'Next to us is the police station,' he says. 'We often work together.' Suddenly, the bell rings! The fire fighters jump into the fire engine and drive to the motorway. 'Fire fighters are so brave!' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "fire station field trip for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 警察局 jǐngchájú, 桥 qiáo, 地址 dìzhǐ, 附近 fùjìn | Ôn: 警察 jǐngchá, 车站 chēzhàn, 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 机场 jīchǎng, 城市 chéngshì
zh.cum: 去警察局 / 过桥 / 你家的地址 / 学校附近
zh.cau: 警察局在哪儿？– 在桥旁边。(Jǐngchájú zài nǎr? – Zài qiáo pángbiān.) / 你家的地址是什么？(Nǐ jiā de dìzhǐ shì shénme?) / 我家附近有一个电影院。(Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yī gè diànyǐngyuàn.) / 过了桥，就是博物馆。(Guòle qiáo, jiù shì bówùguǎn.)
zh.truyen: 去警察局 — Leo的书包丢了。他和爸爸去警察局。警察问："你家的地址是什么？"Leo说了地址。警察说："你家附近有一座桥，是不是？我们找到了一个书包，在桥旁边！"Leo说："是我的！谢谢！" (Qù jǐngchájú — Leo de shūbāo diū le. Tā hé bàba qù jǐngchájú. Jǐngchá wèn: "Nǐ jiā de dìzhǐ shì shénme?" Leo shuōle dìzhǐ. Jǐngchá shuō: "Nǐ jiā fùjìn yǒu yī zuò qiáo, shì bu shì? Wǒmen zhǎodàole yī gè shūbāo, zài qiáo pángbiān!" Leo shuō: "Shì wǒ de! Xièxie!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "警察 儿歌"

en.flash: museum, theatre, bank, bridge, airport, police station, fire station, fire fighter, factory, motorway, platform, cinema, library, hospital
en.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm vào địa điểm trên bản đồ thành phố (6 câu): The museum is near the bridge. / The theatre is in the city centre. / The bank is next to the café. / The airport is far from the city. / The police station is next to the fire station. / The factory is near the motorway. 2) Nối người với nơi làm việc (4 cặp): fire fighter – fire station / police officer – police station / pilot – airport / train driver – platform. 3) So sánh hơn theo tranh (3 câu): The airport is bigger than the bank. / The museum is more beautiful than the factory. / The motorway is busier than our street.
en.truyen: Uncle Minh's City — Uncle Minh works at the airport. Every morning he drives on the motorway, past a big factory and over the bridge. Near the airport there is a fire station and a police station. On Saturdays he takes Nhan to the museum or the theatre. 'City life is busier than village life,' says Uncle Minh, 'but it's fun!'
en.baihat: In the City – giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus: The bus in the city goes over the bridge, / over the bridge, over the bridge. / The bus in the city goes over the bridge, / all through the town. // We see the museum and the bank, / museum and the bank, museum and the bank … // The fire fighters drive to the fire station, / all through the town!

zh.flash: 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 馆 guǎn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 酒店 jiǔdiàn, 机场 jīchǎng, 城市 chéngshì, 生活 shēnghuó, 警察局 jǐngchájú, 桥 qiáo, 地址 dìzhǐ, 附近 fùjìn
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chạm địa điểm trên bản đồ (6 câu): 这是博物馆。/ 那是电影院。/ 这是一个大酒店。/ 机场在城市外面。/ 警察局在桥旁边。/ 我家附近有一个电影院。2) Đọc thẻ địa chỉ – chọn ngôi nhà đúng (3 thẻ): 我家的地址是：学校路5号。/ 我家的地址是：桥路8号。/ 我家的地址是：公园路3号。3) Hỏi đáp theo cặp: 你家附近有什么？– 我家附近有___。/ 你家的地址是什么？– 我家的地址是___。
zh.truyen: 在城市的一天 — 星期六，Xiaomei带Nhan去城市玩。他们先过桥去博物馆，然后去电影院看电影。中午，他们在一个大酒店附近吃饭。Xiaomei说："我叔叔在机场工作，机场也在附近。警察局就在桥旁边。"Nhan说："城市生活真有意思！" (Zài chéngshì de yī tiān — Xīngqīliù, Xiaomei dài Nhan qù chéngshì wán. Tāmen xiān guò qiáo qù bówùguǎn, ránhòu qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng. Zhōngwǔ, tāmen zài yī gè dà jiǔdiàn fùjìn chī fàn. Xiaomei shuō: "Wǒ shūshu zài jīchǎng gōngzuò, jīchǎng yě zài fùjìn. Jǐngchájú jiù zài qiáo pángbiān." Nhan shuō: "Chéngshì shēnghuó zhēn yǒu yìsi!")
zh.baihat: 城市歌 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 博物馆呀，电影院呀，在附近，在附近。过桥就是机场，旁边有警察局，真好玩，真好玩。(Bówùguǎn ya, diànyǐngyuàn ya, zài fùjìn, zài fùjìn. Guò qiáo jiù shì jīchǎng, pángbiān yǒu jǐngchájú, zhēn hǎowán, zhēn hǎowán.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 16. Unit 4 · City Life – Cuộc sống thành phố (2/4): So sánh thành phố – làng quê, nghề nghiệp, lạc đường · Luyện YCT口试（中级）第二部分

web.label: Ngày 31. Unit 4 · Thành phố và làng quê – ồn ào, đông đúc

en.tu: Mới: noisy, crowd, entrance, exit, journey | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): hill, butterfly, friendly, peaceful, fresh, stream, neighbour | Ôn: museum, bridge
en.cum: a noisy street / a big crowd / the entrance of the museum / the exit / a long journey
en.cau: The city is lively but crowded. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn -er than] The city is noisier than the countryside. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn -er than] The air in the countryside is fresher than in the city. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh phủ định not as … as] The countryside is not as crowded as the city. / There is a big crowd at the entrance of the museum. The exit is on the left.
en.truyen: Back to the City — Nhan's journey back to the city is long. When he arrives, the streets are very noisy. 'The city is lively but crowded,' he says. 'The countryside is more peaceful, and the air is fresher.' At the museum, there is a big crowd at the entrance. 'Let's use the other entrance!' says Dad. Inside, there are butterflies from the countryside!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "city and countryside for kids comparing"

zh.tu: Mới: 热闹 rènao, 拥挤 yōngjǐ, 一样 yīyàng, 离 lí | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): 安静 ānjìng, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 既…又… jì…yòu…, 农村 nóngcūn, 新鲜 xīnxiān | Ôn: 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 附近 fùjìn
zh.cum: 很热闹 / 很拥挤 / 和…一样 / 离学校很近 / 离家很远
zh.cau: 城市生活怎么样？(Chéngshì shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?) / 城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。(Chéngshì hěn rènao, dànshì hěn yōngjǐ.) / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn A比B + tính từ] 农村的空气比城市新鲜。(Nóngcūn de kōngqì bǐ chéngshì xīnxiān.) / [Ngữ pháp: phủ định so sánh A没有B那么 + tính từ] 农村没有城市那么拥挤。(Nóngcūn méiyǒu chéngshì nàme yōngjǐ.) / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh bằng A和B一样 + tính từ] 这个博物馆和那个酒店一样大。(Zhège bówùguǎn hé nàge jiǔdiàn yīyàng dà.) / 我家离学校很近。(Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.)
zh.truyen: 回城市 — 寒假完了，Nhan从农村回到城市。城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。Nhan说："农村比城市安静，空气也比城市新鲜。"妈妈说："可是我们家离学校很近，离博物馆也不远。"Nhan想了想："城市和农村一样好！" (Huí chéngshì — Hánjià wán le, Nhan cóng nóngcūn huídào chéngshì. Chéngshì hěn rènao, dànshì hěn yōngjǐ. Nhan shuō: "Nóngcūn bǐ chéngshì ānjìng, kōngqì yě bǐ chéngshì xīnxiān." Māma shuō: "Kěshì wǒmen jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, lí bówùguǎn yě bù yuǎn." Nhan xiǎngle xiǎng: "Chéngshì hé nóngcūn yīyàng hǎo!")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "城市和农村 儿童 汉语"

web.label: Ngày 32. Unit 4 · Nghề trong thành phố – lạc đường trong công viên

en.tu: Mới: artist, designer, photographer, journalist | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): castle, cave, eagle, view, creature, dinosaur | Ôn: noisy, crowd, journey, take a photo
en.cum: a famous artist / a clothes designer / a photographer takes photos / a journalist writes for the newspaper
en.cau: An artist paints pictures. / A photographer takes photos. / A journalist writes stories for the newspaper. / A designer makes new clothes. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh bằng as … as] My aunt is as busy as my uncle. / The photographer took a photo of the view from the castle.
en.truyen: People in the City — Anna's mum is a designer. She makes beautiful clothes. Her neighbour is an artist and paints pictures of the city. Anna's uncle is a photographer, and her aunt is a journalist. One day they all go to the old castle on the hill. The artist paints the view, the photographer takes photos, and the journalist writes a story. 'What a team!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "jobs song for kids artist photographer"

zh.tu: Mới: 迷路 mílù, 草地 cǎodì, 健身 jiànshēn | Ôn (từ nối Unit 3): 打扰 dǎrǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 虫子 chóngzi, 蝴蝶 húdié, 水牛 shuǐniú | Ôn: 热闹 rènao, 拥挤 yōngjǐ, 离 lí, 一样 yīyàng
zh.cum: 在城市里迷路 / 公园的草地 / 去健身 / 健身房
zh.cau: 我在城市里迷路了。(Wǒ zài chéngshì li mílù le.) / 别着急，我帮你。(Bié zháojí, wǒ bāng nǐ.) / 公园的草地上有很多蝴蝶。(Gōngyuán de cǎodì shang yǒu hěn duō húdié.) / 爸爸每天晚上去健身房健身。(Bàba měitiān wǎnshang qù jiànshēnfáng jiànshēn.) / [Ngữ pháp: A比B + tính từ] 城市的公园比农村的田小。(Chéngshì de gōngyuán bǐ nóngcūn de tián xiǎo.)
zh.truyen: 迷路了 — 星期天，Nhan和爸爸去公园。公园里人很多，很拥挤。Nhan去草地上看蝴蝶，回来的时候，他找不到爸爸了。他迷路了！他问一个警察："对不起，打扰一下，我迷路了。"警察带他去公园门口，爸爸就在那儿！ (Mílù le — Xīngqītiān, Nhan hé bàba qù gōngyuán. Gōngyuán li rén hěn duō, hěn yōngjǐ. Nhan qù cǎodì shang kàn húdié, huílai de shíhou, tā zhǎo bu dào bàba le. Tā mílù le! Tā wèn yī gè jǐngchá: "Duìbuqǐ, dǎrǎo yīxià, wǒ mílù le." Jǐngchá dài tā qù gōngyuán ménkǒu, bàba jiù zài nàr!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "迷路了怎么办 儿童 安全"

en.flash: noisy, crowd, entrance, exit, journey, artist, designer, photographer, journalist, peaceful, fresh, friendly, view
en.slide: 1) So sánh thành phố – làng quê: chọn từ đúng (5 câu): The city is ___ (noisier / quieter) than the countryside. / The countryside is more ___ (peaceful / noisy). / The air in the countryside is ___ (fresher / noisier). / The countryside is not as ___ (crowded / fresh) as the city. / The city is lively but ___ (crowded / peaceful). 2) Nối nghề với việc làm (4 cặp): artist – paints pictures / photographer – takes photos / journalist – writes stories / designer – makes clothes. 3) Nghe chỉ đường – chọn cửa Entrance hay Exit trên sơ đồ bảo tàng (3 câu): Go in through the entrance. / The exit is on the left. / Meet me at the exit.
en.truyen: Lost in the Crowd — The museum is very crowded today. Leo and his class go in through the entrance. There's a photographer and a journalist from a newspaper. Suddenly, Leo can't see his class! The museum is noisy and there's a big crowd. A friendly artist helps him. 'Let's go to the exit. Your teacher will wait there.' Leo finds his class at the exit. 'What a journey!' he says.
en.baihat: City or Countryside? – giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star: In the city, noisy streets, / lots of people, crowds I meet. / In the countryside, fresh and green, / the most peaceful place I've seen. / City, countryside, which is best? / Both are great! Now let's have a rest.

zh.flash: 热闹 rènao, 拥挤 yōngjǐ, 一样 yīyàng, 离 lí, 迷路 mílù, 草地 cǎodì, 健身 jiànshēn, 城市 chéngshì, 农村 nóngcūn, 安静 ānjìng, 新鲜 xīnxiān
zh.slide: 1) Chọn mẫu so sánh đúng – 比 / 没有…那么 / 和…一样 / 离 (5 câu): 农村的空气___城市新鲜。/ 农村___城市___拥挤。/ 这个博物馆___那个酒店___大。/ 城市___农村热闹。/ 我家___学校很近。2) Tình huống bị lạc – sắp xếp câu thoại đúng thứ tự (4 câu): 对不起，打扰一下。/ 我迷路了。/ 我家的地址是学校路5号。/ 谢谢警察叔叔！3) Hỏi đáp theo cặp: 你家离学校远吗？– 我家离学校___。/ 城市生活怎么样？– 城市很___，但是很___。 2) YCT口试（中级）第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu, 2 tranh, từng em nói một đoạn 4–5 câu): Tranh 1 – thành phố: 这是一个大城市。城市里有博物馆、电影院和一座桥。路上的人很多。城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。/ Tranh 2 – bạn nhỏ bị lạc: 一个孩子在公园里迷路了。他很害怕。一个警察问他：“你家的地址是什么？”孩子说：“我家离公园不远。”警察带他回家了。
zh.truyen: 城市和农村 — Nhan和Xiaomei在说城市和农村。Xiaomei说："城市很热闹，有博物馆，有电影院，还可以去健身。"Nhan说："可是城市很拥挤，我在公园里还迷路了！农村没有城市那么拥挤，草地上还有很多蝴蝶。"老师说："城市和农村一样好，你们说对吗？" (Chéngshì hé nóngcūn — Nhan hé Xiaomei zài shuō chéngshì hé nóngcūn. Xiaomei shuō: "Chéngshì hěn rènao, yǒu bówùguǎn, yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, hái kěyǐ qù jiànshēn." Nhan shuō: "Kěshì chéngshì hěn yōngjǐ, wǒ zài gōngyuán li hái mílù le! Nóngcūn méiyǒu chéngshì nàme yōngjǐ, cǎodì shang hái yǒu hěn duō húdié." Lǎoshī shuō: "Chéngshì hé nóngcūn yīyàng hǎo, nǐmen shuō duì ma?")
zh.baihat: 比一比 – giai điệu 小星星 (Twinkle Twinkle Little Star): 城市热闹又拥挤，农村安静又美丽。城市比农村热闹，农村比城市安静。城市农村一样好，我们都爱我的家。(Chéngshì rènao yòu yōngjǐ, nóngcūn ānjìng yòu měilì. Chéngshì bǐ nóngcūn rènao, nóngcūn bǐ chéngshì ānjìng. Chéngshì nóngcūn yīyàng hǎo, wǒmen dōu ài wǒ de jiā.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 17. Unit 4 · City Life – Cuộc sống thành phố (3/4): Nghề nghiệp, Vạn Lý Trường Thành, as … as / 一样, ôn không tranh

web.label: Ngày 33. Unit 4 · Người làm kinh doanh, quản lý, thợ máy

en.tu: Mới: business, businessman/woman, manager, mechanic | Ôn: artist, designer, photographer, journalist, factory, bank, airport, repair
en.cum: a small business / a businesswoman in the city / the manager of the hotel / a car mechanic
en.cau: Leo's mum has got a small business. / She is a businesswoman. / The manager of the hotel is very friendly. / A mechanic repairs cars. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh bằng as … as] The bank is as big as the hotel.
en.truyen: Leo's Mum's Business — Leo's mum is a businesswoman. She has got a small business in the city: a café near the bank. The manager of the café is Mr Long. One day, Mum's car doesn't start. 'Call the mechanic!' says Mr Long. The mechanic comes and repairs the car. 'City life is so busy!' laughs Leo's mum.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "jobs vocabulary for kids mechanic manager"

zh.tu: Mới: 长城 Chángchéng, 大海 dàhǎi | Ôn: 迷路 mílù, 草地 cǎodì, 健身 jiànshēn, 热闹 rènao, 拥挤 yōngjǐ, 一样 yīyàng, 离 lí, 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 机场 jīchǎng, 酒店 jiǔdiàn
zh.cum: 去长城 / 看大海 / 离大海很近 / 坐飞机去北京
zh.cau: 你去过长城吗？(Nǐ qùguo Chángchéng ma?) / 长城很长，也很有名。(Chángchéng hěn cháng, yě hěn yǒumíng.) / 我家离大海很近。(Wǒ jiā lí dàhǎi hěn jìn.) / [Ngữ pháp: A没有B那么 + tính từ] 城市的公园没有大海那么大。(Chéngshì de gōngyuán méiyǒu dàhǎi nàme dà.) / [Ngữ pháp: A和B一样 + tính từ] 这个酒店和博物馆一样高。(Zhège jiǔdiàn hé bówùguǎn yīyàng gāo.)
zh.truyen: 去北京 — 放假了，Xiaomei和爸爸妈妈坐飞机去北京。机场很大，人很多，很拥挤。在北京，他们去了长城。长城上人山人海！Xiaomei说："长城真长！"回来以后，他们又去海边看大海。 (Qù Běijīng — Fàngjià le, Xiaomei hé bàba māma zuò fēijī qù Běijīng. Jīchǎng hěn dà, rén hěn duō, hěn yōngjǐ. Zài Běijīng, tāmen qùle Chángchéng. Chángchéng shang rénshān-rénhǎi! Xiaomei shuō: "Chángchéng zhēn cháng!" Huílai yǐhòu, tāmen yòu qù hǎibiān kàn dàhǎi.)

zh.truyen: 长城上人山人海 — 星期天，Xiaomei和妈妈去长城。长城上人山人海，非常热闹。人太多了，妈妈说："跟着我，别迷路！"她们一边走，一边看，长城真长啊！下了长城，她们去附近的酒店休息。Xiaomei说："长城和大海一样，都很美！" (Chángchéng shang rénshān-rénhǎi — Xīngqītiān, Xiaomei hé māma qù Chángchéng. zh.baihat: 长城长 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 长城长呀，长城长呀，真有名，真有名。大海大呀大海，大海蓝呀大海，真美丽，真美丽。(Chángchéng cháng ya, Chángchéng cháng ya, zhēn yǒumíng, zhēn yǒumíng. Dàhǎi dà ya dàhǎi, dàhǎi lán ya dàhǎi, zhēn měilì, zhēn měilì.)

en.slide: 1) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp (4 thẻ, con A đọc tiếng Trung, con B nói tiếng Anh): 城市生活怎么样？→ What's city life like? / 城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。→ The city is lively but crowded. / 农村没有城市那么拥挤。→ The countryside is not as crowded as the city. / 博物馆比酒店漂亮。→ The museum is more beautiful than the hotel. 2) Dự án nhỏ 'City or Countryside?': mỗi nhóm làm poster 2 cột, nói 4 câu so sánh: The city is noisier than the countryside. / The countryside is more peaceful. / The air in the countryside is fresher. / The countryside is not as crowded as the city. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh Unit 4 – nghe chọn tranh (5 câu): The museum is near the bridge. / The fire fighter works at the fire station. / There's a big crowd at the entrance. / A mechanic repairs cars. / The train is at platform 3. 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): hỏi – đáp trao đổi thông tin về hai địa điểm. Cô: 'Anna and Leo went to two places in the city. I don't know about the City Museum, so ask me some questions.' Con hỏi: Where is the museum? – Near the bridge. / What can you see there? – Old cars and dinosaurs. / What time does it open? – At nine o'clock. / How much is a ticket? – Five pounds. / Is it noisy? – No, it's quiet. Rồi cô hỏi về The Star Theatre, con trả lời theo thẻ: next to the police station / You can watch plays. / at seven o'clock / eight pounds / It's very busy.
en.truyen: Uncle Minh's City Day (bản đầy đủ) — Uncle Minh and his wife take Nhan and Bông to the city. The journey is long and the motorway is noisy. They cross the bridge and go to the museum. There's a big crowd at the entrance, so they use the other entrance. Inside, there are old clothes of a king and a queen, and a photographer is taking photos. 'The queen's dress looks like a flower!' says Bông. 'Is there enough time for the theatre?' asks Nhan. 'Of course!' says Uncle Minh. They leave through the exit and walk past the bank to the theatre. 'City life is noisier than village life, but it's so exciting!' says Nhan.

Zhōngwǔ, tāmen zài jiǔdiàn fùjìn chī fàn. Āyí wèn: "Shíjiān gòu bu gòu? Wǒmen hái qù diànyǐngyuàn ma?" Shūshu shuō: "Gòu! Diànyǐngyuàn lí zhèr hěn jìn." Huí jiā de shíhou, Nhan shuō: "Chéngshì bǐ nóngcūn rènao, nóngcūn bǐ chéngshì ānjìng. Chéngshì hé nóngcūn yīyàng hǎo!")
zh.baihat: 城市歌 + 比一比 (hát nối hai bài của unit) – giai điệu 两只老虎 rồi 小星星: 博物馆呀，电影院呀，在附近，在附近 … // 城市热闹又拥挤，农村安静又美丽。城市比农村热闹，农村比城市安静。(Bówùguǎn ya, diànyǐngyuàn ya, zài fùjìn, zài fùjìn … // Chéngshì rènao yòu yōngjǐ, nóngcūn ānjìng yòu měilì. Chéngshì bǐ nóngcūn rènao, nóngcūn bǐ chéngshì ānjìng.)

en.tu: Ôn (Unit 1): husband, wife, married, niece, nephew, grandchild, surname, look like, as, of course, ever, king, queen, repair, hole, enough, finish, such | Ôn (Unit 2): timetable, uniform, textbook, workbook, dictionary, primary, junior, senior, high, gym, together, club, join a club, member, group, share, competition, prize, winner, letter, ring, file, screen, explain, repeat, suddenly
en.cum: Nhan's uncle / work as a nurse / such a big family / join a club / check your timetable / win a prize / repeat after me
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi isn't he?] He is your uncle, isn't he? – Yes, he is. / [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi doesn't he?] Your uncle works in a school, doesn't he? – No, he doesn't. / [Ngữ pháp: câu mệnh lệnh] Open your textbooks, please. Don't forget your workbook. / [Ngữ pháp: câu đề nghị Let's …] Let's join the English club together!
en.truyen: Uncle Minh's Visit — Uncle Minh visits Nhan's primary school. 'He is your uncle, isn't he?' asks Anna. 'Of course! He works as a teacher at a junior high school.' Uncle Minh explains a new game to the English club. 'Work in groups and share your dictionaries.' Suddenly, the bell rings. Nhan's group is the winner! 'You've got such a clever nephew!' says the teacher.

zh.tu: Ôn (Unit 1): 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē, 儿子 érzi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 孩子 háizi, 孙子 sūnzi, 孙女 sūnnǚ, 亲戚 qīnqi, 护士 hùshi, 售票员 shòupiàoyuán, 俩 liǎ, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 别人 biérén, 另外 lìngwài, 够 gòu, 无论 wúlùn, 一边…一边… yībiān…yībiān… | Ôn (Unit 2): 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 校服 xiàofú, 练习册 liànxícè, 练习 liànxí, 小学 xiǎoxué, 初中 chūzhōng, 高中 gāozhōng, 毕业 bìyè, 介绍 jièshào, 参加 cānjiā, 努力 nǔlì, 句子 jùzi, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 成绩 chéngjì, 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià
zh.cum: Nhan的叔叔 / 一边做饭一边唱歌 / 穿上校服 / 别忘了练习册 / 一起复习
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 是不是？] 他是你的外公，是不是？– 是。(Tā shì nǐ de wàigōng, shì bu shì? – Shì.) / [Ngữ pháp: 一边…一边…] 外婆一边做饭，一边唱歌。(Wàipó yībiān zuò fàn, yībiān chàng gē.) / [Ngữ pháp: 请 / 别 + động từ] 请打开你们的课本，别忘了你的练习册。(Qǐng dǎkāi nǐmen de kèběn, bié wàngle nǐ de liànxícè.) / [Ngữ pháp: 我们一起…吧] 我们一起去图书馆复习吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù túshūguǎn fùxí ba.)
zh.truyen: 阿姨来学校 — Nhan的阿姨是护士，今天她来学校给孩子们上课。老师说："我来介绍一下，这是Nhan的阿姨。"阿姨一边说，一边写句子。她问："大家明白了吗？"孩子们说："明白了！"下课以后，Xiaomei说："你阿姨好像老师，是不是？"Nhan说："是！她也很努力。" (Āyí lái xuéxiào — Nhan de āyí shì hùshi, jīntiān tā lái xuéxiào gěi háizimen shàngkè. Lǎoshī shuō: "Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, zhè shì Nhan de āyí." Āyí yībiān shuō, yībiān xiě jùzi. Tā wèn: "Dàjiā míngbai le ma?" Háizimen shuō: "Míngbai le!" Xiàkè yǐhòu, Xiaomei shuō: "Nǐ āyí hǎoxiàng lǎoshī, shì bu shì?" Nhan shuō: "Shì! Tā yě hěn nǔlì.")

web.label: Ngày 38. Ôn chặng 1 · Quét lại Unit 3 (Làng quê) và Unit 4 (Thành phố)

en.tu: Ôn (Unit 3): hill, path, stream, pond, view, buffalo, fresh, peaceful, butterfly, insect, beetle, neighbour, friendly, relationship, nest, eagle, castle, cave, tortoise, creature, dinosaur, extinct, camel, pyramid, octopus | Ôn (Unit 4): museum, theatre, bank, bridge, airport, police station, fire station, fire fighter, factory, motorway, platform, noisy, crowd, entrance, exit, journey, artist, designer, photographer, journalist, business, businessman/woman, manager, mechanic
en.cum: on the hill / near the pond / friendly neighbours / cross the bridge / a big crowd / at the entrance
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: There is / There are + giới từ] There is a forest near my village. There are some cows on the hill. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh hơn -er / more … than] The city is noisier than the countryside. The countryside is more peaceful. / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh bằng as … as] This museum is as big as that hotel. / [Ngữ pháp: not as … as] The countryside is not as crowded as the city.
en.truyen: Two Places, Two Friends — Anna lives in the city and Nhan's grandma lives in the countryside. 'In my city there is a big museum near the bridge. It's lively but noisy,' says Anna. 'In Grandma's village there is a hill, a stream and lots of butterflies. It's not as crowded as the city, and the air is fresher,' says Nhan. 'Let's visit both places together!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "city vs countryside for kids English"

zh.tu: Ôn (Unit 3): 农村 nóngcūn, 田 tián, 农民 nóngmín, 村子 cūnzi, 森林 sēnlín, 水牛 shuǐniú, 虫子 chóngzi, 蝴蝶 húdié, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān, 邻居 línjū, 友好 yǒuhǎo, 亲密 qīnmì, 关系 guānxi, 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 既…又… jì…yòu… | Ôn (Unit 4): 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 馆 guǎn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 酒店 jiǔdiàn, 机场 jīchǎng, 警察局 jǐngchájú, 桥 qiáo, 地址 dìzhǐ, 附近 fùjìn, 热闹 rènao, 拥挤 yōngjǐ, 一样 yīyàng, 离 lí, 迷路 mílù, 草地 cǎodì, 健身 jiànshēn, 长城 Chángchéng, 大海 dàhǎi
zh.cum: 山上有牛 / 田里有水牛 / 既安静又漂亮 / 离学校很近 / 和…一样大
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: nơi chốn + 上/里 + 有] 山上有一些牛，田里有一头水牛。(Shān shang yǒu yīxiē niú, tián li yǒu yī tóu shuǐniú.) / [Ngữ pháp: 既…又…] 农村既安静又漂亮。(Nóngcūn jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang.) / [Ngữ pháp: A比B + tính từ] 农村的空气比城市新鲜。(Nóngcūn de kōngqì bǐ chéngshì xīnxiān.) / [Ngữ pháp: A没有B那么 + tính từ] 农村没有城市那么拥挤。(Nóngcūn méiyǒu chéngshì nàme yōngjǐ.) / [Ngữ pháp: A和B一样 + tính từ] 这个博物馆和那个酒店一样大。(Zhège bówùguǎn hé nàge jiǔdiàn yīyàng dà.)
zh.truyen: 城市还是农村 — Xiaomei住在城市，她家离博物馆很近，附近还有电影院。Nhan的外婆住在农村，村子旁边有一片森林，田里有水牛。Xiaomei说："城市很热闹。"Nhan说："农村没有城市那么拥挤，既安静又漂亮，邻居也很友好。"他们一起说："我们放假一起去农村吧！" (Chéngshì háishi nóngcūn — Xiaomei zhù zài chéngshì, tā jiā lí bówùguǎn hěn jìn, fùjìn hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn. Nhan de wàipó zhù zài nóngcūn, cūnzi pángbiān yǒu yī piàn sēnlín, tián li yǒu shuǐniú. Xiaomei shuō: "Chéngshì hěn rènao." Nhan shuō: "Nóngcūn méiyǒu chéngshì nàme yōngjǐ, jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang, línjū yě hěn yǒuhǎo." Tāmen yīqǐ shuō: "Wǒmen fàngjià yīqǐ qù nóngcūn ba!")

en.flash: Unit 1: husband, wife, niece, nephew, surname, look like, of course, ever, enough, such | Unit 2: timetable, uniform, dictionary, gym, together, member, winner, join a club, file, letter | Unit 3: hill, butterfly, friendly, neighbour, stream, castle | Unit 4: airport, bridge, museum, noisy, police station, fire station, fire fighter, theatre
en.slide: 1) Trò chơi 'Bánh xe ôn tập' – quay vào Unit nào trả lời câu của Unit đó (8 câu): He is your uncle, ___? / Don't forget your ___. / Let's go to the gym ___. / There ___ some cows on the hill. / My neighbours are very ___. / The city is ___ than the countryside. / The countryside is not as ___ as the city. / A fire fighter works at the ___. 2) Nghe và sắp xếp tranh theo truyện 'Two Places, Two Friends' (4 tranh). 3) Đóng vai theo cặp, mỗi cặp bốc 1 thẻ tình huống: giới thiệu người thân / rủ bạn vào câu lạc bộ / tả làng quê / so sánh thành phố và làng quê (mỗi tình huống 3 câu).
en.truyen: A Busy Term — This term, Nhan learned a lot. He made a family tree: 'He is my uncle. He is married, and his wife works as a nurse.' He joined the English club and was the winner of the spelling competition. He visited his grandma's peaceful village, with its hill, stream and friendly neighbours. Then he went back to the noisy city and visited the museum near the bridge. 'The city is lively, but the countryside is not as crowded,' he wrote in his diary.
en.baihat: Review Rap – giai điệu Frère Jacques: Family, school, family, school, / uncle, aunt, timetable! / Countryside, city, countryside, city, / hill and stream, museum, bridge! / Is it noisy? Is it peaceful? / Let's compare, let's compare!

zh.flash: Unit 1: 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 护士 hùshi, 售票员 shòupiàoyuán, 够 gòu, 一边…一边… yībiān…yībiān…, 无论 wúlùn | Unit 2: 词典 cídiǎn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 参加 cānjiā, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí | Unit 3: 邻居 línjū, 蝴蝶 húdié, 虫子 chóngzi, 安静 ānjìng, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 既…又… jì…yòu… | Unit 4: 附近 fùjìn, 离 lí, 一样 yīyàng, 迷路 mílù, 桥 qiáo, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 警察局 jǐngchájú
zh.slide: 1) Trò chơi "Bánh xe ôn tập" (8 câu, điền chỗ trống): 他是你的外公，___？/ 外婆___做饭，___唱歌。/ 请___你的词典。/ ___忘了你的练习册。/ 山___有一些牛。/ 农村___安静___漂亮。/ 农村的空气___城市新鲜。/ 这个博物馆和那个酒店___大。2) Ghép chữ Hán với pinyin (8 thẻ): 售票员 – shòupiàoyuán / 词典 – cídiǎn / 邻居 – línjū / 附近 – fùjìn / 迷路 – mílù / 清楚 – qīngchu / 一样 – yīyàng / 蝴蝶 – húdié. 3) Đóng vai theo thẻ tình huống (mỗi tình huống 3 câu): 介绍家人 / 在课堂上没听清楚 / 介绍村子 / 在城市里迷路。
zh.truyen: 这个学期 — 这个学期，Nhan学了很多。他给同学介绍了他的家：叔叔是售票员，阿姨是护士。他参加了运动会，考试的成绩也很好。寒假，他去了外婆的村子，村子既安静又漂亮，邻居们都很友好。回到城市，他在公园里迷路了，可是警察帮助了他。Nhan说："农村和城市一样好！" (Zhège xuéqī — Zhège xuéqī, Nhan xuéle hěn duō. Tā gěi tóngxué jièshàole tā de jiā: shūshu shì shòupiàoyuán, āyí shì hùshi. Tā cānjiāle yùndònghuì, kǎoshì de chéngjì yě hěn hǎo. Hánjià, tā qùle wàipó de cūnzi, cūnzi jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang, línjūmen dōu hěn yǒuhǎo. Huídào chéngshì, tā zài gōngyuán li mílù le, kěshì jǐngchá bāngzhùle tā. Nhan shuō: "Nóngcūn hé chéngshì yīyàng hǎo!")
zh.baihat: 复习歌 – giai điệu 两只老虎 (Two Tigers): 我的家人，我的学校，学过了，学过了。农村既静又美，城市热闹拥挤，一样好，一样好。(Wǒ de jiārén, wǒ de xuéxiào, xuéguo le, xuéguo le. Nóngcūn jì jìng yòu měi, chéngshì rènao yōngjǐ, yīyàng hǎo, yīyàng hǎo.)

en.tu: Ôn (trọng tâm kiểm tra): uncle, aunt, niece, nephew, surname, look like, of course, timetable, uniform, dictionary, member, winner, hill, stream, butterfly, neighbour, friendly, museum, bridge, airport, noisy, crowd, fire station, police station, theatre

en.cau: [Dạng bài nghe – chọn tranh] Who is she? – She is Nhan's aunt. She works as a nurse. / [Dạng bài đọc – đúng/sai] Leo is a member of the football club. He is the winner. / [Dạng bài đọc – điền từ] There ___ a stream near the path. (is) / [Ngữ pháp: so sánh] The museum is ___ than the bank. (more beautiful)
en.truyen: Practice Test: Read and Answer — 'My name is Anna. My surname is Brown. I go to a primary school in the city. My aunt is a photographer, and my uncle is a mechanic. On Saturdays I go to the gym with my cousin. Last week I visited a village. There was a hill, a stream and lots of butterflies. It was not as noisy as the city!' (Câu hỏi: What's Anna's surname? / What does her uncle do? / What was there in the village? / Was the village noisier than the city?)

zh.tu: Ôn (trọng tâm kiểm tra): 叔叔 shūshu, 阿姨 āyí, 护士 hùshi, 孩子 háizi, 够 gòu, 词典 cídiǎn, 校服 xiàofú, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 明白 míngbai, 邻居 línjū, 蝴蝶 húdié, 安静 ānjìng, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr, 附近 fùjìn, 离 lí, 一样 yīyàng, 迷路 mílù, 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn
zh.cum: 是不是 / 一边…一边… / 我们一起…吧 / 既…又… / 比 / 没有…那么
zh.cau: [Dạng bài nghe – chọn tranh] 她是谁？– 她是Nhan的阿姨，她是护士。(Tā shì shéi? – Tā shì Nhan de āyí, tā shì hùshi.) / [Dạng bài đọc – đúng/sai] 下个星期有考试，我们今天一起复习。(Xià gè xīngqī yǒu kǎoshì, wǒmen jīntiān yīqǐ fùxí.) / [Dạng bài đọc – chọn từ] 我家___学校很近。(离) / [Dạng bài đọc – chọn từ] 农村___城市那么拥挤。(没有)
zh.truyen: 练习题：读一读，回答问题 — "我叫Xiaomei，我上小学三年级。我的叔叔是售票员，我的阿姨是护士。我家离学校很近，附近有一个电影院和一个博物馆。寒假我去了农村，农村既安静又漂亮，有很多蝴蝶。"（问题：Xiaomei上几年级？/ 她的阿姨做什么工作？/ 她家附近有什么？/ 农村怎么样？） (Liànxí tí: dú yi dú, huídá wèntí — "Wǒ jiào Xiaomei, wǒ shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí. Wǒ de shūshu shì shòupiàoyuán, wǒ de āyí shì hùshi. Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, fùjìn yǒu yī gè diànyǐngyuàn hé yī gè bówùguǎn. Hánjià wǒ qùle nóngcūn, nóngcūn jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang, yǒu hěn duō húdié." (Wèntí: Xiaomei shàng jǐ niánjí? / Tā de āyí zuò shénme gōngzuò? / Tā jiā fùjìn yǒu shénme? / Nóngcūn zěnmeyàng?))

en.tu: Ôn: husband, wife, grandchild, as, ever, enough, finish, such, primary, together, share, explain, repeat, peaceful, fresh, relationship, view, journey, entrance, exit, artist, designer, manager
en.cum: tell me about your family / what is there in your village / what is city life like
en.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí ZH → EN] 他是你的外公，是不是？(Tā shì nǐ de wàigōng, shì bu shì?) → He is your grandfather, isn't he? / 我们一起去操场吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng ba.) → Let's go to the playground together. / 我的邻居很友好。(Wǒ de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.) → My neighbours are very friendly. / 城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。(Chéngshì hěn rènao, dànshì hěn yōngjǐ.) → The city is lively but crowded. / [Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu): con nghe câu hỏi, ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói] What's your surname? – My surname is Nguyen. / Who do you look like? – I look like my mum. / Which club are you a member of? – I'm a member of the art club. / Which is better, the city or the countryside? – The countryside, because it's quieter.
en.truyen: Speaking Practice: My Story — 'Hello! I'm Nhan. I've got a big family. My uncle is married, and his wife works as a nurse. I go to a primary school and I'm a member of the English club. My grandma lives in a peaceful village with a beautiful view. I live in the city. It's noisier than the countryside, but it's exciting!' (Con tập nói theo 4 phần: gia đình – trường – làng quê – thành phố.)

zh.tu: Ôn: 外公 wàigōng, 外婆 wàipó, 表哥 biǎogē, 亲戚 qīnqi, 别人 biérén, 另外 lìngwài, 介绍 jièshào, 努力 nǔlì, 成绩 chéngjì, 寒假 hánjià, 农村 nóngcūn, 空气 kōngqì, 新鲜 xīnxiān, 关系 guānxi, 亲密 qīnmì, 热闹 rènao, 拥挤 yōngjǐ, 草地 cǎodì, 健身 jiànshēn, 长城 Chángchéng, 大海 dàhǎi
zh.cum: 我来介绍一下 / 你们村子里有什么 / 城市生活怎么样
zh.cau: [Phiên dịch nhí EN → ZH] She is your aunt, isn't she? → 她是你的阿姨，是不是？(Tā shì nǐ de āyí, shì bu shì?) / Open your textbooks, please. → 请打开你们的课本。(Qǐng dǎkāi nǐmen de kèběn.) / There are some cows on the hill. → 山上有一些牛。(Shān shang yǒu yīxiē niú.) / The countryside is not as crowded as the city. → 农村没有城市那么拥挤。(Nóngcūn méiyǒu chéngshì nàme yōngjǐ.) / [YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu): con đọc câu hỏi có pinyin, ghi âm câu trả lời 2–3 câu trên Trang luyện nói] 你家有几口人？(Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?) – 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、妹妹和我。爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。(Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: bàba, māma, mèimei hé wǒ. Bàba shì yīshēng, māma shì lǎoshī.)
zh.truyen: 口语练习：我的故事 — "大家好！我叫Nhan。我来介绍一下我的家：我有外公、外婆，还有很多亲戚。我上小学三年级，我学习很努力。寒假我去了农村，那儿的空气很新鲜，邻居很友好。我住在城市，城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。"（Con tập nói theo 4 phần: 家人 – 学校 – 农村 – 城市。） (Kǒuyǔ liànxí: wǒ de gùshi — "Dàjiā hǎo! Wǒ jiào Nhan. Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià wǒ de jiā: wǒ yǒu wàigōng, wàipó, hái yǒu hěn duō qīnqi. Wǒ shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí, wǒ xuéxí hěn nǔlì. Hánjià wǒ qùle nóngcūn, nàr de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān, línjū hěn yǒuhǎo. Wǒ zhù zài chéngshì, chéngshì hěn rènao, dànshì hěn yōngjǐ.")
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT 口语 自我介绍 儿童"

en.flash: Unit 1: as, ever, look like, of course, husband, wife, nephew, niece | Unit 2: dictionary, gym, high, member, timetable, together, uniform, winner, file, join a club, letter | Unit 3: butterfly, friendly, hill | Unit 4: airport, bridge, museum, noisy, fire fighter, fire station, police station, theatre
en.slide: 1) KIỂM TRA CHẶNG 1 – Phần Nghe (10 câu, chọn tranh A/B/C): He is Nhan's uncle. / She works as a nurse. / Open your textbooks. / Leo is the winner. / Let's go to the gym together. / There is a stream near the path. / There are butterflies near the pond. / The museum is near the bridge. / The city is noisier than the countryside. / The fire fighter works at the fire station. 2) Phần Đọc – Viết (10 câu): đọc đoạn 'My name is Anna…' trả lời 4 câu; điền 3 từ (enough / together / friendly); viết 3 câu so sánh city – countryside. 3) Phần Nói (mỗi con 2 phút với cô): Tell me about your family. / What is there in your village? / What's city life like? Cô ghi từ con còn quên vào Hộp ôn để quay lại ở Unit 5–8. 4) Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu, từng em với cô, 5 câu, tính vào Phần Nói): What's your surname? – My surname is … / Tell me about your family. – There are … people in my family. My uncle works as … / Who do you look like? – I look like my … / Which club are you a member of at school? – I'm a member of … / Which is better, the city or the countryside? Why? – I think the countryside is better because it's quieter.
en.truyen: Nhan's Diary: Test Day — Today we had our English test. First, I listened and chose the pictures. Then I read a story about Anna's family and her trip to a village. It was easy because I know the words 'surname', 'mechanic' and 'butterfly'. In the speaking test, I talked about my uncle and his wife, my English club and my grandma's peaceful village. 'Well done, Nhan! You're such a hard worker!' said my teacher.
en.baihat: We Did It! – giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat: Listen, read and speak, / we did our test today. / Family, school, and village, city, / hip, hip, hip, hooray!

zh.flash: Unit 1: 阿姨 āyí, 叔叔 shūshu, 儿子 érzi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 孙子 sūnzi, 护士 hùshi, 售票员 shòupiàoyuán, 俩 liǎ, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 无论 wúlùn, 一边…一边… yībiān…yībiān… | Unit 2: 毕业 bìyè, 参加 cānjiā, 初中 chūzhōng, 词典 cídiǎn, 考试 kǎoshì, 练习 liànxí, 明白 míngbai, 清楚 qīngchu, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 练习册 liànxícè | Unit 3: 安静 ānjìng, 虫子 chóngzi, 打扰 dǎrǎo, 蝴蝶 húdié, 既…又… jì…yòu…, 邻居 línjū, 一点儿 yīdiǎnr | Unit 4: 草地 cǎodì, 长城 Chángchéng, 大海 dàhǎi, 地址 dìzhǐ, 附近 fùjìn, 离 lí, 迷路 mílù, 桥 qiáo, 一样 yīyàng, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 警察局 jǐngchájú
zh.slide: 1) KIỂM TRA CHẶNG 1 – Phần Nghe (10 câu, chọn tranh A/B/C): 他是Nhan的叔叔。/ 我阿姨是护士。/ 外婆一边做饭，一边唱歌。/ 请打开你们的课本。/ 别忘了你的练习册。/ 田里有一头水牛。/ 花上有一只蝴蝶。/ 外公在睡觉，别打扰他。/ 我家离学校很近。/ 他在公园里迷路了。2) Phần Đọc (10 câu): đọc đoạn "我叫Xiaomei…" trả lời 4 câu; chọn từ điền chỗ trống (够 / 清楚 / 既…又… / 一样), 4 câu; ghép chữ Hán với pinyin, 2 câu. 3) Phần Nói (mỗi con 2 phút với cô): 介绍一下你的家。/ 你们村子里有什么？/ 城市生活怎么样？Cô ghi chữ con còn quên vào Hộp ôn. 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, tính vào Phần Nói; câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 你家有几口人？他们做什么工作？(Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén? Tāmen zuò shénme gōngzuò?) – Đoạn mẫu: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。我好像我妈妈。/ 你喜欢城市还是农村？为什么？(Nǐ xǐhuan chéngshì háishi nóngcūn? Wèishénme?) – Đoạn mẫu: 我喜欢农村。农村既安静又漂亮，空气也很新鲜。城市很热闹，但是很拥挤。
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的日记：考试那天 — 今天我们考汉语。先听，再读，最后说。考试以前，我和Anna一起复习了一个星期，所以我都听清楚了，也都明白了。说的时候，我介绍了我的家，我的学校，还有外婆的村子。老师说："Xiaomei很努力，成绩一定很好！"考试完了，我们一起去操场玩，真快乐！ (Xiaomei de rìjì: kǎoshì nà tiān — Jīntiān wǒmen kǎo Hànyǔ. Xiān tīng, zài dú, zuìhòu shuō. Kǎoshì yǐqián, wǒ hé Anna yīqǐ fùxíle yī gè xīngqī, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu tīng qīngchu le, yě dōu míngbai le. Shuō de shíhou, wǒ jièshàole wǒ de jiā, wǒ de xuéxiào, hái yǒu wàipó de cūnzi. Lǎoshī shuō: "Xiaomei hěn nǔlì, chéngjì yīdìng hěn hǎo!" Kǎoshì wán le, wǒmen yīqǐ qù cāochǎng wán, zhēn kuàilè!)
zh.baihat: 考完了 – giai điệu 小星星 (Twinkle Twinkle Little Star): 听一听来读一读，说一说来写一写。家人学校都学过，农村城市都说过。考试完了真快乐，我们一起唱唱歌。(Tīng yi tīng lái dú yi dú, shuō yi shuō lái xiě yi xiě. Jiārén xuéxiào dōu xuéguo, nóngcūn chéngshì dōu shuōguo. Kǎoshì wán le zhēn kuàilè, wǒmen yīqǐ chàngchang gē.)

web.label: Ngày 41. Unit 5 · Gỗ, nhựa, thủy tinh, kim loại

en.tu: Mới: wood, plastic, glass, metal | Ôn: cup, bottle, plate, castle
en.cum: Mới: made of wood / made of plastic / a glass cup / a metal box | Ôn: a cup of milk / a big plate
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: be made of – vẫn nhìn thấy chất liệu] What is it made of? / What is this cup made of? / This cup is made of glass. / The table is made of wood. / The chair is made of plastic.
en.truyen: What is it made of? — The teacher holds up a cup. 'What is this cup made of?' she asks. 'It's made of glass,' says Anna. Leo says, 'The table is made of wood and the chair is made of plastic.' 'Great!' says the teacher.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "materials for kids wood plastic glass metal"

zh.tu: Mới: 木头 mùtou, 塑料 sùliào, 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 开始 kāishǐ | Ôn: 杯子 bēizi, 桌子 zhuōzi, 椅子 yǐzi
zh.cum: Mới: 用木头做的 yòng mùtou zuò de / 用塑料做的 yòng sùliào zuò de / 玻璃杯子 bōli bēizi / 金属盒子 jīnshǔ hézi / 开始上课 kāishǐ shàngkè | Ôn: 一张桌子 yì zhāng zhuōzi / 一把椅子 yì bǎ yǐzi
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 是用 + chất liệu + 做的] 这是用什么做的？(Zhè shì yòng shénme zuò de?) / 这个杯子是用什么做的？(Zhège bēizi shì yòng shénme zuò de?) / 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。(Zhège bēizi shì yòng bōli zuò de.) / 这张桌子是用木头做的。(Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì yòng mùtou zuò de.) / 我们开始上课吧！(Wǒmen kāishǐ shàngkè ba!)
zh.truyen: 这是用什么做的？— 上课开始了。老师拿着一个杯子问：“这个杯子是用什么做的？”Anna说：“是用玻璃做的。”Leo说：“这张桌子是用木头做的，那把椅子是用塑料做的。”老师说：“很好！”(Shàngkè kāishǐ le. Lǎoshī názhe yí ge bēizi wèn: “Zhège bēizi shì yòng shénme zuò de?” Anna shuō: “Shì yòng bōli zuò de.” Leo shuō: “Zhè zhāng zhuōzi shì yòng mùtou zuò de, nà bǎ yǐzi shì yòng sùliào zuò de.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Hěn hǎo!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "材料 儿童 木头 塑料 玻璃 金属"

en.tu: Mới: wool, cotton, brick, everywhere | Ôn: sweater, blanket, wall, T-shirt
en.cum: Mới: a wool sweater / a cotton T-shirt / a brick wall / flowers everywhere | Ôn: a warm blanket / a glass bottle
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: be made of] My sweater is made of wool. / This T-shirt is made of cotton. / Grandma's house is made of brick. / There are flowers everywhere in the garden.
en.truyen: Grandma's house — Nhan visits Grandma. Her house is made of brick. Grandma gives Nhan a new sweater. 'It's made of wool,' she says. 'It's beautiful!' says Nhan. There are flowers everywhere in Grandma's garden.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "where does wool come from for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 纸 zhǐ, 砖 zhuān, 到处 dàochù, 啊 a | Ôn: 衣服 yīfu, 房子 fángzi, 外面 wàimiàn
zh.cum: Mới: 用纸做的 yòng zhǐ zuò de / 用砖做的房子 yòng zhuān zuò de fángzi / 到处都是花 dàochù dōu shì huā / 好漂亮啊 hǎo piàoliang a | Ôn: 一件衣服 yí jiàn yīfu / 在外面 zài wàimiàn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 是用……做的] 这本书是用纸做的。(Zhè běn shū shì yòng zhǐ zuò de.) / 奶奶的房子是用砖做的。(Nǎinai de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de.) / 外面到处都是花。(Wàimiàn dàochù dōu shì huā.) / 这件衣服好漂亮啊！(Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎo piàoliang a!)
zh.truyen: 奶奶的房子 — Nhan去看奶奶。奶奶的房子是用砖做的。奶奶送给Nhan一件新衣服。Nhan说：“好漂亮啊！”奶奶家外面到处都是花。(Nhan qù kàn nǎinai. Nǎinai de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de. Nǎinai sòng gěi Nhan yí jiàn xīn yīfu. Nhan shuō: “Hǎo piàoliang a!” Nǎinai jiā wàimiàn dàochù dōu shì huā.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "纸是怎么做的 儿童动画"

en.flash: wood, plastic, glass, metal, wool, cotton, brick, everywhere | Ôn: cup, bottle, plate, sweater, blanket
en.slide: 1) Nhìn đồ vật chọn chất liệu (6 câu): cup – glass / table – wood / bottle – plastic / box – metal / sweater – wool / wall – brick. 2) Kéo thả câu vào tranh: This cup is made of glass. / My sweater is made of wool. / This T-shirt is made of cotton. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp với đồ thật trong lớp: What is it made of? – It's made of ___.
en.truyen: Grandma's house — Nhan visits Grandma. Her house is made of brick and the door is made of wood. In the kitchen, there are glass cups and metal boxes. Grandma gives Nhan a sweater. 'It's made of wool,' she says. 'And this T-shirt is made of cotton.' 'Thank you, Grandma!' says Nhan. There are flowers everywhere in the garden.
en.baihat: What Is It Made Of? (giai điệu: Mary Had a Little Lamb) — What is this cup made of, made of, made of? / What is this cup made of? / It's made of glass! / What is this box made of, made of, made of? / What is this box made of? / It's made of metal! (Câu sau đổi: sweater – wool / table – wood)

zh.flash: 木头 mùtou, 塑料 sùliào, 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 纸 zhǐ, 砖 zhuān, 开始 kāishǐ, 到处 dàochù, 啊 a | Ôn: 杯子 bēizi, 桌子 zhuōzi, 椅子 yǐzi, 衣服 yīfu, 房子 fángzi
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 木头 / 塑料 / 玻璃 / 金属 / 纸 / 砖. 2) Ghép nửa câu: 这个杯子 + 是用玻璃做的。/ 这本书 + 是用纸做的。/ 奶奶的房子 + 是用砖做的。/ 那把椅子 + 是用塑料做的。3) Trò 'Đi săn chất liệu' trong lớp (theo nhóm): 这是用什么做的？— 是用___做的。
zh.truyen: 奶奶的房子 — Nhan去看奶奶。奶奶的房子是用砖做的，门是用木头做的。厨房里到处都是玻璃杯子和金属盒子。奶奶送给Nhan一件新衣服。Nhan说：“好漂亮啊！谢谢奶奶！”(Nhan qù kàn nǎinai. Nǎinai de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de, mén shì yòng mùtou zuò de. Chúfáng li dàochù dōu shì bōli bēizi hé jīnshǔ hézi. Nǎinai sòng gěi Nhan yí jiàn xīn yīfu. Nhan shuō: “Hǎo piàoliang a! Xièxie nǎinai!”)
zh.baihat: 这是用什么做的？(giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 木头桌子，木头桌子，(Mùtou zhuōzi, mùtou zhuōzi,) / 玻璃杯，玻璃杯，(bōli bēi, bōli bēi,) / 这是用什么做的？这是用什么做的？(zhè shì yòng shénme zuò de? zhè shì yòng shénme zuò de?) / 是塑料，是塑料。(shì sùliào, shì sùliào.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 22. Unit 5 · Materials – Made of hay made from?

web.label: Ngày 43. Unit 5 · Made from – Giấy làm từ gỗ

en.tu: Mới: over, perhaps, paper | Ôn: bridge, factory, museum, river
en.cum: Mới: make sure / by myself / over the river / made from wood | Ôn: a metal bridge / a big factory
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: be made from – chất liệu đã biến đổi] Paper is made from wood. / The bridge over the river is made of metal. / I made this paper boat by myself. / Make sure your boat is dry. / Perhaps the box is made of wood.
en.truyen: The paper factory — Leo's class visits a factory near the bridge. 'Paper is made from wood,' says the manager. Leo makes a paper boat. 'I made it by myself!' he says. 'Make sure it's dry,' says the teacher. Perhaps the boat can go over the river!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how paper is made for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 变化 biànhuà, 习惯 xíguàn, 越来越 yuèláiyuè | Ôn: 桥 qiáo, 附近 fùjìn, 博物馆 bówùguǎn
zh.cum: Mới: 很大的变化 hěn dà de biànhuà / 好习惯 hǎo xíguàn / 越来越多 yuèláiyuè duō / 越来越大 yuèláiyuè dà | Ôn: 学校附近 xuéxiào fùjìn / 一座桥 yí zuò qiáo
zh.cau: 纸是用木头做的。(Zhǐ shì yòng mùtou zuò de.) / 学校附近的桥是用金属做的。(Xuéxiào fùjìn de qiáo shì yòng jīnshǔ zuò de.) / 我们用的纸越来越多。(Wǒmen yòng de zhǐ yuèláiyuè duō.) / 少用塑料是一个好习惯。(Shǎo yòng sùliào shì yí ge hǎo xíguàn.) / 我们的城市变化很大。(Wǒmen de chéngshì biànhuà hěn dà.)
zh.truyen: 参观工厂 — Leo的班去参观学校附近的一个工厂。一个叔叔说：“纸是用木头做的。”Leo说：“我们用的纸越来越多。”老师说：“少用一点儿纸，是一个好习惯。”(Leo de bān qù cānguān xuéxiào fùjìn de yí ge gōngchǎng. Yí ge shūshu shuō: “Zhǐ shì yòng mùtou zuò de.” Leo shuō: “Wǒmen yòng de zhǐ yuèláiyuè duō.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Shǎo yòng yìdiǎnr zhǐ, shì yí ge hǎo xíguàn.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "纸是怎么做出来的 动画"

web.label: Ngày 44. Unit 5 · Thư gửi bạn – Cuộc thi chai nhựa

en.tu: Mới: thousand, save | Ôn: competition, prize, letter, airport
en.cum: Mới: dear (Dear Xiaomei) / enter a competition / save plastic / a thousand bottles | Ôn: win a prize / write a letter
en.cau: Dear Xiaomei, I want to enter a competition. / [Ngữ pháp: be made from] Our castle is made from a thousand plastic bottles. / Let's save paper and plastic. / We want to win the prize.
en.truyen: A letter to Xiaomei — Dear Xiaomei, our school has a competition. My group wants to enter it. We are making a castle from a thousand plastic bottles. We want to save plastic and win the prize! Love, Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "plastic bottle castle craft for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 挂 guà, 减 jiǎn, 黄金 huángjīn | Ôn: 参加 cānjiā, 地址 dìzhǐ, 一样 yíyàng, 千 qiān
zh.cum: Mới: 挂在墙上 guà zài qiáng shang / 一千减一百 yìqiān jiǎn yìbǎi / 黄金戒指 huángjīn jièzhi | Ôn: 参加比赛 cānjiā bǐsài / 写地址 xiě dìzhǐ
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 是用……做的] 这个戒指是用黄金做的。(Zhège jièzhi shì yòng huángjīn zuò de.) / 我把信挂在墙上。(Wǒ bǎ xìn guà zài qiáng shang.) / 一千减一百是九百。(Yìqiān jiǎn yìbǎi shì jiǔbǎi.) / 我们班参加了一个比赛。(Wǒmen bān cānjiāle yí ge bǐsài.)
zh.truyen: 给Xiaomei的信 — Bông给Xiaomei写信：“我们班参加了一个比赛。我们用一千个塑料瓶子做了一个城堡。”Xiaomei很高兴，她把信挂在墙上。(Bông gěi Xiaomei xiě xìn: “Wǒmen bān cānjiāle yí ge bǐsài. Wǒmen yòng yìqiān ge sùliào píngzi zuòle yí ge chéngbǎo.” Xiaomei hěn gāoxìng, tā bǎ xìn guà zài qiáng shang.)

en.flash: over, perhaps, paper, thousand, save, make sure, by myself, dear, enter a competition | Ôn: bridge, factory, museum, competition, prize
en.slide: 1) Phân loại câu vào 2 cột made of / made from (6 câu): This cup is made of glass. / Paper is made from wood. / The bridge is made of metal. / Our castle is made from plastic bottles. / My sweater is made of wool. / This card is made from paper. 2) Điền từ vào thư (dear / enter / thousand / save / by myself): Dear Xiaomei, I want to enter a competition... 3) Nói theo tranh: I made this ___ by myself. / Make sure your ___ is dry.
en.truyen: The plastic bottle castle — Dear Xiaomei, our school has a competition. My group wants to enter it. We visit a factory near the bridge over the river. 'Paper is made from wood,' says the manager. Then we make a castle from a thousand plastic bottles. I made the door by myself! Perhaps we will win the prize. Love, Bông.
en.baihat: Made Of, Made From (giai điệu: London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Paper is made from wood, from wood, from wood. / Paper is made from wood. / Save the paper! / The bridge is made of metal, metal, metal. / The bridge is made of metal, / over the river!

zh.flash: 变化 biànhuà, 习惯 xíguàn, 越来越 yuèláiyuè, 挂 guà, 减 jiǎn, 黄金 huángjīn | Ôn: 桥 qiáo, 附近 fùjìn, 博物馆 bówùguǎn, 参加 cānjiā, 地址 dìzhǐ
zh.slide: 1) Tính nhẩm với 减 (4 câu): 一千减一百是多少？(九百) / 十减三是多少？(七) / 一百减二十是多少？(八十) / 五十减五是多少？(四十五). 2) Nối câu: 我们用的纸 + 越来越多。/ 少用塑料 + 是一个好习惯。/ 我们的城市 + 变化很大。3) Nhìn tranh nói câu: 这个戒指是用黄金做的。/ 我把画挂在墙上。
zh.truyen: 参观工厂 — Leo的班去参观学校附近的一个工厂。工厂在一座桥的附近。一个叔叔说：“纸是用木头做的。现在大家用的纸越来越多。”Leo说：“我们要少用一点儿纸。”回家以后，Leo把一张画挂在墙上：“少用纸，是好习惯！”(Leo de bān qù cānguān xuéxiào fùjìn de yí ge gōngchǎng. Gōngchǎng zài yí zuò qiáo de fùjìn. Yí ge shūshu shuō: “Zhǐ shì yòng mùtou zuò de. Xiànzài dàjiā yòng de zhǐ yuèláiyuè duō.” Leo shuō: “Wǒmen yào shǎo yòng yìdiǎnr zhǐ.” Huí jiā yǐhòu, Leo bǎ yì zhāng huà guà zài qiáng shang: “Shǎo yòng zhǐ, shì hǎo xíguàn!”)
zh.baihat: 越来越好 (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — 少用塑料，少用塑料，(Shǎo yòng sùliào, shǎo yòng sùliào,) / 好习惯，好习惯，(hǎo xíguàn, hǎo xíguàn,) / 地球越来越好，地球越来越好，(dìqiú yuèláiyuè hǎo, dìqiú yuèláiyuè hǎo,) / 真快乐，真快乐。(zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè.)

en.truyen: Hurry, Leo! — The lesson begins. Leo can't find his ring. 'Is it made of gold?' asks Anna. 'Actually, it's made of plastic,' says Leo. 'Is there anything under the desk?' Anna looks. 'Here it is! Hurry, Leo!'

zh.tu: Mới: 大概 dàgài, 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme…, 花瓶 huāpíng, 戒指 jièzhi | Ôn: 开始 kāishǐ, 玻璃 bōli, 黄金 huángjīn
zh.cum: Mới: 大概是黄金 dàgài shì huángjīn / 玻璃花瓶 bōli huāpíng / 如果……那么要小心 rúguǒ…nàme yào xiǎoxīn | Ôn: 开始上课 kāishǐ shàngkè / 用玻璃做的 yòng bōli zuò de
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 如果…那么…] 如果花瓶是用玻璃做的，那么你要小心。(Rúguǒ huāpíng shì yòng bōli zuò de, nàme nǐ yào xiǎoxīn.) / 这个花瓶是用玻璃做的。(Zhège huāpíng shì yòng bōli zuò de.) / 这个戒指大概是用黄金做的。(Zhège jièzhi dàgài shì yòng huángjīn zuò de.) / 快！上课开始了！(Kuài! Shàngkè kāishǐ le!)
zh.truyen: Leo的戒指 — 上课开始了，Leo找不到他的戒指。Anna问：“它是用黄金做的吗？”Leo说：“不是，大概是用塑料做的。如果你找到了，那么请给我。”Anna说：“在桌子下面！快！”(Shàngkè kāishǐ le, Leo zhǎo bu dào tā de jièzhi. Anna wèn: “Tā shì yòng huángjīn zuò de ma?” Leo shuō: “Bú shì, dàgài shì yòng sùliào zuò de. Rúguǒ nǐ zhǎodào le, nàme qǐng gěi wǒ.” Anna shuō: “Zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn! Kuài!”)

zh.cau: Ôn (nghe – chọn đúng/sai, không tranh): 这本书是用纸做的。(Zhè běn shū shì yòng zhǐ zuò de.) / 奶奶的房子是用砖做的。(Nǎinai de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de.) / 如果杯子是用玻璃做的，那么要小心。(Rúguǒ bēizi shì yòng bōli zuò de, nàme yào xiǎoxīn.) / 我们的城市越来越大。(Wǒmen de chéngshì yuèláiyuè dà.)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — 我是用玻璃做的。我在桌子上。你可以把花放在我里面。如果你拿我，那么要小心啊！我是什么？（花瓶！）(Wǒ shì yòng bōli zuò de. Wǒ zài zhuōzi shang. Nǐ kěyǐ bǎ huā fàng zài wǒ lǐmiàn. Rúguǒ nǐ ná wǒ, nàme yào xiǎoxīn a! Wǒ shì shénme? (Huāpíng!))

en.flash: begin, hurry, fire, actually, anything, gold, vase | Ôn: wood, plastic, glass, metal, wool, cotton, brick, fire fighter
en.slide: 1) Nghe – chọn đúng/sai (5 câu): This vase is made of glass. / Actually, the ring is made of plastic. / The table is made of metal. / Paper is made from wood. / The wall is made of brick. 2) Trò 'Hộp bí mật': con sờ đồ trong hộp và đoán: Is it made of wood? – Yes, it is. / Actually, it's made of plastic! 3) Đóng vai đoạn hội thoại 'Hurry, Leo!' theo cặp.
en.truyen: Hurry, Leo! — The lesson begins at eight. Leo can't find his ring. 'Is it made of gold?' asks Anna. 'Actually, it's made of plastic,' says Leo. 'It's a present from my grandma.' They look everywhere. 'Is there anything under the desk?' Anna looks. 'Here it is! Hurry, Leo! The teacher is coming!'
en.baihat: Hurry, Hurry! (giai điệu: Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Hurry, hurry, hurry up, / the lesson will begin! / Is my ring made of gold? / Actually, it's plastic! / Hurry, hurry, hurry up, / let's all go in!

zh.flash: 大概 dàgài, 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme…, 花瓶 huāpíng, 戒指 jièzhi | Ôn: 木头 mùtou, 塑料 sùliào, 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 纸 zhǐ, 砖 zhuān, 黄金 huángjīn, 开始 kāishǐ
zh.slide: 1) Hoàn thành câu 如果…那么… (4 câu): 如果花瓶是用玻璃做的，那么___。(要小心) / 如果你找到了戒指，那么___。(请给我) / 如果上课开始了，那么___。(快进教室) / 如果下雨，那么___。(带雨伞). 2) Đoán chất liệu với 大概: 这个大概是用___做的。3) Trò chơi trí nhớ: lật thẻ ghép chữ Hán với tranh (木头 / 塑料 / 玻璃 / 金属 / 纸 / 砖 / 黄金).
zh.truyen: Leo的戒指 — 上课开始了，Leo找不到他的戒指。Anna问：“它是用黄金做的吗？”Leo说：“不是，大概是用塑料做的。是奶奶送给我的。”他们到处找。Anna说：“如果它不在书包里，那么大概在桌子下面。”“找到了！快！老师来了！”(Shàngkè kāishǐ le, Leo zhǎo bu dào tā de jièzhi. Anna wèn: “Tā shì yòng huángjīn zuò de ma?” Leo shuō: “Bú shì, dàgài shì yòng sùliào zuò de. Shì nǎinai sòng gěi wǒ de.” Tāmen dàochù zhǎo. Anna shuō: “Rúguǒ tā bú zài shūbāo li, nàme dàgài zài zhuōzi xiàmiàn.” “Zhǎodào le! Kuài! Lǎoshī lái le!”)
zh.baihat: 如果…那么… (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — 玻璃花瓶真漂亮，(Bōli huāpíng zhēn piàoliang,) / 如果拿它要小心，(rúguǒ ná tā yào xiǎoxīn,) / 木头桌子塑料椅，(mùtou zhuōzi sùliào yǐ,) / 金属盒子纸做书，(jīnshǔ hézi zhǐ zuò shū,) / 这是用什么做的？(zhè shì yòng shénme zuò de?) / 大家一起说一说。(dàjiā yìqǐ shuō yi shuō.)

en.tu: Ôn: brick, wood, paper, hurry, everywhere, metal | Ôn nhanh: cave, path, view

en.cau: Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: The first pig's house is made of paper. / The second pig's house is made of wood. / The third pig's house is made of brick. / Hurry! The wolf is coming! / [Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): nhìn 5 tranh, nghe câu mẫu từng tranh rồi ghi âm câu kể của con] (1) Three little pigs wanted to build new houses. / (2) The first pig made his house of paper. / (3) The second pig made his house of wood. / (4) The third pig made his house of brick. / (5) The wolf couldn't blow down the brick house.
en.truyen: The Three Little Pigs — The first little pig makes a house of paper by himself. The second pig's house is made of wood. The third pig's house is made of brick. The wolf comes. 'Hurry!' The paper house and the wooden house fall down, but the brick house is strong. Actually, the third pig is very clever!

zh.tu: Ôn: 砖 zhuān, 木头 mùtou, 纸 zhǐ, 到处 dàochù, 开始 kāishǐ, 大概 dàgài, 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme…
zh.cum: Ôn: 用纸做的房子 yòng zhǐ zuò de fángzi / 用木头做的房子 yòng mùtou zuò de fángzi / 用砖做的房子 yòng zhuān zuò de fángzi / 快跑 kuài pǎo
zh.cau: Chuyển ngữ Trung → Anh: 第一只小猪的房子是用纸做的。(Dì yī zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng zhǐ zuò de.) / 第二只小猪的房子是用木头做的。(Dì èr zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng mùtou zuò de.) / 第三只小猪的房子是用砖做的。(Dì sān zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de.) / 如果大灰狼来了，那么快跑！(Rúguǒ dà huīláng lái le, nàme kuài pǎo!)
zh.truyen: 三只小猪 — 第一只小猪的房子是用纸做的，第二只小猪的房子是用木头做的，第三只小猪的房子是用砖做的。大灰狼来了！纸房子和木头房子都倒了。砖房子很结实，三只小猪都很安全。(Dì yī zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng zhǐ zuò de, dì èr zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng mùtou zuò de, dì sān zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de. Dà huīláng lái le! Zhǐ fángzi hé mùtou fángzi dōu dǎo le. Zhuān fángzi hěn jiēshi, sān zhī xiǎo zhū dōu hěn ānquán.)

en.flash: Ôn: wood, plastic, glass, metal, wool, cotton, brick, paper, everywhere, over, hurry, begin, fire, save, thousand, by myself, make sure
en.slide: 1) Kể lại truyện 'The Three Little Pigs' theo 4 tranh, dùng: made of paper / made of wood / made of brick / Hurry! 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một bạn nói tiếng Anh, một bạn dịch sang tiếng Trung: This vase is made of glass. ↔ 这个花瓶是用玻璃做的。/ Paper is made from wood. ↔ 纸是用木头做的。/ The bridge is made of metal. ↔ 这座桥是用金属做的。 3) Kiểm tra nhanh unit (6 câu chọn đáp án): made of / made from. 4) Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): kể truyện theo 5 tranh 'The Three Little Pigs'. Cô: 'These pictures tell a story. It's called The Three Little Pigs. Just look at the pictures first.' Cô kể tranh 1: Three little pigs wanted to build new houses. Con kể tranh 2–5: (2) The first pig made his house of paper. The second pig made his house of wood. / (3) The third pig made his house of brick. It was very strong. / (4) The wolf came. He blew down the paper house and the house of wood. 'Hurry!' said the pigs. / (5) They all ran to the brick house. The wolf couldn't blow it down, and the pigs were happy.
en.truyen: The Three Little Pigs — The first little pig makes a house of paper by himself. The second pig's house is made of wood. The third pig's house is made of brick. One day, the wolf comes. 'Hurry!' The paper house and the wooden house fall down. The pigs run to the brick house. It is very strong. Actually, the third pig is very clever! (Nghe thêm cuối truyện: The wolf's shoes are made of leather.)
en.baihat: This Little House (giai điệu: The Wheels on the Bus) — The house is made of brick, brick, brick, / brick, brick, brick, brick, brick, brick. / The house is made of brick, brick, brick, / strong and safe! / The door is made of wood, wood, wood... / The window's made of glass, glass, glass...

zh.flash: Ôn: 木头 mùtou, 塑料 sùliào, 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 纸 zhǐ, 砖 zhuān, 黄金 huángjīn, 到处 dàochù, 变化 biànhuà, 习惯 xíguàn, 越来越 yuèláiyuè, 大概 dàgài, 挂 guà, 减 jiǎn, 开始 kāishǐ, 啊 a, 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme…
zh.slide: 1) Sắp xếp tranh và đọc lại truyện 三只小猪 (4 câu): 第一只小猪的房子是用纸做的。… 2) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Trung, con dịch sang tiếng Anh: 这个戒指是用黄金做的。→ This ring is made of gold. / 纸是用木头做的。→ Paper is made from wood. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh chữ Hán (6 câu): nhìn tranh chọn chữ 木头 / 塑料 / 玻璃 / 金属 / 砖 / 纸.
zh.truyen: 三只小猪 — 第一只小猪的房子是用纸做的，第二只小猪的房子是用木头做的，第三只小猪的房子是用砖做的。有一天，大灰狼来了！纸房子和木头房子都倒了。两只小猪跑到砖房子里。砖房子很结实，三只小猪都很安全。大灰狼说：“如果房子是用砖做的，那么我没有办法啊！”(Dì yī zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng zhǐ zuò de, dì èr zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng mùtou zuò de, dì sān zhī xiǎo zhū de fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de. Yǒu yì tiān, dà huīláng lái le! Zhǐ fángzi hé mùtou fángzi dōu dǎo le. Liǎng zhī xiǎo zhū pǎo dào zhuān fángzi li. Zhuān fángzi hěn jiēshi, sān zhī xiǎo zhū dōu hěn ānquán. Dà huīláng shuō: “Rúguǒ fángzi shì yòng zhuān zuò de, nàme wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ a!”)
zh.baihat: 三只小猪盖房子 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 纸做房子，纸做房子，(Zhǐ zuò fángzi, zhǐ zuò fángzi,) / 倒了，倒了，(dǎo le, dǎo le,) / 砖做房子结实，砖做房子结实，(zhuān zuò fángzi jiēshi, zhuān zuò fángzi jiēshi,) / 真安全，真安全。(zhēn ānquán, zhēn ānquán.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 25. Unit 6 · Space – Con người có thể làm gì trong vũ trụ?

web.label: Ngày 49. Unit 6 · Vũ trụ, hành tinh, Trái Đất, tên lửa

en.tu: Mới: space, planet, Earth, rocket | Ôn nhanh: butterfly, together | Ôn: future, star, moon
en.cum: Mới: in space / planet Earth / travel by rocket / other planets | Ôn: in the future / look at the stars together
en.cau: What could people do in space? / [Ngữ pháp: could + V – khả năng trong tương lai] People could travel to Mars by rocket one day. / Earth is a planet. / In the future, people could live on other planets.
en.truyen: Leo's dream — Leo and Dad look at the stars together at night. 'Earth is a planet,' says Dad. 'One day, people could travel to other planets by rocket.' Leo smiles. 'In the future, I could go to space too!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "planets for kids solar system"

zh.tu: Mới: 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 行星 xíngxīng, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 将来 jiānglái | Ôn nhanh: 孩子 háizi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 叔叔 shūshu | Ôn: 星星 xīngxing, 月亮 yuèliang
zh.cum: Mới: 在太空 zài tàikōng / 坐火箭 zuò huǒjiàn / 地球是行星 dìqiú shì xíngxīng / 将来能… jiānglái néng… | Ôn: 看星星 kàn xīngxing / 叔叔的女儿 shūshu de nǚ'ér
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 将来 + 能 + V] 将来人们在太空能做什么？(Jiānglái rénmen zài tàikōng néng zuò shénme?) / 将来，人们能去太空。(Jiānglái, rénmen néng qù tàikōng.) / 将来人们能坐火箭去火星。(Jiānglái rénmen néng zuò huǒjiàn qù Huǒxīng.) / 地球是一颗行星。(Dìqiú shì yì kē xíngxīng.)
zh.truyen: Leo的梦 — 晚上，Leo和爸爸一起看星星。爸爸说：“地球是一颗行星。将来人们能坐火箭去别的行星。”Leo笑了：“将来我也能去太空！”(Wǎnshang, Leo hé bàba yìqǐ kàn xīngxing. Bàba shuō: “Dìqiú shì yì kē xíngxīng. Jiānglái rénmen néng zuò huǒjiàn qù bié de xíngxīng.” Leo xiào le: “Jiānglái wǒ yě néng qù tàikōng!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "八大行星 儿童 动画"

web.label: Ngày 50. Unit 6 · Phi hành gia, tàu vũ trụ, kính thiên văn

en.tu: Mới: astronaut, spaceship, land, telescope | Ôn nhanh: join, member | Ôn: moon, club
en.cum: Mới: an astronaut in a spaceship / land on the moon / look through a telescope / join the space club | Ôn: a club member
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: could + V] In the future, astronauts could land on other planets. / The spaceship could land on the moon. / We could see the moon with a telescope. / Anna is a member of the space club.
en.truyen: The space club — Anna joins the space club. She is a new member. She looks through a telescope. 'I can see the moon!' she says. An astronaut visits the club. 'One day, our spaceship could land on Mars,' he says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what do astronauts do for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 望远镜 wàngyuǎnjìng, 起飞 qǐfēi, 落地 luòdì | Ôn nhanh: 词典 cídiǎn, 蝴蝶 húdié
zh.cum: Mới: 坐宇宙飞船 zuò yǔzhòu fēichuán / 火箭起飞了 huǒjiàn qǐfēi le / 用望远镜看 yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn / 安全落地 ānquán luòdì | Ôn: 查词典 chá cídiǎn
zh.cau: 将来，宇航员能在别的行星上着陆。(Jiānglái, yǔhángyuán néng zài bié de xíngxīng shang zhuólù.) / 火箭起飞了！(Huǒjiàn qǐfēi le!) / 我们能用望远镜看月亮。(Wǒmen néng yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn yuèliang.) / 宇宙飞船安全落地了。(Yǔzhòu fēichuán ānquán luòdì le.)
zh.truyen: 太空小组 — Anna参加了太空小组。她用望远镜看月亮：“我看到月亮了！”一个宇航员来了。他说：“将来，我们的宇宙飞船能在火星上落地。”(Anna cānjiāle tàikōng xiǎozǔ. Tā yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn yuèliang: “Wǒ kàndào yuèliang le!” Yí ge yǔhángyuán lái le. Tā shuō: “Jiānglái, wǒmen de yǔzhòu fēichuán néng zài Huǒxīng shang luòdì.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "宇航员 宇宙飞船 儿童 科普"

en.flash: space, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, land, telescope | Ôn: butterfly, together, join, member, moon, star
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): space / planet / Earth / rocket / astronaut / spaceship. 2) Kéo thả câu vào tranh: People could travel to Mars by rocket. / Astronauts could land on other planets. / We could see the moon with a telescope. 3) Nói nối tiếp theo vòng: In the future, people could ___ (go to space / live on other planets / land on the moon).
en.truyen: The space club — Anna joins the space club. She is a new member. She and Leo look through a telescope together. 'I can see the moon!' says Anna. 'Earth is a planet, and Mars is a planet too,' says Leo. An astronaut visits the club. 'One day, our spaceship could land on Mars. People could travel there by rocket,' he says.
en.baihat: Ten, Nine, Rocket Time! (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Ten, nine, eight, the rocket's here, / astronauts are sitting near. / Up in space the planets shine, / Earth is blue and looks so fine. / One day we could land on Mars, / flying high above the stars!

zh.flash: 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 行星 xíngxīng, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 将来 jiānglái, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 望远镜 wàngyuǎnjìng, 起飞 qǐfēi, 落地 luòdì | Ôn: 孩子 háizi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 叔叔 shūshu, 词典 cídiǎn, 蝴蝶 húdié
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 太空 / 地球 / 行星 / 火箭 / 宇航员 / 望远镜. 2) Sắp xếp từ thành câu: 将来 / 人们 / 能 / 坐火箭 / 去火星 → 将来人们能坐火箭去火星。/ 宇航员 / 能 / 在别的行星上 / 着陆. 3) Đóng vai đếm ngược phóng tên lửa: 十、九、八……火箭起飞了！……宇宙飞船落地了！
zh.truyen: 太空小组 — Anna参加了太空小组。她和Leo一起用望远镜看月亮。Leo说：“地球是一颗行星，火星也是一颗行星。”一个宇航员来了。他说：“将来，人们能坐火箭去火星，我们的宇宙飞船能在火星上落地。”(Anna cānjiāle tàikōng xiǎozǔ. Tā hé Leo yìqǐ yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn yuèliang. Leo shuō: “Dìqiú shì yì kē xíngxīng, Huǒxīng yě shì yì kē xíngxīng.” Yí ge yǔhángyuán lái le. Tā shuō: “Jiānglái, rénmen néng zuò huǒjiàn qù Huǒxīng, wǒmen de yǔzhòu fēichuán néng zài Huǒxīng shang luòdì.”)
zh.baihat: 火箭起飞 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 火箭起飞，火箭起飞，(Huǒjiàn qǐfēi, huǒjiàn qǐfēi,) / 去太空，去太空，(qù tàikōng, qù tàikōng,) / 将来我当宇航员，将来我当宇航员，(jiānglái wǒ dāng yǔhángyuán, jiānglái wǒ dāng yǔhángyuán,) / 看地球，看地球。(kàn dìqiú, kàn dìqiú.)

web.label: Ngày 51. Unit 6 · Thay vào đó – Chuyến phiêu lưu vũ trụ

en.tu: Mới: instead, adventure | Ôn (từ nối Unit 5): metal, glass, plastic | Ôn nhanh: file | Ôn: museum, engineer
en.cum: Mới: could (khả năng) / if you want / go on an adventure / instead of the park | Ôn: made of metal and glass
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: could + V] If you want, we could go to the space museum. / We could go by bus instead of by car. / The spaceship is made of metal and glass. / What an adventure!
en.truyen: A space adventure — Bông wants to go to the park. 'If you want, we could go to the space museum instead,' says Mum. In the museum, there is a big spaceship. It is made of metal and glass. 'What an adventure!' says Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "space museum tour for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 可能 kěnéng, 决定 juédìng, 办法 bànfǎ | Ôn (từ nối Unit 5): 金属 jīnshǔ, 玻璃 bōli, 塑料 sùliào | Ôn nhanh: 复习 fùxí, 考试 kǎoshì
zh.cum: Mới: 可能会去 kěnéng huì qù / 决定去 juédìng qù / 想办法 xiǎng bànfǎ / 一个好办法 yí ge hǎo bànfǎ | Ôn: 用金属做的 yòng jīnshǔ zuò de / 复习考试 fùxí kǎoshì
zh.cau: 火箭是用金属做的。(Huǒjiàn shì yòng jīnshǔ zuò de.) / 我们决定去太空博物馆。(Wǒmen juédìng qù tàikōng bówùguǎn.) / 明天可能下雨。(Míngtiān kěnéng xià yǔ.) / 这是一个好办法！(Zhè shì yí ge hǎo bànfǎ!)
zh.truyen: 去博物馆 — 明天可能下雨，Bông不能去公园。妈妈说：“我有一个好办法，我们去太空博物馆吧！”她们决定去博物馆。博物馆里有一艘宇宙飞船，是用金属和玻璃做的。(Míngtiān kěnéng xià yǔ, Bông bù néng qù gōngyuán. Māma shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yí ge hǎo bànfǎ, wǒmen qù tàikōng bówùguǎn ba!” Tāmen juédìng qù bówùguǎn. Bówùguǎn li yǒu yì sōu yǔzhòu fēichuán, shì yòng jīnshǔ hé bōli zuò de.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中国科技馆 太空 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 52. Unit 6 · Tin rằng – Quyết định – Bảo vệ môi trường

en.tu: Mới: anywhere, believe, decide, environment | Ôn (từ nối Unit 5): save, wood, paper | Ôn: future, use
en.cum: Mới: by yourself / go anywhere / I believe / decide to save / the environment on Earth | Ôn: save paper and plastic
en.cau: Don't go into space by yourself. / With a rocket, you could go anywhere. / I believe people could live on other planets. / We decide to save the environment on Earth.
en.truyen: Nhan's choice — Nhan reads a book about space. 'I believe we could go anywhere one day,' he says. 'But first, we must save the environment on Earth,' says his teacher. Nhan decides to use less paper and plastic.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "save the earth for kids environment"

zh.tu: Mới: 关于 guānyú, 旅游 lǚyóu, 行 xíng, 其他 qítā | Ôn (từ nối Unit 5): 木头 mùtou, 纸 zhǐ, 习惯 xíguàn | Ôn nhanh: 成绩 chéngjì, 毕业 bìyè
zh.cum: Mới: 关于太空的书 guānyú tàikōng de shū / 去太空旅游 qù tàikōng lǚyóu / 行不行 xíng bu xíng / 其他行星 qítā xíngxīng | Ôn: 好习惯 hǎo xíguàn
zh.cau: 我在看一本关于太空的书。(Wǒ zài kàn yì běn guānyú tàikōng de shū.) / 将来人们能去太空旅游。(Jiānglái rénmen néng qù tàikōng lǚyóu.) / 其他行星上有水吗？(Qítā xíngxīng shang yǒu shuǐ ma?) / 我们一起去，行不行？——行！(Wǒmen yìqǐ qù, xíng bu xíng? — Xíng!)
zh.truyen: 关于太空的书 — Nhan在看一本关于太空的书。他说：“将来人们能去太空旅游，也能去其他行星！”老师说：“行！可是我们也要爱护地球。”Nhan决定少用纸，这是一个好习惯。(Nhan zài kàn yì běn guānyú tàikōng de shū. Tā shuō: “Jiānglái rénmen néng qù tàikōng lǚyóu, yě néng qù qítā xíngxīng!” Lǎoshī shuō: “Xíng! Kěshì wǒmen yě yào àihù dìqiú.” Nhan juédìng shǎo yòng zhǐ, zhè shì yí ge hǎo xíguàn.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "爱护地球 儿童 动画"

en.flash: instead, adventure, anywhere, believe, decide, environment, could, if you want, by yourself | Ôn: metal, glass, plastic, save, paper, museum
en.slide: 1) Ghép câu (5 câu): If you want, + we could go to the museum instead. / With a rocket, + you could go anywhere. / Don't go into space + by yourself. / I believe + people could live on other planets. / We decide + to save the environment. 2) Phiếu chọn lựa (cặp đôi): A: Let's go to the park. B: If you want, we could ___ instead. 3) Bình chọn cả lớp: What could we do to save the environment? (save paper / use less plastic).
en.truyen: A space adventure — Bông wants to go to the park, but it might rain. 'If you want, we could go to the space museum instead,' says Mum. In the museum, there is a big spaceship made of metal and glass. 'With a rocket, you could go anywhere,' says the guide. 'I believe I could be an astronaut,' says Bông. On the way home, she decides to save paper and plastic for the environment.
en.baihat: If You Want (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — If you want, if you want, / we could go, we could go / on a space adventure, on a space adventure, / instead, instead! / Save the Earth, save the Earth, / save our home, save our home!

zh.flash: 可能 kěnéng, 决定 juédìng, 办法 bànfǎ, 关于 guānyú, 旅游 lǚyóu, 行 xíng, 其他 qítā | Ôn: 金属 jīnshǔ, 玻璃 bōli, 塑料 sùliào, 木头 mùtou, 纸 zhǐ, 复习 fùxí, 考试 kǎoshì, 成绩 chéngjì, 毕业 bìyè
zh.slide: 1) Chọn từ điền chỗ trống (可能 / 决定 / 办法 / 关于 / 其他 / 行): 明天___下雨。/ 我们___去博物馆。/ 这是一个好___。/ 我在看一本___太空的书。/ ___行星上有水吗？/ 一起去，___不___？2) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 将来你想去哪儿旅游？— 我想去太空旅游。3) Thảo luận nhóm: 我们有什么办法爱护地球？(少用纸 / 少用塑料).
zh.truyen: 去博物馆 — 明天可能下雨，Bông不能去公园。妈妈说：“我有一个好办法，我们去太空博物馆吧！行不行？”Bông说：“行！”博物馆里有一艘宇宙飞船，是用金属和玻璃做的。Bông买了一本关于太空的书。她说：“将来人们能去太空旅游，也能去其他行星！”(Míngtiān kěnéng xià yǔ, Bông bù néng qù gōngyuán. Māma shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yí ge hǎo bànfǎ, wǒmen qù tàikōng bówùguǎn ba! Xíng bu xíng?” Bông shuō: “Xíng!” Bówùguǎn li yǒu yì sōu yǔzhòu fēichuán, shì yòng jīnshǔ hé bōli zuò de. Bông mǎile yì běn guānyú tàikōng de shū. Tā shuō: “Jiānglái rénmen néng qù tàikōng lǚyóu, yě néng qù qítā xíngxīng!”)
zh.baihat: 去太空旅游 (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — 行不行？行不行？(Xíng bu xíng? Xíng bu xíng?) / 去旅游，去旅游，(qù lǚyóu, qù lǚyóu,) / 坐上火箭去太空，坐上火箭去太空，(zuòshang huǒjiàn qù tàikōng, zuòshang huǒjiàn qù tàikōng,) / 行！行！行！行！行！行！(xíng! xíng! xíng! xíng! xíng! xíng!)
