web.label: Ngày 53. Unit 6 · Đi theo – Tìm kiếm – Thì thầm trên sao Hỏa

en.tu: Mới: follow, search, might, piece, whisper, across, other | Ôn: rock, water, fast
en.cum: Mới: follow me / search for water / a piece of rock / whisper to a friend / fly across the sky / on other planets
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: could / might – có thể] There might be water under the rock. / The astronauts search for water on other planets. / A rocket flies across the sky. / The astronaut brings back a piece of rock. / 'Follow me,' Leo whispers.
en.truyen: Search on Mars — Two astronauts land on Mars. 'Follow me,' says Anna. They search for water across the red sand. Leo finds a piece of rock. 'There might be water under it,' he whispers.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Mars rover for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 等 děng, 不但…而且… búdàn… érqiě…, 火星 Huǒxīng | Ôn nhanh: 另外 lìngwài, 无论 wúlùn | Ôn: 知道 zhīdào, 自己 zìjǐ
zh.cum: Mới: 等一下 děng yíxià / 地球、火星等行星 dìqiú, Huǒxīng děng xíngxīng / 不但……而且…… búdàn… érqiě… | Ôn: 另外一个 lìngwài yí ge
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 不但…而且…] 宇航员不但很勇敢，而且很聪明。(Yǔhángyuán búdàn hěn yǒnggǎn, érqiě hěn cōngming.) / 等一下，火箭要起飞了！(Děng yíxià, huǒjiàn yào qǐfēi le!) / 我们能看到地球、火星等行星。(Wǒmen néng kàndào dìqiú, Huǒxīng děng xíngxīng.) / 火星不但很冷，而且没有水。(Huǒxīng búdàn hěn lěng, érqiě méiyǒu shuǐ.)
zh.truyen: 在火星上 — 两个宇航员在火星上落地了。Anna说：“等一下，我们一起找水。”火星不但很冷，而且很干。Leo找到一块石头，他小声说：“下面可能有水！”(Liǎng ge yǔhángyuán zài Huǒxīng shang luòdì le. Anna shuō: “Děng yíxià, wǒmen yìqǐ zhǎo shuǐ.” Huǒxīng búdàn hěn lěng, érqiě hěn gān. Leo zhǎodào yí kuài shítou, tā xiǎoshēng shuō: “Xiàmiàn kěnéng yǒu shuǐ!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "火星 儿童 科普 动画"

web.label: Ngày 54. Unit 6 · Ôn không tranh – Nghe đoán vũ trụ

en.tu: Ôn: space, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, land, instead, telescope, adventure | Ôn nhanh: butterfly, member, together
en.cum: Ôn: by yourself / could / if you want / go anywhere / search for water / follow me / a piece of rock
en.cau: Ôn (nghe – chọn đúng/sai, không tranh): Earth is a planet. / Astronauts could land on other planets. / We could see the moon with a telescope. / If you want, we could go by rocket instead. / There might be water on Mars.
en.truyen: Who am I? — I live in a spaceship. I wear a big white suit. I could land on the moon or on other planets. I search for water and rocks. Who am I? (An astronaut!)
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "space vocabulary quiz for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 行星 xíngxīng, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 将来 jiānglái, 可能 kěnéng, 决定 juédìng, 办法 bànfǎ, 关于 guānyú, 旅游 lǚyóu, 其他 qítā, 行 xíng, 等 děng
zh.cum: Ôn: 将来能… jiānglái néng… / 去太空旅游 qù tàikōng lǚyóu / 想办法 xiǎng bànfǎ / 其他行星 qítā xíngxīng / 等一下 děng yíxià / 不但……而且…… búdàn… érqiě…
zh.cau: Ôn (nghe – chọn đúng/sai, không tranh): 地球是一颗行星。(Dìqiú shì yì kē xíngxīng.) / 将来人们能去太空旅游。(Jiānglái rénmen néng qù tàikōng lǚyóu.) / 火箭起飞了。(Huǒjiàn qǐfēi le.) / 宇航员不但很勇敢，而且很聪明。(Yǔhángyuán búdàn hěn yǒnggǎn, érqiě hěn cōngming.)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — 我住在宇宙飞船里。我不但会开火箭，而且会在其他行星上落地。将来，我可能去火星。我是谁？（宇航员！）(Wǒ zhù zài yǔzhòu fēichuán li. Wǒ búdàn huì kāi huǒjiàn, érqiě huì zài qítā xíngxīng shang luòdì. Jiānglái, wǒ kěnéng qù Huǒxīng. Wǒ shì shéi? (Yǔhángyuán!))
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "太空 词语 儿童 认知"

en.flash: follow, search, might, piece, whisper, across, other | Ôn: space, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, land, telescope, instead, adventure
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Simon says' phiên bản vũ trụ: Follow me! / Whisper 'rocket'! / Walk across the room! / Search for a piece of rock! 2) Nghe – đánh số tranh theo truyện 'Search on Mars' (4 tranh). 3) Đoán với might: There might be ___ on Mars. (water / rocks / people?) – con giơ thẻ Yes/No.
en.truyen: Search on Mars — Two astronauts land on Mars. 'Follow me,' says Anna. They walk across the red sand and search for water. 'Other planets are cold and dry,' says Anna. Leo finds a piece of rock. 'There might be water under it,' he whispers. They take the rock back to the spaceship. 'What an adventure!'
en.baihat: Follow Me to Mars (giai điệu: The Wheels on the Bus) — The astronauts walk across the sand, / across the sand, across the sand. / The astronauts walk across the sand / and search for water. / 'Follow me,' the astronaut whispers... / 'There might be water here!'

zh.flash: 等 děng, 不但…而且… búdàn… érqiě…, 火星 Huǒxīng | Ôn: 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 行星 xíngxīng, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 将来 jiānglái, 可能 kěnéng, 另外 lìngwài, 无论 wúlùn
zh.slide: 1) Nối hai nửa câu 不但…而且… (4 câu): 宇航员不但很勇敢，+ 而且很聪明。/ 火星不但很冷，+ 而且没有水。/ Leo不但会说英语，+ 而且会说汉语。/ 火箭不但很大，+ 而且很快。2) Nghe – chọn đúng/sai về truyện 在火星上 (4 câu). 3) Trò 'Đếm ngược': cô hô 等一下！— con đứng yên; 起飞！— con nhảy lên; 落地！— con ngồi xuống.
zh.truyen: 在火星上 — 两个宇航员在火星上落地了。Anna说：“等一下，我们一起找水。”火星不但很冷，而且很干。他们看到了很多石头、沙子等东西。Leo找到一块石头，他小声说：“下面可能有水！”他们把石头带回了宇宙飞船。(Liǎng ge yǔhángyuán zài Huǒxīng shang luòdì le. Anna shuō: “Děng yíxià, wǒmen yìqǐ zhǎo shuǐ.” Huǒxīng búdàn hěn lěng, érqiě hěn gān. Tāmen kàndàole hěn duō shítou, shāzi děng dōngxi. Leo zhǎodào yí kuài shítou, tā xiǎoshēng shuō: “Xiàmiàn kěnéng yǒu shuǐ!” Tāmen bǎ shítou dàihuíle yǔzhòu fēichuán.)
zh.baihat: 不但…而且… (giai điệu: Mary Had a Little Lamb) — 宇航员不但勇敢，(Yǔhángyuán búdàn yǒnggǎn,) / 而且聪明，而且聪明，(érqiě cōngming, érqiě cōngming,) / 火星不但很冷，(Huǒxīng búdàn hěn lěng,) / 而且没有水。(érqiě méiyǒu shuǐ.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 28. Unit 6 · Space – Sao chổi & Phiên dịch nhí

web.label: Ngày 55. Unit 6 · Truyện & chuyển ngữ – Sao chổi đêm nay

en.tu: Ôn: telescope, space, planet, rocket, whisper, believe, across | Ôn nhanh: file, join
en.cum: Ôn: look through a telescope / fly across the sky / I believe / whisper to Mum / could see
en.cau: Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: We could see the stars with a telescope. / In the future, people could travel to space. / I believe astronauts could land on Mars. / Let's search the sky together.
en.truyen: The comet — At night, Xiaomei and Mum look through a telescope. 'Look! A comet is flying across the sky,' whispers Mum. 'We could see comets with a telescope.' Xiaomei can't believe it. 'One day, I could fly a rocket into space!' she says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what is a comet for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 望远镜 wàngyuǎnjìng, 太空 tàikōng, 行星 xíngxīng, 将来 jiānglái, 可能 kěnéng, 旅游 lǚyóu, 关于 guānyú
zh.cum: Ôn: 用望远镜看 yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn / 将来能去太空 jiānglái néng qù tàikōng / 一本关于太空的书 yì běn guānyú tàikōng de shū
zh.cau: Chuyển ngữ Trung → Anh: 我们能用望远镜看星星。(Wǒmen néng yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn xīngxing.) / 将来人们能去太空旅游。(Jiānglái rénmen néng qù tàikōng lǚyóu.) / 宇航员可能在火星上落地。(Yǔhángyuán kěnéng zài Huǒxīng shang luòdì.)
zh.truyen: 彗星 — 晚上，Xiaomei和妈妈用望远镜看天空。妈妈小声说：“看！那是彗星。我们能用望远镜看彗星。”Xiaomei说：“将来我也能坐火箭去太空旅游！”(Wǎnshang, Xiaomei hé māma yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn tiānkōng. Māma xiǎoshēng shuō: “Kàn! Nà shì huìxīng. Wǒmen néng yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn huìxīng.” Xiaomei shuō: “Jiānglái wǒ yě néng zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng lǚyóu!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "彗星是什么 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 56. Unit 6 · Phiên dịch nhí – Phỏng vấn phi hành gia

en.tu: Ôn: astronaut, spaceship, Earth, environment, decide, instead, anywhere | Ôn nhanh: together, member
en.cum: Ôn: by yourself / if you want / save the environment / decide to / go anywhere
en.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con dịch cho bạn Xiaomei): What could people do in space? / In the future, people could grow plants in space. / Astronauts never go into space by themselves. / We must save the environment on Earth.
en.truyen: Meet an astronaut — An astronaut visits Bông's school. Xiaomei can't speak English, so Bông helps her. 'What could people do in space?' asks Xiaomei. Bông says it in English. 'In the future, people could grow plants in space,' says the astronaut. Bông tells Xiaomei in Chinese.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "astronaut answers kids questions"

zh.tu: Ôn: 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 地球 dìqiú, 将来 jiānglái, 决定 juédìng, 办法 bànfǎ, 其他 qítā, 等 děng, 行 xíng
zh.cum: Ôn: 在太空能做什么 zài tàikōng néng zuò shénme / 爱护地球 àihù dìqiú / 想办法 xiǎng bànfǎ / 不但……而且…… búdàn… érqiě…
zh.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con dịch cho bạn Anna): 将来人们在太空能做什么？(Jiānglái rénmen zài tàikōng néng zuò shénme?) / 将来，人们能在太空种花。(Jiānglái, rénmen néng zài tàikōng zhòng huā.) / 宇航员不但要会开飞船，而且要身体好。(Yǔhángyuán búdàn yào huì kāi fēichuán, érqiě yào shēntǐ hǎo.)
zh.truyen: 见宇航员 — 一个宇航员来Bông的学校。Anna不会说汉语，Bông帮她。Anna问：“What could people do in space?” Bông用汉语说：“将来人们在太空能做什么？”宇航员说：“将来，人们能在太空种花。”(Yí ge yǔhángyuán lái Bông de xuéxiào. Anna bú huì shuō Hànyǔ, Bông bāng tā. Anna wèn: “What could people do in space?” Bông yòng Hànyǔ shuō: “Jiānglái rénmen zài tàikōng néng zuò shénme?” Yǔhángyuán shuō: “Jiānglái, rénmen néng zài tàikōng zhòng huā.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "王亚平 太空授课 儿童"

en.flash: Ôn: space, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, land, instead, telescope, adventure, anywhere, believe, decide, environment, follow, search, might, piece, whisper, across, other, could, if you want, by yourself
en.slide: 1) Nghe truyện của buổi rồi trả lời 3 câu: What do Xiaomei and Mum look through? (a telescope) / What could Xiaomei do one day? (fly a rocket into space) / What does she decide? (to join the space club). 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: What could people do in space? ↔ 将来人们在太空能做什么？/ People could travel to Mars by rocket. ↔ 将来人们能坐火箭去火星。3) Kiểm tra nhanh unit (6 câu chọn đáp án): could / might / instead / by yourself.
en.truyen: The comet — At night, Xiaomei and Mum look through a telescope. 'Look! A comet is flying across the sky,' whispers Mum. 'We could see comets with a telescope.' Xiaomei can't believe it. 'One day, I could fly a rocket into space. I could go anywhere!' she says. 'If you want, you could join the space club,' says Mum. Xiaomei decides to join it the next day.
en.baihat: Comet in the Sky (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Twinkle, twinkle, comet bright, / flying across the sky tonight. / With my telescope I see / planets, stars and Earth with me. / One day I could fly so far, / past the moon and every star!

zh.flash: Ôn: 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 行星 xíngxīng, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 望远镜 wàngyuǎnjìng, 起飞 qǐfēi, 落地 luòdì, 将来 jiānglái, 可能 kěnéng, 决定 juédìng, 办法 bànfǎ, 关于 guānyú, 旅游 lǚyóu, 其他 qítā, 行 xíng, 等 děng, 不但…而且… búdàn… érqiě…
zh.slide: 1) Nghe truyện của buổi rồi chọn đúng/sai (3 câu): Xiaomei和妈妈用望远镜看天空。(对) / Xiaomei想坐火车去太空。(错) / Xiaomei决定参加太空小组。(对) 2) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Trung, con dịch sang tiếng Anh: 将来人们能去太空旅游。→ In the future, people could travel to space. / 宇航员不但很勇敢，而且很聪明。→ Astronauts are brave and clever. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh chữ Hán (6 câu): nhìn tranh chọn chữ 太空 / 地球 / 火箭 / 宇航员 / 望远镜 / 行星.
zh.truyen: 彗星 — 晚上，Xiaomei和妈妈用望远镜看天空。妈妈小声说：“看！那是彗星。我们能用望远镜看彗星。”Xiaomei说：“将来我也能坐火箭去太空旅游，还能去其他行星！”妈妈说：“如果你想，你可以参加太空小组。”Xiaomei决定第二天就去。(Wǎnshang, Xiaomei hé māma yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn tiānkōng. Māma xiǎoshēng shuō: “Kàn! Nà shì huìxīng. Wǒmen néng yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn huìxīng.” Xiaomei shuō: “Jiānglái wǒ yě néng zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng lǚyóu, hái néng qù qítā xíngxīng!” Māma shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng, nǐ kěyǐ cānjiā tàikōng xiǎozǔ.” Xiaomei juédìng dì-èr tiān jiù qù.)
zh.baihat: 小彗星 (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star – 小星星) — 一闪一闪小彗星，(Yì shǎn yì shǎn xiǎo huìxīng,) / 飞过天空亮晶晶，(fēiguò tiānkōng liàng jīngjīng,) / 用望远镜看一看，(yòng wàngyuǎnjìng kàn yi kàn,) / 地球行星在身边，(dìqiú xíngxīng zài shēnbiān,) / 将来我坐火箭去，(jiānglái wǒ zuò huǒjiàn qù,) / 太空旅游真快乐。(tàikōng lǚyóu zhēn kuàilè.)

web.label: Ngày 57. Unit 7 · Giao thông – Đèn giao thông – Tắc đường

en.tu: Mới: traffic, light, jam, underground | Ôn nhanh: as, ever | Ôn: bus, car, taxi, bicycle
en.cum: Mới: traffic lights / a traffic jam / a red light / by underground | Ôn: by bus / by taxi / by bicycle
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: How …? – hỏi cách đi lại] How do you go to school? / I go to school by underground. / How does your dad go to work? – By car. / There is a big traffic jam. / Stop at the red light!
en.truyen: A traffic jam — Nhan's dad drives him to school. There is a big traffic jam on the road. The traffic light is red and all the cars stop. 'Tomorrow, let's go by underground,' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "traffic lights song for kids red yellow green"

zh.tu: Mới: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 停 tíng | Ôn nhanh: 阿姨 āyí, 儿子 érzi | Ôn: 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 坐 zuò, 开 kāi
zh.cum: Mới: 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě / 堵车了 dǔchē le / 看红绿灯 kàn hónglǜdēng / 停车 tíng chē | Ôn: 坐公共汽车 zuò gōnggòng qìchē / 开车 kāichē
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 怎么 + V; 坐 + phương tiện + 去 + nơi chốn] 你怎么去学校？(Nǐ zěnme qù xuéxiào?) / 我坐地铁去学校。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào.) / 今天路上堵车了。(Jīntiān lùshang dǔchē le.) / 红灯，停！(Hóng dēng, tíng!)
zh.truyen: 堵车 — 爸爸开车送Nhan去学校。路上堵车了。红灯亮了，车都停了。Nhan说：“明天我们坐地铁去学校吧！”(Bàba kāichē sòng Nhan qù xuéxiào. Lùshang dǔchē le. Hóng dēng liàng le, chē dōu tíng le. Nhan shuō: “Míngtiān wǒmen zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào ba!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "红绿灯 儿歌 交通安全"

web.label: Ngày 58. Unit 7 · Xe cứu hỏa, xe điện, bánh xe, hành khách

en.tu: Mới: electric, wheel, passenger | Ôn nhanh: high, winner | Ôn: lorry, motorbike, helicopter
en.cum: Mới: a red fire engine / an electric car / kilometre (ten kilometres) / four wheels / a lot of passengers | Ôn: a big lorry / by motorbike
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: will + V – dự đoán tương lai] Everyone will drive an electric car. / A fire engine has six wheels. / My school is two kilometres from my house. / The bus has a lot of passengers.
en.truyen: Leo's toy cars — Leo has a red fire engine and an electric car. The fire engine has six wheels. His toy bus has ten little passengers. 'In the future, everyone will drive an electric car,' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "vehicles for kids fire engine electric car"

zh.tu: Mới: 辆 liàng, 电动车 diàndòngchē, 船 chuán, 潜艇 qiántǐng | Ôn nhanh: 好像 hǎoxiàng, 俩 liǎ | Ôn: 火车 huǒchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē
zh.cum: Mới: 一辆车 yí liàng chē / 一辆电动车 yí liàng diàndòngchē / 坐船 zuò chuán / 一艘潜艇 yì sōu qiántǐng | Ôn: 一辆自行车 yí liàng zìxíngchē
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 会 + V – dự đoán] 大家都会开电动汽车。(Dàjiā dōu huì kāi diàndòng qìchē.) / 我家有一辆电动车。(Wǒ jiā yǒu yí liàng diàndòngchē.) / 我们坐船去海边。(Wǒmen zuò chuán qù hǎibiān.) / 潜艇在大海下面。(Qiántǐng zài dàhǎi xiàmiàn.)

zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "交通工具 儿童 认知 动画"

en.flash: traffic, light, jam, underground, fire engine, kilometre, electric, wheel, passenger | Ôn: bus, car, taxi, bicycle, lorry, motorbike
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): traffic lights / traffic jam / underground / fire engine / electric car / passenger. 2) Khảo sát lớp: How do you go to school? – I go to school by ___. (ghi bảng kết quả) 3) Đoán với will: In the future, everyone will ___. (drive an electric car / go by underground) – nhiễu: beetle / cave.
en.truyen: A traffic jam — Nhan's dad drives him to school. There is a big traffic jam on the road. The traffic light is red and all the cars stop. A fire engine with six wheels is in the jam too. 'My school is only two kilometres from here,' says Nhan. 'Tomorrow, let's go by underground. In the future, everyone will drive an electric car!'
en.baihat: Red Light, Green Light (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — Red light, red light, / stop the car, stop the car! / Green light, green light, / go, go, go! go, go, go! / Traffic jam, traffic jam, / take the underground!

zh.flash: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 停 tíng, 辆 liàng, 电动车 diàndòngchē, 船 chuán, 潜艇 qiántǐng | Ôn: 公共汽车 gōnggòng qìchē, 火车 huǒchē, 自行车 zìxíngchē, 坐 zuò, 开 kāi, 阿姨 āyí, 儿子 érzi
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 地铁 / 红绿灯 / 电动车 / 船 / 潜艇 / 堵车. 2) Điền lượng từ: 一___车 (辆) / 一___船 (艘) / 一___自行车 (辆). 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你怎么去学校？— 我坐___去学校。
zh.truyen: 堵车 — 爸爸开车送Nhan去学校。路上堵车了。红灯亮了，车都停了。一辆消防车也在堵车。Nhan说：“明天我们坐地铁去学校吧！将来大家都会开电动汽车。”爸爸说：“好！”(Bàba kāichē sòng Nhan qù xuéxiào. Lùshang dǔchē le. Hóng dēng liàng le, chē dōu tíng le. Yí liàng xiāofángchē yě zài dǔchē. Nhan shuō: “Míngtiān wǒmen zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào ba! Jiānglái dàjiā dōu huì kāi diàndòng qìchē.” Bàba shuō: “Hǎo!”)
zh.baihat: 红绿灯 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 红灯停，红灯停，(Hóng dēng tíng, hóng dēng tíng,) / 绿灯行，绿灯行，(lǜ dēng xíng, lǜ dēng xíng,) / 堵车我坐地铁，堵车我坐地铁，(dǔchē wǒ zuò dìtiě, dǔchē wǒ zuò dìtiě,) / 去学校，去学校。(qù xuéxiào, qù xuéxiào.)

web.label: Ngày 59. Unit 7 · Đến nơi – Ngã tư – Đừng quên

en.tu: Mới: arrive, intersection, forget | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): rocket, spaceship, astronaut, could | Ôn: map, ticket, police officer
en.cum: Mới: get to the museum / arrive at the station / at the intersection / don't forget | Ôn: by rocket / buy a ticket
en.cau: How do you get to the museum? / Turn left at the intersection. / We arrive at the station at eight o'clock. / In the future, people could get to the moon by rocket. / Don't forget your ticket!
en.truyen: Getting to the museum — Anna and Xiaomei want to get to the space museum. 'Turn left at the intersection,' says a police officer. They arrive at the museum. 'Oh no! I forgot my ticket!' says Xiaomei. 'Don't worry, I have two,' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "asking for directions for kids turn left turn right"

zh.tu: Mới: 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 斑马线 bānmǎxiàn, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 将来 jiānglái | Ôn: 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu
zh.cum: Mới: 在十字路口 zài shízì lùkǒu / 走斑马线 zǒu bānmǎxiàn / 八点出发 bā diǎn chūfā / 离开家 líkāi jiā | Ôn: 往左拐 wǎng zuǒ guǎi
zh.cau: 在十字路口往左拐。(Zài shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.) / 请走斑马线过马路。(Qǐng zǒu bānmǎxiàn guò mǎlù.) / 我们八点出发。(Wǒmen bā diǎn chūfā.) / 火箭离开了地球。(Huǒjiàn líkāile dìqiú.)
zh.truyen: 去博物馆 — Anna和Xiaomei八点离开家，出发去太空博物馆。警察说：“在十字路口往左拐，请走斑马线过马路。”她们到了博物馆，看到了一个很大的火箭。(Anna hé Xiaomei bā diǎn líkāi jiā, chūfā qù tàikōng bówùguǎn. Jǐngchá shuō: “Zài shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi, qǐng zǒu bānmǎxiàn guò mǎlù.” Tāmen dàole bówùguǎn, kàndàole yí ge hěn dà de huǒjiàn.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "过马路 走斑马线 儿童 安全"

web.label: Ngày 60. Unit 7 · Thích hơn – Khám phá – Cải thiện giao thông

en.tu: Mới: prefer, explore, sell, million, improve | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): Earth, environment, planet | Ôn: travel, train
en.cum: Mới: prefer the train / explore the city / sell tickets / a million cars / improve the traffic | Ôn: save the environment
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: will + V] Will buses replace motorbikes? / I prefer the underground to the bus. / A million people will drive electric cars. / Electric buses will improve the environment on Earth. / They sell tickets at the station.
en.truyen: Leo's city plan — Leo draws a city of the future. 'A million people will travel by electric bus,' he says. 'Electric buses will improve the traffic and the environment.' Anna prefers trains. 'I'll explore the city by train,' she says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "transport of the future for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 上车 shàngchē, 下车 xiàchē | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): 地球 dìqiú, 决定 juédìng, 可能 kěnéng | Ôn: 走 zǒu
zh.cum: Mới: 带车票 dài chēpiào / 别忘记 bié wàngjì / 上车 shàngchē / 下车 xiàchē | Ôn: 爱护地球 àihù dìqiú
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 会 + V] 公共汽车会代替摩托车吗？(Gōnggòng qìchē huì dàitì mótuōchē ma?) / 别忘记带车票！(Bié wàngjì dài chēpiào!) / 请先下车，再上车。(Qǐng xiān xiàchē, zài shàngchē.) / 电动汽车会爱护地球。(Diàndòng qìchē huì àihù dìqiú.)
zh.truyen: 坐公共汽车 — Anna和妈妈决定坐公共汽车去公园。妈妈说：“别忘记带车票！”公共汽车来了。阿姨说：“请先下车，再上车。”Anna说：“将来公共汽车会代替摩托车吗？”(Anna hé māma juédìng zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù gōngyuán. Māma shuō: “Bié wàngjì dài chēpiào!” Gōnggòng qìchē lái le. Āyí shuō: “Qǐng xiān xiàchē, zài shàngchē.” Anna shuō: “Jiānglái gōnggòng qìchē huì dàitì mótuōchē ma?”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "坐公交车 礼仪 儿童"

en.flash: get to, arrive, intersection, forget, prefer, explore, sell, million, improve | Ôn: rocket, spaceship, astronaut, Earth, environment, map, ticket
en.slide: 1) Chỉ đường trên bản đồ (cặp đôi): How do I get to the museum? – Turn left at the intersection. / Go straight. 2) Ghép câu (4 câu): I prefer + the underground to the bus. / Electric buses will + improve the environment. / They sell tickets + at the station. / Don't forget + your ticket! 3) Tranh luận nhỏ: Will buses replace motorbikes? – Yes, they will / No, they won't, because…
en.truyen: Getting to the museum — Anna and Xiaomei want to get to the space museum. 'Turn left at the intersection,' says a police officer. They arrive at the museum at ten. 'Oh no! I forgot my ticket!' says Xiaomei. 'Don't worry. They sell tickets here,' says Anna. Inside, they explore a city of the future. 'A million people will travel by electric bus. It will improve the environment!'
en.baihat: How Do I Get There? (giai điệu: London Bridge Is Falling Down) — How do I get to the museum, museum, museum? / How do I get to the museum? / Turn left here! / Don't forget your ticket, ticket, ticket. / Don't forget your ticket, / now we're here!

zh.flash: 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 斑马线 bānmǎxiàn, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 上车 shàngchē, 下车 xiàchē | Ôn: 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 将来 jiānglái, 地球 dìqiú, 决定 juédìng, 左 zuǒ, 右 yòu
zh.slide: 1) Chỉ đường trên bản đồ: 在十字路口往左拐 / 往右拐 / 一直走 – con đi theo hướng dẫn trên sàn lớp. 2) Sắp xếp các bước lên xe buýt: 带车票 → 等车 → 先下车，再上车 → 下车. 3) Nghe – trả lời: 公共汽车会代替摩托车吗？— 会 / 不会。 4) YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, 10 câu, từng em; cô đọc 1 lần, con nói lại 1 lần): 我每天坐地铁去学校。/ 在十字路口往左拐。/ 别忘记带车票！/ 我们八点出发。/ 路上有很多辆车。/ 红灯的时候，车要停下来。/ 我们离开家的时候，天还没亮。/ 公共汽车停在学校门口。/ 你坐地铁，在第三站下车。/ 先下车，再上车。
zh.truyen: 去博物馆 — Anna和Xiaomei八点离开家，出发去太空博物馆。警察说：“在十字路口往左拐，请走斑马线过马路。”Xiaomei说：“哎呀，我忘记带票了！”Anna说：“别着急，这里可以买票。”她们进了博物馆，看到了将来的城市。(Anna hé Xiaomei bā diǎn líkāi jiā, chūfā qù tàikōng bówùguǎn. Jǐngchá shuō: “Zài shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi, qǐng zǒu bānmǎxiàn guò mǎlù.” Xiaomei shuō: “Āiyā, wǒ wàngjì dài piào le!” Anna shuō: “Bié zháojí, zhèli kěyǐ mǎi piào.” Tāmen jìnle bówùguǎn, kàndàole jiānglái de chéngshì.)
zh.baihat: 过马路 (giai điệu: Mary Had a Little Lamb) — 过马路，走斑马线，(Guò mǎlù, zǒu bānmǎxiàn,) / 斑马线，斑马线，(bānmǎxiàn, bānmǎxiàn,) / 十字路口往左拐，(shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi,) / 别忘记带票！(bié wàngjì dài piào!)

web.label: Ngày 61. Unit 7 · Động cơ, còi tàu – Vừa tỉnh dậy

en.tu: Mới: engine, whistle | Ôn: train, platform, passenger, traffic, journey
en.cum: Mới: the train's engine / blow a whistle / a long journey | Ôn: on the platform / passengers get on
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: will + V] Listen! The train will leave soon. / The guard blows the whistle. / The engine is very loud. / The passengers get on the train.
en.truyen: The night train — Bông and Grandpa are on the platform. The guard blows the whistle. 'Toot toot!' The engine starts. The passengers get on the train. 'Our journey will be long,' says Grandpa. 'It's eight hundred kilometres to Hanoi.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "steam train whistle sound for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 醒 xǐng, 着 zhe | Ôn: 火车 huǒchē, 停 tíng, 出发 chūfā, 辆 liàng, 坐 zuò
zh.cum: Mới: 醒了 xǐng le / 坐着 zuòzhe / 开着窗户 kāizhe chuānghu / 站着等车 zhànzhe děng chē | Ôn: 火车出发了 huǒchē chūfā le
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: động từ + 着 – trạng thái đang kéo dài] Leo在火车上坐着。(Leo zài huǒchē shang zuòzhe.) / 窗户开着。(Chuānghu kāizhe.) / 火车出发了，Anna还没醒。(Huǒchē chūfā le, Anna hái méi xǐng.) / 我们站着等车。(Wǒmen zhànzhe děng chē.)
zh.truyen: 坐火车 — Bông和爷爷坐火车去河内。火车出发了。爷爷坐着看书，窗户开着。Bông睡着了。火车停了，爷爷说：“Bông，醒醒！我们到了！”(Bông hé yéye zuò huǒchē qù Hénèi. Huǒchē chūfā le. Yéye zuòzhe kàn shū, chuānghu kāizhe. Bông shuìzháo le. Huǒchē tíng le, yéye shuō: “Bông, xǐngxing! Wǒmen dào le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "坐火车 儿童 动画 故事"

web.label: Ngày 62. Unit 7 · Ôn không tranh – Nghe đoán phương tiện

en.tu: Ôn: traffic, light, jam, underground, electric, wheel, passenger, arrive, intersection, forget, prefer, engine | Ôn nhanh: as, ever, of course
en.cum: Ôn: fire engine / get to / kilometre / a traffic jam / at the intersection / sell tickets
en.cau: Ôn (nghe – chọn đúng/sai, không tranh): How do you go to school? – By underground. / Turn left at the intersection. / A fire engine is red. / Everyone will drive an electric car. / Have you ever been in a traffic jam? – Of course!
en.truyen: What am I? — I'm red and I have six wheels. I'm very fast. I have a loud whistle and a strong engine. I go to fires and help people. What am I? (A fire engine!)
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "guess the vehicle sound quiz for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 停 tíng, 辆 liàng, 电动车 diàndòngchē, 船 chuán, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 斑马线 bānmǎxiàn, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 醒 xǐng, 着 zhe
zh.cum: Ôn: 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě / 在十字路口往左拐 zài shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi / 走斑马线 zǒu bānmǎxiàn / 别忘记带车票 bié wàngjì dài chēpiào / 上车、下车 shàngchē, xiàchē
zh.cau: Ôn (nghe – chọn đúng/sai, không tranh): 我坐地铁去学校。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào.) / 红灯，停！(Hóng dēng, tíng!) / 公共汽车会代替摩托车吗？(Gōnggòng qìchē huì dàitì mótuōchē ma?) / 窗户开着。(Chuānghu kāizhe.) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu): con nghe rồi nói lại, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] 我们早上七点出发。(Wǒmen zǎoshang qī diǎn chūfā.) / 别忘记带车票！(Bié wàngjì dài chēpiào!) / 火车停了，我醒了。(Huǒchē tíng le, wǒ xǐng le.)
zh.truyen: 猜一猜 — 我在地下走。我不怕堵车。很多人坐着我去上班、去学校。我是什么？（地铁！）(Wǒ zài dìxià zǒu. Wǒ bú pà dǔchē. Hěn duō rén zuòzhe wǒ qù shàngbān, qù xuéxiào. Wǒ shì shénme? (Dìtiě!))
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "猜一猜 交通工具 儿童"

en.flash: engine, whistle | Ôn: traffic, light, jam, underground, fire engine, kilometre, electric, wheel, passenger, arrive, intersection, forget, prefer, train, platform, journey
en.slide: 1) Nghe âm thanh đoán phương tiện (6 âm): train whistle / fire engine / electric car / motorbike / helicopter / underground. 2) Trò 'What am I?' theo nhóm: con tự viết 3 câu đố về một phương tiện (I have ___ wheels. I'm ___.) 3) Nghe – chọn đúng/sai về truyện 'The night train' (4 câu).
en.truyen: The night train — Bông and Grandpa are on the platform. The guard blows the whistle. 'Toot toot!' The engine starts and the passengers get on the train. 'Our journey will be long. It's eight hundred kilometres,' says Grandpa. Bông falls asleep. In the morning, the train arrives in Hanoi. 'Wake up, Bông! We're here!'
en.baihat: The Train Song (giai điệu: The Wheels on the Bus) — The wheels on the train go round and round, / round and round, round and round. / The wheels on the train go round and round / all through the night. / The whistle on the train goes toot, toot, toot... / The passengers on the train go to sleep...

zh.flash: 醒 xǐng, 着 zhe | Ôn: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 停 tíng, 辆 liàng, 电动车 diàndòngchē, 船 chuán, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 斑马线 bānmǎxiàn, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 俩 liǎ
zh.slide: 1) Làm động tác theo lệnh có 着 (5 lệnh): 站着！/ 坐着！/ 开着门！/ 拿着书！/ 笑着说“你好”！2) Nhìn tranh nói câu 着: 爷爷坐着看书。/ 窗户开着。/ Bông睡着了。3) Đố vui theo nhóm: 我在地下走，我不怕堵车。我是什么？
zh.truyen: 坐火车 — Bông和爷爷坐火车去河内。火车出发了。爷爷坐着看书，窗户开着。Bông看着外面的田，看着看着就睡着了。第二天早上，火车停了。爷爷说：“Bông，醒醒！我们到了！”(Bông hé yéye zuò huǒchē qù Hénèi. Huǒchē chūfā le. Yéye zuòzhe kàn shū, chuānghu kāizhe. Bông kànzhe wàimiàn de tián, kànzhe kànzhe jiù shuìzháo le. Dì-èr tiān zǎoshang, huǒchē tíng le. Yéye shuō: “Bông, xǐngxing! Wǒmen dào le!”)
zh.baihat: 开火车 (giai điệu: Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — 坐着火车去河内，(Zuòzhe huǒchē qù Hénèi,) / 呜呜呜呜呜，(wū wū wū wū wū,) / 爷爷坐着看着书，(yéye zuòzhe kànzhe shū,) / 醒醒我们到！(xǐngxing wǒmen dào!)

en.tu: Ôn: fire engine, traffic jam, light, intersection, arrive, improve, million | Ôn nhanh: look like, winner
en.cum: Ôn: a fire engine / a traffic jam / at the intersection / get to the fire / in the future
en.cau: Chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung: How do you go to school? / I go to school by underground. / Turn left at the crossroads. / Cross the road at the zebra crossing.
en.truyen: The fire engine — There is a fire near the bridge. The fire engine leaves the fire station, but there is a big traffic jam. 'Please stop!' says a police officer at the intersection. All the cars stop and the fire engine gets to the fire. The fire fighters save the house!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "fire engine story for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 堵车 dǔchē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 停 tíng, 出发 chūfā, 辆 liàng, 离开 líkāi
zh.cum: Ôn: 一辆消防车 yí liàng xiāofángchē / 堵车了 dǔchē le / 在十字路口 zài shízì lùkǒu / 车都停了 chē dōu tíng le
zh.cau: Chuyển ngữ Trung → Anh: 你怎么去学校？(Nǐ zěnme qù xuéxiào?) / 我坐地铁去学校。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào.) / 在十字路口往左拐。(Zài shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.) / 请走斑马线过马路。(Qǐng zǒu bānmǎxiàn guò mǎlù.)
zh.truyen: 消防车 — 桥附近着火了！一辆消防车离开消防站出发了。可是路上堵车了。在十字路口，警察说：“请停车！”车都停了，消防车很快就到了。(Qiáo fùjìn zháohuǒ le! Yí liàng xiāofángchē líkāi xiāofángzhàn chūfā le. Kěshì lùshang dǔchē le. Zài shízì lùkǒu, jǐngchá shuō: “Qǐng tíng chē!” Chē dōu tíng le, xiāofángchē hěn kuài jiù dào le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "消防车 故事 儿童 动画"

web.label: Ngày 64. Unit 7 · Phiên dịch nhí – Hỏi đường cho bạn

en.tu: Ôn: get to, intersection, underground, ticket, forget, prefer, kilometre | Ôn nhanh: ever, as
en.cum: Ôn: How do I get to…? / turn left / by underground / don't forget your ticket
en.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con dịch cho bạn Xiaomei): How do I get to the airport? / Take the underground and get off at the third station. / It's ten kilometres from here. / Don't forget your ticket!
en.truyen: Lost in the city — Xiaomei is visiting Hanoi. She wants to get to the airport. A man asks, 'Can I help you?' Xiaomei doesn't understand, so Nhan helps her. 'Take the underground. It's ten kilometres from here,' says the man. Nhan tells Xiaomei in Chinese. 'Don't forget your ticket!' he says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how do I get to the station dialogue for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 地铁 dìtiě, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 上车 shàngchē, 下车 xiàchē, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 离开 líkāi, 出发 chūfā
zh.cum: Ôn: 怎么去机场 zěnme qù jīchǎng / 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě / 在第三站下车 zài dì-sān zhàn xiàchē / 别忘记 bié wàngjì
zh.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con dịch cho bạn Anna): 请问，怎么去机场？(Qǐngwèn, zěnme qù jīchǎng?) / 你坐地铁，在第三站下车。(Nǐ zuò dìtiě, zài dì-sān zhàn xiàchē.) / 别忘记带车票！(Bié wàngjì dài chēpiào!)
zh.truyen: 问路 — Xiaomei在河内，她想去机场，可是她迷路了。一个叔叔说英语，Xiaomei不明白，Nhan帮她。Nhan说：“你坐地铁，在第三站下车。别忘记带车票！”Xiaomei说：“谢谢你，Nhan！”(Xiaomei zài Hénèi, tā xiǎng qù jīchǎng, kěshì tā mílù le. Yí ge shūshu shuō Yīngyǔ, Xiaomei bù míngbai, Nhan bāng tā. Nhan shuō: “Nǐ zuò dìtiě, zài dì-sān zhàn xiàchē. Bié wàngjì dài chēpiào!” Xiaomei shuō: “Xièxie nǐ, Nhan!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "问路 汉语 儿童 对话"

en.flash: Ôn: traffic, light, jam, underground, fire engine, get to, kilometre, electric, wheel, passenger, arrive, intersection, forget, prefer, explore, sell, million, improve, engine, whistle
en.slide: 1) Kể lại truyện 'The fire engine' theo 4 tranh (gợi ý: fire / traffic jam / intersection / gets to the fire). 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp, đóng vai hỏi đường: How do I get to the airport? ↔ 请问，怎么去机场？/ Take the underground. ↔ 你坐地铁。3) Kiểm tra nhanh unit (6 câu chọn đáp án): How do you…? / will / by + phương tiện. 3) Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): kể truyện theo 5 tranh 'The Fire Engine and the Traffic Jam'. Cô kể tranh 1: There was a fire in a tall building. The fire fighters got into the fire engine. Con kể tranh 2–5: (2) There was a traffic jam at the intersection. The fire engine couldn't move. / (3) A police officer saw the fire engine. He stopped the cars at the traffic lights. / (4) The cars moved to the side, and the fire engine went very fast. / (5) It got to the building in five minutes. The fire fighters stopped the fire, and everyone said, 'Thank you!'
en.truyen: The fire engine — There is a fire near the bridge. The fire engine leaves the fire station, but there is a big traffic jam. The traffic lights are red. 'Please stop!' says a police officer at the intersection. All the cars stop and the fire engine gets to the fire in five minutes. The fire fighters save the house. 'In the future, electric fire engines will be even faster,' says Leo.
en.baihat: Fire Engine, Fire Engine (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — Fire engine, fire engine, / hurry up, hurry up! / Stop at the intersection, stop at the intersection, / cars, please stop! cars, please stop!

zh.flash: Ôn: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 停 tíng, 辆 liàng, 电动车 diàndòngchē, 船 chuán, 潜艇 qiántǐng, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 斑马线 bānmǎxiàn, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 上车 shàngchē, 下车 xiàchē, 醒 xǐng, 着 zhe
zh.slide: 1) Đọc lại truyện 消防车 theo vai (người kể – cảnh sát). 2) Phiên dịch nhí: cô nói câu tiếng Trung, con dịch sang tiếng Anh: 你坐地铁，在第三站下车。→ Take the underground and get off at the third station. / 别忘记带车票！→ Don't forget your ticket! 3) Kiểm tra nhanh chữ Hán (6 câu): nhìn tranh chọn chữ 地铁 / 红绿灯 / 十字路口 / 斑马线 / 船 / 电动车.
zh.truyen: 消防车 — 桥附近着火了！一辆消防车离开消防站出发了。可是路上堵车了，红绿灯也是红灯。在十字路口，警察说：“请停车！”车都停了，消防车很快就到了。消防员救了那座房子。(Qiáo fùjìn zháohuǒ le! Yí liàng xiāofángchē líkāi xiāofángzhàn chūfā le. Kěshì lùshang dǔchē le, hónglǜdēng yě shì hóng dēng. Zài shízì lùkǒu, jǐngchá shuō: “Qǐng tíng chē!” Chē dōu tíng le, xiāofángchē hěn kuài jiù dào le. Xiāofángyuán jiùle nà zuò fángzi.)
zh.baihat: 消防车来了 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 消防车来，消防车来，(Xiāofángchē lái, xiāofángchē lái,) / 快停车，快停车，(kuài tíng chē, kuài tíng chē,) / 十字路口等一等，十字路口等一等，(shízì lùkǒu děng yi děng, shízì lùkǒu děng yi děng,) / 让它走，让它走。(ràng tā zǒu, ràng tā zǒu.)

web.label: Ngày 65. Unit 8 · Cắm trại, đại dương, sa mạc – Nếu… thì…

en.tu: Mới: camp, ocean, desert, sunshine, if | Ôn nhanh: dictionary, gym | Ôn: weather, hot, cold, sunny, beach
en.cum: Mới: go camping / by the ocean / in the desert / warm sunshine | Ôn: on the beach / a sunny day
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu điều kiện loại 1 – If + hiện tại đơn, … will + V] What will you do if it is cool? / If the weather is cool, we will go camping. / If it is sunny, we will swim in the ocean. / It's very dry in the desert.
en.truyen: Camping plans — 'What will you do this weekend?' asks Anna. 'If the weather is cool, we will go camping by the ocean,' says Leo. 'I love the sunshine and the beach!' 'I don't like the desert. It's very hot and dry,' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "weather song for kids what will you do if"

zh.tu: Mới: 晴 qíng, 阳光 yángguāng, 沙漠 shāmò, 海洋 hǎiyáng, 干燥 gānzào | Ôn nhanh: 参加 cānjiā, 放假 fàngjià | Ôn: 天气 tiānqì, 热 rè, 冷 lěng, 太阳 tàiyáng
zh.cum: Mới: 晴天 qíngtiān / 阳光很好 yángguāng hěn hǎo / 在沙漠里 zài shāmò li / 海洋动物 hǎiyáng dòngwù / 很干燥 hěn gānzào | Ôn: 天气很热 tiānqì hěn rè
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 如果……，就……] 如果天气凉快，你会做什么？(Rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, nǐ huì zuò shénme?) / 如果天气凉快，我们就去露营。(Rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng.) / 沙漠里很干燥。(Shāmò li hěn gānzào.) / 今天是晴天，阳光很好。(Jīntiān shì qíngtiān, yángguāng hěn hǎo.)
zh.truyen: 去露营 — 放假了。Anna问：“周末你会做什么？”Leo说：“如果天气凉快，我们就去海边露营。我喜欢阳光和大海！”Anna说：“我不喜欢沙漠，沙漠里又热又干燥。”(Fàngjià le. Anna wèn: “Zhōumò nǐ huì zuò shénme?” Leo shuō: “Rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù hǎibiān lùyíng. Wǒ xǐhuan yángguāng hé dàhǎi!” Anna shuō: “Wǒ bù xǐhuan shāmò, shāmò li yòu rè yòu gānzào.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "天气 儿歌 晴天 下雨"

web.label: Ngày 66. Unit 8 · Tháng Tư, tháng Mười một – Sương mù lúc này

en.tu: Mới: April, November, fog, foggy | Ôn nhanh: letter, timetable | Ôn: spring, autumn, temperature, cloudy
en.cum: Mới: a.m. (7 a.m.) / at the moment / in April / in November / a foggy morning | Ôn: in spring / in autumn
en.cau: What's the weather like at the moment? – It's foggy. / What's the temperature today? / We go to school at 7 a.m. / It's warm in April. / [Ngữ pháp: If + hiện tại, will + V] If it is foggy, we will not go by bike.
en.truyen: A foggy morning — It's 7 a.m. in November. Nhan looks out of the window. 'What's the weather like at the moment?' asks Mum. 'It's foggy. I can't see the trees!' says Nhan. 'If it is foggy, we will go by bus, not by bike,' says Mum.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "months of the year song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 春季 chūnjì, 夏 xià, 秋 qiū, 冬 dōng, 温度 wēndù | Ôn nhanh: 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 寒假 hánjià | Ôn: 季节 jìjié, 春天 chūntiān, 冬天 dōngtiān
zh.cum: Mới: 春夏秋冬 chūn xià qiū dōng / 春季运动会 chūnjì yùndònghuì / 温度很高 wēndù hěn gāo / 多少度 duōshao dù | Ôn: 四个季节 sì ge jìjié
zh.cau: 今天多少度？(Jīntiān duōshao dù?) / 今天的温度是二十五度。(Jīntiān de wēndù shì èrshíwǔ dù.) / 一年有春、夏、秋、冬四个季节。(Yì nián yǒu chūn, xià, qiū, dōng sì ge jìjié.) / 我们学校四月有春季运动会。(Wǒmen xuéxiào sì yuè yǒu chūnjì yùndònghuì.)
zh.truyen: 四个季节 — 老师问：“一年有几个季节？”Nhan说：“有春、夏、秋、冬四个季节。”老师说：“今天多少度？”Bông说：“今天的温度是二十度，很凉快。”(Lǎoshī wèn: “Yì nián yǒu jǐ ge jìjié?” Nhan shuō: “Yǒu chūn, xià, qiū, dōng sì ge jìjié.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Jīntiān duōshao dù?” Bông shuō: “Jīntiān de wēndù shì èrshí dù, hěn liángkuai.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "春夏秋冬 儿歌 四季"

en.flash: camp, ocean, desert, sunshine, if, April, November, fog, foggy, a.m., at the moment | Ôn: weather, hot, cold, sunny, spring, autumn, temperature
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): camp / ocean / desert / sunshine / fog / foggy. 2) Vòng tròn 'If…': cô rút thẻ thời tiết, con nói: If it is sunny, we will ___. / If it is foggy, we will ___. 3) Lịch tháng: chỉ và nói It's warm in April. / It's cool in November. (nhiễu: castle / prize).
en.truyen: Camping plans — 'What will you do this weekend?' asks Anna. 'If the weather is cool, we will go camping by the ocean,' says Leo. 'I love the sunshine.' On Saturday, at 7 a.m., Leo looks out of the window. 'What's the weather like at the moment?' asks Mum. 'It's foggy!' says Leo. 'If it is foggy, we will wait. It's November, so it's cool.' At midday, the sun comes out. They go camping!
en.baihat: If It's Sunny (giai điệu: If You're Happy and You Know It – dân gian) — If it's sunny, we will go camping, yes, we will! / If it's sunny, we will go camping, yes, we will! / If it's foggy, we will wait, / we will play and we'll be late, / if it's sunny, we will go camping, yes, we will!

zh.flash: 晴 qíng, 阳光 yángguāng, 沙漠 shāmò, 海洋 hǎiyáng, 干燥 gānzào, 春季 chūnjì, 夏 xià, 秋 qiū, 冬 dōng, 温度 wēndù | Ôn: 天气 tiānqì, 热 rè, 冷 lěng, 季节 jìjié, 参加 cānjiā, 放假 fàngjià, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 寒假 hánjià
zh.slide: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (6 câu): 晴天 / 阳光 / 沙漠 / 海洋 / 春季 / 冬. 2) Đọc nhiệt kế: 今天多少度？— 今天三十度。(4 nhiệt kế: 30 / 15 / 5 / 25). 3) Hoàn thành câu 如果……，就……: 如果天气凉快，我们就___。/ 如果是晴天，我们就___。
zh.truyen: 去露营 — 放假了。Anna问：“周末你会做什么？”Leo说：“如果天气凉快，我们就去海边露营。”星期六，妈妈问：“今天多少度？”Leo说：“今天的温度是二十度，是晴天，阳光很好！”他们就去露营了。(Fàngjià le. Anna wèn: “Zhōumò nǐ huì zuò shénme?” Leo shuō: “Rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù hǎibiān lùyíng.” Xīngqīliù, māma wèn: “Jīntiān duōshao dù?” Leo shuō: “Jīntiān de wēndù shì èrshí dù, shì qíngtiān, yángguāng hěn hǎo!” Tāmen jiù qù lùyíng le.)
zh.baihat: 春夏秋冬 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 春季温暖，春季温暖，(Chūnjì wēnnuǎn, chūnjì wēnnuǎn,) / 夏天热，夏天热，(xiàtiān rè, xiàtiān rè,) / 秋天凉快冬天冷，秋天凉快冬天冷，(qiūtiān liángkuai dōngtiān lěng, qiūtiān liángkuai dōngtiān lěng,) / 春夏秋冬，春夏秋冬。(chūn xià qiū dōng, chūn xià qiū dōng.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 34. Unit 8 · Weather – Sớm, muộn & các tháng · Luyện YCT口试（中级）第三部分

web.label: Ngày 67. Unit 8 · Lát nữa – Sớm, muộn – Buổi trưa

en.tu: Mới: early, late, hour, midday | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): traffic, jam, underground, electric | Ôn nhanh: uniform
en.cum: Mới: in a minute / get up early / be late for school / an hour / at midday | Ôn: a traffic jam / by underground
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: If + hiện tại, will + V] If there is a traffic jam, we will be late. / If you get up early, you won't be late. / Hurry! The bus will come in a minute. / It takes an hour by car. / It's very hot at midday.
en.truyen: Don't be late! — It's raining and there is a traffic jam. 'If we go by car, we will be late,' says Dad. 'It takes an hour!' 'Let's go by underground. The train will come in a minute,' says Leo. They get to school early.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "early or late kids english lesson"

zh.tu: Mới: 马上 mǎshàng, 来得及 láidejí, 刻 kè | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 出发 chūfā | Ôn nhanh: 初中 chūzhōng, 介绍 jièshào
zh.cum: Mới: 马上出发 mǎshàng chūfā / 还来得及 hái láidejí / 来不及 lái bu jí / 七点一刻 qī diǎn yí kè | Ôn: 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě / 堵车了 dǔchē le
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 如果……，就……] 如果堵车，我们就坐地铁。(Rúguǒ dǔchē, wǒmen jiù zuò dìtiě.) / 现在七点一刻。(Xiànzài qī diǎn yí kè.) / 快走吧，还来得及！(Kuài zǒu ba, hái láidejí!) / 我们马上出发。(Wǒmen mǎshàng chūfā.)
zh.truyen: 来得及吗？— 下雨了，路上堵车。爸爸说：“现在七点一刻，如果我们开车，就来不及了。”Leo说：“我们坐地铁吧，地铁马上就来，还来得及！”他们很早就到了学校。(Xià yǔ le, lùshang dǔchē. Bàba shuō: “Xiànzài qī diǎn yí kè, rúguǒ wǒmen kāichē, jiù lái bu jí le.” Leo shuō: “Wǒmen zuò dìtiě ba, dìtiě mǎshàng jiù lái, hái láidejí!” Tāmen hěn zǎo jiù dàole xuéxiào.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "认识时间 一刻 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 68. Unit 8 · Tháng Hai, tháng Bảy, tháng Tám – Bờ biển

en.tu: Mới: February, July, August, coast, later | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): light, passenger, arrive | Ôn: summer, winter, snow, Beijing
en.cum: Mới: in February / in July and August / on the coast / see you later | Ôn: in summer / in winter / arrive in Beijing
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: If + hiện tại, will + V?] If it snows today, will you go to Beijing? / In July and August, it's hot on the coast. / It's cold in February. / I'll call you later.
en.truyen: A phone call — Xiaomei calls Bông from Beijing in February. 'It's snowing here!' says Xiaomei. 'If it snows tomorrow, will you make a snowman?' asks Bông. 'Yes! In July and August, I will visit you on the coast,' says Xiaomei. 'See you later!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "seasons and months for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 经常 jīngcháng, 海岸 hǎi'àn, 潮湿 cháoshī, 空气 kōngqì | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): 离开 líkāi, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì | Ôn nhanh: 句子 jùzi, 练习 liànxí
zh.cum: Mới: 经常下雨 jīngcháng xià yǔ / 在海岸边 zài hǎi'àn biān / 很潮湿 hěn cháoshī / 空气很好 kōngqì hěn hǎo | Ôn: 别忘记带雨伞 bié wàngjì dài yǔsǎn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 如果……，会……] 如果今天下雪，你会去北京吗？(Rúguǒ jīntiān xiàxuě, nǐ huì qù Běijīng ma?) / 夏天，海岸边经常下雨。(Xiàtiān, hǎi'àn biān jīngcháng xià yǔ.) / 这里的空气很潮湿。(Zhèli de kōngqì hěn cháoshī.) / 如果下雨，别忘记带雨伞。(Rúguǒ xià yǔ, bié wàngjì dài yǔsǎn.)
zh.truyen: 打电话 — 二月，Xiaomei从北京给Bông打电话：“北京下雪了！”Bông说：“这里不冷，可是空气很潮湿，经常下雨。”Xiaomei说：“七月我会去海岸边看你。”Bông说：“如果下雨，别忘记带雨伞！”(Èr yuè, Xiaomei cóng Běijīng gěi Bông dǎ diànhuà: “Běijīng xià xuě le!” Bông shuō: “Zhèli bù lěng, kěshì kōngqì hěn cháoshī, jīngcháng xià yǔ.” Xiaomei shuō: “Qī yuè wǒ huì qù hǎi'àn biān kàn nǐ.” Bông shuō: “Rúguǒ xià yǔ, bié wàngjì dài yǔsǎn!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "北京 冬天 下雪 儿童"

en.flash: early, late, hour, midday, in a minute, February, July, August, coast, later | Ôn: traffic, jam, underground, electric, summer, winter, snow
en.slide: 1) Ghép câu điều kiện (5 câu): If there is a traffic jam, + we will be late. / If you get up early, + you won't be late. / If it snows today, + will you go to Beijing? / If it is hot in July, + we will go to the coast. / If it rains, + we will stay at home. 2) Vòng quay tháng: con quay và nói một câu về tháng đó (It's cold in February.). 3) Đóng vai gọi điện 'A phone call' theo cặp.
en.truyen: Don't be late! — It's 7 a.m. in February. It's raining and there is a traffic jam. 'If we go by car, we will be late,' says Dad. 'It takes an hour!' 'Let's go by underground. The train will come in a minute,' says Leo. They get to school early. Later, Leo talks to Xiaomei on the phone. 'In July and August, I will visit you on the coast,' says Xiaomei.
en.baihat: Months of the Year (giai điệu: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush – dân gian) — January, February, it's cold, it's cold, / it's cold, it's cold! / April, it's warm, the flowers grow, / July, August, it's hot on the coast! / November, it's cool, let's go to bed early!

zh.flash: 马上 mǎshàng, 来得及 láidejí, 刻 kè, 经常 jīngcháng, 海岸 hǎi'àn, 潮湿 cháoshī, 空气 kōngqì | Ôn: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi, 带 dài, 忘记 wàngjì, 初中 chūzhōng, 介绍 jièshào, 句子 jùzi, 练习 liànxí
zh.slide: 1) Đọc giờ trên đồng hồ: 七点一刻 / 八点半 / 九点三刻 / 十点一刻. 2) Chọn câu đúng: 还来得及 hay 来不及？(Xe 7:15 – con đến lúc 7:10 / 7:20). 3) Nói về thời tiết nơi mình: 这里经常___。空气很___。 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, từng em, câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 你最喜欢什么季节？为什么？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jìjié? Wèishénme?) – Đoạn mẫu: 我最喜欢秋天。秋天不冷也不热，经常是晴天。我经常和爸爸去公园。/ 下雨的时候，你经常做什么？(Xià yǔ de shíhou, nǐ jīngcháng zuò shénme?) – Đoạn mẫu: 下雨的时候，我经常在家看书。雨停了，我就马上出去玩。
zh.truyen: 来得及吗？— 下雨了，路上堵车。爸爸说：“现在七点一刻，如果我们开车，就来不及了。”Leo说：“我们坐地铁吧，地铁马上就来！”他们很早就到了学校。晚上，Xiaomei给Leo打电话：“北京下雪了！”Leo说：“这里空气很潮湿，经常下雨。”(Xià yǔ le, lùshang dǔchē. Bàba shuō: “Xiànzài qī diǎn yí kè, rúguǒ wǒmen kāichē, jiù lái bu jí le.” Leo shuō: “Wǒmen zuò dìtiě ba, dìtiě mǎshàng jiù lái!” Tāmen hěn zǎo jiù dàole xuéxiào. Wǎnshang, Xiaomei gěi Leo dǎ diànhuà: “Běijīng xià xuě le!” Leo shuō: “Zhèli kōngqì hěn cháoshī, jīngcháng xià yǔ.”)
zh.baihat: 来得及 (giai điệu: Frère Jacques) — 七点一刻，七点一刻，(Qī diǎn yí kè, qī diǎn yí kè,) / 快出发，快出发，(kuài chūfā, kuài chūfā,) / 地铁马上就来，地铁马上就来，(dìtiě mǎshàng jiù lái, dìtiě mǎshàng jiù lái,) / 来得及，来得及！(láidejí, láidejí!)

en.truyen: Snow at midnight — Two days ago, it was sunny in the mountains. Then, at midnight, it began to snow. 'If it is very cold, the lake will freeze,' says Grandpa. 'A century ago, people skated on this lake.' In the morning, Leo and Anna make a snowman.

en.truyen: Snow at midnight — Two days ago, it was sunny in the mountains. Leo and Anna went camping with Grandpa. Then, at midnight, it began to snow. 'If it is very cold, the lake will freeze,' says Grandpa. 'A century ago, people skated on this lake.' In the morning, the lake is white. Leo and Anna make a big snowman. 'If it is sunny at midday, our snowman will melt!' laughs Anna.
en.baihat: Snowflakes at Midnight (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Snowflakes, snowflakes, falling down, / at midnight on the quiet town. / If it's cold, the lake will freeze, / white and shiny on the trees. / In the morning, come and play, / make a snowman, hip hooray!

en.slide: 1) Kể lại truyện 'The camping trip' theo 4 tranh (gợi ý: sunny / suddenly foggy and windy / swim later / stars at night). 2) Dự án nhóm 'Weather report': mỗi nhóm làm bản tin 4 câu (It's 7 a.m. / At the moment, it's ___. / The temperature is ___ degrees. / If ___, ___ will ___.) rồi một bạn dịch sang tiếng Trung. 3) Kiểm tra nhanh unit (6 câu chọn đáp án): If…will / months / a.m.
en.truyen: The camping trip — In July, Leo's family goes camping on the coast. In the morning, it's sunny and there is a lot of sunshine. 'Let's swim in the ocean!' says Leo. Suddenly, it becomes foggy and windy. 'If it is windy, we won't swim,' says Dad. 'We'll swim later.' At midnight, the sky is clear. Dad tells Leo about the Earth's atmosphere. 'The atmosphere keeps us safe,' he says. Leo looks at the stars and smiles.
en.baihat: Weather Report Song (giai điệu: The Wheels on the Bus) — The weather today is sunny and hot, / sunny and hot, sunny and hot. / The weather today is sunny and hot, / let's go camping! / The weather today is foggy and cold... / let's stay at home! / The weather today is windy and wet... / take your coat!

zh.truyen: 去海边露营 — 七月，Leo一家去海岸边露营。早上是晴天，阳光很好。Leo说：“我们去海里游泳吧！”突然，刮风了，海上也有雾了。爸爸说：“如果刮风，我们就不游泳。我们晚一点儿再去。”晚上，天空很清楚，Leo和爸爸一起看星星。爸爸说：“地球外面有大气层，它保护我们。”(Qī yuè, Leo yì jiā qù hǎi'àn biān lùyíng. Zǎoshang shì qíngtiān, yángguāng hěn hǎo. Leo shuō: “Wǒmen qù hǎi li yóuyǒng ba!” Tūrán, guāfēng le, hǎi shang yě yǒu wù le. Bàba shuō: “Rúguǒ guāfēng, wǒmen jiù bù yóuyǒng. Wǒmen wǎn yìdiǎnr zài qù.” Wǎnshang, tiānkōng hěn qīngchu, Leo hé bàba yìqǐ kàn xīngxing. Bàba shuō: “Dìqiú wàimiàn yǒu dàqìcéng, tā bǎohù wǒmen.”)
zh.baihat: 天气预报 (giai điệu: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star – 小星星) — 今天天气怎么样？(Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) / 晴天阳光照四方，(qíngtiān yángguāng zhào sìfāng,) / 如果刮风不出去，(rúguǒ guāfēng bù chūqu,) / 如果下雨带雨伞，(rúguǒ xià yǔ dài yǔsǎn,) / 春夏秋冬四季变，(chūn xià qiū dōng sìjì biàn,) / 天气预报天天看。(tiānqì yùbào tiāntiān kàn.)

blocks.title: Tuần 19 · Ôn và kiểm tra chặng 2 (Unit 5–8)

en.tu: Ôn: Unit 1 as, ever, husband, nephew / Unit 2 dictionary, timetable, uniform, winner / Unit 3 butterfly, hill, friendly / Unit 4 airport, bridge, museum, noisy / Unit 5 wood, plastic, glass, metal, wool, everywhere
en.cum: Ôn: look like / of course / join a club / write a letter / fire station / police station / made of glass / made from wood / by myself / make sure
en.cau: Ôn: Your uncle is a teacher, isn't he? / Don't forget your workbook. / My neighbours are very friendly. / This museum is as big as that hotel. / This cup is made of glass. / Paper is made from wood.
en.truyen: A day in the city — Nhan's uncle is a photographer. He takes Nhan to the museum by the bridge. The museum is as big as a castle. Inside, there are old cups made of glass and boxes made of metal. 'Paper is made from wood,' Uncle explains. 'Of course!' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Flyers vocabulary review family school city"

zh.tu: Ôn: Unit 1 叔叔 shūshu, 孩子 háizi, 一边…一边… yìbiān… yìbiān… / Unit 2 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 词典 cídiǎn / Unit 3 邻居 línjū, 安静 ānjìng, 蝴蝶 húdié / Unit 4 附近 fùjìn, 迷路 mílù, 桥 qiáo, 一样 yíyàng / Unit 5 木头 mùtou, 塑料 sùliào, 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 越来越 yuèláiyuè
zh.cum: Ôn: 他是你的叔叔，是不是？tā shì nǐ de shūshu, shì bu shì / 复习考试 fùxí kǎoshì / 既安静又漂亮 jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang / 和……一样大 hé… yíyàng dà / 是用……做的 shì yòng… zuò de
zh.cau: Ôn: 你叔叔是老师，是不是？(Nǐ shūshu shì lǎoshī, shì bu shì?) / 别忘了你的练习册。(Bié wàngle nǐ de liànxícè.) / 我的邻居很友好。(Wǒ de línjū hěn yǒuhǎo.) / 这个博物馆和那个酒店一样大。(Zhège bówùguǎn hé nàge jiǔdiàn yíyàng dà.) / 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。(Zhège bēizi shì yòng bōli zuò de.)
zh.truyen: 去博物馆 — Nhan的叔叔带他去桥附近的博物馆。博物馆和城堡一样大。里面有很多用玻璃做的杯子和用金属做的盒子。叔叔一边走一边说：“纸是用木头做的。”Nhan说：“我明白了！”(Nhan de shūshu dài tā qù qiáo fùjìn de bówùguǎn. Bówùguǎn hé chéngbǎo yíyàng dà. Lǐmiàn yǒu hěn duō yòng bōli zuò de bēizi hé yòng jīnshǔ zuò de hézi. Shūshu yìbiān zǒu yìbiān shuō: “Zhǐ shì yòng mùtou zuò de.” Nhan shuō: “Wǒ míngbai le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT4 词汇 复习"

en.tu: Ôn: Unit 6 space, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, land, instead / Unit 7 traffic, light, jam, underground, electric, passenger / Unit 8 camp, desert, ocean, April, November, foggy, freeze
en.cum: Ôn: could (khả năng) / if you want / by yourself / fire engine / get to / kilometre / a.m. / at the moment / in a minute
en.cau: Ôn: People could travel to Mars by rocket one day. / How do you go to school? – I go to school by underground. / Everyone will drive an electric car. / If the weather is cool, we will go camping. / If it is windy, we won't go outside.
en.truyen: Leo's future day — It's 7 a.m. in the future. At the moment, it's foggy. Leo goes to school by electric underground. There is no traffic jam. After school, he could fly to the moon by rocket. 'If the weather is good on the moon, we will go camping!' he laughs.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Flyers vocabulary review space transport weather"

zh.tu: Ôn: Unit 6 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 将来 jiānglái, 可能 kěnéng, 不但…而且… búdàn… érqiě… / Unit 7 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 出发 chūfā, 忘记 wàngjì, 着 zhe / Unit 8 晴 qíng, 温度 wēndù, 马上 mǎshàng, 来得及 láidejí, 突然 tūrán
zh.cum: Ôn: 将来能… jiānglái néng… / 坐地铁去学校 zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào / 会开电动汽车 huì kāi diàndòng qìchē / 如果……，就…… rúguǒ…, jiù… / 七点一刻 qī diǎn yí kè
zh.cau: Ôn: 将来人们能坐火箭去火星。(Jiānglái rénmen néng zuò huǒjiàn qù Huǒxīng.) / 我坐地铁去学校。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào.) / 大家都会开电动汽车。(Dàjiā dōu huì kāi diàndòng qìchē.) / 如果天气凉快，我们就去露营。(Rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng.)
zh.truyen: 将来的一天 — 将来的一天，早上七点一刻，Leo坐地铁去学校，路上不堵车。下午，他可能坐火箭去太空。他说：“如果月亮上是晴天，我们就去露营！”(Jiānglái de yì tiān, zǎoshang qī diǎn yí kè, Leo zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào, lùshang bù dǔchē. Xiàwǔ, tā kěnéng zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng. Tā shuō: “Rúguǒ yuèliang shang shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT4 模拟题 听力"

en.flash: Ôn quét: husband, nephew, timetable, uniform, butterfly, hill, airport, bridge, museum, wood, plastic, glass, metal, wool, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, traffic, jam, underground, electric, fire engine, camp, desert, ocean, foggy, April, November
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Bánh xe chủ đề' (8 ô = 8 unit): quay trúng ô nào, đội nói 2 câu của unit đó (VD Unit 5: This cup is made of glass. / Unit 8: If it is cool, we will go camping.). 2) Phân loại 24 từ vào 4 cột Materials / Space / Transport / Weather (có từ nhiễu của Unit 1–4: nephew, timetable, hill, museum). 3) Đố nhanh ngữ pháp: chọn made of / made from, could / will, If… will….
en.truyen: Leo's future day — It's 7 a.m. in the future. At the moment, it's foggy. Leo puts on his uniform and goes to school by electric underground. There is no traffic jam. His school is made of glass and metal. After school, his uncle, an astronaut, says, 'If you want, we could fly to the moon by rocket.' 'If the weather is good on the moon, we will go camping!' laughs Leo.
en.baihat: Our Big Review (giai điệu: The Wheels on the Bus) — The cup is made of glass, glass, glass... / The rocket goes up to space, space, space... / The underground goes fast, fast, fast... / If it's cool, we will go camping, camping, camping... all day long!

zh.flash: Ôn quét: 叔叔 shūshu, 孩子 háizi, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 邻居 línjū, 蝴蝶 húdié, 附近 fùjìn, 桥 qiáo, 木头 mùtou, 塑料 sùliào, 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 太空 tàikōng, 地球 dìqiú, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 十字路口 shízì lùkǒu, 晴 qíng, 温度 wēndù, 沙漠 shāmò, 海洋 hǎiyáng
zh.slide: 1) Trò 'Bánh xe chủ đề' (8 ô = 8 unit): đội nói 2 câu tiếng Trung của unit đó (VD Unit 6: 将来人们能坐火箭去火星。/ Unit 7: 我坐地铁去学校。). 2) Ghép mẫu câu với nghĩa: 是用……做的 / 将来……能…… / 会 + V / 如果……，就…… / 不但……而且…… / V + 着. 3) Thi đọc chữ Hán nhanh theo đội (20 thẻ từ Unit 5–8).
zh.truyen: 将来的一天 — 将来的一天，早上七点一刻，Leo穿着校服，坐地铁去学校，路上不堵车。学校是用玻璃和金属做的。下午，他的叔叔是宇航员，他说：“如果你想，我们能坐火箭去太空。”Leo说：“如果月亮上是晴天，我们就去露营！”(Jiānglái de yì tiān, zǎoshang qī diǎn yí kè, Leo chuānzhe xiàofú, zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào, lùshang bù dǔchē. Xuéxiào shì yòng bōli hé jīnshǔ zuò de. Xiàwǔ, tā de shūshu shì yǔhángyuán, tā shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng, wǒmen néng zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng.” Leo shuō: “Rúguǒ yuèliang shang shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng!”)
zh.baihat: 我们一起复习 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 玻璃杯子，木头桌子，(Bōli bēizi, mùtou zhuōzi,) / 坐火箭，去太空，(zuò huǒjiàn, qù tàikōng,) / 坐着地铁上学，如果晴天露营，(zuòzhe dìtiě shàngxué, rúguǒ qíngtiān lùyíng,) / 真快乐，真快乐。(zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè.)

web.label: Ngày 75. Ôn chặng 2 · Luyện đề kiểm tra tiếng Anh (Unit 5–8, dạng Flyers)

en.tu: Ôn: glass, metal, wool, plastic, planet, astronaut, rocket, traffic, underground, passenger, desert, ocean, coast, foggy
en.cum: Ôn: made of / made from / could + V / will + V / If…, … will… / by underground / at the moment
en.cau: Luyện đề – Listening (nối tên với tranh): Anna's sweater is made of wool. / Leo goes to school by underground. / Nhan wants to be an astronaut. / Bông's family will go camping if it is cool. – Reading (chọn từ điền): An ___ travels in a spaceship. (astronaut) / Stop at the red ___! (light)
en.truyen: Luyện đề – Reading & Writing (đọc truyện, trả lời 4 câu): Bông's class enters a competition. They make a rocket from plastic bottles. 'If it is sunny, we will show it in the playground,' says the teacher. But at midday it becomes foggy, so they show it in the gym instead. Their rocket wins the prize!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Cambridge Flyers listening practice"

zh.tu: Ôn: 玻璃 bōli, 金属 jīnshǔ, 塑料 sùliào, 行星 xíngxīng, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 地铁 dìtiě, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 沙漠 shāmò, 海洋 hǎiyáng, 温度 wēndù
zh.cum: Ôn: 是用……做的 shì yòng… zuò de / 将来能 jiānglái néng / 会开电动汽车 huì kāi diàndòng qìchē / 如果……，就…… rúguǒ…, jiù… / 坐地铁去学校 zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào / 坐着 zuòzhe
zh.cau: Luyện đề nhẹ (cho quen dạng YCT4 – Nghe chọn tranh): 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。(Zhège bēizi shì yòng bōli zuò de.) / 我坐地铁去学校。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào.) / 将来，宇航员能在别的行星上着陆。(Jiānglái, yǔhángyuán néng zài bié de xíngxīng shang zhuólù.) / 今天的温度是三十度。(Jīntiān de wēndù shì sānshí dù.)
zh.truyen: Bài đọc ngắn – trả lời câu hỏi: Bông的班参加了一个比赛。他们用塑料瓶子做了一个火箭。老师说：“如果是晴天，我们就在外面看。”可是中午突然下雨了，他们就在教室里看。(Bông de bān cānjiāle yí ge bǐsài. Tāmen yòng sùliào píngzi zuòle yí ge huǒjiàn. Lǎoshī shuō: “Rúguǒ shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù zài wàimiàn kàn.” Kěshì zhōngwǔ tūrán xià yǔ le, tāmen jiù zài jiàoshì li kàn.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT4 听力 第一部分 练习"

web.label: Ngày 76. Ôn chặng 2 · Luyện đề kiểm tra tiếng Trung (Unit 5–8, dạng YCT4)

en.tu: Ôn: everywhere, perhaps, instead, believe, arrive, forget, prefer, early, late, later, ago
en.cum: Ôn: by myself / by yourself / if you want / get to / in a minute / at the moment
en.cau: Ôn chuyển ngữ (phục vụ phần chuyển ngữ trong bài kiểm tra): This vase is made of glass. ↔ 这个花瓶是用玻璃做的。/ People could travel to Mars by rocket. ↔ 将来人们能坐火箭去火星。/ Turn left at the intersection. ↔ 在十字路口往左拐。/ If it is windy, we won't go outside. ↔ 如果刮风，我们就不出去。
en.truyen: Speaking practice — Look at the picture and tell the story: Leo forgets his umbrella. Suddenly it rains. 'If we hurry, we will get to the underground in a minute,' says Anna. They arrive early. 'Perhaps I'll take my umbrella tomorrow,' laughs Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Flyers speaking tell the story practice"

zh.tu: Ôn: 到处 dàochù, 大概 dàgài, 习惯 xíguàn, 决定 juédìng, 办法 bànfǎ, 其他 qítā, 带 dài, 离开 líkāi, 醒 xǐng, 经常 jīngcháng, 刚才 gāngcái, 春季 chūnjì
zh.cum: Ôn: 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme… / 不但…而且… búdàn… érqiě… / 越来越 yuèláiyuè / 来得及 láidejí / 别忘记带 bié wàngjì dài
zh.cau: Luyện đề YCT4 – Sắp xếp từ thành câu: 用 / 这个 / 是 / 做的 / 杯子 / 玻璃 → 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。(Zhège bēizi shì yòng bōli zuò de.) / 不但 / 很冷 / 火星 / 而且 / 没有水 → 火星不但很冷，而且没有水。(Huǒxīng búdàn hěn lěng, érqiě méiyǒu shuǐ.) / 如果 / 下雨 / 就 / 我们 / 坐地铁 → 如果下雨，我们就坐地铁。(Rúguǒ xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù zuò dìtiě.) / [YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu): con đọc câu hỏi có pinyin, ghi âm câu trả lời 2–3 câu trên Trang luyện nói] 你怎么去学校？(Nǐ zěnme qù xuéxiào?) – 我坐地铁去学校。如果下雨，妈妈就开车送我。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào. Rúguǒ xià yǔ, māma jiù kāichē sòng wǒ.) / 你觉得将来人们会去太空旅游吗？(Nǐ juéde jiānglái rénmen huì qù tàikōng lǚyóu ma?) – 我觉得会，因为火箭越来越多。(Wǒ juéde huì, yīnwèi huǒjiàn yuèláiyuè duō.)
zh.truyen: Bài đọc YCT4 – chọn đúng/sai: Leo忘记带雨伞了。突然下雨了。Anna说：“快走，地铁马上就来，还来得及！”他们很早就到了学校。Leo说：“明天我一定带雨伞。”(Leo wàngjì dài yǔsǎn le. Tūrán xià yǔ le. Anna shuō: “Kuài zǒu, dìtiě mǎshàng jiù lái, hái láidejí!” Tāmen hěn zǎo jiù dàole xuéxiào. Leo shuō: “Míngtiān wǒ yídìng dài yǔsǎn.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "YCT4 阅读 练习 小学生"

en.flash: Từ kiểm tra: wood, plastic, glass, metal, wool, everywhere, over, planet, Earth, rocket, astronaut, spaceship, land, instead, traffic, light, jam, fire engine, get to, kilometre, camp, desert, ocean, April, November, a.m., at the moment, in a minute
en.slide: Bài kiểm tra tiếng Anh (dạng Flyers, ≤30 phút): 1) Listening (5 câu): nghe và nối tên – tranh (Anna: wool sweater / Leo: underground / Nhan: astronaut / Bông: camping / Xiaomei: fire engine). 2) Reading & Writing (6 câu): đọc định nghĩa chọn từ: You use this to look at stars. (telescope) / This is very dry and hot. (desert) / You can see this at the intersection: red, yellow, green. (traffic lights). 3) Speaking (theo cặp): kể truyện 3 tranh với If…, … will… và made of. 4) Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu, từng em với cô): tìm điểm khác giữa 2 tranh 'At the Space Museum'. Cô: 'For example, in my picture the rocket is red, but in your picture it's white.' Con nêu 5 điểm khác: In my picture, there are two astronauts. – In my picture, there are three. / In my picture, the girl is looking through a telescope. – In my picture, she's reading a book. / In my picture, the bus is at the traffic lights. – In my picture, it's on the bridge. / In my picture, the boy's sweater is made of wool. – In my picture, he's wearing a plastic coat. / In my picture, it's sunny. – In my picture, it's foggy.
en.truyen: Bài đọc kiểm tra — Bông's class enters a competition. They make a rocket from a thousand plastic bottles. 'If it is sunny, we will show it in the playground,' says the teacher. But at midday it becomes foggy, so they show it in the gym instead. A real astronaut comes to see it. 'In the future, you could build a real spaceship!' he says. Their rocket wins the prize! (Câu hỏi: What is the rocket made from? / Where do they show it? / Who comes to see it?)
en.baihat: Cả lớp hát ôn trước giờ kiểm tra: 'If It's Sunny' (giai điệu: If You're Happy and You Know It) — If it's sunny, we will go camping, yes, we will! / If it's foggy, we will stay inside, yes, we will! / If you want, we could fly a rocket to the moon, / if it's sunny, we will go camping, yes, we will!

zh.flash: Từ kiểm tra: 啊 a, 变化 biànhuà, 大概 dàgài, 到处 dàochù, 挂 guà, 减 jiǎn, 开始 kāishǐ, 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme…, 习惯 xíguàn, 越来越 yuèláiyuè, 办法 bànfǎ, 不但…而且… búdàn… érqiě…, 等 děng, 关于 guānyú, 将来 jiānglái, 决定 juédìng, 可能 kěnéng, 旅游 lǚyóu, 其他 qítā, 行 xíng, 出发 chūfā, 带 dài, 地铁 dìtiě, 离开 líkāi, 辆 liàng, 停 tíng, 忘记 wàngjì, 醒 xǐng, 春季 chūnjì, 冬 dōng, 刚才 gāngcái, 经常 jīngcháng, 刻 kè, 来得及 láidejí, 马上 mǎshàng, 晴 qíng, 秋 qiū, 突然 tūrán, 夏 xià
zh.slide: Bài kiểm tra tiếng Trung (dạng YCT4, ≤30 phút): 1) Nghe chọn tranh (5 câu): 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。/ 火箭起飞了。/ 我坐地铁去学校。/ 在十字路口往左拐。/ 今天是晴天。2) Đọc – sắp xếp từ thành câu (4 câu) với 是用……做的 / 不但……而且…… / 如果……，就…… / V + 着. 3) Chuyển ngữ ngắn (BRIDGE, 3 câu): Paper is made from wood. → 纸是用木头做的。/ I go to school by underground. → 我坐地铁去学校。/ If it is windy, we won't go outside. → 如果刮风，我们就不出去。
zh.truyen: Bài đọc kiểm tra — Bông的班参加了一个比赛。他们用一千个塑料瓶子做了一个火箭。老师说：“如果是晴天，我们就在外面看。”可是中午突然下雨了，他们就在教室里看。一个宇航员也来了，他说：“将来你们能做真的宇宙飞船！”(Bông de bān cānjiāle yí ge bǐsài. Tāmen yòng yìqiān ge sùliào píngzi zuòle yí ge huǒjiàn. Lǎoshī shuō: “Rúguǒ shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù zài wàimiàn kàn.” Kěshì zhōngwǔ tūrán xià yǔ le, tāmen jiù zài jiàoshì li kàn. Yí ge yǔhángyuán yě lái le, tā shuō: “Jiānglái nǐmen néng zuò zhēn de yǔzhòu fēichuán!”) (Câu hỏi: 火箭是用什么做的？/ 他们在哪儿看火箭？/ 谁来了？)
zh.baihat: Hát ôn trước giờ kiểm tra: 春夏秋冬 (giai điệu: 两只老虎 Two Tigers) — 春季温暖，春季温暖，(Chūnjì wēnnuǎn, chūnjì wēnnuǎn,) / 夏天热，夏天热，(xiàtiān rè, xiàtiān rè,) / 如果天气凉快，我们就去露营，(rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng,) / 真快乐，真快乐。(zhēn kuàilè, zhēn kuàilè.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 39. Unit 9 · Health – Sức khỏe (1): Thói quen khỏe mạnh, ăn uống lành mạnh

web.label: Ngày 77. Unit 9 · Thói quen khỏe mạnh

en.tu: Mới: healthy, unhealthy, exercise, fit, jog, so | Ôn: tired, feel, practise, team, volleyball, shoulder, knee
en.cum: do exercise / go jogging / every morning / keep fit / healthy food / unhealthy food
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so – chỉ kết quả] I do exercise every day, so I am fit. / Leo goes jogging every morning. / Eating too many sweets is unhealthy. / Is jogging healthy? – Yes, it is. / I feel tired, so I go to bed early.
en.truyen: Leo Keeps Fit — Leo often feels tired in the afternoon. His uncle says, 'Let's go jogging every morning!' Now Leo jogs with his uncle before school. He also practises volleyball with his team. He does exercise every day, so he is fit and happy.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "healthy habits song for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 重要 zhòngyào | Ôn: 身体 shēntǐ, 累 lèi, 跑步 pǎobù, 休息 xiūxi, 每 měi, 经常 jīngcháng
zh.cum: 锻炼身体 duànliàn shēntǐ / 去慢跑 qù mànpǎo / 每天早上 měi tiān zǎoshang / 很健康 hěn jiànkāng / 很重要 hěn zhòngyào
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 因为……所以……] 因为我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。(Yīnwèi wǒ měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn jiànkāng.) / Leo每天早上去慢跑。(Leo měi tiān zǎoshang qù mànpǎo.) / 锻炼身体很重要。(Duànliàn shēntǐ hěn zhòngyào.) / 你每天锻炼吗？——我每天早上去慢跑。(Nǐ měi tiān duànliàn ma? —— Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qù mànpǎo.)
zh.truyen: Leo去慢跑 — Leo下午经常觉得很累。叔叔说：“我们每天早上去慢跑吧！”现在Leo每天早上和叔叔去慢跑。因为他每天锻炼身体，所以他很健康。(Leo xiàwǔ jīngcháng juéde hěn lèi. Shūshu shuō: “Wǒmen měi tiān zǎoshang qù mànpǎo ba!” Xiànzài Leo měi tiān zǎoshang hé shūshu qù mànpǎo. Yīnwèi tā měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, suǒyǐ tā hěn jiànkāng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "锻炼身体 儿童歌曲"

web.label: Ngày 78. Unit 9 · Ăn uống lành mạnh

en.tu: Mới: diet, important, excellent, hard, alone | Ôn: hungry, thirsty, stomach-ache, toothbrush, toothpaste, healthy, so
en.cum: a healthy diet / too many sweets / drink water / brush your teeth / work hard / play alone
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so – chỉ kết quả] I am thirsty, so I drink some water. / A healthy diet is important. / Sweets are unhealthy, so I eat fruit after lunch. / Anna works hard at school. / Don't play alone in the park. / Your diet is excellent!
en.truyen: Anna's Excellent Diet — Anna eats fruit and vegetables every day. She doesn't eat too many sweets. 'Too many sweets are unhealthy,' she says. After school she is thirsty, so she drinks water. She brushes her teeth with her toothbrush and toothpaste. Her teacher says, 'Your diet is excellent, Anna!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "healthy eating for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 饮食 yǐnshí, 渴 kě, 非常 fēicháng, 极 jí | Ôn: 健康 jiànkāng, 重要 zhòngyào, 饿 è, 喝 hē, 水 shuǐ, 甜 tián, 糖果 tángguǒ
zh.cum: 健康的饮食 jiànkāng de yǐnshí / 渴了 kě le / 喝水 hē shuǐ / 非常重要 fēicháng zhòngyào / 好极了 hǎo jí le
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 因为……所以……] 因为我渴了，所以我喝水。(Yīnwèi wǒ kě le, suǒyǐ wǒ hē shuǐ.) / 吃太多糖果不健康。(Chī tài duō tángguǒ bù jiànkāng.) / 健康的饮食非常重要。(Jiànkāng de yǐnshí fēicháng zhòngyào.) / 你的饮食好极了！(Nǐ de yǐnshí hǎo jí le!) / 你渴吗？——我非常渴。(Nǐ kě ma? —— Wǒ fēicháng kě.)
zh.truyen: Anna的饮食 — Anna每天吃水果和菜。她不吃太多糖果。她说：“吃太多糖果不健康。”放学以后，她渴了，所以她喝水。老师说：“Anna，你的饮食好极了！”(Anna měi tiān chī shuǐguǒ hé cài. Tā bù chī tài duō tángguǒ. Tā shuō: “Chī tài duō tángguǒ bù jiànkāng.” Fàngxué yǐhòu, tā kě le, suǒyǐ tā hē shuǐ. Lǎoshī shuō: “Anna, nǐ de yǐnshí hǎo jí le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "健康饮食 儿童动画"

en.flash: healthy, unhealthy, exercise, fit, jog, so, diet, important, excellent, hard, alone | Ôn: tired, thirsty, hungry, practise, toothbrush
en.slide: 1) Kéo thẻ vào hai cột Healthy / Unhealthy (8 thẻ): jog every morning / eat too many sweets / drink water / go to bed late / do exercise / eat fruit / play computer games all day / brush your teeth. 2) Nối hai nửa câu với so (4 câu): I am thirsty, → so I drink water. / I do exercise every day, → so I am fit. / Leo is tired, → so he goes to bed early. / Sweets are unhealthy, → so I eat fruit. 3) Nghe cô đọc, chọn tranh đúng (3 câu): Anna works hard. / Leo plays alone. / Your diet is excellent!
en.truyen: Leo and Anna Keep Fit — Leo often feels tired, so his uncle takes him jogging every morning. Anna doesn't jog, but she has a healthy diet: fruit, vegetables and lots of water. One day Leo says, 'Anna, let's jog together!' Anna says, 'OK! And you can eat fruit with me.' Now they are both fit. Their teacher says, 'Excellent! Exercise and a healthy diet are important.'
en.baihat: Healthy Me (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — This is the way we jog, jog, jog, / jog, jog, jog, / jog, jog, jog. / This is the way we jog, jog, jog, / so early in the morning. // This is the way we drink our water, / drink our water, drink our water. / This is the way we drink our water, / so we are fit and healthy.

zh.flash: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 重要 zhòngyào, 饮食 yǐnshí, 渴 kě, 非常 fēicháng, 极 jí | Ôn: 身体 shēntǐ, 累 lèi, 休息 xiūxi, 喝水 hē shuǐ, 糖果 tángguǒ
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (6 câu): 健康 / 锻炼 / 慢跑 / 渴 / 饮食 / 重要. 2) Ghép vế câu 因为……所以…… (4 câu): 因为我渴了，→ 所以我喝水。/ 因为他每天锻炼，→ 所以他很健康。/ 因为我很累，→ 所以我休息。/ 因为吃太多糖果不健康，→ 所以我吃水果。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp có đếm giờ: 你每天锻炼吗？——我每天早上去慢跑。/ 你渴吗？——我非常渴。
zh.truyen: Leo和Anna一起锻炼 — Leo经常觉得很累，所以叔叔每天早上带他去慢跑。Anna不去慢跑，但是她的饮食很健康：她吃水果和菜，喝很多水。一天，Leo说：“Anna，我们一起去慢跑吧！”Anna说：“好！你也跟我一起吃水果吧！”现在他们俩都很健康。老师说：“好极了！锻炼身体和健康的饮食都非常重要。”(Leo jīngcháng juéde hěn lèi, suǒyǐ shūshu měi tiān zǎoshang dài tā qù mànpǎo. Anna bù qù mànpǎo, dànshì tā de yǐnshí hěn jiànkāng: tā chī shuǐguǒ hé cài, hē hěn duō shuǐ. Yī tiān, Leo shuō: “Anna, wǒmen yīqǐ qù mànpǎo ba!” Anna shuō: “Hǎo! Nǐ yě gēn wǒ yīqǐ chī shuǐguǒ ba!” Xiànzài tāmen liǎ dōu hěn jiànkāng. Lǎoshī shuō: “Hǎo jí le! Duànliàn shēntǐ hé jiànkāng de yǐnshí dōu fēicháng zhòngyào.”)
zh.baihat: 健康歌 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎) — 锻炼身体，锻炼身体，每天跑，每天跑，每天早上慢跑，多喝水吃水果，真健康！真健康！(Duànliàn shēntǐ, duànliàn shēntǐ, měi tiān pǎo, měi tiān pǎo, měi tiān zǎoshang mànpǎo, duō hē shuǐ chī shuǐguǒ, zhēn jiànkāng! Zhēn jiànkāng!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 40. Unit 9 · Health – Sức khỏe (2): Đi khám, tai nạn nhỏ · Luyện YCT口试（中级）第一部分

web.label: Ngày 79. Unit 9 · Đi khám sức khỏe

en.tu: Mới: still, check-up, medical, elbow, broken | Ôn: early, late, hour, at the moment, sore, cough, temperature
en.cum: have a sore throat / have a medical check-up / a broken arm / my elbow hurts / still go to school / at nine a.m.
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: but – tương phản] I have a sore throat, but I still go to school. / I have a medical check-up at nine a.m. / At the moment, Nhan's elbow hurts. / Is your arm broken? – No, it isn't. / I feel tired, but I still do my homework. / The check-up takes one hour.
en.truyen: Nhan's Check-up — Today Nhan has a medical check-up. He gets up early. The doctor looks at his elbow. 'Is it broken?' asks Nhan. 'No, it isn't. It's fine,' says the doctor. Nhan has a little cough, but he still feels happy. After the check-up, he goes to school. He isn't late!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "going to the doctor check-up for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 体检 tǐjiǎn, 喉咙 hóulóng, 担心 dānxīn, 紧张 jǐnzhāng | Ôn: 刚才 gāngcái, 经常 jīngcháng, 马上 mǎshàng, 突然 tūrán, 疼 téng, 发烧 fāshāo, 医生 yīshēng
zh.cum: 去体检 qù tǐjiǎn / 喉咙疼 hóulóng téng / 别担心 bié dānxīn / 有一点儿紧张 yǒu yīdiǎnr jǐnzhāng / 去看医生 qù kàn yīshēng
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: ……，但是……还是…… – tương phản] 我喉咙疼，但是我还是去上学。(Wǒ hóulóng téng, dànshì wǒ háishi qù shàngxué.) / 今天Nhan去体检。(Jīntiān Nhan qù tǐjiǎn.) / 你紧张吗？——有一点儿紧张。(Nǐ jǐnzhāng ma? —— Yǒu yīdiǎnr jǐnzhāng.) / 别担心，医生马上来。(Bié dānxīn, yīshēng mǎshàng lái.) / [Ngữ pháp: 所以] 我发烧了，所以我要去看医生。(Wǒ fāshāo le, suǒyǐ wǒ yào qù kàn yīshēng.)
zh.truyen: Nhan去体检 — 今天Nhan去医院体检。他有一点儿紧张。妈妈说：“别担心！”医生看了看他的喉咙，说：“你的喉咙有一点儿红，但是你很健康。”Nhan听了，马上不紧张了。(Jīntiān Nhan qù yīyuàn tǐjiǎn. Tā yǒu yīdiǎnr jǐnzhāng. Māma shuō: “Bié dānxīn!” Yīshēng kàn le kàn tā de hóulóng, shuō: “Nǐ de hóulóng yǒu yīdiǎnr hóng, dànshì nǐ hěn jiànkāng.” Nhan tīng le, mǎshàng bù jǐnzhāng le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小朋友 体检 动画"

web.label: Ngày 80. Unit 9 · Tai nạn nhỏ và hiệu thuốc

en.tu: Mới: ambulance, bandage, chemist('s), frightening, horrible | Ôn: later, in a minute, midnight, knee, toe, stomach-ache, still
en.cum: call an ambulance / put on a bandage / go to the chemist's / buy some medicine / a horrible stomach-ache / a frightening noise
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so – chỉ kết quả] Bông's knee hurts, so Mum puts on a bandage. / Call an ambulance, please! / Let's go to the chemist's and buy some medicine. / The ambulance is coming in a minute. / [Ngữ pháp: because – chỉ nguyên nhân] I feel horrible because I have a stomach-ache. / The ambulance is loud and frightening.
en.truyen: Bông and the Bandage — Bông is riding her bike in the park. Oh no! She falls and her knee hurts. It's frightening, but Leo says, 'It's OK, Bông!' They go to the chemist's. The man puts a bandage on her knee. 'Do we need an ambulance?' asks Leo. 'No, she's OK,' says the man. Later, Bông still rides her bike, but slowly.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "first aid for kids bandage cartoon"

zh.tu: Mới: 安全 ānquán, 破 pò, 错 cuò, 厉害 lìhai, 虽然 suīrán | Ôn: 突然 tūrán, 马上 mǎshàng, 药 yào, 疼 téng, 医院 yīyuàn, 担心 dānxīn
zh.cum: 很安全 hěn ānquán / 不安全 bù ānquán / 手破了 shǒu pò le / 疼得很厉害 téng de hěn lìhai / 不是你的错 bù shì nǐ de cuò / 吃药 chī yào
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 虽然……但是……] 虽然我很累，但是我每天早上还是去慢跑。(Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang háishi qù mànpǎo.) / 虽然Bông的手破了，但是她没哭。(Suīrán Bông de shǒu pò le, dànshì tā méi kū.) / 骑车骑得太快不安全。(Qí chē qí de tài kuài bù ānquán.) / 我的肚子疼得很厉害。(Wǒ de dùzi téng de hěn lìhai.) / 别哭，这不是你的错。(Bié kū, zhè bù shì nǐ de cuò.)
zh.truyen: Bông的手破了 — Bông在公园里骑自行车，骑得太快了。突然，她的手破了。Leo说：“别哭！这不是你的错。”他们马上去药店买药。虽然Bông的手很疼，但是她没哭。Leo说：“骑车骑得太快不安全！”(Bông zài gōngyuán li qí zìxíngchē, qí de tài kuài le. Tūrán, tā de shǒu pò le. Leo shuō: “Bié kū! Zhè bù shì nǐ de cuò.” Tāmen mǎshàng qù yàodiàn mǎi yào. Suīrán Bông de shǒu hěn téng, dànshì tā méi kū. Leo shuō: “Qí chē qí de tài kuài bù ānquán!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童安全教育 骑自行车"

en.flash: still, check-up, medical, elbow, broken, ambulance, bandage, chemist's, frightening, horrible | Ôn: sore throat, cough, knee, stomach-ache, early, late
en.slide: 1) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân bằng thẻ tình huống (4 thẻ): What's the matter? – I have a sore throat. / My elbow hurts. / I have a horrible stomach-ache. / Is my arm broken? – No, it isn't. 2) Chọn but hay so (5 câu): I have a cough, ___ I still go to school. (but) / My knee hurts, ___ Mum puts on a bandage. (so) / I feel horrible, ___ I go to the chemist's. (so) / I am tired, ___ I still do my homework. (but) / The man is hurt, ___ we call an ambulance. (so) 3) Nghe truyện Bông and the Bandage, xếp 4 tranh theo thứ tự.
en.truyen: A Busy Day at the Clinic — At nine a.m., Nhan has a medical check-up. His elbow is not broken, but he has a little cough. At ten a.m., Bông comes in with Leo. Her knee hurts and she feels horrible. The doctor puts on a bandage. 'Do we need an ambulance?' asks Leo. 'No,' says the doctor. 'Go to the chemist's and buy some medicine.' Bông still smiles. 'Thank you, doctor!'
en.baihat: Healthy Me (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush), lời 2 — This is the way we put on a bandage, / put on a bandage, put on a bandage. / This is the way we put on a bandage / when our knee is hurting. // This is the way we see the doctor, / see the doctor, see the doctor. / This is the way we see the doctor / for a medical check-up.

zh.flash: 体检 tǐjiǎn, 喉咙 hóulóng, 担心 dānxīn, 紧张 jǐnzhāng, 安全 ānquán, 破 pò, 错 cuò, 厉害 lìhai, 虽然 suīrán | Ôn: 疼 téng, 发烧 fāshāo, 药 yào, 医生 yīshēng, 突然 tūrán, 马上 mǎshàng
zh.slide: 1) Nối tranh với cụm (5 cặp): 喉咙疼 / 手破了 / 去体检 / 吃药 / 看医生. 2) Hoàn thành câu 虽然……但是…… (4 câu): 虽然我喉咙疼，但是我还是去上学。/ 虽然Bông的手破了，但是她没哭。/ 虽然Nhan很紧张，但是他还是去体检。/ 虽然我很累，但是我还是去慢跑。 3) Trò chơi 'Bác sĩ nhí' theo cặp: 你怎么了？——我喉咙疼。/ 别担心，吃药，多休息。/ 疼得厉害吗？——不太厉害。 4) YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, 10 câu, từng em; cô đọc 1 lần, con nói lại 1 lần): 我每天早上锻炼身体。/ 健康非常重要。/ 骑车太快不安全。/ 别担心，吃药，多休息。/ 我很渴，我要喝水。/ 虽然我很累，但是我还是去慢跑。/ 你怎么了？——我喉咙疼。/ Nhan去体检的时候很紧张。/ Bông的手破了，但是她没哭。/ 疼得厉害吗？——不太厉害。
zh.truyen: 诊所里的一天 — 早上九点，Nhan去体检。他有一点儿紧张。医生说：“别担心，你很健康，但是你的喉咙有一点儿红。”十点，Leo和Bông来了。Bông的手破了，疼得很厉害。医生给她吃药，说：“这不是你的错。骑车要安全！”虽然Bông的手很疼，但是她还是笑了：“谢谢医生！”(Zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn, Nhan qù tǐjiǎn. Tā yǒu yīdiǎnr jǐnzhāng. Yīshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, nǐ hěn jiànkāng, dànshì nǐ de hóulóng yǒu yīdiǎnr hóng.” Shí diǎn, Leo hé Bông lái le. Bông de shǒu pò le, téng de hěn lìhai. Yīshēng gěi tā chī yào, shuō: “Zhè bù shì nǐ de cuò. Qí chē yào ānquán!” Suīrán Bông de shǒu hěn téng, dànshì tā háishi xiào le: “Xièxie yīshēng!”)
zh.baihat: 健康歌 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎), lời 2 — 别担心呀，别担心呀，看医生，看医生，喉咙疼要吃药，手破了别哭了，多休息，多休息！(Bié dānxīn ya, bié dānxīn ya, kàn yīshēng, kàn yīshēng, hóulóng téng yào chī yào, shǒu pò le bié kū le, duō xiūxi, duō xiūxi!)

en.tu: Mới: bored, comb, deep, enormous, amazing, fur, furry | Ôn: hard, healthy, still, so, alone, tired
en.cum: take a deep breath / comb my hair / an enormous dog / a furry dog / long fur / feel bored
en.cau: Take a deep breath! / Xiaomei combs her hair every morning. / [Ngữ pháp: because – chỉ nguyên nhân] Leo feels bored because he is alone at home. / Max is an enormous, furry dog. / [Ngữ pháp: so] Max's fur is long, so Leo combs it every day. / Jogging with Max is amazing!
en.truyen: Leo and Max — Leo is bored because he is alone at home. His dog, Max, is enormous and furry. Leo combs Max's long fur. Then they go jogging in the park. Leo takes a deep breath. 'This is amazing!' he says. Now Leo is not bored, and he is fit, too.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "deep breathing exercise for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 方便 fāngbiàn, 多么 duōme, 聪明 cōngming, 礼貌 lǐmào | Ôn: 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 附近 fùjìn, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng, 停 tíng, 狗 gǒu
zh.cum: 很方便 hěn fāngbiàn / 多么聪明啊 duōme cōngming a / 很有礼貌 hěn yǒu lǐmào / 聪明的狗 cōngming de gǒu / 家附近 jiā fùjìn
zh.cau: 你的狗多么聪明啊！(Nǐ de gǒu duōme cōngming a!) / 我家附近有公园，锻炼很方便。(Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu gōngyuán, duànliàn hěn fāngbiàn.) / Xiaomei很有礼貌，她说：“谢谢医生！”(Xiaomei hěn yǒu lǐmào, tā shuō: “Xièxie yīshēng!”) / [Ngữ pháp: 因为……所以……] 因为Max很聪明，所以它看到红灯就停。(Yīnwèi Max hěn cōngming, suǒyǐ tā kàndào hóngdēng jiù tíng.)
zh.truyen: 聪明的Max — Leo家附近有一个公园，去锻炼很方便。Leo每天和他的狗Max去慢跑。Max非常聪明，看到红灯就停。Xiaomei说：“你的狗多么聪明啊！”Leo很有礼貌地说：“谢谢你！”(Leo jiā fùjìn yǒu yī gè gōngyuán, qù duànliàn hěn fāngbiàn. Leo měi tiān hé tā de gǒu Max qù mànpǎo. Max fēicháng cōngming, kàndào hóngdēng jiù tíng. Xiaomei shuō: “Nǐ de gǒu duōme cōngming a!” Leo hěn yǒu lǐmào de shuō: “Xièxie nǐ!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "有礼貌的好孩子 儿歌"
