en.tu: Ôn: healthy, unhealthy, exercise, fit, jog, so, diet, important, excellent, still, check-up, medical, ambulance, bandage, chemist's, bored, deep, enormous
en.cum: do exercise / a healthy diet / have a sore throat / have a medical check-up / call an ambulance / take a deep breath
en.cau: Why are you tired? – Because I didn't sleep well. / I feel tired because I didn't sleep well. / I have a fever, so I'm going to see a doctor. / I have a sore throat, but I still go to school. / Although I'm tired, I still go jogging every morning. / Eating too many sweets is unhealthy.
en.truyen: A Week of Health — On Monday, Nhan has a sore throat, but he still goes to school. On Tuesday, he has a fever, so he goes to see a doctor. On Wednesday, he takes his medicine and sleeps a lot. On Thursday, he feels excellent! Although he is still a little tired, he goes jogging with Leo on Friday.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "because so but although kids grammar"

zh.tu: Ôn: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 重要 zhòngyào, 饮食 yǐnshí, 渴 kě, 非常 fēicháng, 极 jí, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 喉咙 hóulóng, 担心 dānxīn, 紧张 jǐnzhāng, 安全 ānquán, 破 pò, 错 cuò, 厉害 lìhai, 虽然 suīrán, 方便 fāngbiàn, 多么 duōme, 聪明 cōngming, 礼貌 lǐmào
zh.cum: 锻炼身体 duànliàn shēntǐ / 健康的饮食 jiànkāng de yǐnshí / 喉咙疼 hóulóng téng / 去体检 qù tǐjiǎn / 别担心 bié dānxīn / 很有礼貌 hěn yǒu lǐmào
zh.cau: 我觉得很累，因为我没睡好。(Wǒ juéde hěn lèi, yīnwèi wǒ méi shuì hǎo.) / 我发烧了，所以我要去看医生。(Wǒ fāshāo le, suǒyǐ wǒ yào qù kàn yīshēng.) / 虽然我很累，但是我每天早上还是去慢跑。(Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang háishi qù mànpǎo.) / 因为我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。(Yīnwèi wǒ měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn jiànkāng.) / 吃太多糖果不健康。(Chī tài duō tángguǒ bù jiànkāng.) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu): con nghe rồi nói lại, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] 我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。(Wǒ měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn jiànkāng.) / 虽然我很累，但是我还是去慢跑。(Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ háishi qù mànpǎo.) / 别担心，你的手很快就好了。(Bié dānxīn, nǐ de shǒu hěn kuài jiù hǎo le.)
zh.truyen: Nhan的一个星期 — 星期一，Nhan喉咙疼，但是他还是去上学。星期二，他发烧了，所以他去看医生。星期三，他吃药，多休息。星期四，他觉得好极了！虽然他还有一点儿累，但是星期五他还是和Leo去慢跑。(Xīngqīyī, Nhan hóulóng téng, dànshì tā háishi qù shàngxué. Xīngqī'èr, tā fāshāo le, suǒyǐ tā qù kàn yīshēng. Xīngqīsān, tā chī yào, duō xiūxi. Xīngqīsì, tā juéde hǎo jí le! Suīrán tā hái yǒu yīdiǎnr lèi, dànshì xīngqīwǔ tā háishi hé Leo qù mànpǎo.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "因为所以 虽然但是 儿童中文"

en.flash: bored, comb, deep, enormous, amazing, fur, furry | Ôn: healthy, fit, jog, diet, still, check-up, bandage, ambulance
en.slide: 1) Trò Simon says sức khỏe (6 lệnh): Take a deep breath! / Comb your hair! / Jog on the spot! / Touch your elbow! / Touch your knee! / Drink some water! 2) Nghe mô tả, chọn con vật đúng (3 câu): It's enormous and furry. / It has long fur. / It isn't furry, it's small. (tranh: dog, cat, fish, bear) 3) Viết nối câu bằng because hoặc although (4 câu): Leo feels bored ___ he is alone. (because) / ___ I'm tired, I still jog. (Although) / Nhan goes to the doctor ___ he has a fever. (because) / ___ it's hard, Anna still does exercise. (Although)
en.truyen: Leo, Max and the Amazing Run — Leo is bored because it's raining and he is alone at home. Max, his enormous, furry dog, is bored, too. When the rain stops, Leo combs Max's fur and they go to the park. They jog for an hour. Leo takes a deep breath. 'The air is amazing!' Although Leo is tired after the run, he is very happy.
en.baihat: Healthy Me (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush), lời 3 — This is the way we take a deep breath, / take a deep breath, take a deep breath. / This is the way we take a deep breath / when we are feeling tired. // This is the way we comb our hair, / comb our hair, comb our hair. / This is the way we comb our hair, / so early in the morning.

zh.flash: 方便 fāngbiàn, 多么 duōme, 聪明 cōngming, 礼貌 lǐmào | Ôn: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 喉咙 hóulóng, 担心 dānxīn, 紧张 jǐnzhāng, 安全 ānquán, 虽然 suīrán, 厉害 lìhai, 错 cuò, 破 pò
zh.slide: 1) Thẻ phản xạ không tranh: cô đọc từ, con giơ thẻ chữ Hán đúng (8 từ): 健康 / 锻炼 / 担心 / 紧张 / 安全 / 方便 / 聪明 / 礼貌. 2) Khen bạn bằng 多么……啊！ (mỗi con 1 câu): 你多么聪明啊！/ 你多么有礼貌啊！/ 你的饮食多么健康啊！ 3) Chuyển ngữ nhanh Anh ↔ Trung (3 câu): I do exercise every day, so I am fit. ↔ 因为我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。/ I have a sore throat, but I still go to school. ↔ 我喉咙疼，但是我还是去上学。/ Your dog is so clever! ↔ 你的狗多么聪明啊！
zh.truyen: 有礼貌的Xiaomei — Xiaomei每天早上跟妈妈去公园锻炼。公园在她家附近，很方便。一天，一个小朋友的手破了，他很紧张。Xiaomei说：“别担心！”她马上带他去找医生。医生说：“你多么有礼貌啊，也很聪明！”虽然Xiaomei有一点儿累，但是她非常高兴。(Xiaomei měi tiān zǎoshang gēn māma qù gōngyuán duànliàn. Gōngyuán zài tā jiā fùjìn, hěn fāngbiàn. Yī tiān, yī gè xiǎopéngyou de shǒu pò le, tā hěn jǐnzhāng. Xiaomei shuō: “Bié dānxīn!” Tā mǎshàng dài tā qù zhǎo yīshēng. Yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ duōme yǒu lǐmào a, yě hěn cōngming!” Suīrán Xiaomei yǒu yīdiǎnr lèi, dànshì tā fēicháng gāoxìng.)
zh.baihat: 健康歌 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎), lời 3 — 有礼貌呀，有礼貌呀，说谢谢，说谢谢，每天早上锻炼，多么健康快乐，好极了！好极了！(Yǒu lǐmào ya, yǒu lǐmào ya, shuō xièxie, shuō xièxie, měi tiān zǎoshang duànliàn, duōme jiànkāng kuàilè, hǎo jí le! Hǎo jí le!)

en.tu: Ôn: fit, healthy, exercise, jog, diet, check-up, medical, important, still, so | Ôn truyện: astronaut, rocket, space, Earth, planet, spaceship
en.cum: a fit astronaut / a medical check-up / fly into space / come back to Earth / a healthy diet
en.cau: Astronauts must be fit and healthy. / Anna wants to be an astronaut, so she does exercise every day. / Although jogging is hard, she still jogs every morning. / Before every trip, astronauts have a medical check-up. / Anna is excited because she can see the rocket.
en.truyen: The Fit Astronaut — Anna wants to be an astronaut. 'Astronauts must be fit,' says her uncle. So Anna jogs every morning and has a healthy diet. Although jogging is hard, she still does it. One day, she visits a space museum. She sees an enormous rocket and a spaceship. 'One day I could fly into space and see the Earth from a planet!' she says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how astronauts stay healthy in space for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 重要 zhòngyào, 虽然 suīrán, 非常 fēicháng | Ôn truyện: 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 地球 dìqiú, 宇宙飞船 yǔzhòu fēichuán, 行星 xíngxīng, 起飞 qǐfēi, 将来 jiānglái
zh.cum: 健康的宇航员 jiànkāng de yǔhángyuán / 坐火箭 zuò huǒjiàn / 回到地球 huídào dìqiú / 去体检 qù tǐjiǎn / 将来 jiānglái
zh.cau: 宇航员的身体要非常健康。(Yǔhángyuán de shēntǐ yào fēicháng jiànkāng.) / [Ngữ pháp: 因为……所以……] 因为Anna想当宇航员，所以她每天锻炼身体。(Yīnwèi Anna xiǎng dāng yǔhángyuán, suǒyǐ tā měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ.) / [Ngữ pháp: 虽然……但是……] 虽然慢跑很累，但是她每天早上还是去慢跑。(Suīrán mànpǎo hěn lèi, dànshì tā měi tiān zǎoshang háishi qù mànpǎo.) / 起飞以前，宇航员要去体检。(Qǐfēi yǐqián, yǔhángyuán yào qù tǐjiǎn.)
zh.truyen: 健康的宇航员 — Anna将来想当宇航员。叔叔说：“宇航员的身体要非常健康。”所以Anna每天早上去慢跑，饮食也很健康。虽然慢跑很累，但是她还是每天跑。一天，她去博物馆，看到了很大的火箭和宇宙飞船。她说：“将来我可能坐火箭去别的行星，再回到地球！”(Anna jiānglái xiǎng dāng yǔhángyuán. Shūshu shuō: “Yǔhángyuán de shēntǐ yào fēicháng jiànkāng.” Suǒyǐ Anna měi tiān zǎoshang qù mànpǎo, yǐnshí yě hěn jiànkāng. Suīrán mànpǎo hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi měi tiān pǎo. Yī tiān, tā qù bówùguǎn, kàndào le hěn dà de huǒjiàn hé yǔzhòu fēichuán. Tā shuō: “Jiānglái wǒ kěnéng zuò huǒjiàn qù bié de xíngxīng, zài huídào dìqiú!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "宇航员 怎么锻炼身体 儿童"

en.cum: go jogging / a healthy diet / have a sore throat / put on a bandage / go to the chemist's / take a deep breath
en.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Trung, nói lại bằng tiếng Anh): I feel tired because I didn't sleep well. / I have a sore throat, but I still go to school. / Although I'm tired, I still go jogging every morning. / I have a fever, so I'm going to see a doctor. / I do exercise every day, so I am fit. / Eating too many sweets is unhealthy. / [Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu): con nghe câu hỏi, ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói] What do you do to stay healthy? – I go jogging and I eat fruit. / What do you do when you are thirsty? – I drink water. / Tell me about the last time you were ill. – I had a cough, so I stayed at home.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter at the Clinic — Xiaomei's grandmother visits Hanoi. She only speaks Chinese. At the clinic, she says, 'My throat hurts.' Nhan helps her. He tells the doctor in English, 'She has a sore throat, but she doesn't have a fever.' The doctor says, 'Go to the chemist's and buy this medicine.' Nhan says it again in Chinese. Grandmother smiles: 'You are so clever!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "health vocabulary kids quiz"

zh.tu: Ôn: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 饮食 yǐnshí, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 喉咙 hóulóng, 担心 dānxīn, 紧张 jǐnzhāng, 安全 ānquán, 厉害 lìhai, 虽然 suīrán, 聪明 cōngming, 礼貌 lǐmào, 多么 duōme, 渴 kě

zh.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Anh, nói lại bằng tiếng Trung): 我觉得很累，因为我没睡好。(Wǒ juéde hěn lèi, yīnwèi wǒ méi shuì hǎo.) / 我喉咙疼，但是我还是去上学。(Wǒ hóulóng téng, dànshì wǒ háishi qù shàngxué.) / 虽然我很累，但是我每天早上还是去慢跑。(Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang háishi qù mànpǎo.) / 我发烧了，所以我要去看医生。(Wǒ fāshāo le, suǒyǐ wǒ yào qù kàn yīshēng.) / 因为我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。(Yīnwèi wǒ měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn jiànkāng.)
zh.truyen: 小翻译 — Xiaomei的奶奶来河内了。她只会说中文。在医院，奶奶说：“我的喉咙很疼。”Nhan帮她，用英语告诉医生：“她喉咙疼，但是她没发烧。”医生说：“别担心，去药店买药吧。”Nhan再用中文告诉奶奶。奶奶笑了：“你多么聪明啊，也很有礼貌！”(Xiaomei de nǎinai lái Hénèi le. Tā zhǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén. Zài yīyuàn, nǎinai shuō: “Wǒ de hóulóng hěn téng.” Nhan bāng tā, yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu yīshēng: “Tā hóulóng téng, dànshì tā méi fāshāo.” Yīshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, qù yàodiàn mǎi yào ba.” Nhan zài yòng Zhōngwén gàosu nǎinai. Nǎinai xiào le: “Nǐ duōme cōngming a, yě hěn yǒu lǐmào!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "身体健康 中文儿歌"

en.flash: Ôn cả unit: healthy, unhealthy, exercise, fit, jog, so, still, diet, important, excellent, check-up, medical, ambulance, bandage, chemist's, bored, deep, amazing + ôn truyện: astronaut, rocket, spaceship
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nghe (5 câu, chọn tranh A/B/C): Leo goes jogging every morning. / Bông needs a bandage. / Nhan has a medical check-up. / Anna is thirsty, so she drinks water. / Leo is bored because he is alone. 2) Nối câu thành một câu với because / so / but / although (4 câu): I have a fever. I go to see a doctor. → I have a fever, so I go to see a doctor. / I'm tired. I still jog. → Although I'm tired, I still jog. / I feel horrible. I have a stomach-ache. → I feel horrible because I have a stomach-ache. / I have a cough. I still go to school. → I have a cough, but I still go to school. 3) Dự án nhỏ theo nhóm: vẽ poster 'My Healthy Week' và nói 3 câu. 4) Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu, từng em với cô, 5 câu): What do you do to stay healthy? – I go jogging every morning. / What do you usually have for breakfast? – I have … / What do you do when you have a cold? – I stay in bed and drink water. / Have you ever been to the chemist's? – Yes, I have. I bought … / Tell me about the last time you were ill. – Last month I had a fever, so I …
en.truyen: The Fit Astronaut (kể đầy đủ) — Anna wants to be an astronaut, so she jogs every morning and has a healthy diet. Although jogging is hard, she still does it. Before the big day, she has a medical check-up. The doctor says, 'Excellent! You are very fit.' Anna visits the rocket. It's enormous! She takes a deep breath and says, 'One day I could fly into space. But first, I must eat well and do exercise every day!'
en.baihat: Healthy Me (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush), cả bài — This is the way we jog, jog, jog… so early in the morning. / This is the way we drink our water… so we are fit and healthy. / This is the way we put on a bandage… when our knee is hurting. / This is the way we take a deep breath… when we are feeling tired.

zh.flash: Ôn cả unit: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 重要 zhòngyào, 饮食 yǐnshí, 渴 kě, 非常 fēicháng, 极 jí, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 喉咙 hóulóng, 担心 dānxīn, 紧张 jǐnzhāng, 安全 ānquán, 破 pò, 错 cuò, 厉害 lìhai, 虽然 suīrán, 方便 fāngbiàn, 多么 duōme, 聪明 cōngming, 礼貌 lǐmào + ôn truyện: 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 火箭 huǒjiàn
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra đọc chữ Hán (8 câu, chọn chữ đúng điền chỗ trống): 我每天___身体。(锻炼) / 我___疼。(喉咙) / 别___！(担心) / 骑车太快不___。(安全) / ___我很累，但是我还是去慢跑。(虽然) / 你的狗多么___啊！(聪明) / 健康的___非常重要。(饮食) / 我很___，我要喝水。(渴) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một con nói câu tiếng Anh trong thẻ, con kia nói lại bằng tiếng Trung (4 thẻ). 3) Nói về poster 'My Healthy Week': 星期一我去慢跑。因为我每天锻炼，所以我很健康。
zh.truyen: 健康的宇航员 (kể đầy đủ) — Anna将来想当宇航员，所以她每天早上去慢跑，饮食也很健康。虽然慢跑很累，但是她还是每天跑。起飞以前，她去体检。医生说：“好极了！你的身体非常健康。”Anna去看火箭，火箭多么大啊！她有一点儿紧张，但是她说：“别担心，我可以！将来我要坐火箭去太空。”(Anna jiānglái xiǎng dāng yǔhángyuán, suǒyǐ tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù mànpǎo, yǐnshí yě hěn jiànkāng. Suīrán mànpǎo hěn lèi, dànshì tā háishi měi tiān pǎo. Qǐfēi yǐqián, tā qù tǐjiǎn. Yīshēng shuō: “Hǎo jí le! Nǐ de shēntǐ fēicháng jiànkāng.” Anna qù kàn huǒjiàn, huǒjiàn duōme dà a! Tā yǒu yīdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, dànshì tā shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒ kěyǐ! Jiānglái wǒ yào zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng.”)
zh.baihat: 健康歌 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎), cả bài 3 lời — 锻炼身体，锻炼身体，每天跑，每天跑……真健康！真健康！/ 别担心呀，别担心呀，看医生，看医生……多休息，多休息！/ 有礼貌呀，有礼貌呀，说谢谢，说谢谢……好极了！好极了！(Duànliàn shēntǐ… zhēn jiànkāng! / Bié dānxīn ya… duō xiūxi! / Yǒu lǐmào ya… hǎo jí le!)

blocks.title: Unit 10 · Natural disaster · 自然灾害

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 43. Unit 10 · Natural disaster – Thiên tai (1): Bão, lũ lụt, động đất

web.label: Ngày 85. Unit 10 · Bão đến

en.tu: Mới: storm, before, after, lightning | Ôn: everywhere, over, make sure, wood, metal, dear
en.cum: a big storm / before the storm / after the storm / close all the windows / lightning in the sky / clean the house
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: before + mệnh đề – hòa hợp thì] Before the storm came, I closed all the windows. / [Ngữ pháp: after + danh từ] After the storm, I cleaned my house. / Before you go out, check the weather. / Look! There is lightning over the hill. / Make sure the door is closed before the storm. / Don't go out without your coat.
en.truyen: The Big Storm — It was a windy evening. Dad said, 'A storm is coming!' Before the storm came, Nhan closed all the windows. Then there was lightning over the house. Nhan was a little frightened, but Dad said, 'We are safe inside.' After the storm, there were leaves and pieces of wood everywhere. Nhan and Dad cleaned the garden together.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what to do in a storm for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi | Ôn: 到处 dàochù, 大概 dàgài, 附近 fùjìn, 突然 tūrán, 关 guān, 安全 ānquán
zh.cum: 暴风雨来了 bàofēngyǔ lái le / 关上窗户 guānshang chuānghu / 天上有闪电 tiānshang yǒu shǎndiàn / 准备好了 zhǔnbèi hǎo le / 暴风雨来之前 bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: ……之前] 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户。(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒ guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu.) / [Ngữ pháp: ……过后] 暴风雨过后，我打扫了房子。(Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒ dǎsǎo le fángzi.) / 天上突然有闪电。(Tiānshang tūrán yǒu shǎndiàn.) / [Ngữ pháp: 被] 窗户被风吹开了。(Chuānghu bèi fēng chuīkāi le.) / 你准备好了吗？——我准备好了。(Nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? —— Wǒ zhǔnbèi hǎo le.)
zh.truyen: 暴风雨来了 — 晚上，风很大。爸爸说：“暴风雨大概马上就来了！”暴风雨来之前，Nhan关上了所有的窗户。突然，天上有闪电。Nhan有一点儿害怕，爸爸说：“别担心，我们在家里很安全。”暴风雨过后，到处都是树叶。Nhan和爸爸一起打扫了房子。(Wǎnshang, fēng hěn dà. Bàba shuō: “Bàofēngyǔ dàgài mǎshàng jiù lái le!” Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, Nhan guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu. Tūrán, tiānshang yǒu shǎndiàn. Nhan yǒu yīdiǎnr hàipà, bàba shuō: “Bié dānxīn, wǒmen zài jiā li hěn ānquán.” Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, dàochù dōu shì shùyè. Nhan hé bàba yīqǐ dǎsǎo le fángzi.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "暴风雨 安全知识 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 86. Unit 10 · Lũ lụt và động đất

en.tu: Mới: should, flood, earthquake, shelter, prepare | Ôn: by myself, enter, gym, timetable, uniform, letter
en.cum: prepare for a flood / go to a shelter / a safe place / water everywhere / after the earthquake / food and water
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: should – lời khuyên] What should people do before and after a natural disaster? / You should prepare food and water before a flood. / [Ngữ pháp: after + danh từ] After the earthquake, we went to a safe place. / People should go to a shelter. / You shouldn't stand near the windows in an earthquake.
en.truyen: The Flood — It rained for three days. There was water everywhere in Leo's village. 'We should go to the shelter,' said Leo's mum. They prepared food, water and warm clothes. At the shelter, Leo saw his friends from school. After the flood, the village was very dirty, but everyone was safe.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "earthquake safety for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 只要 zhǐyào, 敢 gǎn | Ôn: 阿姨 āyí, 孩子 háizi, 别人 biérén, 够 gòu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 安全 ānquán
zh.cum: 发洪水 fā hóngshuǐ / 地震后 dìzhèn hòu / 安全的地方 ānquán de dìfang / 不敢出去 bù gǎn chūqu / 只要……就…… zhǐyào… jiù…
zh.cau: 自然灾害前后，人们应该做什么？(Zìrán zāihài qián hòu, rénmen yīnggāi zuò shénme?) / [Ngữ pháp: ……后] 地震后，我们去了安全的地方。(Dìzhèn hòu, wǒmen qù le ānquán de dìfang.) / 发洪水的时候，孩子们不敢出去。(Fā hóngshuǐ de shíhou, háizimen bù gǎn chūqu.) / [Ngữ pháp: 只要……就……] 只要我们准备好，就很安全。(Zhǐyào wǒmen zhǔnbèi hǎo, jiù hěn ānquán.) / 我们准备的水够吗？——够了。(Wǒmen zhǔnbèi de shuǐ gòu ma? —— Gòu le.)
zh.truyen: 发洪水了 — 下了三天雨，Leo的村子发洪水了，到处都是水。孩子们不敢出去。妈妈说：“我们应该去安全的地方。”他们准备了吃的、水和衣服。阿姨说：“只要大家在一起，就不用害怕。”洪水过后，村子很脏，但是大家都很安全。(Xià le sān tiān yǔ, Leo de cūnzi fā hóngshuǐ le, dàochù dōu shì shuǐ. Háizimen bù gǎn chūqu. Māma shuō: “Wǒmen yīnggāi qù ānquán de dìfang.” Tāmen zhǔnbèi le chī de, shuǐ hé yīfu. Āyí shuō: “Zhǐyào dàjiā zài yīqǐ, jiù bù yòng hàipà.” Hóngshuǐ guòhòu, cūnzi hěn zāng, dànshì dàjiā dōu hěn ānquán.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "地震来了怎么办 儿童安全"

en.flash: storm, before, after, lightning, should, flood, earthquake, shelter, prepare | Ôn: everywhere, make sure, safe, frightening, window
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (5 câu): storm / lightning / flood / earthquake / shelter. 2) Sắp xếp việc làm vào cột Before the storm / After the storm (6 thẻ): close the windows / prepare food and water / clean the house / check the weather / go to the shelter / help your neighbours. 3) Chọn should / shouldn't (4 câu): You ___ go out in a storm. (shouldn't) / You ___ prepare water before a flood. (should) / You ___ stand near the windows in an earthquake. (shouldn't) / You ___ listen to your teacher. (should)
en.truyen: Before and After the Storm — On Monday, the TV says, 'A big storm is coming!' Before the storm came, Nhan's family prepared food and water and closed all the windows. That night, there was lightning everywhere. In the next village, there was a flood, so people went to the shelter. After the storm, Nhan and his dad helped their neighbours clean their houses. 'We should always be ready,' says Dad.
en.baihat: Storm Is Coming (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — Storm is coming, close the windows, / close the windows, close the windows. / Storm is coming, close the windows, / stay inside! // After the storm, clean the house, / clean the house, clean the house. / After the storm, clean the house, / help your friends!

zh.flash: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 只要 zhǐyào, 敢 gǎn | Ôn: 到处 dàochù, 大概 dàgài, 安全 ānquán, 突然 tūrán, 害怕 hàipà
zh.slide: 1) Nghe cô đọc, chỉ tranh đúng (6 câu): 暴风雨 / 闪电 / 洪水 / 地震 / 窗户 / 安全的地方. 2) Ghép vế câu với 之前 / 过后 / 后 (4 câu): 暴风雨来之前，→ 我关上了所有的窗户。/ 暴风雨过后，→ 我打扫了房子。/ 地震后，→ 我们去了安全的地方。/ 出门前，→ 看看天气。 3) Đóng vai gia đình chuẩn bị trước bão: 你准备好了吗？——准备好了。/ 水够吗？——够了。/ 只要我们在一起，就不怕！
zh.truyen: 暴风雨前后 — 星期一，电视上说：“大概晚上有暴风雨！”暴风雨来之前，Nhan家准备了吃的和水，还关上了所有的窗户。晚上，天上到处都是闪电。旁边的村子发洪水了，孩子们都不敢出去，大家去了安全的地方。暴风雨过后，Nhan和爸爸帮邻居打扫房子。爸爸说：“只要我们准备好，就很安全。”(Xīngqīyī, diànshì shang shuō: “Dàgài wǎnshang yǒu bàofēngyǔ!” Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, Nhan jiā zhǔnbèi le chī de hé shuǐ, hái guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu. Wǎnshang, tiānshang dàochù dōu shì shǎndiàn. Pángbiān de cūnzi fā hóngshuǐ le, háizimen dōu bù gǎn chūqu, dàjiā qù le ānquán de dìfang. Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, Nhan hé bàba bāng línjū dǎsǎo fángzi. Bàba shuō: “Zhǐyào wǒmen zhǔnbèi hǎo, jiù hěn ānquán.”)
zh.baihat: 暴风雨来了 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星) — 暴风雨要来了呀，关上窗户准备好，天上闪电亮闪闪，我们在家很安全。暴风雨呀过去了，大家一起打扫好。(Bàofēngyǔ yào lái le ya, guānshang chuānghu zhǔnbèi hǎo, tiānshang shǎndiàn liàng shǎnshǎn, wǒmen zài jiā hěn ānquán. Bàofēngyǔ ya guòqu le, dàjiā yīqǐ dǎsǎo hǎo.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 44. Unit 10 · Natural disaster – Thiên tai (2): Hạn hán, núi lửa, nơi trú ẩn

web.label: Ngày 87. Unit 10 · Hạn hán và núi lửa

en.tu: Mới: drought, volcano, wild, appear, several | Ôn: so, still, important, frightening, enormous, deep
en.cum: Mới: fall over | a long drought / wild animals / for several months / an enormous volcano / fire appears
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so – chỉ kết quả] There was no rain for several months, so there was a drought. / After the drought came, the wild animals had no water. / Fire appeared at the top of the volcano. / Be careful on the path! Don't fall over. / The volcano is enormous, but it is still sleeping. / Water is very important in a drought.
en.truyen: The Sleeping Volcano — Anna's family visits a mountain. 'It's a volcano,' says Dad. 'But it's still sleeping.' Several wild birds live there. Suddenly, Anna falls over on the path. 'Are you OK?' asks Dad. 'Yes, I'm fine!' That evening, they see another volcano on TV. Fire appears and the volcano erupts! 'That's frightening!' says Anna. 'I'm happy our volcano is still sleeping.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "volcano for kids National Geographic Kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 干旱 gānhàn, 火山 huǒshān, 听说 tīngshuō | Ôn: 担心 dānxīn, 厉害 lìhai, 非常 fēicháng, 重要 zhòngyào, 虽然 suīrán, 渴 kě, 儿子 érzi
zh.cum: 听说…… tīngshuō… / 很久没下雨 hěn jiǔ méi xià yǔ / 干旱的时候 gānhàn de shíhou / 一座火山 yī zuò huǒshān / 非常渴 fēicháng kě
zh.cau: 听说那里很久没下雨了。(Tīngshuō nàli hěn jiǔ méi xià yǔ le.) / 干旱的时候，动物们非常渴。(Gānhàn de shíhou, dòngwùmen fēicháng kě.) / 这座火山很高，也很厉害。(Zhè zuò huǒshān hěn gāo, yě hěn lìhai.) / [Ngữ pháp: 虽然……但是……] 虽然火山现在很安静，但是我们还是要小心。(Suīrán huǒshān xiànzài hěn ānjìng, dànshì wǒmen háishi yào xiǎoxīn.) / 干旱的时候，水非常重要。(Gānhàn de shíhou, shuǐ fēicháng zhòngyào.)
zh.truyen: 安静的火山 — Anna听说山上有一座火山。爸爸说：“这座火山现在很安静。”他们去看火山。虽然火山很安静，但是Anna还是有一点儿担心。晚上，电视上有另外一座火山，它喷发了！Anna说：“多么厉害啊！还好我们的火山很安静。”(Anna tīngshuō shān shang yǒu yī zuò huǒshān. Bàba shuō: “Zhè zuò huǒshān xiànzài hěn ānjìng.” Tāmen qù kàn huǒshān. Suīrán huǒshān hěn ānjìng, dànshì Anna háishi yǒu yīdiǎnr dānxīn. Wǎnshang, diànshì shang yǒu lìngwài yī zuò huǒshān, tā pēnfā le! Anna shuō: “Duōme lìhai a! Háihǎo wǒmen de huǒshān hěn ānjìng.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "火山 科普 儿童动画"

web.label: Ngày 88. Unit 10 · Chờ trong nơi trú ẩn

en.tu: Mới: bit, guess, agree, chat | Ôn: healthy, check-up, ambulance, bandage, so, still, bored
en.cum: Mới: lie down | a little bit / chat with friends / guess what / I agree with you / a guessing game
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: should] In an earthquake, you shouldn't lie down near the windows. / Can you guess what's in the bag? / I agree with you. / [Ngữ pháp: after + danh từ] After the storm, we chatted in the shelter. / Wait a bit! / Don't go out without an adult.
en.truyen: Waiting in the Shelter — After the flood, Leo and his friends are in the shelter. They are a bit bored. 'Let's chat!' says Xiaomei. 'Let's play a guessing game!' says Leo. 'Guess what animal I am!' Anna lies down on her bed and laughs. 'A furry panda!' They all agree it's a great game. Now the shelter doesn't feel so frightening.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "guessing game for kids animals"

zh.tu: Mới: 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 躺 tǎng | Ôn: 健康 jiànkāng, 安全 ānquán, 紧张 jǐnzhāng, 聪明 cōngming, 方便 fāngbiàn, 好像 hǎoxiàng
zh.cum: 猜一猜 cāi yi cāi / 我同意 wǒ tóngyì / 和朋友聊天儿 hé péngyou liáotiānr / 躺下 tǎngxia / 躺在床上 tǎng zài chuáng shang
zh.cau: 地震的时候，不要站在窗户旁边。(Dìzhèn de shíhou, bùyào zhàn zài chuānghu pángbiān.) / 你猜猜，包里有什么？(Nǐ cāicai, bāo li yǒu shénme?) / 我同意你的办法。(Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de bànfǎ.) / 暴风雨过后，我们在安全的地方聊天儿。(Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒmen zài ānquán de dìfang liáotiānr.) / [Ngữ pháp: 被] 我的雨伞被风吹走了。(Wǒ de yǔsǎn bèi fēng chuīzǒu le.) / 你累了，躺下休息吧。(Nǐ lèi le, tǎngxia xiūxi ba.)
zh.truyen: 在安全的地方 — 洪水过后，Leo和朋友们在一个安全的地方。他们没有事情做。Xiaomei说：“我们聊天儿吧！”Leo说：“我们玩儿猜一猜吧！你们猜猜我是什么动物？”Anna躺在床上笑了：“你好像熊猫！”大家都同意，这个游戏好玩儿极了。(Hóngshuǐ guòhòu, Leo hé péngyoumen zài yī gè ānquán de dìfang. Tāmen méiyǒu shìqing zuò. Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒmen liáotiānr ba!” Leo shuō: “Wǒmen wánr cāi yi cāi ba! Nǐmen cāicai wǒ shì shénme dòngwù?” Anna tǎng zài chuáng shang xiào le: “Nǐ hǎoxiàng xióngmāo!” Dàjiā dōu tóngyì, zhè gè yóuxì hǎowánr jí le.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "猜猜我是谁 儿童游戏"

en.flash: drought, volcano, wild, appear, several, fall over, bit, guess, agree, chat, lie down | Ôn: storm, flood, shelter, should, bored, frightening
en.slide: 1) Đoán thiên tai qua câu mô tả (4 câu): There is no rain for several months. (drought) / Fire appears at the top. (volcano) / There is water everywhere. (flood) / There is lightning and a lot of wind. (storm) 2) Hành động theo lệnh (TPR): Lie down! / Don't fall over! / Chat with your friend! / Guess! 3) Trò Guess what? theo cặp: Guess what animal I am. – Are you wild? – Yes, I am. – Are you a lion? – Yes! / I agree. / I don't agree.
en.truyen: A Day in the Shelter — After the flood, Leo's family stayed in the shelter for several days. On the first day, Leo was a bit bored. Then Xiaomei came. 'Let's chat!' she said. They talked about the drought in another country and a volcano on TV. 'I heard the wild animals had no water,' said Xiaomei. 'Let's play a guessing game!' said Leo. Anna lay down and guessed every animal. They all agreed: 'This is the best game!'
en.baihat: Storm Is Coming (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down), lời 2 — In the shelter, chat and guess, / chat and guess, chat and guess. / In the shelter, chat and guess, / we are safe! // Earthquake, earthquake, don't fall over, / don't fall over, don't fall over. / Earthquake, earthquake, don't fall over, / find a safe place!

zh.flash: 干旱 gānhàn, 火山 huǒshān, 听说 tīngshuō, 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 躺 tǎng | Ôn: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 担心 dānxīn, 厉害 lìhai, 虽然 suīrán
zh.slide: 1) Nghe – chọn tranh thiên tai (4 câu): 很久没下雨，这是干旱。/ 这是火山。/ 到处都是水，这是洪水。/ 天上有闪电，风很大，这是暴风雨。 2) Trò '猜一猜': một con mô tả, cả lớp đoán: 它很高，上面有火。——是火山！/ 很久没下雨。——是干旱！ 3) Nói theo cặp với 听说 và 同意: 听说那里发洪水了。——真的吗？/ 我们去安全的地方吧！——我同意。
zh.truyen: 在安全的地方的一天 — 洪水过后，Leo家在一个安全的地方住了几天。第一天，Leo没有事情做。Xiaomei来了，她说：“我们聊天儿吧！”她说：“我听说别的国家有干旱，很久没下雨了，动物们非常渴。”Leo说：“我听说电视上有一座火山，非常厉害！”Anna累了，躺在床上说：“我们玩儿猜一猜吧！”大家都同意。(Hóngshuǐ guòhòu, Leo jiā zài yī gè ānquán de dìfang zhù le jǐ tiān. Dì yī tiān, Leo méiyǒu shìqing zuò. Xiaomei lái le, tā shuō: “Wǒmen liáotiānr ba!” Tā shuō: “Wǒ tīngshuō bié de guójiā yǒu gānhàn, hěn jiǔ méi xià yǔ le, dòngwùmen fēicháng kě.” Leo shuō: “Wǒ tīngshuō diànshì shang yǒu yī zuò huǒshān, fēicháng lìhai!” Anna lèi le, tǎng zài chuáng shang shuō: “Wǒmen wánr cāi yi cāi ba!” Dàjiā dōu tóngyì.)
zh.baihat: 暴风雨来了 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星), lời 2 — 我们一起聊天儿呀，你猜一猜我同意，累了躺下休息吧，只要一起就不怕。听说那里没下雨，大家快来帮帮它。(Wǒmen yīqǐ liáotiānr ya, nǐ cāi yi cāi wǒ tóngyì, lèi le tǎngxia xiūxi ba, zhǐyào yīqǐ jiù bù pà. Tīngshuō nàli méi xià yǔ, dàjiā kuài lái bāngbang tā.)

en.tu: Mới: mind, design, invent | Ôn: storm, shelter, should, before, after, flood, robot
en.cum: design a safe house / invent a robot / never mind / I don't mind / try again
en.cau: Leo wants to design a safe house. / Anna invents a robot to help people after an earthquake. / Do you mind closing the window? – No, I don't mind. / Never mind! Let's try again. / [Ngữ pháp: should] A safe house should be strong. / [Ngữ pháp: after + mệnh đề] After the flood came, the house on long legs was still dry.
en.truyen: Little Inventors — Leo and Anna want to invent something for storms and floods. Leo designs a house on long legs. 'After a flood, the house is still dry!' he says. Anna designs a robot that helps people after an earthquake. The first robot falls over. 'Never mind!' says Anna. 'Let's try again.' The second robot works! 'Excellent!' says their teacher.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "kid inventors for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 选择 xuǎnzé, 接 jiē | Ôn: 准备 zhǔnbèi, 窗户 chuānghu, 地震 dìzhèn, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 办法 bànfǎ, 决定 juédìng, 词典 cídiǎn
zh.cum: 做选择 zuò xuǎnzé / 选择安全的地方 xuǎnzé ānquán de dìfang / 来接我 lái jiē wǒ / 接电话 jiē diànhuà
zh.cau: 暴风雨过后，爸爸来学校接我。(Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, bàba lái xuéxiào jiē wǒ.) / 地震的时候，我们要选择安全的地方。(Dìzhèn de shíhou, wǒmen yào xuǎnzé ānquán de dìfang.) / 你选择哪个办法？——我选择这个。(Nǐ xuǎnzé nǎ gè bànfǎ? —— Wǒ xuǎnzé zhè gè.) / [Ngữ pháp: 动词 + 前] 出门前，看看天气。(Chūmén qián, kànkan tiānqì.) / 妈妈的电话响了，我去接。(Māma de diànhuà xiǎng le, wǒ qù jiē.)
zh.truyen: Leo和Anna的好办法 — Leo和Anna想找一个办法帮助大家。Leo说：“我选择做一个高高的房子。发洪水的时候，房子里没有水。”Anna决定做一个机器人，地震后去找人。第一个机器人不行。Anna说：“没关系，我们再试试！”下午，妈妈来接他们，看到了第二个机器人。妈妈说：“你们多么聪明啊！”(Leo hé Anna xiǎng zhǎo yī gè bànfǎ bāngzhù dàjiā. Leo shuō: “Wǒ xuǎnzé zuò yī gè gāogāo de fángzi. Fā hóngshuǐ de shíhou, fángzi li méiyǒu shuǐ.” Anna juédìng zuò yī gè jīqìrén, dìzhèn hòu qù zhǎo rén. Dì yī gè jīqìrén bù xíng. Anna shuō: “Méi guānxi, wǒmen zài shìshi!” Xiàwǔ, māma lái jiē tāmen, kàndào le dì èr gè jīqìrén. Māma shuō: “Nǐmen duōme cōngming a!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "小发明 儿童科学"

en.tu: Ôn: storm, before, after, should, lightning, flood, earthquake, drought, volcano, shelter, prepare, wild, several, guess, agree, chat, design, invent, fall over, lie down
en.cum: before the storm / after the earthquake / go to a shelter / prepare food and water / fall over / lie down / chat with friends
en.cau: What should people do before and after a natural disaster? / Before the storm came, I closed all the windows. / After the storm, I cleaned my house. / Before you go out, check the weather. / After the earthquake, we went to a safe place. / You shouldn't go out without an adult.
en.truyen: Nhan's Storm Diary — Before the storm came, I closed all the windows and prepared some water. During the night, I saw lightning. I was a bit frightened, so I chatted with my sister. After the storm, Dad said, 'Let's clean the house.' I agreed. In the afternoon, we helped our neighbours. It was a long day!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "before and after grammar for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 只要 zhǐyào, 敢 gǎn, 干旱 gānhàn, 火山 huǒshān, 听说 tīngshuō, 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 躺 tǎng, 选择 xuǎnzé, 接 jiē
zh.cum: 暴风雨来之前 bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián / 地震后 dìzhèn hòu / 出门前 chūmén qián / 安全的地方 ānquán de dìfang / 来接我 lái jiē wǒ
zh.cau: 自然灾害前后，人们应该做什么？(Zìrán zāihài qián hòu, rénmen yīnggāi zuò shénme?) / 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户。(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒ guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu.) / 暴风雨过后，我打扫了房子。(Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒ dǎsǎo le fángzi.) / 出门前，看看天气。(Chūmén qián, kànkan tiānqì.) / 地震后，我们去了安全的地方。(Dìzhèn hòu, wǒmen qù le ānquán de dìfang.) / 窗户被风吹开了。(Chuānghu bèi fēng chuīkāi le.)
zh.truyen: Nhan的日记 — 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户，还准备了水。晚上，我看到了闪电。我有一点儿害怕，所以和妹妹聊天儿。暴风雨过后，爸爸说：“我们打扫房子吧。”我同意了。下午，我们帮邻居打扫。只要大家一起，就不累！(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒ guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu, hái zhǔnbèi le shuǐ. Wǎnshang, wǒ kàndào le shǎndiàn. Wǒ yǒu yīdiǎnr hàipà, suǒyǐ hé mèimei liáotiānr. Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, bàba shuō: “Wǒmen dǎsǎo fángzi ba.” Wǒ tóngyì le. Xiàwǔ, wǒmen bāng línjū dǎsǎo. Zhǐyào dàjiā yīqǐ, jiù bù lèi!)

en.flash: mind, design, invent | Ôn: storm, before, after, should, flood, earthquake, drought, volcano, shelter, prepare, guess, agree, fall over, lie down
en.slide: 1) Nối câu hỏi – câu trả lời (4 cặp): Do you mind closing the window? – No, I don't mind. / What should we do before a flood? – We should prepare food and water. / Can you guess? – Is it a volcano? / The robot fell over! – Never mind! 2) Nhóm 3 con: thiết kế 'A Safe House' trên slide (kéo thả: long legs / strong windows / a shelter room / water and food) và nói 2 câu: We designed… It should have… 3) Viết lại câu với before / after (3 câu): I closed the windows. Then the storm came. → Before the storm came, I closed the windows. / The storm ended. I cleaned my house. → After the storm, I cleaned my house. / Check the weather. Then go out. → Before you go out, check the weather.
en.truyen: Little Inventors (kể đầy đủ) — At school, the teacher says, 'Let's design something for natural disasters!' Leo designs a house on long legs: 'After a flood, it's still dry.' Anna invents a robot that can find people after an earthquake. The first robot falls over. 'Never mind!' says Anna. Xiaomei asks, 'Do you mind if I help?' 'No, I don't mind!' The second robot walks and finds a toy under a table. 'Excellent!' says the teacher.
en.baihat: Storm Is Coming (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down), lời 3 — Let's design a safe, safe house, / safe, safe house, safe, safe house. / Let's design a safe, safe house / on long legs! // Robot fell over, never mind, / never mind, never mind. / Robot fell over, never mind, / try again!

zh.flash: 选择 xuǎnzé, 接 jiē | Ôn: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 只要 zhǐyào, 敢 gǎn, 干旱 gānhàn, 火山 huǒshān, 听说 tīngshuō, 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 躺 tǎng
zh.slide: 1) Thẻ phản xạ không tranh: cô đọc từ, con giơ thẻ chữ Hán (8 từ): 选择 / 接 / 准备 / 同意 / 敢 / 躺 / 猜 / 听说. 2) Chọn đúng – sai về việc nên làm khi có thiên tai (5 câu): 暴风雨来之前，关上窗户。(对) / 地震的时候，站在窗户旁边。(错) / 发洪水的时候，选择安全的地方。(对) / 出门前，看看天气。(对) / 只要下雨，我们就去游泳。(错) 3) Nhóm 3 con thiết kế 'Ngôi nhà an toàn' và nói: 我们选择……，因为……
zh.truyen: Leo和Anna的好办法 (kể đầy đủ) — 老师说：“我们想一想，自然灾害的时候，有什么好办法？”Leo选择做一个高高的房子：“发洪水的时候，房子里没有水。”Anna决定做一个机器人，地震后去找人。第一个机器人不行，Anna不敢再试了。Xiaomei说：“没关系！只要我们一起，就行！”第二个机器人找到了桌子下面的玩具。下午，妈妈来接她们，说：“你们多么聪明啊！”(Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen xiǎng yi xiǎng, zìrán zāihài de shíhou, yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?” Leo xuǎnzé zuò yī gè gāogāo de fángzi: “Fā hóngshuǐ de shíhou, fángzi li méiyǒu shuǐ.” Anna juédìng zuò yī gè jīqìrén, dìzhèn hòu qù zhǎo rén. Dì yī gè jīqìrén bù xíng, Anna bù gǎn zài shì le. Xiaomei shuō: “Méi guānxi! Zhǐyào wǒmen yīqǐ, jiù xíng!” Dì èr gè jīqìrén zhǎodào le zhuōzi xiàmian de wánjù. Xiàwǔ, māma lái jiē tāmen, shuō: “Nǐmen duōme cōngming a!”)
zh.baihat: 暴风雨来了 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星), lời 3 — 出门前呀看天气，地震后去安全地，选择一个好办法，只要一起就不怕。爸爸妈妈来接我，一家人呀笑哈哈。(Chūmén qián ya kàn tiānqì, dìzhèn hòu qù ānquán dì, xuǎnzé yī gè hǎo bànfǎ, zhǐyào yīqǐ jiù bù pà. Bàba māma lái jiē wǒ, yī jiā rén ya xiào hāhā.)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 46. Unit 10 · Natural disaster – Thiên tai (4): Truyện, Phiên dịch nhí, kiểm tra unit · Luyện Flyers Nói phần 3

web.label: Ngày 91. Unit 10 · Truyện và chuyển ngữ: Bão và tắc đường

en.tu: Ôn: storm, before, after, should, prepare, shelter, lightning, fall over | Ôn truyện: traffic, jam, fire engine, passenger, underground, arrive, forget, light
en.cum: a traffic jam / a fire engine / take the underground / arrive at school / before the storm
en.cau: Before the storm came, there was a big traffic jam. / The passengers took the underground, so they arrived early. / A tree fell over in the storm, so a fire engine came. / After the storm, the traffic lights didn't work. / We should not forget our umbrellas. / [Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): nhìn 5 tranh 'The Storm', nghe câu mẫu rồi ghi âm câu kể của con] (1) A big storm was coming. / (2) Before the storm came, Nhan closed the windows. / (3) Some trees fell over. / (4) The family went to a shelter and lay down. / (5) After the storm, they cleaned the garden together.
en.truyen: The Storm and the Traffic Jam — It was Friday afternoon. Before the storm came, there was a big traffic jam in the city. Nhan and his mum were passengers on a bus. 'We should take the underground,' said Mum. So they got off and took the underground. Outside, a tree fell over and a fire engine came. They arrived home before the lightning. 'Don't forget,' said Mum, 'check the weather before you go out!' On TV, they heard about a hurricane in another country.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hurricane for kids explained"

zh.tu: Ôn: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 窗户 chuānghu, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 只要 zhǐyào | Ôn truyện: 堵车 dǔchē, 地铁 dìtiě, 出发 chūfā, 离开 líkāi, 停 tíng, 忘记 wàngjì, 下车 xià chē, 红绿灯 hónglǜdēng
zh.cum: 堵车了 dǔchē le / 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě / 下车 xià chē / 离开学校 líkāi xuéxiào / 别忘记 bié wàngjì
zh.cau: 暴风雨来之前，路上堵车了。(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, lùshang dǔchē le.) / [Ngữ pháp: 所以] 我们坐地铁，所以很快就到家了。(Wǒmen zuò dìtiě, suǒyǐ hěn kuài jiù dào jiā le.) / [Ngữ pháp: 被] 一棵树被风吹倒了。(Yī kē shù bèi fēng chuīdǎo le.) / 暴风雨过后，红绿灯停了。(Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, hónglǜdēng tíng le.) / 出门前，别忘记看看天气。(Chūmén qián, bié wàngjì kànkan tiānqì.)
zh.truyen: 暴风雨和堵车 — 星期五下午，Nhan和妈妈离开学校。暴风雨来之前，路上堵车了。妈妈说：“我们下车，去坐地铁吧！”他们坐地铁回家，很快就到了。外面，一棵树被风吹倒了。闪电来之前，他们到家了。妈妈说：“出门前，别忘记看看天气！”电视上说，别的国家有飓风。(Xīngqīwǔ xiàwǔ, Nhan hé māma líkāi xuéxiào. Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, lùshang dǔchē le. Māma shuō: “Wǒmen xià chē, qù zuò dìtiě ba!” Tāmen zuò dìtiě huí jiā, hěn kuài jiù dào le. Wàimian, yī kē shù bèi fēng chuīdǎo le. Shǎndiàn lái zhīqián, tāmen dào jiā le. Māma shuō: “Chūmén qián, bié wàngjì kànkan tiānqì!” Diànshì shang shuō, bié de guójiā yǒu jùfēng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "飓风 海啸 儿童科普"

en.tu: Ôn: storm, before, after, should, flood, earthquake, drought, volcano, shelter, prepare, wild, appear, guess, agree, chat, design, invent, fall over, lie down
en.cum: before the storm / after the earthquake / go to a shelter / prepare food and water / never mind / I agree
en.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Trung, nói lại bằng tiếng Anh): What should people do before and after a natural disaster? / Before the storm came, I closed all the windows. / After the storm, I cleaned my house. / Before you go out, check the weather. / After the earthquake, we went to a safe place.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter on the Phone — Xiaomei's aunt calls from China. She only speaks Chinese. 'I heard there was a storm in Hanoi! Are you OK?' she asks. Xiaomei answers in Chinese, and Nhan tells his mum in English: 'Before the storm came, they closed all the windows. After the storm, they cleaned the house. They are all safe!' Xiaomei's aunt says, 'You should always prepare food and water before a storm.' Everyone agrees.
