zh.tu: Ôn: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 只要 zhǐyào, 敢 gǎn, 干旱 gānhàn, 火山 huǒshān, 听说 tīngshuō, 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 躺 tǎng, 选择 xuǎnzé, 接 jiē, 被 bèi
zh.cum: 接电话 jiē diànhuà / 听说…… tīngshuō… / 我们都很安全 wǒmen dōu hěn ānquán / 暴风雨过后 bàofēngyǔ guòhòu / 我同意 wǒ tóngyì
zh.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Anh, nói lại bằng tiếng Trung): 自然灾害前后，人们应该做什么？(Zìrán zāihài qián hòu, rénmen yīnggāi zuò shénme?) / 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户。(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒ guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu.) / 暴风雨过后，我打扫了房子。(Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒ dǎsǎo le fángzi.) / 出门前，看看天气。(Chūmén qián, kànkan tiānqì.) / 地震后，我们去了安全的地方。(Dìzhèn hòu, wǒmen qù le ānquán de dìfang.)
zh.truyen: 电话里的小翻译 — Xiaomei的阿姨从中国打电话来。Xiaomei接电话。阿姨说：“我听说河内有暴风雨！你们好吗？”Xiaomei告诉阿姨：“暴风雨来之前，我们关上了所有的窗户。暴风雨过后，我们打扫了房子。我们都很安全！”Nhan在旁边用英语告诉妈妈。阿姨说：“暴风雨来之前，你们应该准备好水和吃的。”大家都同意。(Xiaomei de āyí cóng Zhōngguó dǎ diànhuà lái. Xiaomei jiē diànhuà. Āyí shuō: “Wǒ tīngshuō Hénèi yǒu bàofēngyǔ! Nǐmen hǎo ma?” Xiaomei gàosu āyí: “Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒmen guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu. Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒmen dǎsǎo le fángzi. Wǒmen dōu hěn ānquán!” Nhan zài pángbiān yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu māma. Āyí shuō: “Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, nǐmen yīnggāi zhǔnbèi hǎo shuǐ hé chī de.” Dàjiā dōu tóngyì.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "自然灾害 安全教育 儿歌"

en.flash: Ôn cả unit: storm, before, after, should, lightning, flood, earthquake, shelter, prepare, drought, volcano, wild, appear, several, fall over, lie down, bit, guess, agree, chat, mind, design, invent + nghe hiểu: hurricane, tsunami, erupt
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nghe (5 câu, chọn tranh A/B/C): Before the storm came, Nhan closed the windows. / After the earthquake, they went to a safe place. / There is a drought. / The volcano is sleeping. / Anna lies down in the shelter. 2) Điền before / after / should (5 câu): ___ the storm came, I closed all the windows. (Before) / ___ the storm, I cleaned my house. (After) / People ___ go to a shelter. (should) / ___ you go out, check the weather. (Before) / ___ the earthquake, we went to a safe place. (After) 3) Nhóm 4 con làm poster 'Before – During – After a storm', mỗi con nói 1 câu. 4) Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): kể truyện theo 5 tranh 'The Storm'. Cô kể tranh 1: One afternoon, Nhan and his dad watched the weather on TV. A big storm was coming. Con kể tranh 2–5: (2) Before the storm came, Nhan and Dad closed all the windows. / (3) The storm was very strong. Some trees fell over and it rained a lot. / (4) The family went to a shelter. Nhan lay down and listened to the wind. / (5) After the storm, they went home and cleaned the garden together. Nhan said, 'We should always be ready!'
en.truyen: The Storm and the Traffic Jam (kể đầy đủ) — Before the storm came, there was a big traffic jam. Nhan and Mum got off the bus and took the underground. 'We should get home before the lightning,' said Mum. A tree fell over outside and a fire engine came. At home, they closed all the windows. After the storm, they cleaned the house and helped their neighbours. On TV, they heard about a hurricane and a tsunami in other countries. 'We are lucky,' said Nhan. 'We prepared well.'
en.baihat: Storm Is Coming (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down), cả bài — Storm is coming, close the windows… stay inside! / After the storm, clean the house… help your friends! / In the shelter, chat and guess… we are safe! / Let's design a safe, safe house… on long legs!

zh.flash: Ôn cả unit: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 闪电 shǎndiàn, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 洪水 hóngshuǐ, 地震 dìzhèn, 只要 zhǐyào, 敢 gǎn, 干旱 gānhàn, 火山 huǒshān, 听说 tīngshuō, 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 躺 tǎng, 选择 xuǎnzé, 接 jiē, 被 bèi + nghe hiểu: 飓风 jùfēng, 海啸 hǎixiào, 喷发 pēnfā
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra đọc chữ Hán (8 câu, chọn chữ điền chỗ trống): 暴风雨来之前，我关上了___。(窗户) / 地震___，我们去了安全的地方。(后) / 你___好了吗？(准备) / ___我们一起，就不怕。(只要) / 我___那里很久没下雨了。(听说) / 你___猜，我是谁？(猜) / 我的雨伞___风吹走了。(被) / 下午妈妈来___我。(接) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một con đọc thẻ tiếng Anh, con kia nói tiếng Trung (4 thẻ câu mẫu). 3) Nói về poster: 暴风雨来之前，我们……。暴风雨过后，我们……。
zh.truyen: 暴风雨和堵车 (kể đầy đủ) — 星期五下午，暴风雨来之前，路上堵车了。Nhan和妈妈下车，去坐地铁。妈妈说：“我们应该在闪电来之前到家。”外面，一棵树被风吹倒了。到家后，他们关上了所有的窗户。暴风雨过后，他们打扫了房子，还帮了邻居。电视上说，别的国家有飓风和海啸。Nhan说：“只要准备好，就很安全！”(Xīngqīwǔ xiàwǔ, bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, lùshang dǔchē le. Nhan hé māma xià chē, qù zuò dìtiě. Māma shuō: “Wǒmen yīnggāi zài shǎndiàn lái zhīqián dào jiā.” Wàimian, yī kē shù bèi fēng chuīdǎo le. Dào jiā hòu, tāmen guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu. Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, tāmen dǎsǎo le fángzi, hái bāng le línjū. Diànshì shang shuō, bié de guójiā yǒu jùfēng hé hǎixiào. Nhan shuō: “Zhǐyào zhǔnbèi hǎo, jiù hěn ānquán!”)
zh.baihat: 暴风雨来了 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星), cả bài 3 lời — 暴风雨要来了呀，关上窗户准备好…… / 我们一起聊天儿呀，你猜一猜我同意…… / 出门前呀看天气，地震后去安全地……(Bàofēngyǔ yào lái le ya… / Wǒmen yīqǐ liáotiānr ya… / Chūmén qián ya kàn tiānqì…)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 47. Unit 11 · Food – Ăn uống (1): Hôm qua con ăn gì, bữa sáng

web.label: Ngày 93. Unit 11 · Hôm qua con ăn gì?

en.tu: Mới: delicious, noodle, snack, cereal | Ôn: ever, of course, together, airport, museum, eat, pizza, rice, milk
en.cum: eat noodles / a delicious snack / cereal with milk / last night / for breakfast / with chopsticks
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn – What did you eat?] What did you eat last night? – I ate pizza. / I ate noodles with chopsticks. / The noodles were delicious. / I had cereal with milk for breakfast. / [Ngữ pháp: Did…? – Yes, I did.] Did you eat a snack after school? – Yes, I did.
en.truyen: Leo's Food Diary — Yesterday morning, Leo had cereal with milk for breakfast. At lunch, he ate noodles with chopsticks. 'The noodles were delicious!' he said. After school, he ate a small snack: an apple. Last night, his family ate pizza together. 'What a delicious day!' said Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "what did you eat yesterday past simple kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 披萨 pīsà, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào | Ôn: 啊 a, 参加 cānjiā, 吃 chī, 喝 hē, 米饭 mǐfàn, 面条 miàntiáo, 好吃 hǎochī, 牛奶 niúnǎi, 果汁 guǒzhī
zh.cum: 吃了披萨 chī le pīsà / 一个三明治 yī gè sānmíngzhì / 喝饮料 hē yǐnliào / 昨天晚上 zuótiān wǎnshang / 吃早饭 chī zǎofàn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 了 – hành động đã hoàn thành] 你昨天晚上吃了什么？(Nǐ zuótiān wǎnshang chī le shénme?) / 我吃了披萨。(Wǒ chī le pīsà.) / 早上我吃了一个三明治，喝了牛奶。(Zǎoshang wǒ chī le yī gè sānmíngzhì, hē le niúnǎi.) / 你喝了什么饮料？——我喝了果汁。(Nǐ hē le shénme yǐnliào? —— Wǒ hē le guǒzhī.) / 我用筷子吃了面条。(Wǒ yòng kuàizi chī le miàntiáo.)
zh.truyen: Leo的一天 — 昨天早上，Leo吃了一个三明治，喝了牛奶。中午，他用筷子吃了面条。他说：“面条很好吃啊！”下午，他喝了果汁。晚上，他们一家人一起吃了披萨。Leo说：“昨天吃的东西都很好吃！”(Zuótiān zǎoshang, Leo chī le yī gè sānmíngzhì, hē le niúnǎi. Zhōngwǔ, tā yòng kuàizi chī le miàntiáo. Tā shuō: “Miàntiáo hěn hǎochī a!” Xiàwǔ, tā hē le guǒzhī. Wǎnshang, tāmen yī jiā rén yīqǐ chī le pīsà. Leo shuō: “Zuótiān chī de dōngxi dōu hěn hǎochī!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你吃了什么 中文 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 94. Unit 11 · Bữa sáng của Anna

en.tu: Mới: spoon, honey, yoghurt, strawberry | Ôn: glass, plastic, high, member, bowl, chopsticks, ice cream
en.cum: eat with a spoon / yoghurt with honey / a bowl of strawberries / a plastic spoon / a glass of milk
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: Did…? – Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.] Did you eat yoghurt yesterday? – Yes, I did. / Did you eat strawberries? – No, I didn't. / I ate yoghurt with honey. / Anna ate a bowl of strawberries with a spoon. / Can I have a spoon, please?
en.truyen: Anna's Breakfast — 'Did you eat breakfast, Anna?' asked Mum. 'No, I didn't,' said Anna. So Mum gave her some yoghurt with honey and a bowl of strawberries. Anna couldn't find a spoon. 'Here's a plastic spoon,' said her brother. Anna ate it all. 'Mmm, delicious!' she said.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "breakfast food vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 勺子 sháozi, 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao | Ôn: 安静 ānjìng, 变化 biànhuà, 用 yòng, 筷子 kuàizi, 早饭 zǎofàn, 甜 tián
zh.cum: 用勺子 yòng sháozi / 吃冰激凌 chī bīngjīlíng / 很多葡萄 hěn duō pútao / 没吃 méi chī / 吃了 chī le
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: ……了吗？ – 吃了。/ 没吃。] 你昨天吃米饭了吗？——吃了。(Nǐ zuótiān chī mǐfàn le ma? —— Chī le.) / 你吃冰激凌了吗？——没吃。(Nǐ chī bīngjīlíng le ma? —— Méi chī.) / 我用勺子吃了冰激凌。(Wǒ yòng sháozi chī le bīngjīlíng.) / Anna吃了很多葡萄。(Anna chī le hěn duō pútao.) / 葡萄很甜。(Pútao hěn tián.)
zh.truyen: Anna的早饭 — 妈妈问：“Anna，你吃早饭了吗？”Anna说：“没吃。”妈妈给她一些葡萄和一点儿冰激凌。Anna找不到勺子。哥哥说：“这里有一个勺子。”Anna用勺子吃了冰激凌，又吃了葡萄。她说：“真好吃！”(Māma wèn: “Anna, nǐ chī zǎofàn le ma?” Anna shuō: “Méi chī.” Māma gěi tā yīxiē pútao hé yīdiǎnr bīngjīlíng. Anna zhǎo bu dào sháozi. Gēge shuō: “Zhèli yǒu yī gè sháozi.” Anna yòng sháozi chī le bīngjīlíng, yòu chī le pútao. Tā shuō: “Zhēn hǎochī!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "水果 葡萄 冰激凌 儿歌"

en.flash: delicious, noodle, snack, cereal, spoon, honey, yoghurt, strawberry | Ôn: pizza, rice, milk, chopsticks, bowl, ice cream
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (8 câu): noodles / snack / cereal / spoon / honey / yoghurt / strawberry / pizza. 2) Phỏng vấn bạn và tích bảng (4 câu): Did you eat cereal yesterday? – Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. / What did you eat last night? – I ate noodles. 3) Chọn đúng dạng quá khứ (4 câu): I (eat / ate) pizza last night. / Anna (has / had) yoghurt yesterday. / Did you (eat / ate) a snack? / The noodles (are / were) delicious.
en.truyen: A Delicious Weekend — On Saturday morning, Leo had cereal with milk. Anna had yoghurt with honey and some strawberries. At lunch, they ate noodles with chopsticks at Leo's house. 'Did you eat a snack after lunch?' asked Leo's mum. 'No, we didn't!' they said. So she gave them some ice cream with a spoon. In the evening, everyone ate pizza together. 'What a delicious weekend!' said Anna.
en.baihat: What Did You Eat? (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — What did you eat last night, / last night, last night? / What did you eat last night? / I ate noodles, yum! // Did you eat a snack today, / snack today, snack today? / Did you eat a snack today? / Yes, I did, yum!

zh.flash: 披萨 pīsà, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào, 勺子 sháozi, 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao | Ôn: 米饭 mǐfàn, 面条 miàntiáo, 牛奶 niúnǎi, 果汁 guǒzhī, 筷子 kuàizi, 好吃 hǎochī
zh.slide: 1) Nghe cô đọc, chọn tranh (6 câu): 披萨 / 三明治 / 饮料 / 勺子 / 冰激凌 / 葡萄. 2) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp có bảng tích: 你昨天吃披萨了吗？——吃了。/ 没吃。/ 你昨天晚上吃了什么？——我吃了面条。/ 你喝了什么饮料？——我喝了牛奶。 3) Chọn 了 hay 没 (4 câu): 我昨天吃___三明治。(了) / 我___吃冰激凌。(没) / 你喝___什么？(了) / 他___喝饮料。(没)
zh.truyen: 好吃的周末 — 星期六早上，Leo吃了一个三明治，喝了牛奶。Anna吃了很多葡萄。中午，他们在Leo家用筷子吃了面条。Leo的妈妈问：“你们吃冰激凌了吗？”他们说：“没吃！”妈妈给他们冰激凌和勺子。晚上，大家一起吃了披萨，喝了饮料。Anna说：“这个周末真好吃啊！”(Xīngqīliù zǎoshang, Leo chī le yī gè sānmíngzhì, hē le niúnǎi. Anna chī le hěn duō pútao. Zhōngwǔ, tāmen zài Leo jiā yòng kuàizi chī le miàntiáo. Leo de māma wèn: “Nǐmen chī bīngjīlíng le ma?” Tāmen shuō: “Méi chī!” Māma gěi tāmen bīngjīlíng hé sháozi. Wǎnshang, dàjiā yīqǐ chī le pīsà, hē le yǐnliào. Anna shuō: “Zhè gè zhōumò zhēn hǎochī a!”)
zh.baihat: 好吃歌 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — 昨天吃什么？我吃了面条，三明治披萨冰激凌，真好吃好吃！(Zuótiān chī shénme? Wǒ chī le miàntiáo, sānmíngzhì pīsà bīngjīlíng, zhēn hǎochī hǎochī!) // 你吃了吗？我没吃葡萄，拿个勺子吃冰激凌，真好吃好吃！(Nǐ chī le ma? Wǒ méi chī pútao, ná gè sháozi chī bīngjīlíng, zhēn hǎochī hǎochī!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 48. Unit 11 · Food – Ăn uống (2): Nêm nếm, ở nhà hàng · Luyện YCT口试（中级）第三部分

web.label: Ngày 95. Unit 11 · Nêm nếm món ăn

en.tu: Mới: salt, pepper, sugar, taste | Ôn: before, after, should, guess, prepare, salty, sweet, soup
en.cum: too much salt / a little pepper / no sugar / taste the soup / too salty / tomato soup
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn – be: was] The soup was too salty. / Dad tasted the soup before dinner. / [Ngữ pháp: should] You shouldn't put too much salt in the soup. / I put a little pepper on my egg. / This cake tastes sweet because it has sugar in it. / Guess! What did I put in the soup?
en.truyen: Dad's Soup — Before dinner, Dad prepared some tomato soup. Leo tasted it. 'It's too salty!' he said. Dad tasted it, too. 'I agree. Guess what? I put salt in it two times!' They added some water and a little pepper. After that, the soup tasted delicious. 'You should taste it before you put the salt in,' laughed Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sweet salty sour bitter tastes for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì | Ôn: 准备 zhǔnbèi, 猜 cāi, 同意 tóngyì, 选择 xuǎnzé, 咸 xián, 甜 tián, 汤 tāng
zh.cum: 尝一尝 cháng yi cháng / 西红柿汤 xīhóngshì tāng / 放糖 fàng táng / 太咸了 tài xián le / 一点儿糖 yīdiǎnr táng
zh.cau: 汤太咸了。(Tāng tài xián le.) / [Ngữ pháp: 了] 晚饭前，爸爸尝了尝汤。(Wǎnfàn qián, bàba cháng le cháng tāng.) / 你尝一尝这个西红柿汤。(Nǐ cháng yi cháng zhè gè xīhóngshì tāng.) / [Ngữ pháp: 没 + động từ] 我没放糖。(Wǒ méi fàng táng.) / 你猜猜，我放了什么？(Nǐ cāicai, wǒ fàng le shénme?) / 吃太多糖不健康。(Chī tài duō táng bù jiànkāng.)
zh.truyen: 爸爸的西红柿汤 — 晚饭前，爸爸准备了西红柿汤。Leo尝了一口，说：“汤太咸了！”爸爸也尝了尝，说：“我同意，太咸了！”他们加了水，还放了一点儿糖。Leo又尝了尝，说：“现在好吃了！”(Wǎnfàn qián, bàba zhǔnbèi le xīhóngshì tāng. Leo cháng le yī kǒu, shuō: “Tāng tài xián le!” Bàba yě cháng le cháng, shuō: “Wǒ tóngyì, tài xián le!” Tāmen jiā le shuǐ, hái fàng le yīdiǎnr táng. Leo yòu cháng le cháng, shuō: “Xiànzài hǎochī le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "酸甜苦辣咸 儿童 味道"

web.label: Ngày 96. Unit 11 · Ở nhà hàng

en.tu: Mới: smell, butter, olives | Ôn: fall over, lie down, agree, chat, storm, cheese, bread, waiter
en.cum: smell good / bread and butter / a bowl of olives / Beijing roast duck / at a restaurant
en.cau: Mmm! It smells good! / I ate bread with butter for breakfast. / Did you eat olives? – No, I didn't. I don't like olives. / [Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn] We ate Beijing roast duck at a restaurant. / The roast duck smelled delicious. / We chatted with the waiter.
en.truyen: At the Restaurant — Last Saturday, Xiaomei's family went to a Chinese restaurant. They ate Beijing roast duck. 'It smells delicious!' said Xiaomei. Her brother ate some bread with butter and a bowl of olives. 'Did you eat the lamb?' asked the waiter. 'No, we didn't,' said Dad. 'But the duck was excellent!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "at the restaurant English dialogue for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 羊肉 yángròu | Ôn: 躺 tǎng, 聊天儿 liáotiānr, 听说 tīngshuō, 长城 Chángchéng, 服务员 fúwùyuán, 菜 cài, 面包 miànbāo
zh.cum: 北京烤鸭 Běijīng kǎoyā / 吃羊肉 chī yángròu / 去饭馆 qù fànguǎn / 点菜 diǎn cài
zh.cau: 上个星期六，我们吃了北京烤鸭。(Shàng gè xīngqīliù, wǒmen chī le Běijīng kǎoyā.) / 你吃羊肉了吗？——没吃。(Nǐ chī yángròu le ma? —— Méi chī.) / [Ngữ pháp: 没 + động từ] 我没吃羊肉，我吃了烤鸭。(Wǒ méi chī yángròu, wǒ chī le kǎoyā.) / 我听说北京烤鸭非常好吃。(Wǒ tīngshuō Běijīng kǎoyā fēicháng hǎochī.) / 服务员，我们要一只烤鸭。(Fúwùyuán, wǒmen yào yī zhī kǎoyā.)
zh.truyen: 在饭馆 — 上个星期六，Xiaomei一家去饭馆吃饭。服务员问：“你们吃什么？”爸爸说：“我听说这里的北京烤鸭非常好吃。”他们吃了烤鸭，没吃羊肉。哥哥还吃了面包。Xiaomei说：“烤鸭好吃极了！”(Shàng gè xīngqīliù, Xiaomei yī jiā qù fànguǎn chī fàn. Fúwùyuán wèn: “Nǐmen chī shénme?” Bàba shuō: “Wǒ tīngshuō zhèli de Běijīng kǎoyā fēicháng hǎochī.” Tāmen chī le kǎoyā, méi chī yángròu. Gēge hái chī le miànbāo. Xiaomei shuō: “Kǎoyā hǎochī jí le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "北京烤鸭 儿童 中文"

en.flash: salt, pepper, sugar, taste, smell, butter, olives | Ôn: salty, sweet, sour, spicy, bitter, soup, bread, cheese, waiter
en.slide: 1) Phân loại vị (kéo thả, 6 thẻ): sugar → sweet / salt → salty / lemon → sour / pepper → spicy / chocolate → sweet / olives → salty. 2) Đóng vai ở nhà hàng (theo nhóm 3): What would you like? – I'd like roast duck, please. / Did you eat the olives? – No, I didn't. / It smells delicious! / The soup was too salty. 3) Nghe – chọn đúng / sai (4 câu): Dad tasted the soup. / The soup was sweet. / Xiaomei ate lamb. / The duck smelled delicious.
en.truyen: The Salty Soup and the Delicious Duck — On Friday, Dad prepared tomato soup, but it was too salty. Leo tasted it and said, 'Too much salt!' They added water and a little pepper, and it tasted better. On Saturday, Leo went to a restaurant with Xiaomei's family. They ate Beijing roast duck. It smelled delicious! Xiaomei's brother ate bread with butter and some olives. 'Did you put sugar on the duck?' asked Leo. 'No!' laughed the waiter.
en.baihat: What Did You Eat? (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb), lời 2 — Taste the soup, it's too salty, / too salty, too salty. / Taste the soup, it's too salty, / no more salt, please! // Mmm, it smells so delicious, / delicious, delicious. / Mmm, it smells so delicious, / roast duck, yum!

zh.flash: 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 羊肉 yángròu | Ôn: 咸 xián, 甜 tián, 辣 là, 酸 suān, 苦 kǔ, 汤 tāng, 服务员 fúwùyuán, 面包 miànbāo
zh.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh nói vị (6 câu): 糖很甜。/ 汤太咸了。/ 这个菜很辣。/ 这个水果很酸。/ 药很苦。/ 西红柿汤很好吃。 2) Đóng vai nhà hàng (nhóm 3): 服务员：你们吃什么？——我们要一只烤鸭。/ 你吃羊肉了吗？——没吃。/ 你尝一尝！——好吃极了！ 3) Sắp xếp từ thành câu (3 câu): 汤 / 太 / 咸 / 了 → 汤太咸了。/ 我 / 没 / 放 / 糖 → 我没放糖。/ 我们 / 吃了 / 北京烤鸭 → 我们吃了北京烤鸭。 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, từng em, câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 你最喜欢吃什么水果？为什么？(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan chī shénme shuǐguǒ? Wèishénme?) – Đoạn mẫu: 我最喜欢吃葡萄，因为葡萄很甜。我也喜欢西红柿。我每天都吃水果。/ 你吃过北京烤鸭吗？(Nǐ chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā ma?) – Đoạn mẫu: 吃过。我和外公外婆在饭馆吃的。烤鸭好吃极了！
zh.truyen: 太咸的汤和好吃的烤鸭 — 星期五，爸爸做了西红柿汤，可是汤太咸了。Leo尝了尝，说：“太咸了！”他们加了水，放了一点儿糖，汤就好吃了。星期六，Leo和Xiaomei一家去饭馆。他们吃了北京烤鸭，没吃羊肉。Leo问：“烤鸭里有糖吗？”服务员笑了：“没有！你尝一尝！”Leo说：“好吃极了！”(Xīngqīwǔ, bàba zuò le xīhóngshì tāng, kěshì tāng tài xián le. Leo cháng le cháng, shuō: “Tài xián le!” Tāmen jiā le shuǐ, fàng le yīdiǎnr táng, tāng jiù hǎochī le. Xīngqīliù, Leo hé Xiaomei yī jiā qù fànguǎn. Tāmen chī le Běijīng kǎoyā, méi chī yángròu. Leo wèn: “Kǎoyā li yǒu táng ma?” Fúwùyuán xiào le: “Méiyǒu! Nǐ cháng yi cháng!” Leo shuō: “Hǎochī jí le!”)
zh.baihat: 好吃歌 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat), lời 2 — 尝一尝汤，汤太咸了，放一点儿糖再尝一尝，真好吃好吃！(Cháng yi cháng tāng, tāng tài xián le, fàng yīdiǎnr táng zài cháng yi cháng, zhēn hǎochī hǎochī!) // 去饭馆呀，吃北京烤鸭，没吃羊肉吃了西红柿，真好吃好吃！(Qù fànguǎn ya, chī Běijīng kǎoyā, méi chī yángròu chī le xīhóngshì, zhēn hǎochī hǎochī!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 49. Unit 11 · Food – Ăn uống (3): Làm bánh, ôn cả unit

web.label: Ngày 97. Unit 11 · Làm bánh với bà

en.tu: Mới: flour, mix | Ôn: design, invent, guess, prepare, butter, sugar, strawberry, honey
en.cum: mix flour and sugar / make a cake / a strawberry cake / mix it with a spoon / a big bowl
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn] We mixed flour, sugar and butter. / Bông mixed it with a spoon. / Then we put strawberries and honey on the cake. / Did you make the cake? – Yes, I did! / The cake was delicious.
en.truyen: Bông's Strawberry Cake — On Sunday, Bông and her grandma made a cake. First, they mixed flour, sugar and butter in a big bowl. Bông mixed it with a spoon. Then Grandma cooked it. After that, Bông put strawberries and honey on the cake. 'Mmm, it smells delicious!' said Grandpa. 'Guess who made it?' said Bông.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "easy strawberry cake for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 梨 lí, 桃 táo | Ôn: 葡萄 pútao, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 苹果 píngguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo, 西瓜 xīguā, 水果 shuǐguǒ, 打扰 dǎrǎo
zh.cum: 一个梨 yī gè lí / 两个桃 liǎng gè táo / 买水果 mǎi shuǐguǒ / 很甜 hěn tián / 水果蛋糕 shuǐguǒ dàngāo
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 了] Bông买了两个桃和一个梨。(Bông mǎi le liǎng gè táo hé yī gè lí.) / 你吃梨了吗？——吃了。(Nǐ chī lí le ma? —— Chī le.) / [Ngữ pháp: 没 + động từ] 我没吃桃，我吃了葡萄。(Wǒ méi chī táo, wǒ chī le pútao.) / 桃很甜，梨也很甜。(Táo hěn tián, lí yě hěn tián.)
zh.truyen: Bông的水果蛋糕 — 星期天，Bông和奶奶去超市，买了两个桃、一个梨和一些葡萄。回家以后，她们做了一个蛋糕。Bông在蛋糕上放了很多水果。爷爷尝了尝，说：“桃很甜，梨也很甜，好吃极了！”(Xīngqītiān, Bông hé nǎinai qù chāoshì, mǎi le liǎng gè táo, yī gè lí hé yīxiē pútao. Huí jiā yǐhòu, tāmen zuò le yī gè dàngāo. Bông zài dàngāo shang fàng le hěn duō shuǐguǒ. Yéye cháng le cháng, shuō: “Táo hěn tián, lí yě hěn tián, hǎochī jí le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "水果儿歌 桃 梨"

web.label: Ngày 98. Unit 11 · Ôn không tranh cả unit

en.tu: Ôn: delicious, noodle, snack, cereal, spoon, honey, yoghurt, strawberry, salt, pepper, sugar, taste, smell, butter, olives, flour, mix
en.cum: eat noodles with chopsticks / yoghurt with honey / too much salt / taste the soup / mix flour and sugar
en.cau: What did you eat last night? – I ate pizza. / Did you eat rice yesterday? – Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. / I ate noodles with chopsticks. / The dumplings were delicious. / The soup was too salty.
en.truyen: Anna's Food Week — On Monday, Anna ate noodles with chopsticks. On Tuesday, she had yoghurt with honey. On Wednesday, the soup was too salty, so she didn't eat it. On Thursday, she mixed flour and sugar and made a cake. On Friday, she ate dumplings with her family. 'The dumplings were delicious!' she said.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "past simple food song for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 披萨 pīsà, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào, 勺子 sháozi, 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao, 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 羊肉 yángròu, 梨 lí, 桃 táo
zh.cum: 吃了披萨 chī le pīsà / 用勺子 yòng sháozi / 尝一尝 cháng yi cháng / 太咸了 tài xián le / 北京烤鸭 Běijīng kǎoyā
zh.cau: 你昨天晚上吃了什么？(Nǐ zuótiān wǎnshang chī le shénme?) / 我吃了披萨。(Wǒ chī le pīsà.) / 你昨天吃米饭了吗？——吃了。/ 没吃。(Nǐ zuótiān chī mǐfàn le ma? —— Chī le. / Méi chī.) / 我用筷子吃了面条。(Wǒ yòng kuàizi chī le miàntiáo.) / 饺子很好吃。(Jiǎozi hěn hǎochī.) / 汤太咸了。(Tāng tài xián le.)
zh.truyen: Anna的一个星期 — 星期一，Anna用筷子吃了面条。星期二，她吃了冰激凌和葡萄。星期三，汤太咸了，她没喝。星期四，她吃了一个三明治，喝了饮料。星期五，她和家人一起吃了饺子。她说：“饺子很好吃！”(Xīngqīyī, Anna yòng kuàizi chī le miàntiáo. Xīngqī'èr, tā chī le bīngjīlíng hé pútao. Xīngqīsān, tāng tài xián le, tā méi hē. Xīngqīsì, tā chī le yī gè sānmíngzhì, hē le yǐnliào. Xīngqīwǔ, tā hé jiārén yīqǐ chī le jiǎozi. Tā shuō: “Jiǎozi hěn hǎochī!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "了 没 中文语法 儿童"

en.flash: flour, mix | Ôn: delicious, noodle, snack, cereal, spoon, honey, yoghurt, strawberry, salt, pepper, sugar, taste, smell, butter, olives
en.slide: 1) Sắp xếp các bước làm bánh (kéo thả, 5 bước): First, we mixed flour and sugar. / Then we added butter. / We mixed it with a spoon. / Grandma cooked it. / Last, we put strawberries on the cake. 2) Thẻ phản xạ không tranh: cô đọc định nghĩa, con nói từ (5 câu): It's white and salty. (salt) / Bees make it. (honey) / You eat soup with it. (spoon) / It's red and sweet. (strawberry) / You use it to make bread. (flour) 3) Hỏi – đáp vòng tròn: What did you eat yesterday? – I ate… / Did you…? – Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
en.truyen: Bông's Strawberry Cake (kể đầy đủ) — On Sunday, Bông wanted to make a cake for Grandpa. She and Grandma mixed flour, sugar and butter in a big bowl. Bông mixed it with a spoon. 'Can I taste it?' she asked. 'Not yet!' laughed Grandma. Then Grandma cooked it. After that, Bông put strawberries and honey on the cake. Grandpa tasted it. 'It was delicious! Did you make it?' 'Yes, I did!' said Bông.
en.baihat: What Did You Eat? (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb), lời 3 — Mix the flour and the sugar, / the sugar, the sugar. / Mix the flour and the sugar, / mix it with a spoon! // Put strawberries on the cake, / on the cake, on the cake. / Put strawberries on the cake, / taste it, yum, yum, yum!

zh.flash: 梨 lí, 桃 táo | Ôn: 披萨 pīsà, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào, 勺子 sháozi, 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao, 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 羊肉 yángròu
zh.slide: 1) Thẻ phản xạ không tranh: cô đọc từ, con giơ thẻ chữ Hán (8 từ): 梨 / 桃 / 葡萄 / 西红柿 / 糖 / 勺子 / 烤鸭 / 羊肉. 2) Trò 'Đi chợ': mỗi con nói nối tiếp một câu có 了: 我买了一个梨。——我买了一个梨和两个桃。——我买了一个梨、两个桃和一些葡萄。 3) Chuyển ngữ nhanh Anh ↔ Trung (3 câu): What did you eat last night? ↔ 你昨天晚上吃了什么？/ Did you eat rice yesterday? – No, I didn't. ↔ 你昨天吃米饭了吗？——没吃。/ The soup was too salty. ↔ 汤太咸了。
zh.truyen: Bông的水果蛋糕 (kể đầy đủ) — 星期天，Bông想给爷爷做一个蛋糕。她和奶奶去超市买了两个桃、一个梨和一些葡萄，还买了糖。回家以后，她们做了蛋糕。Bông在蛋糕上放了很多水果。她问：“奶奶，我可以尝一尝吗？”奶奶说：“等一等！”晚上，爷爷尝了蛋糕，说：“桃很甜，梨也很甜，你做的蛋糕好吃极了！”(Xīngqītiān, Bông xiǎng gěi yéye zuò yī gè dàngāo. Tā hé nǎinai qù chāoshì mǎi le liǎng gè táo, yī gè lí hé yīxiē pútao, hái mǎi le táng. Huí jiā yǐhòu, tāmen zuò le dàngāo. Bông zài dàngāo shang fàng le hěn duō shuǐguǒ. Tā wèn: “Nǎinai, wǒ kěyǐ cháng yi cháng ma?” Nǎinai shuō: “Děng yi děng!” Wǎnshang, yéye cháng le dàngāo, shuō: “Táo hěn tián, lí yě hěn tián, nǐ zuò de dàngāo hǎochī jí le!”)
zh.baihat: 好吃歌 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat), lời 3 — 去超市呀，买了水果，两个桃一个梨和葡萄，真好吃好吃！(Qù chāoshì ya, mǎi le shuǐguǒ, liǎng gè táo yī gè lí hé pútao, zhēn hǎochī hǎochī!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 50. Unit 11 · Food – Ăn uống (4): Truyện, Phiên dịch nhí, kiểm tra unit · Luyện Flyers Nói phần 4, YCT口试（中级）第二部分

web.label: Ngày 99. Unit 11 · Truyện và chuyển ngữ: Dã ngoại ở bờ biển

en.tu: Ôn: delicious, snack, spoon, yoghurt, strawberry, salt, taste, smell, mix | Ôn truyện: camp, coast, ocean, sunshine, desert
en.cum: go camping on the coast / a picnic in the sunshine / a delicious snack / mix a fruit salad / near the ocean
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn] Last summer, we went camping on the coast. / We ate sandwiches in the sunshine. / Did you eat fish? – Yes, I did. It was delicious. / Anna mixed strawberries and yoghurt with a spoon. / The sea water tasted salty.
en.truyen: A Picnic on the Coast — Last summer, Leo's family went camping on the coast. In the morning, there was lots of sunshine. They had a picnic near the ocean. Leo ate a sandwich and Anna mixed strawberries and yoghurt with a spoon. Leo tasted the sea water. 'It's so salty!' he said. In the evening, they cooked fish. It smelled delicious. 'This is better than the desert!' laughed Dad.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "picnic food vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào, 勺子 sháozi, 尝 cháng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 桃 táo, 梨 lí | Ôn truyện: 海岸 hǎi'àn, 海洋 hǎiyáng, 阳光 yángguāng, 温度 wēndù, 空气 kōngqì, 沙漠 shāmò
zh.cum: 在海边 zài hǎibiān / 阳光很好 yángguāng hěn hǎo / 吃三明治 chī sānmíngzhì / 喝饮料 hē yǐnliào / 空气很新鲜 kōngqì hěn xīnxiān
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 了] 去年夏天，我们去了海边。(Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒmen qù le hǎibiān.) / 我们在阳光下吃了三明治。(Wǒmen zài yángguāng xià chī le sānmíngzhì.) / 你吃鱼了吗？——吃了，很好吃。(Nǐ chī yú le ma? —— Chī le, hěn hǎochī.) / 海水很咸。(Hǎishuǐ hěn xián.) / [Ngữ pháp: 没] 我们没去沙漠。(Wǒmen méi qù shāmò.)
zh.truyen: 海边野餐 — 去年夏天，Leo一家去了海边。早上，阳光很好，温度也不高，空气很新鲜。他们在海边吃了三明治、桃和梨，喝了饮料。Leo尝了尝海水，说：“海水太咸了！”晚上，他们吃了鱼。爸爸说：“这里比沙漠好多了！”(Qùnián xiàtiān, Leo yī jiā qù le hǎibiān. Zǎoshang, yángguāng hěn hǎo, wēndù yě bù gāo, kōngqì hěn xīnxiān. Tāmen zài hǎibiān chī le sānmíngzhì, táo hé lí, hē le yǐnliào. Leo cháng le cháng hǎishuǐ, shuō: “Hǎishuǐ tài xián le!” Wǎnshang, tāmen chī le yú. Bàba shuō: “Zhèli bǐ shāmò hǎo duō le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "海边野餐 儿童动画"

web.label: Ngày 100. Unit 11 · Phiên dịch nhí và ôn cả tuần

en.tu: Ôn: delicious, noodle, snack, cereal, spoon, honey, yoghurt, strawberry, salt, pepper, sugar, taste, smell, butter, olives, flour, mix
en.cum: eat noodles with chopsticks / Beijing roast duck / taste the soup / too salty / mix flour and sugar
en.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Trung, nói lại bằng tiếng Anh): What did you eat last night? / I ate pizza. / Did you eat rice yesterday? – Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. / I ate noodles with chopsticks. / The dumplings were delicious. / The soup was too salty.
en.truyen: Little Interpreter at the Restaurant — Xiaomei's grandpa visits Hanoi. They go to a restaurant. The waiter only speaks English. Grandpa says in Chinese, 'I didn't eat lunch. I'd like noodles.' Xiaomei tells the waiter, 'He didn't eat lunch. He'd like some noodles, please.' Later, the waiter asks, 'Was it delicious?' Xiaomei tells Grandpa in Chinese. Grandpa smiles: 'Yes! But the soup was a bit salty.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "food quiz for kids past simple"

zh.tu: Ôn: 披萨 pīsà, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào, 勺子 sháozi, 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao, 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 羊肉 yángròu, 梨 lí, 桃 táo
zh.cum: 吃了午饭 chī le wǔfàn / 没吃午饭 méi chī wǔfàn / 要一碗面条 yào yī wǎn miàntiáo / 汤有一点儿咸 tāng yǒu yīdiǎnr xián
zh.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Anh, nói lại bằng tiếng Trung): 你昨天晚上吃了什么？(Nǐ zuótiān wǎnshang chī le shénme?) / 我吃了披萨。(Wǒ chī le pīsà.) / 你昨天吃米饭了吗？——吃了。/ 没吃。(Nǐ zuótiān chī mǐfàn le ma? —— Chī le. / Méi chī.) / 我用筷子吃了面条。(Wǒ yòng kuàizi chī le miàntiáo.) / 饺子很好吃。(Jiǎozi hěn hǎochī.) / 汤太咸了。(Tāng tài xián le.)
zh.truyen: 饭馆里的小翻译 — Xiaomei的爷爷来河内了。他们去饭馆吃饭。服务员只会说英语。爷爷说：“我没吃午饭，我要一碗面条。”Xiaomei用英语告诉服务员。吃完以后，服务员问：“好吃吗？”Xiaomei用中文问爷爷。爷爷笑了：“面条很好吃！可是汤有一点儿咸。”(Xiaomei de yéye lái Hénèi le. Tāmen qù fànguǎn chī fàn. Fúwùyuán zhǐ huì shuō Yīngyǔ. Yéye shuō: “Wǒ méi chī wǔfàn, wǒ yào yī wǎn miàntiáo.” Xiaomei yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu fúwùyuán. Chī wán yǐhòu, fúwùyuán wèn: “Hǎochī ma?” Xiaomei yòng Zhōngwén wèn yéye. Yéye xiào le: “Miàntiáo hěn hǎochī! Kěshì tāng yǒu yīdiǎnr xián.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "中国美食 儿童 中文"

en.flash: Ôn cả unit: delicious, noodle, snack, cereal, spoon, honey, yoghurt, strawberry, salt, pepper, sugar, taste, smell, butter, olives, flour, mix + ôn truyện: camp, coast, ocean, sunshine
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nghe (5 câu, chọn tranh A/B/C): Leo ate noodles last night. / Anna had yoghurt with honey. / The soup was too salty. / They ate roast duck at a restaurant. / Bông mixed flour and sugar. 2) Hoàn thành câu với did / didn't / ate / was (5 câu): What ___ you eat last night? (did) / I ___ pizza. (ate) / Did you eat rice? – No, I ___. (didn't) / The soup ___ too salty. (was) / ___ you make the cake? – Yes, I did. (Did) 3) Dự án nhóm 'Our Picnic Menu': vẽ thực đơn và nói 3 câu: Last weekend, we ate… It was delicious. 4) Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu, từng em với cô, 4 câu): What did you eat yesterday? – I ate … / What's your favourite food? Why? – My favourite food is … because it's delicious. / Can you cook? What can you make? – I can make … / Do you use a spoon or chopsticks for noodles? – I use …
en.truyen: A Picnic on the Coast (kể đầy đủ) — Last summer, Leo's family went camping on the coast. There was lots of sunshine. They had a picnic near the ocean: sandwiches, strawberries with yoghurt, and some olives. Anna mixed the fruit with a spoon. Leo tasted the sea water. 'Too salty!' In the evening, Dad cooked fish with salt and pepper. It smelled delicious. 'Did you like the trip?' asked Mum. 'Yes, I did! The food was excellent!' said Leo.
en.baihat: What Did You Eat? (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb), cả bài — What did you eat last night… I ate noodles, yum! / Did you eat a snack today… Yes, I did, yum! / Taste the soup, it's too salty… no more salt, please! / Mix the flour and the sugar… mix it with a spoon!

zh.flash: Ôn cả unit: 披萨 pīsà, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 饮料 yǐnliào, 勺子 sháozi, 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao, 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 西红柿 xīhóngshì, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 羊肉 yángròu, 梨 lí, 桃 táo + ôn truyện: 海岸 hǎi'àn, 阳光 yángguāng, 空气 kōngqì
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra đọc chữ Hán (8 câu, chọn chữ điền chỗ trống): 我昨天吃___披萨。(了) / 我___吃羊肉。(没) / 我用___吃冰激凌。(勺子) / 你___一___这个汤。(尝 / 尝) / 汤太___了。(咸) / 我们吃了北京___。(烤鸭) / 桃很___。(甜) / 你喝了什么___？(饮料) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: đóng vai khách và người phiên dịch ở nhà hàng (4 câu mẫu). 3) Nói về thực đơn 'Our Picnic Menu': 上个周末，我们吃了……，喝了……，没吃…… 4) YCT口试（中级）第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu, 2 tranh, từng em nói một đoạn 4–5 câu): Tranh 1 – đi chơi bờ biển: 星期六，Anna一家去海边玩。他们带了葡萄、桃和饮料。Anna一边吃冰激凌，一边看大海。/ Tranh 2 – làm bánh với bà: 外婆在做蛋糕。Bông帮外婆放糖。外婆说：“你尝一尝！”Bông说：“好吃极了！”
zh.truyen: 海边野餐 (kể đầy đủ) — 去年夏天，Leo一家去海边露营。阳光很好，空气很新鲜。他们在海边吃了三明治、桃、梨和葡萄，喝了饮料。Anna用勺子吃了冰激凌。Leo尝了尝海水：“太咸了！”晚上，爸爸做了西红柿汤，还做了烤羊肉。妈妈问：“你们吃饱了吗？”Leo说：“吃饱了！今天的饭好吃极了！”(Qùnián xiàtiān, Leo yī jiā qù hǎibiān lùyíng. Yángguāng hěn hǎo, kōngqì hěn xīnxiān. Tāmen zài hǎibiān chī le sānmíngzhì, táo, lí hé pútao, hē le yǐnliào. Anna yòng sháozi chī le bīngjīlíng. Leo cháng le cháng hǎishuǐ: “Tài xián le!” Wǎnshang, bàba zuò le xīhóngshì tāng, hái zuò le kǎo yángròu. Māma wèn: “Nǐmen chī bǎo le ma?” Leo shuō: “Chī bǎo le! Jīntiān de fàn hǎochī jí le!”)
zh.baihat: 好吃歌 (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat), cả bài 3 lời — 昨天吃什么？我吃了面条…… / 尝一尝汤，汤太咸了…… / 去超市呀，买了水果……(Zuótiān chī shénme?… / Cháng yi cháng tāng… / Qù chāoshì ya…)

blocks.title: Unit 12 · Holiday activities · 假期活动

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 51. Unit 12 · Holiday activities – Hoạt động kỳ nghỉ (1): Dã ngoại, tham quan đảo

web.label: Ngày 101. Unit 12 · Rủ bạn đi dã ngoại

en.tu: Mới: bake | Ôn: astronaut, space, rocket, planet, beach, cake, kite, holiday
en.cum: Mới: have a picnic / bake a cake / go to the beach / fly a kite
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: Let's + động từ] Let's go to the beach. / [Ngữ pháp: How about + V-ing?] How about having a picnic? / How about baking a cake? / Let's fly a kite on the beach. / Good idea! Let's go together.
en.truyen: A Holiday Plan — It's the summer holiday. Leo calls Anna. 'Let's go to the beach!' he says. 'How about having a picnic on the beach?' says Anna. 'Good idea! How about baking a cake for the picnic?' says Leo. On Saturday, they bake a strawberry cake together. Then they fly a kite on the beach and eat the cake. 'This is the best holiday!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Let's and How about suggestions for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo | Ôn: 办法 bànfǎ, 等 děng, 将来 jiānglái, 海滩 hǎitān, 蛋糕 dàngāo, 放假 fàngjià, 寒假 hánjià
zh.cum: 去野餐 qù yěcān / 烤蛋糕 kǎo dàngāo / 去海滩 qù hǎitān / 放风筝 fàng fēngzheng
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 吧 – rủ rê, đề nghị] 我们去海滩吧。(Wǒmen qù hǎitān ba.) / [Ngữ pháp: ……，怎么样？] 我们去野餐，怎么样？(Wǒmen qù yěcān, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们烤蛋糕，怎么样？(Wǒmen kǎo dàngāo, zěnmeyàng?) / 好啊！我们一起去吧。(Hǎo a! Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba.) / 放假了，我们去放风筝吧！(Fàngjià le, wǒmen qù fàng fēngzheng ba!)
zh.truyen: 放假的计划 — 放假了，Leo给Anna打电话：“我们去海滩吧！”Anna说：“我们去海滩野餐，怎么样？”Leo说：“好办法！我们再烤一个蛋糕吧！”星期六，他们一起烤了一个蛋糕，然后去海滩野餐，还放了风筝。Anna说：“这个假期太好玩儿了！”(Fàngjià le, Leo gěi Anna dǎ diànhuà: “Wǒmen qù hǎitān ba!” Anna shuō: “Wǒmen qù hǎitān yěcān, zěnmeyàng?” Leo shuō: “Hǎo bànfǎ! Wǒmen zài kǎo yī gè dàngāo ba!” Xīngqīliù, tāmen yīqǐ kǎo le yī gè dàngāo, ránhòu qù hǎitān yěcān, hái fàng le fēngzheng. Anna shuō: “Zhè gè jiàqī tài hǎowánr le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "去野餐 儿童中文 动画"

web.label: Ngày 102. Unit 12 · Tham quan trên đảo

en.tu: Mới: sightseeing | Ôn: Earth, land, instead, by yourself, if you want, island, boat, camera
en.cum: Mới: go sightseeing / on the island / take a boat / take photos
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: Let's + động từ] Let's go sightseeing on the island. / Let's take a boat to the island. / [Ngữ pháp: How about + V-ing?] How about taking photos with your camera? / We can go by boat if you want. / Let's go together instead of going by yourself.
en.truyen: Sightseeing on the Island — Xiaomei's family is on holiday by the sea. 'Let's go sightseeing on the island!' says Dad. They take a boat to the island. Xiaomei takes photos with her camera. 'How about walking up the hill?' says Mum. From the top, they can see the sea and many boats. 'The island is beautiful!' says Xiaomei.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "island holiday for kids vocabulary"

zh.tu: Mới: 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo | Ôn: 旅游 lǚyóu, 关于 guānyú, 其他 qítā, 行 xíng, 坐船 zuò chuán, 照相 zhàoxiàng, 大海 dàhǎi
zh.cum: 去岛上观光 qù dǎo shang guānguāng / 坐船去 zuò chuán qù / 照相 zhàoxiàng / 一个小岛 yī gè xiǎo dǎo
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 吧] 我们去岛上观光吧。(Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba.) / 我们坐船去岛上，怎么样？(Wǒmen zuò chuán qù dǎo shang, zěnmeyàng?) / 行！我们一起去吧。(Xíng! Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba.) / 在岛上，我们可以照相。(Zài dǎo shang, wǒmen kěyǐ zhàoxiàng.) / 这个岛很漂亮。(Zhè gè dǎo hěn piàoliang.)
zh.truyen: 去岛上观光 — 放假了，Xiaomei一家去海边旅游。爸爸说：“我们去岛上观光吧！”他们坐船去了一个小岛。Xiaomei照了很多相。妈妈说：“我们去山上看看，怎么样？”在山上，他们看到了大海和很多船。Xiaomei说：“这个岛真漂亮！”(Fàngjià le, Xiaomei yī jiā qù hǎibiān lǚyóu. Bàba shuō: “Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba!” Tāmen zuò chuán qù le yī gè xiǎo dǎo. Xiaomei zhào le hěn duō xiàng. Māma shuō: “Wǒmen qù shān shang kànkan, zěnmeyàng?” Zài shān shang, tāmen kàndào le dàhǎi hé hěn duō chuán. Xiaomei shuō: “Zhè gè dǎo zhēn piàoliang!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "海岛旅游 儿童 中文"

en.flash: bake, sightseeing, have a picnic, bake a cake, go to the beach, go sightseeing, on the island | Ôn: kite, camera, boat, holiday, beach
en.slide: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn cụm (6 câu): have a picnic / bake a cake / go to the beach / fly a kite / go sightseeing / take photos. 2) Trò 'Lời mời': bốc thẻ tranh, nói lời đề nghị, bạn đáp (4 lượt): Let's go to the beach! – Good idea! / How about baking a cake? – OK, let's do it! / How about going sightseeing? – Sorry, I can't. 3) Chọn Let's hay How about (4 câu): ___ go to the beach. (Let's) / ___ having a picnic? (How about) / ___ baking a cake? (How about) / ___ go together. (Let's)
en.truyen: The Best Holiday Plan — It's the first day of the summer holiday. Leo, Anna and Xiaomei meet in the park. 'Let's go to the beach!' says Leo. 'How about having a picnic there?' says Anna. 'And how about baking a cake for it?' says Xiaomei. On Saturday, they bake a cake and go to the beach. On Sunday, they take a boat and go sightseeing on an island. 'Let's do this every holiday!' they say.
en.baihat: Let's Go! (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — Let's go to the beach and have a picnic, / have a picnic, have a picnic. / Let's go to the beach and have a picnic, / all summer long! // How about baking a cake today, / a cake today, a cake today? / How about baking a cake today? / Yes, let's go!

zh.flash: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo | Ôn: 海滩 hǎitān, 蛋糕 dàngāo, 放假 fàngjià, 旅游 lǚyóu, 照相 zhàoxiàng, 坐船 zuò chuán
zh.slide: 1) Nghe cô đọc, chọn tranh (6 câu): 去野餐 / 烤蛋糕 / 去海滩 / 去岛上观光 / 坐船 / 照相. 2) Đề nghị và đáp lại theo cặp (4 lượt): 我们去海滩吧！——好啊！/ 我们去野餐，怎么样？——行！/ 我们烤蛋糕，怎么样？——好吧。/ 我们去岛上观光吧！——太好了！ 3) Thêm 吧 hoặc 怎么样 vào câu (4 câu): 我们一起去___。(吧) / 我们去野餐，___？(怎么样) / 我们坐船去岛上___。(吧) / 我们烤蛋糕，___？(怎么样)
zh.truyen: 最好的假期计划 — 放假的第一天，Leo、Anna和Xiaomei在公园见面。Leo说：“我们去海滩吧！”Anna说：“我们去海滩野餐，怎么样？”Xiaomei说：“我们再烤一个蛋糕吧！”星期六，他们烤了蛋糕，去海滩野餐了。星期天，他们坐船去岛上观光，照了很多相。大家说：“每个假期我们都一起玩儿吧！”(Fàngjià de dì yī tiān, Leo, Anna hé Xiaomei zài gōngyuán jiànmiàn. Leo shuō: “Wǒmen qù hǎitān ba!” Anna shuō: “Wǒmen qù hǎitān yěcān, zěnmeyàng?” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒmen zài kǎo yī gè dàngāo ba!” Xīngqīliù, tāmen kǎo le dàngāo, qù hǎitān yěcān le. Xīngqītiān, tāmen zuò chuán qù dǎo shang guānguāng, zhào le hěn duō xiàng. Dàjiā shuō: “Měi gè jiàqī wǒmen dōu yīqǐ wánr ba!”)
zh.baihat: 我们一起去 (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — 我们一起去野餐，去野餐，去野餐，我们一起去野餐，你呢？你呢？(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù yěcān, qù yěcān, qù yěcān, wǒmen yīqǐ qù yěcān, nǐ ne? Nǐ ne?) // 我们去岛上观光，去观光，去观光，我们去岛上观光，怎么样呀？(Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng, qù guānguāng, qù guānguāng, wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng, zěnmeyàng ya?)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 52. Unit 12 · Holiday activities – Hoạt động kỳ nghỉ (2): Cắm trại, khu nghỉ dưỡng

web.label: Ngày 103. Unit 12 · Đi cắm trại

en.tu: Ôn: delicious, snack, spoon, taste, smell, honey, camp, hill, river
en.cum: Mới: go camping / What about you? | sleep in a tent / cook dinner / near the river
en.cau: I want to go camping. What about you? / I want to go fishing. What about you? / [Ngữ pháp: Let's + động từ] Let's go camping near the river. / How about cooking dinner on the fire? / The snacks smell delicious!
en.truyen: Camping by the River — 'I want to go camping this weekend. What about you?' asks Nhan. 'Me too!' says Leo. They go camping with Nhan's uncle near the river. They cook dinner on a small fire. 'Mmm, it smells delicious!' says Leo. He tastes the soup with a spoon. At night, they look at the stars. 'Let's go camping again!' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "camping for kids vocabulary"

zh.tu: Mới: 露营 lùyíng | Ôn: 尝 cháng, 饮料 yǐnliào, 三明治 sānmíngzhì, 披萨 pīsà, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 河 hé, 星星 xīngxing
zh.cum: 去露营 qù lùyíng / 你呢？nǐ ne? / 在河边 zài hébiān / 看星星 kàn xīngxing / 尝一尝 cháng yi cháng
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 呢 – hỏi lại] 我想去露营，你呢？(Wǒ xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?) / 我也想去。(Wǒ yě xiǎng qù.) / [Ngữ pháp: 吧] 我们去河边露营吧。(Wǒmen qù hébiān lùyíng ba.) / 晚上我们一起看星星，怎么样？(Wǎnshang wǒmen yīqǐ kàn xīngxing, zěnmeyàng?) / 你尝一尝我做的汤。(Nǐ cháng yi cháng wǒ zuò de tāng.)
zh.truyen: 河边露营 — Nhan说：“这个周末我想去露营，你呢？”Leo说：“我也想去！”他们和叔叔去河边露营。晚上，叔叔做了汤，Leo尝了尝，说：“真好吃！”他们还喝了饮料，吃了三明治。晚上，他们一起看星星。Nhan说：“我们下次再来露营吧！”(Nhan shuō: “Zhè gè zhōumò wǒ xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ yě xiǎng qù!” Tāmen hé shūshu qù hébiān lùyíng. Wǎnshang, shūshu zuò le tāng, Leo cháng le cháng, shuō: “Zhēn hǎochī!” Tāmen hái hē le yǐnliào, chī le sānmíngzhì. Wǎnshang, tāmen yīqǐ kàn xīngxing. Nhan shuō: “Wǒmen xià cì zài lái lùyíng ba!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "露营 儿童 动画"

web.label: Ngày 104. Unit 12 · Khu nghỉ dưỡng

en.tu: Mới: resort | Ôn: butter, cereal, strawberry, yoghurt, swim, pool, hotel, sightseeing
en.cum: Mới: stay at a resort / swim in the pool | play badminton / ride a bike
en.cau: Let's stay at a resort near the beach. / How about swimming in the pool? / At the resort, we can play badminton. / I want to ride a bike. What about you? / The breakfast at the resort is delicious.
en.truyen: A Day at the Resort — Anna's family stays at a resort. In the morning, they eat cereal with yoghurt and strawberries. 'How about swimming in the pool?' says Anna. 'Good idea!' says Mum. In the afternoon, they play badminton and ride bikes. 'I want to go sightseeing tomorrow. What about you?' asks Dad. 'Let's go together!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "holiday resort activities for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 度假村 dùjiàcūn | Ôn: 冰激凌 bīngjīlíng, 葡萄 pútao, 桃 táo, 梨 lí, 游泳 yóuyǒng, 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú, 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē
zh.cum: 住在度假村 zhù zài dùjiàcūn / 去游泳 qù yóuyǒng / 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú / 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 吧] 我们住在海边的度假村吧。(Wǒmen zhù zài hǎibiān de dùjiàcūn ba.) / 我们去游泳，怎么样？(Wǒmen qù yóuyǒng, zěnmeyàng?) / 在度假村，我们可以打羽毛球。(Zài dùjiàcūn, wǒmen kěyǐ dǎ yǔmáoqiú.) / [Ngữ pháp: 呢] 我想骑自行车，你呢？(Wǒ xiǎng qí zìxíngchē, nǐ ne?)
zh.truyen: 在度假村的一天 — Anna一家住在海边的度假村。早上，他们吃了桃、梨和葡萄。Anna说：“我们去游泳，怎么样？”妈妈说：“好啊！”下午，他们打羽毛球，骑自行车。爸爸说：“明天我想去观光，你们呢？”Anna说：“我们一起去吧！”(Anna yī jiā zhù zài hǎibiān de dùjiàcūn. Zǎoshang, tāmen chī le táo, lí hé pútao. Anna shuō: “Wǒmen qù yóuyǒng, zěnmeyàng?” Māma shuō: “Hǎo a!” Xiàwǔ, tāmen dǎ yǔmáoqiú, qí zìxíngchē. Bàba shuō: “Míngtiān wǒ xiǎng qù guānguāng, nǐmen ne?” Anna shuō: “Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "度假村 儿童 中文 假期"

en.flash: resort, go camping, What about you?, stay at a resort, swim in the pool | Ôn: bake, sightseeing, have a picnic, camp, badminton, ride a bike
en.slide: 1) Khảo sát lớp (mỗi con hỏi 4 bạn, tích bảng): I want to go camping. What about you? – I want to go to a resort. / I want to go sightseeing. 2) Nối hoạt động với nơi chốn (5 cặp): go camping → near the river / swim in the pool → at the resort / have a picnic → on the beach / go sightseeing → on the island / bake a cake → at home 3) Nghe hội thoại, điền từ (4 chỗ trống): How about ___ in the pool? (swimming) / Let's stay at a ___. (resort) / I want to go ___. What about you? (camping) / Let's go ___. (together)
en.truyen: Camping or Resort? — Nhan and Anna are talking about the holiday. 'I want to go camping near the river. What about you?' asks Nhan. 'I want to stay at a resort and swim in the pool,' says Anna. 'How about doing both?' says Nhan's uncle. So on Saturday, they go camping and cook dinner on a fire. On Sunday, they go to a resort, swim and play badminton. 'Let's go together again next holiday!' says Anna.
en.baihat: Let's Go! (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus), lời 2 — Let's go camping by the river, / by the river, by the river. / Let's go camping by the river. / What about you? // How about swimming at the resort, / at the resort, at the resort? / How about swimming at the resort? / Let's go together!

zh.flash: 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn | Ôn: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 游泳 yóuyǒng, 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú, 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē
zh.slide: 1) Khảo sát lớp bằng 呢 (mỗi con hỏi 4 bạn): 我想去露营，你呢？——我想去度假村。/ 我想去岛上观光。 2) Nối hoạt động với nơi chốn (5 cặp): 露营 → 河边 / 游泳 → 度假村 / 野餐 → 海滩 / 观光 → 岛上 / 烤蛋糕 → 家里 3) Đóng vai rủ bạn theo cặp: 我们去露营吧！——好啊！/ 我们去度假村游泳，怎么样？——行！/ 我想打羽毛球，你呢？——我也想。
zh.truyen: 露营还是度假村？— Nhan和Anna在聊天儿。Nhan说：“我想去河边露营，你呢？”Anna说：“我想住在度假村，去游泳。”叔叔说：“我们两个都去，怎么样？”星期六，他们去河边露营，晚上一起看星星。星期天，他们去度假村游泳、打羽毛球。Anna说：“下个假期我们再一起去吧！”(Nhan hé Anna zài liáotiānr. Nhan shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng qù hébiān lùyíng, nǐ ne?” Anna shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng zhù zài dùjiàcūn, qù yóuyǒng.” Shūshu shuō: “Wǒmen liǎng gè dōu qù, zěnmeyàng?” Xīngqīliù, tāmen qù hébiān lùyíng, wǎnshang yīqǐ kàn xīngxing. Xīngqītiān, tāmen qù dùjiàcūn yóuyǒng, dǎ yǔmáoqiú. Anna shuō: “Xià gè jiàqī wǒmen zài yīqǐ qù ba!”)
zh.baihat: 我们一起去 (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down), lời 2 — 我们一起去露营，去露营，去露营，我们一起去露营，好吧！好吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù lùyíng, qù lùyíng, qù lùyíng, wǒmen yīqǐ qù lùyíng, hǎo ba! Hǎo ba!) // 我们去度假村吧，去游泳，去游泳，我想游泳你呢？我也去！(Wǒmen qù dùjiàcūn ba, qù yóuyǒng, qù yóuyǒng, wǒ xiǎng yóuyǒng nǐ ne? Wǒ yě qù!)

en.tu: Ôn: bake, sightseeing, resort, camp, island, beach, picnic, together, timetable
en.cum: Mới: plan a trip / How about…? | on Monday / in the morning / in the afternoon
en.cau: Let's plan a trip together! / On Monday, let's go to the beach. / How about going sightseeing on Tuesday? / On Wednesday, let's bake a cake. / I want to stay at a resort. What about you?
en.truyen: Our Holiday Timetable — Leo and Xiaomei plan a trip for the holiday. 'On Monday, let's go to the beach,' says Leo. 'How about going sightseeing on the island on Tuesday?' says Xiaomei. 'OK! On Wednesday, let's go camping.' 'And on Thursday, how about baking a cake at home?' They write it all on a timetable. 'This is a great plan!' says Leo.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "plan a holiday kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 行程 xíngchéng | Ôn: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 决定 juédìng, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo
zh.cum: 我们的行程 wǒmen de xíngchéng / 做行程 zuò xíngchéng / 星期一 xīngqīyī / 上午 shàngwǔ / 下午 xiàwǔ
zh.cau: 我们一起做一个行程吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ zuò yī gè xíngchéng ba!) / 星期一，我们去海滩吧。(Xīngqīyī, wǒmen qù hǎitān ba.) / 星期二去岛上观光，怎么样？(Xīngqī'èr qù dǎo shang guānguāng, zěnmeyàng?) / 星期三我们去露营。你呢？(Xīngqīsān wǒmen qù lùyíng. Nǐ ne?) / 我们决定了，行程很好！(Wǒmen juédìng le, xíngchéng hěn hǎo!)
zh.truyen: 我们的假期行程 — Leo和Xiaomei一起做假期的行程。Leo说：“星期一，我们去海滩野餐吧。”Xiaomei说：“星期二我们去岛上观光，怎么样？”“好！星期三去露营。”“星期四我们在家烤蛋糕吧！”他们决定了，把行程写在时间表上。Leo说：“这个行程好极了！”(Leo hé Xiaomei yīqǐ zuò jiàqī de xíngchéng. Leo shuō: “Xīngqīyī, wǒmen qù hǎitān yěcān ba.” Xiaomei shuō: “Xīngqī'èr wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng, zěnmeyàng?” “Hǎo! Xīngqīsān qù lùyíng.” “Xīngqīsì wǒmen zài jiā kǎo dàngāo ba!” Tāmen juédìng le, bǎ xíngchéng xiě zài shíjiānbiǎo shang. Leo shuō: “Zhè gè xíngchéng hǎo jí le!”)

Then on Sunday, let's go sightseeing on the island.' 'I want to go camping, too. What about you?' 'Me too! Let's go together!'

zh.tu: Ôn: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 行程 xíngchéng, 吧 ba, 呢 ne, 怎么样 zěnmeyàng
zh.cum: 去野餐 qù yěcān / 烤蛋糕 kǎo dàngāo / 去岛上观光 qù dǎo shang guānguāng / 去露营 qù lùyíng / 住在度假村 zhù zài dùjiàcūn
zh.cau: 我们去海滩吧。(Wǒmen qù hǎitān ba.) / 我们去野餐，怎么样？(Wǒmen qù yěcān, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们烤蛋糕，怎么样？(Wǒmen kǎo dàngāo, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们一起去吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba.) / 我们去岛上观光吧。(Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba.) / 我想去露营，你呢？(Wǒ xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?)
zh.truyen: 假期的电话 — Anna给Nhan打电话：“星期六我们去海滩吧！”Nhan说：“好啊！我们在海滩野餐，怎么样？”“我们再烤一个蛋糕吧！”“行！星期天我们去岛上观光吧。”“我还想去露营，你呢？”“我也想去！我们一起去吧！”(Anna gěi Nhan dǎ diànhuà: “Xīngqīliù wǒmen qù hǎitān ba!” Nhan shuō: “Hǎo a! Wǒmen zài hǎitān yěcān, zěnmeyàng?” “Wǒmen zài kǎo yī gè dàngāo ba!” “Xíng! Xīngqītiān wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba.” “Wǒ hái xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?” “Wǒ yě xiǎng qù! Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba!”)

en.flash: plan a trip, How about…? | Ôn: bake, sightseeing, resort, have a picnic, bake a cake, go camping, go to the beach, stay at a resort, What about you?
en.slide: 1) Nhóm 3 con làm 'Our Holiday Timetable' trên slide (kéo thả hoạt động vào thứ trong tuần): go to the beach / go sightseeing / go camping / bake a cake / stay at a resort. 2) Thẻ phản xạ không tranh: cô nói hoạt động, con đưa lời đề nghị (5 lượt): picnic → How about having a picnic? / beach → Let's go to the beach! / cake → How about baking a cake? / island → Let's go sightseeing on the island! / camping → I want to go camping. What about you? 3) Nhóm trình bày kế hoạch: On Monday, let's… On Tuesday, how about…?
en.truyen: Our Holiday Timetable (kể đầy đủ) — Leo, Xiaomei and Anna plan a holiday together. 'On Monday, let's go to the beach and have a picnic,' says Leo. 'How about going sightseeing on the island on Tuesday?' says Xiaomei. 'On Wednesday, I want to go camping. What about you?' asks Anna. 'Me too!' On Thursday, they plan to stay at a resort, and on Friday, they will bake a cake at home. 'What a busy holiday!' laughs Anna's mum.
en.baihat: Let's Go! (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus), lời 3 — Let's plan a trip for the holiday, / the holiday, the holiday. / Let's plan a trip for the holiday, / Monday to Friday! // Beach and island, camp and cake, / camp and cake, camp and cake. / Beach and island, camp and cake, / let's go together!

zh.flash: 行程 xíngchéng | Ôn: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 时间表 shíjiānbiǎo, 决定 juédìng
zh.slide: 1) Nhóm 3 con làm '我们的行程' (kéo thả hoạt động vào 星期一 – 星期五): 去海滩野餐 / 去岛上观光 / 去露营 / 住在度假村 / 烤蛋糕. 2) Thẻ phản xạ không tranh: cô đọc từ, con giơ thẻ chữ Hán (7 từ): 野餐 / 烤 / 观光 / 岛 / 露营 / 度假村 / 行程. 3) Nhóm trình bày: 星期一，我们去……吧。星期二……，怎么样？我想……，你呢？
zh.truyen: 我们的假期行程 (kể đầy đủ) — Leo、Xiaomei和Anna一起做假期的行程。Leo说：“星期一，我们去海滩野餐吧。”Xiaomei说：“星期二去岛上观光，怎么样？”Anna说：“星期三我想去露营，你们呢？”“我们也想去！”星期四，他们住在度假村，星期五在家烤蛋糕。他们决定了，把行程写在时间表上。Anna的妈妈笑了：“这个假期多么忙啊！”(Leo, Xiaomei hé Anna yīqǐ zuò jiàqī de xíngchéng. Leo shuō: “Xīngqīyī, wǒmen qù hǎitān yěcān ba.” Xiaomei shuō: “Xīngqī'èr qù dǎo shang guānguāng, zěnmeyàng?” Anna shuō: “Xīngqīsān wǒ xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐmen ne?” “Wǒmen yě xiǎng qù!” Xīngqīsì, tāmen zhù zài dùjiàcūn, xīngqīwǔ zài jiā kǎo dàngāo. Tāmen juédìng le, bǎ xíngchéng xiě zài shíjiānbiǎo shang. Anna de māma xiào le: “Zhè gè jiàqī duōme máng a!”)
zh.baihat: 我们一起去 (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down), lời 3 — 我们一起做行程，星期一，星期二，海滩岛上去观光，好吧！好吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ zuò xíngchéng, xīngqīyī, xīngqī'èr, hǎitān dǎo shang qù guānguāng, hǎo ba! Hǎo ba!)

en.tu: Ôn: bake, sightseeing, resort, go camping, have a picnic | Ôn truyện: healthy, fit, jog, exercise, bandage, ambulance, still, so
en.cum: a healthy holiday / go jogging on the beach / do exercise / put on a bandage / still have fun
en.cau: Let's go jogging on the beach every morning! / How about doing exercise at the resort? / Leo fell over, so Mum put on a bandage. / Although his knee hurt, he still went sightseeing. / Holidays are fun, and we should keep fit, too.
en.truyen: A Healthy Holiday — Nhan's family stayed at a resort for the holiday. 'Let's go jogging on the beach every morning!' said Dad. 'How about swimming after that?' said Nhan. On the second day, Nhan fell over on the sand. Mum put a bandage on his knee. 'Do we need an ambulance?' asked his sister. 'No!' laughed Nhan. Although his knee hurt a little, he still went sightseeing on the island. It was a healthy, happy holiday!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "healthy summer holiday tips for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 野餐 yěcān, 观光 guānguāng, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 行程 xíngchéng | Ôn truyện: 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 安全 ānquán, 担心 dānxīn, 虽然 suīrán, 破 pò
zh.cum: 健康的假期 jiànkāng de jiàqī / 在海滩慢跑 zài hǎitān mànpǎo / 锻炼身体 duànliàn shēntǐ / 很安全 hěn ānquán / 别担心 bié dānxīn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 吧] 每天早上我们去海滩慢跑吧！(Měi tiān zǎoshang wǒmen qù hǎitān mànpǎo ba!) / 我们在度假村锻炼身体，怎么样？(Wǒmen zài dùjiàcūn duànliàn shēntǐ, zěnmeyàng?) / [Ngữ pháp: 虽然……但是……] 虽然Nhan的手破了，但是他还是去岛上观光了。(Suīrán Nhan de shǒu pò le, dànshì tā háishi qù dǎo shang guānguāng le.) / 别担心，他很安全。(Bié dānxīn, tā hěn ānquán.)
zh.truyen: 健康的假期 — 放假了，Nhan一家住在海边的度假村。爸爸说：“每天早上我们去海滩慢跑吧！”Nhan说：“慢跑以后去游泳，怎么样？”第二天，Nhan的手破了。妹妹很担心。妈妈说：“别担心，他很安全。”虽然Nhan的手有一点儿疼，但是他还是去岛上观光了。这是一个健康、快乐的假期！(Fàngjià le, Nhan yī jiā zhù zài hǎibiān de dùjiàcūn. Bàba shuō: “Měi tiān zǎoshang wǒmen qù hǎitān mànpǎo ba!” Nhan shuō: “Mànpǎo yǐhòu qù yóuyǒng, zěnmeyàng?” Dì èr tiān, Nhan de shǒu pò le. Mèimei hěn dānxīn. Māma shuō: “Bié dānxīn, tā hěn ānquán.” Suīrán Nhan de shǒu yǒu yīdiǎnr téng, dànshì tā háishi qù dǎo shang guānguāng le. Zhè shì yī gè jiànkāng, kuàilè de jiàqī!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "暑假 安全 健康 儿童"
