en.tu: Ôn: bake, sightseeing, resort, have a picnic, bake a cake, go to the beach, go sightseeing, go camping, stay at a resort, plan a trip, What about you?
en.cum: Let's go… / How about…? / What about you? / go together / plan a trip
en.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Trung, nói lại bằng tiếng Anh): Let's go to the beach. / How about having a picnic? / How about baking a cake? / Let's go together. / Let's go sightseeing on the island. / I want to go camping. What about you?
en.truyen: Little Interpreter on Holiday — Xiaomei's cousin from China visits Vietnam for the holiday. He only speaks Chinese. Xiaomei's English friend, Anna, wants to plan a trip with him. Anna says, 'How about going sightseeing on the island?' Xiaomei says it in Chinese. Her cousin says, 'Good idea! Let's go together!' Then he asks, 'I want to go camping, too. What about you?' Xiaomei tells Anna in English. 'Me too!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Let's go song for kids holiday"

zh.tu: Ôn: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 行程 xíngchéng, 吧 ba, 呢 ne
zh.cum: 我们去……吧 wǒmen qù… ba / ……，怎么样？…, zěnmeyàng? / 你呢？nǐ ne? / 一起去 yīqǐ qù
zh.cau: Phiên dịch nhí (con nghe tiếng Anh, nói lại bằng tiếng Trung): 我们去海滩吧。(Wǒmen qù hǎitān ba.) / 我们去野餐，怎么样？(Wǒmen qù yěcān, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们烤蛋糕，怎么样？(Wǒmen kǎo dàngāo, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们一起去吧。(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba.) / 我们去岛上观光吧。(Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba.) / 我想去露营，你呢？(Wǒ xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?)
zh.truyen: 假期里的小翻译 — 放假了，Xiaomei的表哥从中国来越南。他只会说中文。Anna想和他一起做行程。Anna用英语说：“我们去岛上观光，怎么样？”Xiaomei用中文告诉表哥。表哥说：“好啊！我们一起去吧！我还想去露营，你呢？”Xiaomei用英语告诉Anna。Anna说：“我也想去！”(Fàngjià le, Xiaomei de biǎogē cóng Zhōngguó lái Yuènán. Tā zhǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén. Anna xiǎng hé tā yīqǐ zuò xíngchéng. Anna yòng Yīngyǔ shuō: “Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng, zěnmeyàng?” Xiaomei yòng Zhōngwén gàosu biǎogē. Biǎogē shuō: “Hǎo a! Wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba! Wǒ hái xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?” Xiaomei yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu Anna. Anna shuō: “Wǒ yě xiǎng qù!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "假期活动 儿歌 中文"

en.flash: Ôn cả unit: bake, sightseeing, resort, have a picnic, bake a cake, go to the beach, go sightseeing, go camping, stay at a resort, plan a trip + ôn truyện: healthy, jog, bandage, still
en.slide: 1) Kiểm tra nghe (5 câu, chọn tranh A/B/C): Let's go to the beach. / How about baking a cake? / They went sightseeing on the island. / Nhan wants to go camping. / Anna's family stayed at a resort. 2) Hoàn thành hội thoại (5 chỗ trống): A: ___ go to the beach! (Let's) B: Good idea! How about ___ a picnic? (having) A: OK. I want to go camping, too. What ___ you? (about) B: Me too! Let's go ___! (together) A: How about ___ a cake? (baking) 3) Dự án nhóm 'A Healthy Holiday': poster kế hoạch 3 ngày, mỗi con nói 1 câu đề nghị.
en.truyen: A Healthy Holiday (kể đầy đủ) — Nhan's family stayed at a resort by the sea. Every morning, they went jogging on the beach. 'How about baking a cake at the resort?' asked Nhan's sister. 'Good idea!' On the second day, Nhan fell over on the sand. Mum put a bandage on his knee. Although it hurt a little, he still went sightseeing on the island. On the last day, they had a picnic and ate the cake. 'Let's come back next year!' said Nhan.
en.baihat: Let's Go! (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus), cả bài — Let's go to the beach and have a picnic… all summer long! / How about baking a cake today… Yes, let's go! / Let's go camping by the river… What about you? / Let's plan a trip for the holiday… let's go together!

zh.flash: Ôn cả unit: 野餐 yěcān, 烤 kǎo, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 行程 xíngchéng + ôn truyện: 健康 jiànkāng, 慢跑 mànpǎo, 担心 dānxīn, 虽然 suīrán
zh.slide: 1) Kiểm tra đọc chữ Hán (7 câu, chọn chữ điền chỗ trống): 我们去海滩___。(吧) / 我想去露营，你___？(呢) / 我们去野餐，___？(怎么样) / 我们去岛上___吧。(观光) / 我们___蛋糕，怎么样？(烤) / 我们住在___。(度假村) / 我们一起做一个___吧！(行程) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một con đọc lời mời tiếng Anh, con kia nói lại tiếng Trung và đáp (4 thẻ). 3) Trình bày poster '健康的假期': 星期一我们去……吧。我想……，你呢？
zh.truyen: 健康的假期 (kể đầy đủ) — Nhan一家住在海边的度假村。每天早上，他们去海滩慢跑。妹妹说：“我们在度假村烤蛋糕，怎么样？”大家都同意。第二天，Nhan的手破了，妈妈说：“别担心！”虽然手有一点儿疼，但是他还是去岛上观光了。最后一天，他们去野餐，吃了蛋糕。Nhan说：“明年我们再来吧！”(Nhan yī jiā zhù zài hǎibiān de dùjiàcūn. Měi tiān zǎoshang, tāmen qù hǎitān mànpǎo. Mèimei shuō: “Wǒmen zài dùjiàcūn kǎo dàngāo, zěnmeyàng?” Dàjiā dōu tóngyì. Dì èr tiān, Nhan de shǒu pò le, māma shuō: “Bié dānxīn!” Suīrán shǒu yǒu yīdiǎnr téng, dànshì tā háishi qù dǎo shang guānguāng le. Zuìhòu yī tiān, tāmen qù yěcān, chī le dàngāo. Nhan shuō: “Míngnián wǒmen zài lái ba!”)
zh.baihat: 我们一起去 (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down), cả bài 3 lời — 我们一起去野餐…… 你呢？你呢？/ 我们一起去露营…… 好吧！好吧！/ 我们一起做行程…… 好吧！好吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ qù yěcān… / Wǒmen yīqǐ qù lùyíng… / Wǒmen yīqǐ zuò xíngchéng…)

blocks.title: Tuần 28 · Cuối khóa: ôn toàn khóa, dự án, hồ sơ BRIDGE

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 55. Cuối khóa (1): Ôn toàn khóa Unit 1–6, khởi động dự án 'My Pupa Year Book' · Mini thi nói Flyers P1–P4 và YCT口试（中级）(lượt 1)

web.label: Ngày 109. Cuối khóa · Ôn quét Unit 1–3 (Gia đình, Trường học, Nông thôn)

en.tu: Ôn: as, ever, look like, of course, dictionary, gym, high, member, timetable, together, uniform, winner, file, join (a club), letter, butterfly, friendly, hill
en.cum: look like / of course / join a club / open a file / write a letter / a friendly neighbour / on the hill
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: câu hỏi đuôi] He is your uncle, isn't he? – Yes, he is. / You look like your mum, don't you? / Check your timetable. / Put on your school uniform. / There are some cows on the hill. / My neighbours are very friendly. / [Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): nhìn 2 tranh lớp học, nghe câu tranh A rồi nói câu tranh B, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] In my picture, the dictionary is on the desk. – In my picture, it's under the desk. / In my picture, there are three children in the club. – In my picture, there are four.
en.truyen: Nhan's Year Book, Page 1 — This is my family. My uncle is a teacher, isn't he? Yes, he is! I look like my dad. At school, I joined the English club and I was the winner of a competition. I use my dictionary every day. In the summer, I visited my grandma's village. There are butterflies on the hill and my grandma's neighbours are very friendly.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "family school countryside vocabulary review kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 阿姨 āyí, 儿子 érzi, 女儿 nǚ'ér, 叔叔 shūshu, 孩子 háizi, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 一边…一边… yībiān… yībiān…, 参加 cānjiā, 考试 kǎoshì, 复习 fùxí, 词典 cídiǎn, 放假 fàngjià, 练习 liànxí, 明白 míngbai, 安静 ānjìng, 邻居 línjū, 蝴蝶 húdié, 既…又… jì… yòu…
zh.cum: Nhan的叔叔 Nhan de shūshu / 是不是？shì bu shì? / 参加考试 cānjiā kǎoshì / 用词典 yòng cídiǎn / 安静的农村 ānjìng de nóngcūn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 是不是？] 他是你的外公，是不是？(Tā shì nǐ de wàigōng, shì bu shì?) / 他是Nhan的叔叔。(Tā shì Nhan de shūshu.) / [Ngữ pháp: 一边……一边……] 我一边听音乐，一边复习。(Wǒ yībiān tīng yīnyuè, yībiān fùxí.) / [Ngữ pháp: 既……又……] 农村既安静又漂亮。(Nóngcūn jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang.) / 农村的空气很新鲜。(Nóngcūn de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān.)
zh.truyen: Nhan的一年 (第一页) — 这是我的家。我叔叔是老师，是不是？是！我好像我爸爸。在学校，我参加了英语俱乐部，还参加了考试，成绩很好。我每天用词典。暑假，我去了外婆的农村。那里很安静，有很多蝴蝶，邻居们都很友好。(Zhè shì wǒ de jiā. Wǒ shūshu shì lǎoshī, shì bu shì? Shì! Wǒ hǎoxiàng wǒ bàba. Zài xuéxiào, wǒ cānjiā le Yīngyǔ jùlèbù, hái cānjiā le kǎoshì, chéngjì hěn hǎo. Wǒ měi tiān yòng cídiǎn. Shǔjià, wǒ qù le wàipó de nóngcūn. Nàli hěn ānjìng, yǒu hěn duō húdié, línjūmen dōu hěn yǒuhǎo.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "家庭 学校 农村 词汇 复习 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 110. Cuối khóa · Ôn quét Unit 4–6 (Thành phố, Vật liệu, Vũ trụ)

en.tu: Ôn: airport, bridge, museum, noisy, fire fighter, fire station, police station, theatre, everywhere, glass, metal, plastic, wood, wool, make sure, astronaut, Earth, planet, rocket, spaceship, could
en.cum: a noisy city / a fire station / made of glass / made of wood / make sure / fly to another planet / by rocket
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh as … as] This museum is as big as that hotel. / The countryside is not as crowded as the city. / [Ngữ pháp: be made of] This cup is made of glass. / Paper is made from wood. / [Ngữ pháp: could – khả năng] In the future, astronauts could land on other planets. / People could travel to Mars by rocket one day. / [Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): con nghe câu hỏi, ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói] What did you do last weekend? – I went to the museum with my uncle. / What would you like to be in the future? – I'd like to be an astronaut.
en.truyen: Nhan's Year Book, Page 2 — The city is lively but noisy. Near my school, there is a fire station and a police station. Last month, I visited a museum. It was as big as the airport! I learned that my school chair is made of plastic and metal. In the space unit, I made a model rocket. In the future, I could be an astronaut and see the Earth from space!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "city materials space vocabulary review kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 附近 fùjìn, 离 lí, 迷路 mílù, 桥 qiáo, 一样 yīyàng, 电影院 diànyǐngyuàn, 警察局 jǐngchájú, 到处 dàochù, 变化 biànhuà, 习惯 xíguàn, 越来越 yuèláiyuè, 如果…那么… rúguǒ… nàme…, 玻璃 bōli, 木头 mùtou, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 地球 dìqiú, 将来 jiānglái, 可能 kěnéng, 不但…而且… bùdàn… érqiě…
zh.cum: 学校附近 xuéxiào fùjìn / 跟……一样 gēn… yīyàng / 玻璃做的 bōli zuò de / 越来越热闹 yuèláiyuè rènao / 坐火箭 zuò huǒjiàn
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: A跟B一样] 这个博物馆跟那个酒店一样大。(Zhè gè bówùguǎn gēn nà gè jiǔdiàn yīyàng dà.) / [Ngữ pháp: ……是……做的] 这个杯子是玻璃做的。(Zhè gè bēizi shì bōli zuò de.) / [Ngữ pháp: 越来越] 城市越来越热闹。(Chéngshì yuèláiyuè rènao.) / [Ngữ pháp: 不但……而且……] 宇航员不但很聪明，而且很健康。(Yǔhángyuán bùdàn hěn cōngming, érqiě hěn jiànkāng.) / 将来人们可能坐火箭去别的行星。(Jiānglái rénmen kěnéng zuò huǒjiàn qù bié de xíngxīng.) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): con nghe rồi nói lại, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói] 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。(Zhège bēizi shì yòng bōli zuò de.) / 将来人们可能去太空旅游。(Jiānglái rénmen kěnéng qù tàikōng lǚyóu.) / 晚上村子里很安静。(Wǎnshang cūnzi li hěn ānjìng.)
zh.truyen: Nhan的一年 (第二页) — 城市越来越热闹。我的学校附近有警察局和电影院。上个月，我去了博物馆，博物馆跟机场一样大！我知道了我的椅子是塑料和金属做的。在太空的课上，我做了一个火箭。将来我可能当宇航员，从太空看地球！(Chéngshì yuèláiyuè rènao. Wǒ de xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu jǐngchájú hé diànyǐngyuàn. Shàng gè yuè, wǒ qù le bówùguǎn, bówùguǎn gēn jīchǎng yīyàng dà! Wǒ zhīdào le wǒ de yǐzi shì sùliào hé jīnshǔ zuò de. Zài tàikōng de kè shang, wǒ zuò le yī gè huǒjiàn. Jiānglái wǒ kěnéng dāng yǔhángyuán, cóng tàikōng kàn dìqiú!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "城市 材料 太空 儿童 中文 复习"

en.flash: Ôn Unit 1–6: as, ever, look like, of course, dictionary, timetable, uniform, winner, join, butterfly, friendly, hill, airport, bridge, museum, noisy, fire station, police station, glass, metal, plastic, wood, astronaut, Earth, planet, rocket, could
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Bánh xe chủ điểm': quay vào Unit nào, con nói 1 câu mẫu của unit đó (6 lượt): He is your uncle, isn't he? / Check your timetable. / There are some cows on the hill. / This museum is as big as that hotel. / This cup is made of glass. / In the future, people could live on another planet. 2) Phân loại 12 thẻ từ vào 6 chủ điểm (kéo thả): uniform, hill, bridge, wool, rocket, nephew, timetable, butterfly, museum, plastic, planet, surname. 3) Khởi động dự án: mỗi con làm trang 1–2 của 'My Pupa Year Book' (vẽ + viết 3 câu về gia đình, trường, thành phố/vũ trụ). 4) MINI THI NÓI FLYERS – lượt 1 (nhóm A, từng cặp, cô làm giám khảo, ~8 phút/cặp; nhóm B làm tiếp dự án). Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu): 2 tranh 'Sports Day at School' – In my picture, Leo is wearing a blue uniform. – In my picture, he's wearing a red uniform. / In my picture, there are four children in the gym. – In my picture, there are five. / In my picture, the winner has got a prize. – In my picture, she hasn't. / In my picture, the timetable is on the wall. – In my picture, it's on the table. — Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): hỏi – đáp về kỳ nghỉ của Uncle Minh / Aunt Hoa: Where did he go? – To the desert. / How did he get there? – By plane. / How long did he stay? – Five days. / What was the weather like? – Hot and sunny. / What did he buy? – A big hat. — Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): 5 tranh 'Lost in the City' – (1) Bông went to the museum with her class. (2) She stopped to look at a butterfly and got lost. (3) She asked a police officer for help. (4) He took her to the police station near the bridge. (5) Her teacher came, and everyone was happy. — Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu): What did you do last weekend? / Tell me about your best friend. / What would you like to be in the future? / Which unit did you like best this year? Why? Cô chấm theo phiếu (từ, câu, phát âm, tương tác) và ghi vào hồ sơ BRIDGE 4.
en.truyen: Nhan's Year Book (phần 1–2, kể đầy đủ) — 'This is my family. My uncle is a teacher, isn't he? Yes, he is! At school, I joined the English club and I was the winner of a competition. In the summer, I visited my grandma's village. The air is fresh and the neighbours are friendly. The city is not as quiet as the countryside, but it has a big museum and a fire station. I know my chair is made of plastic and metal. In the future, I could be an astronaut!'
en.baihat: Our Pupa Year (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Family, school and countryside, / city life and space so wide, / glass and metal, wood and wool, / rockets flying, isn't it cool? / One, two, three, we learned it all, / now we're ready, big and tall!

zh.flash: Ôn Unit 1–6: 阿姨 āyí, 叔叔 shūshu, 好像 hǎoxiàng, 参加 cānjiā, 考试 kǎoshì, 词典 cídiǎn, 复习 fùxí, 安静 ānjìng, 邻居 línjū, 蝴蝶 húdié, 附近 fùjìn, 桥 qiáo, 一样 yīyàng, 迷路 mílù, 玻璃 bōli, 越来越 yuèláiyuè, 宇航员 yǔhángyuán, 火箭 huǒjiàn, 地球 dìqiú, 将来 jiānglái
zh.slide: 1) Trò 'Bánh xe chủ điểm' tiếng Trung (6 lượt, mỗi lượt 1 câu mẫu): 他是你的外公，是不是？/ 我一边听音乐，一边复习。/ 农村的空气很新鲜。/ 这个博物馆跟那个酒店一样大。/ 这个杯子是玻璃做的。/ 将来人们可能坐火箭去别的行星。 2) Nối chữ Hán với pinyin (10 cặp): 叔叔 – shūshu / 词典 – cídiǎn / 邻居 – línjū / 蝴蝶 – húdié / 附近 – fùjìn / 迷路 – mílù / 玻璃 – bōli / 宇航员 – yǔhángyuán / 火箭 – huǒjiàn / 地球 – dìqiú. 3) Dự án: mỗi con viết trang 1–2 '我的一年' bằng tiếng Trung (3 câu). 4) MINI THI YCT口试（中级）– lượt 1 (nhóm B, từng em với cô, ~9 phút/em, 10 phút chuẩn bị; nhóm A làm tiếp dự án). 第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, 10 câu): 他是你的叔叔，是不是？/ 考试以前，我们要努力复习。/ 晚上村子里很安静。/ 我家离学校很近。/ 这个杯子是用玻璃做的。/ 将来人们可能去太空旅游。/ 别忘记带车票！/ 如果明天是晴天，我们就去露营。/ 我每天锻炼身体。/ 暴风雨来之前，我关上了窗户。— 第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu, 2 tranh, mỗi tranh nói một đoạn): tranh 'Ngày hội thể thao' – 星期五，我们学校开运动会。同学们穿着校服，在操场上跑步。Anna跑得最快，大家都很高兴。/ tranh 'Đi chơi Vạn Lý Trường Thành' – 放假的时候，Xiaomei一家去长城旅游。长城上人很多。Xiaomei一边走，一边说：“长城真长啊！” — 第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, câu hỏi in kèm pinyin): 你放假的时候喜欢做什么？(Nǐ fàngjià de shíhou xǐhuan zuò shénme?) / 你觉得城市好还是农村好？为什么？(Nǐ juéde chéngshì hǎo háishi nóngcūn hǎo? Wèishénme?) Cô chấm theo thang 100 điểm (đạt từ 60) và ghi vào hồ sơ BRIDGE 4.
zh.truyen: Nhan的一年 (第一、二页，kể đầy đủ) — “这是我的家。我叔叔是老师，是不是？是！在学校，我参加了英语俱乐部，还参加了考试。暑假，我去了外婆的农村，那里既安静又漂亮，邻居们都很友好。城市没有农村安静，但是有很大的博物馆。我知道了我的椅子是塑料做的。将来我可能当宇航员，坐火箭去太空！”(“Zhè shì wǒ de jiā. Wǒ shūshu shì lǎoshī, shì bu shì? Shì! Zài xuéxiào, wǒ cānjiā le Yīngyǔ jùlèbù, hái cānjiā le kǎoshì. Shǔjià, wǒ qù le wàipó de nóngcūn, nàli jì ānjìng yòu piàoliang, línjūmen dōu hěn yǒuhǎo. Chéngshì méiyǒu nóngcūn ānjìng, dànshì yǒu hěn dà de bówùguǎn. Wǒ zhīdào le wǒ de yǐzi shì sùliào zuò de. Jiānglái wǒ kěnéng dāng yǔhángyuán, zuò huǒjiàn qù tàikōng!”)
zh.baihat: 我们的一年 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星) — 家庭学校和农村，城市材料和太空，交通天气身体好，饮食假期真快乐，一年学了这么多，中文英文都会说！(Jiātíng xuéxiào hé nóngcūn, chéngshì cáiliào hé tàikōng, jiāotōng tiānqì shēntǐ hǎo, yǐnshí jiàqī zhēn kuàilè, yī nián xué le zhème duō, Zhōngwén Yīngwén dōu huì shuō!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 56. Cuối khóa (2): Ôn Unit 7–12, trình bày dự án, hồ sơ BRIDGE 4 · Mini thi nói Flyers P1–P4 và YCT口试（中级）(lượt 2)

web.label: Ngày 111. Cuối khóa · Ôn quét Unit 7–9 (Giao thông, Thời tiết, Sức khỏe)

en.tu: Ôn: jam, light, traffic, fire engine, get to, kilometre, April, November, camp, desert, ocean, a.m., at the moment, in a minute, so, still, healthy, exercise
en.cum: a traffic jam / traffic lights / get to school / go camping / at the moment / in a minute / do exercise
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: will – tương lai] People will travel by electric car. / [Ngữ pháp: câu điều kiện loại 1] If the weather is cool, we will go camping. / If it is windy, we won't go outside. / [Ngữ pháp: because / so] I do exercise every day, so I am fit. / [Ngữ pháp: but / although] Although I'm tired, I still go jogging every morning. / [Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): nhìn 5 tranh 'Lost in the City', ghi âm câu kể của con] (1) Bông went to the museum with her class. / (2) She got lost. / (3) She asked a police officer for help. / (4) He took her to the police station. / (5) Her teacher came, and everyone was happy.
en.truyen: Nhan's Year Book, Page 3 — I go to school by underground, so I am never in a traffic jam. In the future, people will travel by electric car. In April, it was cool, so we went camping by the ocean. In November, I had a sore throat, but I still went to school. Now I do exercise every day, so I am fit and healthy!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "transport weather health vocabulary review kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 出发 chūfā, 地铁 dìtiě, 离开 líkāi, 停 tíng, 忘记 wàngjì, 醒 xǐng, 堵车 dǔchē, 春季 chūnjì, 秋 qiū, 刚才 gāngcái, 经常 jīngcháng, 马上 mǎshàng, 突然 tūrán, 来得及 láidejí, 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 担心 dānxīn, 虽然 suīrán, 重要 zhòngyào
zh.cum: 坐地铁 zuò dìtiě / 堵车了 dǔchē le / 来得及 láidejí / 如果……就…… rúguǒ… jiù… / 锻炼身体 duànliàn shēntǐ
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: 如果……就……] 如果天气凉快，我们就去露营。(Rúguǒ tiānqì liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù lùyíng.) / 如果刮风，我们就不出去。(Rúguǒ guāfēng, wǒmen jiù bù chūqu.) / 我坐地铁上学，所以不堵车。(Wǒ zuò dìtiě shàngxué, suǒyǐ bù dǔchē.) / [Ngữ pháp: 因为……所以……] 因为我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。(Yīnwèi wǒ měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, suǒyǐ wǒ hěn jiànkāng.) / [Ngữ pháp: 虽然……但是……] 虽然我很累，但是我每天早上还是去慢跑。(Suīrán wǒ hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang háishi qù mànpǎo.) / [YCT口试（中级）第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): nhìn tranh ngày hội thể thao, ghi âm đoạn của con] 星期五，我们学校开运动会。同学们在操场上跑步。Anna跑得最快！(Xīngqīwǔ, wǒmen xuéxiào kāi yùndònghuì. Tóngxuémen zài cāochǎng shang pǎobù. Anna pǎo de zuì kuài!)
zh.truyen: Nhan的一年 (第三页) — 我坐地铁上学，所以经常来得及，不会迟到。秋天，天气很凉快，我们就去海边露营了。冬天，我喉咙疼，但是我还是去上学。现在我每天锻炼身体，因为健康非常重要！(Wǒ zuò dìtiě shàngxué, suǒyǐ jīngcháng láidejí, bù huì chídào. Qiūtiān, tiānqì hěn liángkuai, wǒmen jiù qù hǎibiān lùyíng le. Dōngtiān, wǒ hóulóng téng, dànshì wǒ háishi qù shàngxué. Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, yīnwèi jiànkāng fēicháng zhòngyào!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "交通工具 天气 健康 儿童 中文 复习"

web.label: Ngày 112. Cuối khóa · Ôn quét Unit 10–12 và hồ sơ BRIDGE

en.tu: Ôn: after, before, should, storm, fall over, lie down, delicious, spoon, flour, taste, bake, sightseeing, resort, earthquake, flood, picnic
en.cum: before the storm / after the earthquake / taste the soup / bake a cake / go sightseeing / stay at a resort
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: before / after] Before the storm came, I closed all the windows. / After the earthquake, we went to a safe place. / [Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn] What did you eat last night? – I ate noodles. / The dumplings were delicious. / [Ngữ pháp: Let's / How about + V-ing?] Let's go sightseeing on the island. / How about baking a cake? / [Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): con nghe câu hỏi, nhìn thẻ thông tin rồi ghi âm câu trả lời trên Trang luyện nói] Where did Uncle Minh go? – He went to the desert. / How did he get there? – By plane. / What was the weather like? – It was hot and sunny.
en.truyen: Nhan's Year Book, Page 4 — Before the big storm came, I closed all the windows. After the storm, I helped my neighbours. Last week, I baked a cake with my grandma. It was delicious! Now it's the holiday. 'Let's go sightseeing on the island!' I said to my friends. 'How about staying at a resort?' said Anna. It's going to be a great holiday!
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "end of year review English kids"

zh.tu: Ôn: 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 窗户 chuānghu, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 地震 dìzhèn, 选择 xuǎnzé, 同意 tóngyì, 披萨 pīsà, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 尝 cháng, 糖 táng, 葡萄 pútao, 野餐 yěcān, 观光 guānguāng, 岛 dǎo, 露营 lùyíng, 度假村 dùjiàcūn, 行程 xíngchéng
zh.cum: 暴风雨来之前 bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián / 地震后 dìzhèn hòu / 吃了烤鸭 chī le kǎoyā / 尝一尝 cháng yi cháng / 去岛上观光 qù dǎo shang guānguāng
zh.cau: [Ngữ pháp: ……之前 / ……后] 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户。(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒ guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu.) / 地震后，我们去了安全的地方。(Dìzhèn hòu, wǒmen qù le ānquán de dìfang.) / [Ngữ pháp: 了 / 没] 你昨天吃米饭了吗？——没吃。(Nǐ zuótiān chī mǐfàn le ma? —— Méi chī.) / [Ngữ pháp: 吧 / 呢] 我们去岛上观光吧。(Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba.) / 我想去露营，你呢？(Wǒ xiǎng qù lùyíng, nǐ ne?) / [YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, chuẩn bị mini thi): con đọc câu hỏi có pinyin, ghi âm câu trả lời 2–3 câu] 你放假的时候喜欢做什么？(Nǐ fàngjià de shíhou xǐhuan zuò shénme?) – 放假的时候，我喜欢和家人去旅游。(Fàngjià de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan hé jiārén qù lǚyóu.)
zh.truyen: Nhan的一年 (第四页) — 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户。暴风雨过后，我帮邻居打扫。上个星期，我和奶奶烤了一个蛋糕，好吃极了！现在放假了。我对朋友们说：“我们去岛上观光吧！”Anna说：“我们住在度假村，怎么样？”这个假期一定很好玩儿！(Bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián, wǒ guānshang le suǒyǒu de chuānghu. Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, wǒ bāng línjū dǎsǎo. Shàng gè xīngqī, wǒ hé nǎinai kǎo le yī gè dàngāo, hǎochī jí le! Xiànzài fàngjià le. Wǒ duì péngyoumen shuō: “Wǒmen qù dǎo shang guānguāng ba!” Anna shuō: “Wǒmen zhù zài dùjiàcūn, zěnmeyàng?” Zhè gè jiàqī yīdìng hěn hǎowánr!)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "期末复习 儿童中文"

en.flash: Ôn Unit 7–12: traffic, jam, light, fire engine, get to, camp, desert, ocean, at the moment, in a minute, so, still, healthy, before, after, should, storm, fall over, lie down, delicious, spoon, bake, sightseeing, resort
en.slide: 1) Thi 'Ai nhanh hơn' theo đội: cô đưa tranh, đội nói câu đúng chủ điểm (6 lượt): People will travel by electric car. / If it is windy, we won't go outside. / I have a fever, so I'm going to see a doctor. / Before the storm came, I closed all the windows. / The soup was too salty. / How about having a picnic? 2) Trình bày dự án 'My Pupa Year Book': mỗi con đọc 4 trang (mỗi trang 2 câu tiếng Anh) trước lớp, bạn hỏi 1 câu. 3) Hồ sơ BRIDGE 4 – chuyển ngữ: con nghe 3 câu tiếng Trung từ năm học và nói lại bằng tiếng Anh (Before the storm came… / I ate noodles with chopsticks. / Let's go together.). 4) MINI THI NÓI FLYERS – lượt 2 (nhóm B, đề 2, từng cặp, cô làm giám khảo; nhóm A chuẩn bị trình bày dự án). Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu): 2 tranh 'At the Camp' – In my picture, there are two bikes. – In my picture, there are three. / In my picture, Dad is cooking. – In my picture, he's sleeping. / In my picture, the boy has got a spoon. – In my picture, he's got a cup. / In my picture, it's foggy. – In my picture, it's sunny. — Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu): hỏi – đáp về chuyến đi của lớp Leo / lớp Anna: Where did they go? – To an island. / How did they get there? – By boat. / What did they see? – Fish and birds. / What did they eat? – Fish and rice. / Was it fun? – Yes, it was great. — Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu): 5 tranh 'The Picnic' – (1) Nhan's family had a picnic by the lake. (2) Mum made delicious sandwiches. (3) Suddenly, it started to rain. (4) They ran to a café and drank hot chocolate. (5) After the rain, they saw a rainbow and finished their picnic. — Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu): Where would you like to go next holiday? / What do you do with your family at the weekend? / What do you like doing in winter? / What do you want to learn next year? Cô ghi kết quả vào hồ sơ BRIDGE 4.
en.truyen: Nhan's Pupa Year (kể đầy đủ cả năm) — 'This year, I learned so much! I talked about my family and my school. I visited the countryside and the city. I learned what things are made of and what astronauts could do in space. I took the underground and went camping when the weather was cool. I learned to keep fit, I closed the windows before a storm, I baked a cake, and now I'm planning a holiday. Let's go to Butterfly together!'
en.baihat: Our Pupa Year (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star), lời 2 — Trains and buses, rain and sun, / keeping fit is so much fun, / storms and floods, we know what to do, / noodles, cake and roast duck too, / holidays are here today, / let's go sightseeing, hip hooray!

zh.flash: Ôn Unit 7–12: 地铁 dìtiě, 堵车 dǔchē, 出发 chūfā, 忘记 wàngjì, 秋 qiū, 马上 mǎshàng, 突然 tūrán, 来得及 láidejí, 健康 jiànkāng, 锻炼 duànliàn, 虽然 suīrán, 暴风雨 bàofēngyǔ, 准备 zhǔnbèi, 地震 dìzhèn, 选择 xuǎnzé, 烤鸭 kǎoyā, 尝 cháng, 野餐 yěcān, 观光 guānguāng, 露营 lùyíng, 行程 xíngchéng
zh.slide: 1) Thi đội 'Ai nhanh hơn' bằng tiếng Trung (6 lượt): 如果天气凉快，我们就去露营。/ 我坐地铁上学。/ 因为我每天锻炼身体，所以我很健康。/ 暴风雨来之前，我关上了所有的窗户。/ 我吃了北京烤鸭。/ 我们去野餐，怎么样？ 2) Trình bày dự án '我的一年': mỗi con đọc 4 trang (mỗi trang 2 câu tiếng Trung), bạn hỏi 1 câu bằng tiếng Trung. 3) Hồ sơ BRIDGE 4 – chuyển ngữ: con nghe 3 câu tiếng Anh và nói lại bằng tiếng Trung (Although I'm tired, I still go jogging. → 虽然我很累，但是我还是去慢跑。/ After the earthquake, we went to a safe place. → 地震后，我们去了安全的地方。/ I want to go camping. What about you? → 我想去露营，你呢？). 4) MINI THI YCT口试（中级）– lượt 2 (nhóm A, đề 2, từng em với cô, ~9 phút/em, 10 phút chuẩn bị). 第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu, 10 câu): 我阿姨是护士，她在医院工作。/ 你明白这个句子吗？/ 花上有一只蝴蝶。/ 我迷路了，请问警察局在哪儿？/ 天气越来越冷了。/ 宇航员不但很勇敢，而且很聪明。/ 我们早上八点出发。/ 刚才突然下雨了。/ 骑车太快不安全。/ 我们一起去海边野餐吧！— 第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu, 2 tranh, mỗi tranh nói một đoạn): tranh 'Đi khám sức khỏe' – Nhan今天去体检。他有一点儿紧张。医生说：“别担心，你很健康！”Nhan笑了。/ tranh 'Cắm trại trên đảo' – 假期的时候，Leo一家去岛上露营。白天他们去游泳，晚上一边吃东西，一边看星星。— 第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu, câu hỏi in kèm pinyin): 你每天怎么锻炼身体？(Nǐ měitiān zěnme duànliàn shēntǐ?) / 下个假期你想去哪儿旅游？为什么？(Xià ge jiàqī nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr lǚyóu? Wèishénme?) Cô chấm theo thang 100 điểm (đạt từ 60) và ghi vào hồ sơ BRIDGE 4.
zh.truyen: Nhan的Pupa一年 (kể đầy đủ) — “这一年，我学了很多！我介绍了我的家和学校，去了农村和城市，知道了东西是什么做的，也知道了将来宇航员可能做什么。我坐地铁上学，天气凉快的时候去露营。我每天锻炼身体，暴风雨来之前关上窗户，还和奶奶烤了蛋糕。现在放假了，我们一起做行程吧！明年，我们一起去Butterfly！”(“Zhè yī nián, wǒ xué le hěn duō! Wǒ jièshào le wǒ de jiā hé xuéxiào, qù le nóngcūn hé chéngshì, zhīdào le dōngxi shì shénme zuò de, yě zhīdào le jiānglái yǔhángyuán kěnéng zuò shénme. Wǒ zuò dìtiě shàngxué, tiānqì liángkuai de shíhou qù lùyíng. Wǒ měi tiān duànliàn shēntǐ, bàofēngyǔ lái zhīqián guānshang chuānghu, hái hé nǎinai kǎo le dàngāo. Xiànzài fàngjià le, wǒmen yīqǐ zuò xíngchéng ba! Míngnián, wǒmen yīqǐ qù Butterfly!”)
zh.baihat: 我们的一年 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star 小星星), lời 2 — 坐地铁呀去露营，锻炼身体真健康，暴风雨前关窗户，尝尝烤鸭好吃哦，放假我们做行程，一起观光真开心！(Zuò dìtiě ya qù lùyíng, duànliàn shēntǐ zhēn jiànkāng, bàofēngyǔ qián guān chuānghu, chángchang kǎoyā hǎochī o, fàngjià wǒmen zuò xíngchéng, yīqǐ guānguāng zhēn kāixīn!)

blocks.title: Tuần lễ hội 1 (xếp theo lịch thật: Trung thu / Halloween / Noel / Tết / 1-6)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 57. Lễ hội 1 · Noel (1): Từ, câu và truyện Giáng sinh (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 113. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: từ và hình ảnh Giáng sinh

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas, Christmas tree, Santa Claus, reindeer, snowman, stocking | Ôn: present, gift, card, snow, star, festival, celebrate
en.cum: Merry Christmas! / a Christmas tree / Santa Claus / make a snowman / hang a stocking
en.cau: Merry Christmas! / Look at the Christmas tree! There is a star on the top. / Santa Claus has a red coat. / Let's make a snowman! / We celebrate Christmas on 25th December.
en.truyen: Christmas Eve — It's Christmas Eve. Anna and her family put a big star on the Christmas tree. Anna hangs her stocking. 'Santa Claus will come tonight with his reindeer,' says Dad. In the morning, there is a present in the stocking. 'Merry Christmas!' says Anna.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Christmas vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 雪人 xuěrén | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 下雪 xiàxuě, 星星 xīngxing
zh.cum: 圣诞节快乐 Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè / 一棵圣诞树 yī kē Shèngdànshù / 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén / 堆雪人 duī xuěrén
zh.cau: 圣诞节快乐！(Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè!) / 看，圣诞树上有一颗星星。(Kàn, Shèngdànshù shang yǒu yī kē xīngxing.) / 圣诞老人穿红衣服。(Shèngdàn Lǎorén chuān hóng yīfu.) / 我们一起堆雪人吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ duī xuěrén ba!) / 十二月二十五日是圣诞节。(Shí'èr yuè èrshíwǔ rì shì Shèngdàn Jié.)
zh.truyen: 圣诞节前夜 — 圣诞节前夜，Anna一家在圣诞树上放了一颗大星星。爸爸说：“今天晚上，圣诞老人会来。”第二天早上，Anna看到了一个礼物。她说：“圣诞节快乐！”(Shèngdàn Jié qiányè, Anna yī jiā zài Shèngdànshù shang fàng le yī kē dà xīngxing. Bàba shuō: “Jīntiān wǎnshang, Shèngdàn Lǎorén huì lái.” Dì èr tiān zǎoshang, Anna kàndào le yī gè lǐwù. Tā shuō: “Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞节 儿童 中文 动画"

web.label: Ngày 114. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: truyện Giáng sinh

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): Christmas, Christmas tree, Santa Claus, reindeer, snowman, stocking, present, card, wish
en.cum: write a Christmas card / give a present / a Christmas wish / sing Christmas songs
en.cau: I wrote a Christmas card for my teacher. / What do you wish for at Christmas? – I wish for a new bike. / Let's sing Christmas songs together. / Santa Claus gave me a present.
en.truyen: Leo's Christmas Card — Leo wants to give his grandma a present, but he doesn't have any money. 'How about making a Christmas card?' says Mum. Leo draws a Christmas tree, a snowman and Santa Claus with his reindeer. He writes, 'Merry Christmas, Grandma! I love you.' Grandma is very happy. 'This is the best present!' she says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how to make a Christmas card for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén, 雪人 xuěrén, 礼物 lǐwù, 贺卡 hèkǎ, 送 sòng
zh.cum: 做贺卡 zuò hèkǎ / 送礼物 sòng lǐwù / 圣诞节的愿望 Shèngdàn Jié de yuànwàng / 唱圣诞歌 chàng Shèngdàn gē
zh.cau: 我给老师做了一张圣诞贺卡。(Wǒ gěi lǎoshī zuò le yī zhāng Shèngdàn hèkǎ.) / 我们一起唱圣诞歌吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ chàng Shèngdàn gē ba!) / 圣诞老人送了我一个礼物。(Shèngdàn Lǎorén sòng le wǒ yī gè lǐwù.) / 你想要什么礼物？——我想要一辆自行车。(Nǐ xiǎng yào shénme lǐwù? —— Wǒ xiǎng yào yī liàng zìxíngchē.)
zh.truyen: Leo的圣诞贺卡 — Leo想送奶奶一个礼物，可是他没有钱。妈妈说：“我们做一张贺卡，怎么样？”Leo在贺卡上画了圣诞树、雪人和圣诞老人。他写：“奶奶，圣诞节快乐！我爱你。”奶奶非常高兴，说：“这是最好的礼物！”(Leo xiǎng sòng nǎinai yī gè lǐwù, kěshì tā méiyǒu qián. Māma shuō: “Wǒmen zuò yī zhāng hèkǎ, zěnmeyàng?” Leo zài hèkǎ shang huà le Shèngdànshù, xuěrén hé Shèngdàn Lǎorén. Tā xiě: “Nǎinai, Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè! Wǒ ài nǐ.” Nǎinai fēicháng gāoxìng, shuō: “Zhè shì zuì hǎo de lǐwù!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞贺卡 手工 儿童"

en.flash: Christmas, Christmas tree, Santa Claus, reindeer, snowman, stocking, star | Ôn: present, card, wish, snow, celebrate
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Trang trí cây thông' trên slide: nghe cô nói, kéo hình vào cây (5 lượt): Put a star on the top. / Put a red ball on the tree. / Put a present under the tree. / Put a snowman next to the tree. / Put Santa Claus near the door. 2) Thủ công: làm thiệp Noel và viết lời chúc: Merry Christmas, … ! / I wish you a happy new year! 3) Nghe truyện Leo's Christmas Card, giơ thẻ tranh khi nghe từ: Christmas tree / snowman / Santa Claus / reindeer.
en.truyen: The Snowman's Christmas — On Christmas Eve, Anna and Leo make a snowman in the garden. They give him a hat and a red scarf. At night, Santa Claus comes with his reindeer. He sees the snowman and smiles. In the morning, there are presents under the Christmas tree, and the snowman has a new present, too: a big star! 'Merry Christmas, Snowman!' say the children.
en.baihat: Christmas Is Here (giai điệu We Wish You a Merry Christmas, lời mới) — The Christmas tree is shining, / the Christmas tree is shining, / the Christmas tree is shining / with a star on the top! // Santa Claus is coming, / Santa Claus is coming, / Santa Claus is coming / with presents for all! (Nghe thêm: Jingle Bells)

zh.flash: 圣诞节 Shèngdàn Jié, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 雪人 xuěrén | Ôn: 礼物 lǐwù, 贺卡 hèkǎ, 星星 xīngxing, 下雪 xiàxuě, 庆祝 qìngzhù
zh.slide: 1) Trò 'Trang trí cây thông' tiếng Trung (5 lượt): 在圣诞树上放一颗星星。/ 放一个红色的球。/ 在树下放一个礼物。/ 在树旁边放一个雪人。/ 圣诞老人在门旁边。 2) Viết lời chúc trên thiệp: 圣诞节快乐！/ 新年快乐！/ 祝你身体健康！ 3) Hát và vận động theo bài 圣诞歌, giơ tay khi nghe 圣诞树 / 圣诞老人 / 雪人.
zh.truyen: 雪人的圣诞节 — 圣诞节前夜，Anna和Leo在花园里堆了一个雪人。他们给雪人一顶帽子。晚上，圣诞老人和驯鹿来了。他看到雪人，笑了。第二天早上，圣诞树下有很多礼物，雪人也有一个礼物：一颗大星星！孩子们说：“雪人，圣诞节快乐！”(Shèngdàn Jié qiányè, Anna hé Leo zài huāyuán li duī le yī gè xuěrén. Tāmen gěi xuěrén yī dǐng màozi. Wǎnshang, Shèngdàn Lǎorén hé xùnlù lái le. Tā kàndào xuěrén, xiào le. Dì èr tiān zǎoshang, Shèngdànshù xià yǒu hěn duō lǐwù, xuěrén yě yǒu yī gè lǐwù: yī kē dà xīngxing! Háizimen shuō: “Xuěrén, Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè!”)
zh.baihat: 圣诞歌 (giai điệu Jingle Bells, lời mới) — 圣诞节，圣诞节，大家真快乐！圣诞树上星星亮，礼物送给你！(Shèngdàn Jié, Shèngdàn Jié, dàjiā zhēn kuàilè! Shèngdànshù shang xīngxing liàng, lǐwù sòng gěi nǐ!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 58. Lễ hội 1 · Noel (2): Lời chúc, quà tặng, tiệc Giáng sinh (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 115. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: lời chúc và quà tặng

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): Merry Christmas, Happy New Year, present, card, wish, Santa Claus, stocking
en.cum: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! / I wish you… / thank you for the present
en.cau: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! / I wish you a happy Christmas. / Thank you for the present! / What's in the stocking? – Guess! / This present is for you.
en.truyen: Presents for Everyone — Xiaomei has five presents. 'This one is for Mum, this one is for Dad, and these are for my friends,' she says. Leo opens his present. It's a book about space! 'Thank you, Xiaomei! Merry Christmas!' he says. 'Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!' says Xiaomei.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Merry Christmas greetings for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): 圣诞节快乐 Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè, 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 礼物 lǐwù, 贺卡 hèkǎ, 祝 zhù, 谢谢 xièxie
zh.cum: 祝你圣诞节快乐 zhù nǐ Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè / 谢谢你的礼物 xièxie nǐ de lǐwù / 这是给你的 zhè shì gěi nǐ de
zh.cau: 祝你圣诞节快乐，新年快乐！(Zhù nǐ Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè, xīnnián kuàilè!) / 谢谢你的礼物！(Xièxie nǐ de lǐwù!) / 这个礼物是给你的。(Zhè gè lǐwù shì gěi nǐ de.) / 你猜猜，里面有什么？(Nǐ cāicai, lǐmian yǒu shénme?)
zh.truyen: 大家的礼物 — Xiaomei有五个礼物。她说：“这个是给妈妈的，这个是给爸爸的，这些是给朋友们的。”Leo打开礼物，是一本关于太空的书！他说：“谢谢你，Xiaomei！圣诞节快乐！”Xiaomei说：“祝你圣诞节快乐，新年快乐！”(Xiaomei yǒu wǔ gè lǐwù. Tā shuō: “Zhè gè shì gěi māma de, zhè gè shì gěi bàba de, zhèxiē shì gěi péngyoumen de.” Leo dǎkāi lǐwù, shì yī běn guānyú tàikōng de shū! Tā shuō: “Xièxie nǐ, Xiaomei! Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè!” Xiaomei shuō: “Zhù nǐ Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè, xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞节 祝福语 儿童"

web.label: Ngày 116. Lễ hội 1 · Noel: tiệc Giáng sinh của lớp

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): Christmas party, Christmas tree, snowman, Santa Claus, present, cake, sing, dance
en.cum: have a Christmas party / sing and dance / eat Christmas cake / play games
en.cau: Let's have a Christmas party! / How about singing a Christmas song? / We ate Christmas cake at the party. / Santa Claus danced with us!
en.truyen: Our Class Christmas Party — On Friday, our class had a Christmas party. We put a star on the Christmas tree. Our teacher was Santa Claus! We sang songs, danced and played games. Then we ate a delicious Christmas cake. 'Merry Christmas, everyone!' said Santa Claus.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Christmas party games for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): 圣诞晚会 Shèngdàn wǎnhuì, 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén, 唱歌 chànggē, 跳舞 tiàowǔ, 蛋糕 dàngāo, 游戏 yóuxì
zh.cum: 开圣诞晚会 kāi Shèngdàn wǎnhuì / 唱歌跳舞 chànggē tiàowǔ / 玩游戏 wán yóuxì / 吃蛋糕 chī dàngāo
zh.cau: 我们开一个圣诞晚会吧！(Wǒmen kāi yī gè Shèngdàn wǎnhuì ba!) / 我们唱圣诞歌，怎么样？(Wǒmen chàng Shèngdàn gē, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们在晚会上吃了蛋糕。(Wǒmen zài wǎnhuì shang chī le dàngāo.) / 圣诞老人跟我们一起跳舞！(Shèngdàn Lǎorén gēn wǒmen yīqǐ tiàowǔ!)
zh.truyen: 我们班的圣诞晚会 — 星期五，我们班开了一个圣诞晚会。我们在圣诞树上放了一颗星星。老师当圣诞老人！我们一起唱歌、跳舞、玩游戏，还吃了很好吃的蛋糕。圣诞老人说：“大家圣诞节快乐！”(Xīngqīwǔ, wǒmen bān kāi le yī gè Shèngdàn wǎnhuì. Wǒmen zài Shèngdànshù shang fàng le yī kē xīngxing. Lǎoshī dāng Shèngdàn Lǎorén! Wǒmen yīqǐ chànggē, tiàowǔ, wán yóuxì, hái chī le hěn hǎochī de dàngāo. Shèngdàn Lǎorén shuō: “Dàjiā Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞晚会 儿童 游戏"

en.flash: Merry Christmas, Happy New Year, Christmas party, present, card, stocking | Ôn: Christmas tree, Santa Claus, snowman, reindeer
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Đoán quà trong tất' (Guess what's in the stocking?): con sờ túi và đoán: Is it a ball? – Yes, it is! / Is it a book? – No, it isn't. 2) Đổi quà và nói lời chúc theo vòng tròn: This present is for you. Merry Christmas! – Thank you! Happy New Year! 3) Tiệc lớp: hát bài 'Christmas Is Here', trò 'Santa says' (Santa says dance! / Santa says sing!).
en.truyen: Presents for Everyone (kể đầy đủ) — Xiaomei made five presents for Christmas: a card for Mum, a cake for Dad and three books for her friends. At the class party, she gave Leo his present. It was a book about space! 'Thank you! Merry Christmas!' said Leo. Anna got a book about animals. Then their teacher came in as Santa Claus. Everyone sang, danced and ate cake. 'Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!' they all said.
en.baihat: Christmas Is Here (giai điệu We Wish You a Merry Christmas, lời mới), lời 2 — Let's have a Christmas party, / let's have a Christmas party, / let's have a Christmas party / and sing all day long! // Thank you for the present, / thank you for the present, / thank you for the present, / Merry Christmas to you!

zh.flash: 圣诞节快乐 Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè, 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 圣诞晚会 Shèngdàn wǎnhuì, 礼物 lǐwù, 贺卡 hèkǎ | Ôn: 圣诞树 Shèngdànshù, 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén, 雪人 xuěrén
zh.slide: 1) Trò '猜猜礼物': 你猜猜，里面有什么？——是一本书吗？——对了！/ 不对！ 2) Đổi quà vòng tròn bằng tiếng Trung: 这个礼物是给你的。圣诞节快乐！——谢谢你！新年快乐！ 3) Tiệc lớp: hát 圣诞歌, trò 'Ông già Noel bảo' (圣诞老人说：跳舞！/ 唱歌！/ 拍手！).
zh.truyen: 大家的礼物 (kể đầy đủ) — 圣诞节，Xiaomei做了五个礼物：给妈妈一张贺卡，给爸爸一个蛋糕，给朋友们三本书。在班里的圣诞晚会上，她送给Leo一本关于太空的书。Leo说：“谢谢你！圣诞节快乐！”Anna得到了一本关于动物的书。然后，老师当圣诞老人来了。大家一起唱歌、跳舞、吃蛋糕。大家说：“圣诞节快乐，新年快乐！”(Shèngdàn Jié, Xiaomei zuò le wǔ gè lǐwù: gěi māma yī zhāng hèkǎ, gěi bàba yī gè dàngāo, gěi péngyoumen sān běn shū. Zài bān li de Shèngdàn wǎnhuì shang, tā sòng gěi Leo yī běn guānyú tàikōng de shū. Leo shuō: “Xièxie nǐ! Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè!” Anna dédào le yī běn guānyú dòngwù de shū. Ránhòu, lǎoshī dāng Shèngdàn Lǎorén lái le. Dàjiā yīqǐ chànggē, tiàowǔ, chī dàngāo. Dàjiā shuō: “Shèngdàn Jié kuàilè, xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.baihat: 圣诞歌 (giai điệu Jingle Bells, lời mới), lời 2 — 开晚会，开晚会，唱歌又跳舞！谢谢你的好礼物，新年快乐哦！(Kāi wǎnhuì, kāi wǎnhuì, chànggē yòu tiàowǔ! Xièxie nǐ de hǎo lǐwù, xīnnián kuàilè o!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 59. Lễ hội 2 · Tết (1): Từ, hình ảnh và món ăn ngày Tết (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 117. Lễ hội 2 · Tết: từ và hình ảnh ngày Tết

en.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Lunar New Year, Tet, peach blossom, kumquat tree, lucky money | Ôn: festival, celebrate, firework, lantern, lucky, wish, red
en.cum: Happy New Year! / Happy Lunar New Year! / peach blossoms / a kumquat tree / get lucky money
en.cau: Happy Lunar New Year! / We celebrate Tet in January or February. / There are pink peach blossoms in my house. / We have a kumquat tree with little orange fruit. / Children get lucky money in red envelopes.
en.truyen: Tet Is Coming — Tet is coming! Nhan and his family clean the house. Dad buys a kumquat tree and Mum buys pink peach blossoms. 'Why do we clean the house before Tet?' asks Nhan. 'For a lucky new year!' says Mum. On the first day of Tet, Nhan gets lucky money from his grandparents. 'Happy New Year!' he says.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Tet Lunar New Year Vietnam for kids"

zh.tu: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 春节 Chūn Jié, 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 桃花 táohuā, 金橘树 jīnjúshù, 拜年 bàinián | Ôn: 红包 hóngbāo, 节日 jiérì, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 灯笼 dēnglong, 舞狮 wǔshī
zh.cum: 过春节 guò Chūn Jié / 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè / 给红包 gěi hóngbāo / 去拜年 qù bàinián / 桃花开了 táohuā kāi le
zh.cau: 新年快乐！(Xīnnián kuàilè!) / 春节的时候，我们打扫房子。(Chūn Jié de shíhou, wǒmen dǎsǎo fángzi.) / 我家有桃花和金橘树。(Wǒ jiā yǒu táohuā hé jīnjúshù.) / 爷爷奶奶给我红包。(Yéye nǎinai gěi wǒ hóngbāo.) / 我们去外婆家拜年。(Wǒmen qù wàipó jiā bàinián.)
zh.truyen: 春节来了 — 春节快到了！Nhan一家打扫房子。爸爸买了一棵金橘树，妈妈买了桃花。Nhan问：“春节前为什么要打扫房子？”妈妈说：“新的一年会很好！”春节第一天，爷爷奶奶给Nhan红包。Nhan说：“新年快乐！”(Chūn Jié kuài dào le! Nhan yī jiā dǎsǎo fángzi. Bàba mǎi le yī kē jīnjúshù, māma mǎi le táohuā. Nhan wèn: “Chūn Jié qián wèishénme yào dǎsǎo fángzi?” Māma shuō: “Xīn de yī nián huì hěn hǎo!” Chūn Jié dì yī tiān, yéye nǎinai gěi Nhan hóngbāo. Nhan shuō: “Xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "春节 儿童 动画 中文"

web.label: Ngày 118. Lễ hội 2 · Tết: món ăn ngày Tết

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): banh chung, sticky rice, dumplings, delicious, Lunar New Year, family, cook
en.cum: make banh chung / sticky rice cake / eat dumplings / a family dinner
en.cau: In Vietnam, we make banh chung at Tet. / Banh chung is a square sticky rice cake. / In China, people eat dumplings at New Year. / The banh chung was delicious! / Let's cook together!
en.truyen: Banh Chung and Dumplings — Xiaomei's family is from China and they live in Hanoi. At Tet, Nhan's grandma teaches Xiaomei how to make banh chung. 'It's square, like the Earth,' says Grandma. Then Xiaomei's mum teaches Nhan how to make dumplings. That evening, the two families eat dinner together. 'The banh chung was delicious!' says Xiaomei. 'The dumplings were delicious, too!' says Nhan.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "how to make banh chung for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): 越南粽子 Yuènán zòngzi, 饺子 jiǎozi, 年夜饭 niányèfàn, 好吃 hǎochī, 一起 yīqǐ, 包 bāo
zh.cum: 包饺子 bāo jiǎozi / 做越南粽子 zuò Yuènán zòngzi / 吃年夜饭 chī niányèfàn / 一家人一起 yī jiā rén yīqǐ
zh.cau: 春节的时候，越南人做粽子。(Chūn Jié de shíhou, Yuènánrén zuò zòngzi.) / 越南的粽子是方的。(Yuènán de zòngzi shì fāng de.) / 中国人过年吃饺子。(Zhōngguórén guònián chī jiǎozi.) / 我们一起包饺子吧！(Wǒmen yīqǐ bāo jiǎozi ba!) / 年夜饭很好吃。(Niányèfàn hěn hǎochī.)
zh.truyen: 粽子和饺子 — Xiaomei一家是中国人，住在河内。春节的时候，Nhan的奶奶教Xiaomei做越南粽子。奶奶说：“越南的粽子是方的。”Xiaomei的妈妈教Nhan包饺子。晚上，两家人一起吃年夜饭。Xiaomei说：“粽子很好吃！”Nhan说：“饺子也很好吃！”(Xiaomei yī jiā shì Zhōngguórén, zhù zài Hénèi. Chūn Jié de shíhou, Nhan de nǎinai jiāo Xiaomei zuò Yuènán zòngzi. Nǎinai shuō: “Yuènán de zòngzi shì fāng de.” Xiaomei de māma jiāo Nhan bāo jiǎozi. Wǎnshang, liǎng jiā rén yīqǐ chī niányèfàn. Xiaomei shuō: “Zòngzi hěn hǎochī!” Nhan shuō: “Jiǎozi yě hěn hǎochī!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "包饺子 春节 儿童"

en.flash: Lunar New Year, Tet, peach blossom, kumquat tree, lucky money, banh chung, dumplings | Ôn: firework, lantern, lucky, wish, celebrate
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Chợ Tết' trên slide: nghe cô nói, kéo hình vào giỏ (5 lượt): Buy a kumquat tree. / Buy some peach blossoms. / Buy a red lantern. / Buy some sticky rice for banh chung. / Buy a red envelope for lucky money. 2) Thủ công: gói bánh chưng giấy (gấp hình vuông) và nói: Banh chung is square. It's delicious! 3) Nghe truyện 'Banh Chung and Dumplings', giơ thẻ tranh: banh chung / dumplings / peach blossom / lucky money.
en.truyen: Tet in Two Families (kể đầy đủ) — Before Tet, Nhan's family cleans the house and buys a kumquat tree and peach blossoms. Xiaomei's family puts red lanterns on the door. Nhan's grandma and Xiaomei make banh chung together. 'It's square!' says Xiaomei. Xiaomei's mum and Nhan make dumplings. On New Year's Eve, the two families eat dinner together and watch the fireworks. 'Happy New Year!' they say.
en.baihat: Happy New Year (giai điệu Frère Jacques, lời mới) — Happy New Year, / Happy New Year, / lucky money, / lucky money, / peach blossoms are pink, / kumquats are orange, / Happy Tet! / Happy Tet!

zh.flash: 春节 Chūn Jié, 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 桃花 táohuā, 金橘树 jīnjúshù, 拜年 bàinián, 粽子 zòngzi, 饺子 jiǎozi | Ôn: 红包 hóngbāo, 灯笼 dēnglong, 庆祝 qìngzhù
zh.slide: 1) Trò 'Chợ Tết' tiếng Trung (5 lượt): 买一棵金橘树。/ 买桃花。/ 买一个红灯笼。/ 买红包。/ 买饺子。 2) Thủ công: gấp bánh chưng giấy, nói: 越南的粽子是方的，很好吃！ 3) Đóng vai chúc Tết theo cặp: 新年快乐！——新年快乐！这是给你的红包。——谢谢！
zh.truyen: 两家人的春节 (kể đầy đủ) — 春节前，Nhan一家打扫房子，买了金橘树和桃花。Xiaomei家在门上挂了红灯笼。Nhan的奶奶和Xiaomei一起做越南粽子。Xiaomei说：“粽子是方的！”Xiaomei的妈妈和Nhan一起包饺子。除夕晚上，两家人一起吃年夜饭，看烟花。大家说：“新年快乐！”(Chūn Jié qián, Nhan yī jiā dǎsǎo fángzi, mǎi le jīnjúshù hé táohuā. Xiaomei jiā zài mén shang guà le hóng dēnglong. Nhan de nǎinai hé Xiaomei yīqǐ zuò Yuènán zòngzi. Xiaomei shuō: “Zòngzi shì fāng de!” Xiaomei de māma hé Nhan yīqǐ bāo jiǎozi. Chúxī wǎnshang, liǎng jiā rén yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, kàn yānhuā. Dàjiā shuō: “Xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.baihat: 新年歌 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎, lời mới) — 新年快乐，新年快乐，拜年了，拜年了，桃花开得真美，红包拿在手里，真快乐！真快乐！(Xīnnián kuàilè, xīnnián kuàilè, bàinián le, bàinián le, táohuā kāi de zhēn měi, hóngbāo ná zài shǒu li, zhēn kuàilè! Zhēn kuàilè!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 60. Lễ hội 2 · Tết (2): Lời chúc năm mới, hội xuân của lớp (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra)

web.label: Ngày 119. Lễ hội 2 · Tết: lời chúc năm mới

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): Happy New Year, wish, healthy, lucky, lucky money, grandparents
en.cum: I wish you… / a happy and healthy new year / good luck / study well
en.cau: Happy New Year, Grandma! I wish you a happy and healthy new year! / Good luck! / I wish you good health. / Thank you for the lucky money!
en.truyen: New Year Wishes — On the first day of Tet, Nhan visits his grandparents. 'Happy New Year, Grandma and Grandpa! I wish you a happy and healthy new year!' he says. Grandpa smiles and gives him some lucky money. 'Thank you! I will study well,' says Nhan. Then they all watch the lion dance on TV.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "Happy New Year wishes for kids"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 身体健康 shēntǐ jiànkāng, 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái, 万事如意 wànshì rúyì, 学习进步 xuéxí jìnbù, 红包 hóngbāo
zh.cum: 祝你新年快乐 zhù nǐ xīnnián kuàilè / 身体健康 shēntǐ jiànkāng / 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái / 学习进步 xuéxí jìnbù
zh.cau: 爷爷奶奶，新年快乐！祝你们身体健康！(Yéye nǎinai, xīnnián kuàilè! Zhù nǐmen shēntǐ jiànkāng!) / 恭喜发财！(Gōngxǐ fācái!) / 祝你学习进步！(Zhù nǐ xuéxí jìnbù!) / 谢谢你的红包！(Xièxie nǐ de hóngbāo!)
zh.truyen: 新年的祝福 — 春节第一天，Nhan去爷爷奶奶家拜年。他说：“爷爷奶奶，新年快乐！祝你们身体健康！”爷爷笑了，给了他一个红包，说：“祝你学习进步！”Nhan说：“谢谢爷爷！”然后，他们一起在电视上看舞狮。(Chūn Jié dì yī tiān, Nhan qù yéye nǎinai jiā bàinián. Tā shuō: “Yéye nǎinai, xīnnián kuàilè! Zhù nǐmen shēntǐ jiànkāng!” Yéye xiào le, gěi le tā yī gè hóngbāo, shuō: “Zhù nǐ xuéxí jìnbù!” Nhan shuō: “Xièxie yéye!” Ránhòu, tāmen yīqǐ zài diànshì shang kàn wǔshī.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "新年祝福语 儿童 拜年"

web.label: Ngày 120. Lễ hội 2 · Tết: hội xuân của lớp

en.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): lion dance, lantern, firework, lucky money, banh chung, Happy New Year, celebrate
en.cum: watch the lion dance / make a lantern / play Tet games / celebrate together
en.cau: Let's watch the lion dance! / How about making a red lantern? / We celebrated Tet at school. / The lion danced to the drums.
en.truyen: Our Spring Festival at School — Before Tet, our school had a spring festival. We made red lanterns and wrote New Year wishes. Then a big red lion danced in the playground. Anna was a little frightened, but Leo laughed. Our teacher gave everyone a red envelope with a sweet inside. 'Happy New Year, class!' she said.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "lion dance for kids Lunar New Year"

zh.tu: Ôn (nghe hiểu): 舞狮 wǔshī, 灯笼 dēnglong, 烟花 yānhuā, 红包 hóngbāo, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè
zh.cum: 看舞狮 kàn wǔshī / 做灯笼 zuò dēnglong / 一起庆祝 yīqǐ qìngzhù / 写祝福 xiě zhùfú
zh.cau: 我们去看舞狮吧！(Wǒmen qù kàn wǔshī ba!) / 我们做红灯笼，怎么样？(Wǒmen zuò hóng dēnglong, zěnmeyàng?) / 我们在学校庆祝了春节。(Wǒmen zài xuéxiào qìngzhù le Chūn Jié.) / 狮子跳得真好！(Shīzi tiào de zhēn hǎo!)
zh.truyen: 学校的新春会 — 春节前，我们学校开了新春会。我们做了红灯笼，写了新年祝福。然后，一只大红狮子在操场上跳舞。Anna有一点儿害怕，Leo笑了。老师给每个人一个红包，里面有糖。老师说：“同学们，新年快乐！”(Chūn Jié qián, wǒmen xuéxiào kāi le xīnchūn huì. Wǒmen zuò le hóng dēnglong, xiě le xīnnián zhùfú. Ránhòu, yī zhī dà hóng shīzi zài cāochǎng shang tiàowǔ. Anna yǒu yīdiǎnr hàipà, Leo xiào le. Lǎoshī gěi měi gè rén yī gè hóngbāo, lǐmian yǒu táng. Lǎoshī shuō: “Tóngxuémen, xīnnián kuàilè!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "舞狮 儿童 春节"

en.flash: Happy New Year, I wish you…, healthy, good luck, lucky money, lion dance, lantern | Ôn: firework, celebrate, banh chung, peach blossom
en.slide: 1) Trò 'Hái lộc đầu xuân': mỗi con hái 1 lộc trên cây (slide), đọc lời chúc và chúc bạn: I wish you a happy new year! / I wish you good health! / Good luck! / Study well! 2) Đóng vai đi chúc Tết ông bà (nhóm 3): Happy New Year, Grandpa! I wish you a healthy new year! – Thank you! Here's some lucky money. 3) Hội xuân: làm đèn lồng giấy đỏ và múa lân theo nhạc; cô hô Let's dance! / Let's jump!
en.truyen: The Little Lion — At the school spring festival, Leo wanted to be the lion in the lion dance. The lion's head was big and heavy, but Leo still danced. Anna played the drum: boom, boom, boom! Everyone clapped. After the dance, Leo said to his teacher, 'Happy New Year! I wish you a happy and healthy new year!' The teacher gave him a red envelope. 'Good luck, little lion!' she said.
en.baihat: Happy New Year (giai điệu Frère Jacques, lời mới), lời 2 — I wish you, / I wish you, / a happy year, / a happy year, / healthy and lucky, / healthy and lucky, / Happy Tet! / Happy Tet!

zh.flash: 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè, 身体健康 shēntǐ jiànkāng, 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái, 学习进步 xuéxí jìnbù, 舞狮 wǔshī, 灯笼 dēnglong | Ôn: 红包 hóngbāo, 庆祝 qìngzhù, 拜年 bàinián
zh.slide: 1) Trò 'Hái lộc đầu xuân' tiếng Trung: hái lộc, đọc lời chúc và chúc bạn: 新年快乐！/ 祝你身体健康！/ 恭喜发财！/ 祝你学习进步！ 2) Đóng vai đi chúc Tết ông bà (nhóm 3): 爷爷，新年快乐！祝您身体健康！——谢谢！这是给你的红包。——谢谢爷爷！ 3) Hội xuân: hát 新年歌, múa lân, cô hô 我们跳舞吧！/ 我们一起庆祝吧！
zh.truyen: 小狮子 — 学校的新春会上，Leo想当舞狮的狮子。狮子的头又大又重，但是Leo还是跳得很好。Anna打鼓：咚、咚、咚！大家都拍手。舞狮以后，Leo对老师说：“老师，新年快乐！祝您身体健康！”老师给他一个红包，说：“小狮子，恭喜发财，学习进步！”(Xuéxiào de xīnchūn huì shang, Leo xiǎng dāng wǔshī de shīzi. Shīzi de tóu yòu dà yòu zhòng, dànshì Leo háishi tiào de hěn hǎo. Anna dǎ gǔ: dōng, dōng, dōng! Dàjiā dōu pāishǒu. Wǔshī yǐhòu, Leo duì lǎoshī shuō: “Lǎoshī, xīnnián kuàilè! Zhù nín shēntǐ jiànkāng!” Lǎoshī gěi tā yī gè hóngbāo, shuō: “Xiǎo shīzi, gōngxǐ fācái, xuéxí jìnbù!”)
zh.baihat: 新年歌 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎, lời mới), lời 2 — 恭喜发财，恭喜发财，身体好，身体好，大家一起舞狮，红红灯笼挂起，真热闹！真热闹！(Gōngxǐ fācái, gōngxǐ fācái, shēntǐ hǎo, shēntǐ hǎo, dàjiā yīqǐ wǔshī, hónghóng dēnglong guàqǐ, zhēn rènao! Zhēn rènao!)
